title: SMARtCARE: Privacy-Preserving Agentic AI Systems for Bounded-Autonomy Clinical Decision Support
comment: Paper accepted to, and to appear in, the 2026 IEEE HealthCom Conference
summary: Long-context clinical AI systems can miss relevant patient history when prior admissions fall outside the active reasoning context. In ICU monitoring, this can cause early vital-sign drift to appear nonspecific even when it resembles a prior deterioration pattern. SMARtCARE addresses this gap through a four-state clinical decision-support architecture: Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated (Revoked). Rather than automatically retrieving prior records, SMARtCARE uses a lossy six-channel fingerprint of the patient's prior trajectory. When current drift matches that fingerprint and the prior record is absent from context, the system raises a Meta-cognitive escalation for clinician review; full retrieval occurs only through clinician action in the Assisted state. A patient-identity guard is designed to enforce correct attribution across data loading, logging, and audit layers. Evaluation combines a synthetic Monte Carlo study that validates the state-transition logic and estimator stability, not clinical performance, with real-data runs on both the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos. On MIMIC-III, one prior-pattern recurrence was identified among 14 two-admission patients; on MIMIC-IV, the same pipeline produced no fingerprint matches among 9 two-admission patients, which illustrates a key limitation of a fixed canonical pattern library. Across both runs all logged decisions were fully traceable and correctly attributed. The results support SMARtCARE as a traceable, privacy-aware mechanism for surfacing middle-context risk; they are not a clinical efficacy claim.

AI.tldr: SMARtCARE是一种针对长上下文临床AI系统遗忘历史患者记录的解决方案。它通过“稳定、元认知、辅助、管制”四状态架构，利用有损指纹匹配当前症状与历史模式，仅在医生确认后检索完整记录，从而在隐私保护和风险预警之间取得平衡，主要优势在于决策的可追溯性而非临床疗效。
AI.motivation: 解决长上下文临床AI系统在上下文中缺失早期住院病历时，可能忽略与既往恶化模式相似的生命体征漂移问题，避免误判为无关紧要的非特异性信号。
AI.method: 提出SMARtCARE四状态临床决策支持架构（稳定、元认知、辅助、管制）。使用患者历史轨迹的有损六通道指纹进行匹配。当当前漂移与指纹匹配但历史记录不在上下文中时，触发元认知升级供医生审查；仅在辅助状态下由医生行动触发全量记录检索。设计了患者身份守卫以确保数据加载、记录和审计层的正确归属。
AI.result: 通过合成蒙特卡洛研究验证了状态转换逻辑和估计器稳定性，并在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV真实数据集上运行。在MIMIC-III的14名两次入院患者中识别出1次既往模式复发；在MIMIC-IV的9名两次入院患者中无匹配，显示了固定规范模式库的局限性。所有日志决策均完全可追溯且归属正确。
AI.conclusion: SMARtCARE被证明是一种可追溯、注重隐私的中层风险浮现机制，旨在提高对长上下文背景下历史风险的敏感性，但这并非关于临床有效性的声明。

title: Witeness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
summary: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. Direction is inferred by asking which candidate behaves more like a branching parent. Motivated by this idea, and by the empirically observed asymmetry between parent-anchored and child-anchored witness-overlap distributions, we propose Witness Overlap, a prompt-free, training-free white-box test for directional provenance. On 176 LLM checkpoints from 16 families, our one-witness test orients 95.3\% of parent-child decisions using Frobenius cosine. We further evaluate root identification, sibling discrimination, generalizations to VLM and diffusion families, and chain-structured ordering. The signal is robust to weight noise and sparse pruning, with a proposed SVD weight reduction variant showing greater robustness than Frobenius cosine.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为“Witness Overlap”的无提示、免训练的白色盒测试方法，用于解决大语言模型检查点（checkpoints）的方向性溯源问题。通过引入同族第三检查点作为“见证人”，利用几何对比推断父子关系方向，在176个检查点上实现了95.3%的方向判断准确率，且对权重噪声和稀疏修剪具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型溯源方法多为对称性比较，只能检测两个模型之间是否存在关联，无法确定哪个检查点是父节点、哪个是子节点（即无法确定先后顺序）。随着开源模型的频繁微调、对齐和合并，亟需能够定向追踪模型演化路径的技术。
AI.method: 提出“见证人重叠”（Witness Overlap）方法：不直接比较两个候选检查点，而是引入第三个同族检查点作为见证人。通过比较以每个候选点为中心的局部几何结构，观察哪个候选点在行为上更接近分叉后的父节点。该方法基于父锚定和子锚定的见证人重叠分布的实证不对称性，无需提示词且无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在包含16个家族的176个LLM检查点数据集上，使用Frobenius余弦相似度进行的单见证人测试成功确定了95.3%的父子决策方向。该方法进一步验证了根节点识别、兄弟节点区分、向视觉语言模型（VLM）和扩散模型家族的推广能力，以及链式结构的排序能力。实验表明该信号对权重噪声和稀疏修剪具有鲁棒性，提出的SVD降权变体比Frobenius余弦更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Witness Overlap提供了一种有效、鲁棒的机制来解决模型检查点的方向性溯源问题，填补了现有对称性对比方法无法确定演化顺序的空白，并展现出广泛的适用性和抗干扰能力。

title: CP-Agent: A Harness-Engineered Agent for Crystal Plasticity Simulation Workflows
summary: Crystal plasticity (CP) simulations predict the mechanical behavior of polycrystalline metals, yet their routine use is hindered by the manual effort of configuring heterogeneous tools, orchestrating multi-step data pipelines, and calibrating constitutive parameters against experiments. These bottlenecks impede productivity in systematic parameter studies, motivating interest in automated workflows. This study presents CP-Agent, a harness-engineered LLM-based agent that autonomously executes complete CP modeling workflows from natural-language tasks. Operating under the ReAct paradigm, the agent reasons about tool selection and sequencing while delegating numerical search to established optimizers. The harness comprises a minimal system prompt, typed tool definitions, a dispatcher, and a safety-bounded iteration loop, encoding domain knowledge through tool schemas rather than hard-coded logic. CP-Agent is demonstrated on four case studies: calibrating four slip parameters of additively manufactured stainless steel 316L against tensile data; validating the workflow against published copper benchmarks, reproducing stress-strain and texture evolution; recovering the initial crystallographic texture of copper, where the agent correctly identifies a diffuse initial texture; and reproducing the multi-pass rolling texture evolution of a Mg-Zn-Ca alloy, where the agent chains five deformation passes and recovers the experimentally observed weakened, split basal texture. In all cases, the agent inferred the correct execution sequence from the task statement, robustly across repeated runs, and delivered physically interpretable results. This work establishes harness engineering as a systematic approach to automating CP modeling workflows while maintaining physical interpretability and auditability through visible reasoning traces.

AI.tldr: 提出CP-Agent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化晶体塑性（CP）模拟智能体，通过Harness Engineering技术实现从自然语言指令到完整CP建模工作流的自主执行，解决了传统方法中参数配置、数据管道和校准耗时且繁琐的问题。
AI.motivation: 晶体塑性模拟虽能预测多晶金属力学行为，但因其需手动配置异构工具、编排多步数据流程及校准本构参数，导致生产力受限；这些瓶颈阻碍了系统性参数研究的效率，亟需自动化工作流以提升生产力。
AI.method: 开发CP-Agent，采用ReAct范式和Harness Engineering方法：构建包含最小系统提示、类型化工具定义、调度器和安全界限迭代循环的框架；利用工具模式编码领域知识而非硬编码逻辑，由LLM负责推理工具选择与序列，并将数值搜索委托给既定优化器。
AI.result: 在四个案例研究中验证：1) 校准增材制造不锈钢316L的四个滑移参数；2) 在铜基准上复现应力-应变和织构演化；3) 识别铜的扩散初始织构；4) 复现Mg-Zn-Ca合金五道次轧制的弱化分裂基面织构。所有案例中，代理均能正确推断执行序列，结果物理可解释且在多次运行中稳健。
AI.conclusion: 证实了Harness Engineering作为系统化方法，在保持物理可解释性和可审计性（通过可见推理轨迹）的同时，能有效自动化晶体塑性建模工作流。

title: ConflictVLA-Bench: Benchmarking Behavioral Responses of Vision-Language-Action Models to Premise Conflicts
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform strongly on manipulation tasks, their responses to invalid task premises remain underexplored. Existing evaluations of premise conflicts often focus on terminal task outcomes, yet task failure alone cannot distinguish behavioral disengagement from continued pursuit followed by an execution error. We call the latter pattern Failed Persistence. To study this phenomenon, we introduce ConflictVLA-Bench, which pairs conflict rollouts with premise-consistent reference rollouts and evaluates both outcomes and execution processes. Built on LIBERO, the benchmark contains 2,826 prompt-conditioned conflict tasks spanning four conflict families, four structural configurations, and two prompt conditions. Across all eight VLAs, invalid premises reduce original goal completion by at least 17.3 percentage points, with the reduction reaching 56.2 percentage points for OpenVLA. Crucially, even when models succeed on premise-consistent tasks and fail on their matched conflict tasks, they often continue to approach the original targets, retain early trajectory structure, and show limited action magnitude suppression. Failed Persistence therefore recurs across the evaluated models. Explicit premise checking does not consistently produce selective and coordinated behavioral changes. These findings show that terminal failure alone establishes neither behavioral disengagement nor refusal and that outcomes alone are insufficient for VLA evaluation. Experimental data and additional details are available on the project page: https://github.com/EmbodiedAISurvey/ConflictVLA-Bench

AI.tldr: 提出了ConflictVLA-Bench基准，揭示了Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型在遇到无效任务前提时存在的“失败坚持”（Failed Persistence）现象，即模型倾向于继续执行原目标而非退出或调整行为，表明仅依赖终端结果评估VLA存在局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA研究忽视了模型对无效任务前提的反应，且传统评估仅关注终端结果，无法区分真正的行为不参与（如拒绝）和执行错误导致的失败。
AI.method: 基于LIBEO构建了包含2,826个提示冲突任务的ConflictVLA-Bench基准，涵盖四种冲突家族和两种提示条件；通过对比冲突 rollout 与一致参考 rollout 的结果及执行过程，对八个VLA模型进行评估。
AI.result: 1. 无效前提使所有测试的VLA模型的目标完成率至少下降17.3%（OpenVLA下降56.2%）。2. 模型普遍表现出“失败坚持”，即在失败情况下仍接近原目标、保留早期轨迹结构且行动幅度抑制有限。3. 显式的前提检查未能产生选择性且协调的行为变化。
AI.conclusion: 单纯的终端失败既不能证明行为不参与也不能证明拒绝能力；仅依靠结果不足以全面评估VLA模型，需深入分析其执行过程和鲁棒性。

title: Working with AI: A Design Framework for Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly GenAI, is becoming an increasingly important part of modern work. In industrial settings, AI can support decision-making, automate routine activities, assist humans, and improve productivity. However, successful AI adoption depends on more than what the technology can do. It also depends on how people experience and work with it. This raises an important question: how should human-AI collaboration be designed so that it works well for both people and organisations? This white paper addresses that question by presenting a practical framework for designing human-AI collaboration. The framework considers the human, the AI system, the task, the organisation, and the wider societal environment. It explains what effective collaboration looks like, what conditions influence it, what requirements should be met, and what design decisions organisations should consider. The report also includes a human-AI collaborative assembly system with cobot use case to demonstrate how the framework can be applied in practice. The use case shows how design requirements can be translated into specific collaboration features and evaluated through a case study. The aim of this white paper is to provide a clear and practical guide for designing human-AI collaboration that is effective, human-centred, and responsible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以人为本、负责任的人机协作设计框架，涵盖人、AI系统、任务、组织和社会环境五个维度，并通过协作机器人案例展示其实际应用与评估方法。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在工业环境中日益重要，单纯的技术能力不足以保证成功采纳；关键挑战在于如何通过合理设计人机协作，使其既提升组织效率又优化人类工作体验。
AI.method: 构建并阐述一个包含五大要素（人、AI系统、任务、组织、社会环境）的设计框架，定义有效协作的特征、影响因素及设计要求；通过引入具有协作机器人用例的人类-AI协作装配系统，将设计要求转化为具体协作功能并进行案例研究验证。
AI.result: 框架成功展示了如何将抽象的设计要求转化为具体的协作特性，并通过实际案例证明了该框架在指导实践中的可行性和有效性，实现了从理论到应用的闭环。
AI.conclusion: 该白皮书为组织提供了一个清晰、实用的指南，旨在设计出高效、以人为中心和负责任的人机协作系统，强调成功采纳不仅取决于技术性能，更取决于对人机交互体验和社会语境的综合考量。

title: DriveHierarchy: A Benchmark for Diagnosing VLM Driving Capabilities from Open-Loop Understanding to Closed-Loop Execution
summary: Evaluating VLM-based autonomous driving remains difficult because driving competence is composite, where a capable system must ground traffic participants and hazards, integrate context across views and time, reason about future evolution, and act appropriately under closed-loop interaction. Existing benchmarks usually assess either open-loop understanding or closed-loop driving but provide limited structure for explaining how these abilities are organized, how they relate, and how they may inform model diagnosis and improvement. We present \textsc{DriveHierarchy}, a hierarchical benchmark that organizes VLM-based autonomous driving into four ranks, spanning perceptual grounding, contextual memory, mental reasoning, and closed-loop execution. To instantiate this hierarchy, we integrate multiple open-source autonomous-driving datasets into a unified open-loop benchmark with 76,798 question-answer pairs over 84,279 frames and develop a closed-loop simulation platform with interactive scenario construction on a real-world road network, from which 100 driving scenarios are curated for embodied evaluation. Experiments on 15 VLMs show that \textsc{DriveHierarchy} captures structured but non-redundant capability variation, relates open-loop understanding to closed-loop driving, and provides a practical basis for diagnosis and benchmark-guided optimization. \textsc{DriveHierarchy} therefore serves as a unified framework for evaluating and improving VLM-based autonomous driving systems. An anonymized project has been released on https://github.com/PerfectXu88/DriveHierarchy

AI.tldr: 提出DriveHierarchy分层基准，整合开环理解与闭环驾驶评估，通过15个VLM实验验证其诊断与优化价值。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多局限于开环理解或闭环驾驶单一维度，缺乏对能力结构、关联性及模型诊断改进的系统性指导。
AI.method: 构建包含四个层级（感知定位、上下文记忆、心智推理、闭环执行）的分层基准；整合开源数据集形成含76,798问答对的开环基准；开发基于真实路网的闭环仿真平台并生成100个驾驶场景进行评估。
AI.result: 在15个视觉语言模型上的实验表明，该基准能捕捉结构化且非冗余的能力差异，建立了开环理解与闭环驾驶的关联，并为模型诊断提供了实用基础。
AI.conclusion: DriveHierarchy为视觉语言模型驱动的汽车系统提供了一个统一的评价与改进框架。

title: LLM Judge Validation Under Sparse Overlap: From Inference to Design
summary: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge requires estimating its agreement with humans, yet annotation budgets rarely allow every item to be multiply labeled. We prove that this \emph{overlap sparsity} is the first-order determinant of wrong deployment decisions: at 5\% pairwise overlap, wrong-decision rates reach 25\% and the probability of selecting the wrong best judge among ten candidates is 65\%. The two actionable levers are overlap \emph{quantity} and \emph{allocation}. For quantity, we derive a minimum-overlap formula showing $ρ\geq 0.25$ suffices for non-borderline judges while borderline cases remain fundamentally hard. For allocation, a zero-cost stratified scheme halves false-rejection rates relative to random sampling when strata are informative. We validate on 10 LLM judges across four evaluation matrices spanning visual assessment, causal reasoning, and summarization.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了LLM-as-a-judge验证中的“重叠稀疏性”是关键问题。当两两重叠仅为5%时，错误部署率高达25%，选错最佳模型的概率为65%。通过推导最小重叠公式（ρ≥0.25）和提出分层抽样策略，可有效降低误判率。实验在10个LLM模型和四种评估矩阵上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型作为评委（LLM-as-a-judge）的验证中，通常需要估计其与人类的一致性。然而，由于标注预算有限，很难对每个项目进行多次标记（即数据稀疏），导致难以准确评估模型性能并做出正确的部署决策。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：证明重叠稀疏性是导致错误部署的首要因素。2. 数量优化：推导最小重叠量公式，确定非边界案例所需的最小重叠阈值。3. 分配优化：提出一种零成本的分层抽样方案，根据信息含量优化样本分配。4. 实验验证：在视觉评估、因果推理和摘要四个维度的评估矩阵上，对10个LLM评委进行测试。
AI.result: 1. 重叠稀疏性严重影响决策准确性：5%重叠时，错误决策率达25%，从10个候选者中选错最佳评委的概率达65%。2. 定量结果：对于非边界评委，重叠率ρ≥0.25即可满足要求；但边界案例本质难解。3. 定性结果：相比随机采样，利用信息量进行分层的抽样方案能将错误拒绝率降低一半。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM-as-a-judge的验证中，确保足够的样本重叠量（如ρ≥0.25）并采用智能的分层抽样策略，是提升评估可靠性、避免错误部署的关键手段。这为解决预算受限下的大模型自动化评估提供了重要的理论和实践指导。

title: Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals
summary: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner. In this work, we demonstrate that unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction is fundamentally flawed. A rigorous evaluation reveals that a leading state-of-the-art macro planner routinely emits physically unrealisable sub-goals. To resolve this, we introduce Metro-WM, a hierarchical framework that issues sub-goals by retrieving genuine states from prior experience rather than generating ungrounded latent vectors. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the next best hierarchical approach while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. Additional analysis reveals that Metro-WM finds shorter paths than the offline demonstrations, outperforms an oracle relying on the query's own demonstration, and maintains robust performance under extremely sparse dataset conditions.

AI.tldr: Metro-WM通过检索真实状态而非生成潜在向量解决JEPAS宏规划器物理不可行问题，显著提升长视界任务成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 解决基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）的模型预测控制在短视界有效但长视界受限的问题；揭示现有层级扩展中宏观规划器生成的潜在子目标往往在物理上不可行且无实际 grounding。
AI.method: 提出Metro-WM层级框架：1) 避免生成未扎根的潜在向量，改为从过往经验中检索真实状态作为子目标；2) 构建以离线专家演示或随机轨迹帧为顶点的图结构，连接不同episode的帧形成到目标的路径；3) 利用全图规划机制应对执行偏差，动态寻找最优路径。
AI.result: 1) 长期任务成功率比次优层级方法高出多达37.33个百分点；2) 速度提升高达10.9倍；3) 离线计算量减少13-56倍，超参数调整更少；4) 发现比离线演示更短的路径；5) 优于依赖自身演示数据的oracle基线；6) 在极稀疏数据集下保持鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于检索真实状态的层级规划框架（Metro-WM）能有效克服传统JEPAs长视界规划的缺陷，在准确性、效率、鲁棒性和数据利用率上均显著优于现有方法，为复杂长视界决策提供了更可靠解决方案。

title: IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement
comment: Technical Report, 56 pages, 6 figures. Model weights and configs available at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM
summary: Industrial procurement requires language models to bridge informal buyer jargon, sparse marketplace attributes, and authoritative engineering standards under strict safety tolerances. We present IndustryLLM, an open-weight industrial language model trained from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base (35B total parameters with ~3B activated per token, with the vision encoder frozen). Rather than relying on generic text scaling, we introduce a failure-driven adaptation recipe spanning continued pre-training (CPT) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). CPT leverages a curated ~100B-token corpus integrating 5B tokens of national standards (e.g., GB/T) and technical archives, 10B tokens of de-identified real-world industrial transaction and inquiry records, and 60B tokens of general replay. To overcome register mismatch and factual brittleness, we systematically reconstruct an estimated 20B-token domain subset via multi-register rewriting across 10 genres and 8 writing styles, confidence-routed minimal factual editing, and error-targeted QA synthesis (resolving colloquial typos like '42-luo-mu' -> 42CrMo, expanding ambiguous codes like '16674' -> GB/T 16674, and clarifying conflicting dimensional specs). For downstream deployment, we formalize an evidence-gated constraint-evaluation interface enforcing three-valued logic where unverified product evidence remains unknown rather than satisfied. Offline evaluations demonstrate consistent gains on procurement-query structuring (+2.97 percentage points in exact match, 95% CI [2.11, 3.86] in No-Think mode), while randomized online A/B experiments in production yield substantial improvements (+4.25% GMV, +8.3% satisfied inquiries) alongside a latency reduction from 6-7 s to 1.5 s. Model weights and configs are released at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出IndustryLLM，基于Qwen3.5-35B的开源工业语言模型。通过包含国家标准和行业数据的混合语料进行持续预训练（CPT）及失败驱动的微调（SFT），解决了非正式行话与权威标准间的鸿沟。线下评估在采购查询结构化任务上提升2.97%，线上A/B测试显示GMV增长4.25%且延迟从6-7秒降至1.5秒。
AI.motivation: 工业采购场景需要语言模型在处理严格安全容差时，能够弥合买方非正式行话、稀疏的市场属性以及权威的工程标准之间的差距，并克服通用文本扩展带来的注册不匹配和事实脆弱性问题。
AI.method:
1. 基础架构：基于Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base（350亿参数，每token约3B激活，冻结视觉编码器）。
2. 持续预训练（CPT）：使用约1000亿Token的语料，包括50亿国家技术标准、100亿脱敏工业交易记录及600亿通用重放数据。
3. 领域适应：对约200亿Token的子集进行多注册重写、最小化事实编辑和错误靶向QA合成，以解决口语化拼写错误和代码歧义。
4. 监督微调（SFT）：采用失败驱动的适配策略。
5. 部署接口：实施证据门控约束评估界面，应用三值逻辑处理未验证证据。
AI.result:
1. 离线评估：在无思维（No-Think）模式下，采购查询结构化任务的精确匹配率提升2.97个百分点（95% CI [2.11, 3.86]）。
2. 线上实验：在生产环境的随机A/B测试中，总交易额（GMV）增加4.25%，满意咨询量增加8.3%，推理延迟从6-7秒降低至1.5秒。
AI.conclusion: IndustryLLM通过专门的工业语料库构建和失败驱动的适应机制，有效提升了工业采购场景下的准确性、商业价值和系统效率，证明了在垂直领域结合严格约束与大量行业数据进行模型定制的有效性。

title: COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents
summary: Existing agent memory frameworks mainly create memory through an agent's interaction with the factual world, e.g., remembering feedback from actions taken to improve performance on future tasks. However, these frameworks seldom ask the "what if" question during memory construction: what if a different action had been taken, would the feedback have changed, and how could this feedback become useful memory? Obtaining such feedback directly in an active environment can be expensive and can alter the state needed for comparison. In this work, we introduce COUNTERMEM, a reinforcement-learning framework for constructing and using verified counterfactual memory across tasks. After a failed action, COUNTERMEM evaluates local alternatives from a copy or reset of the original state using executable world models, such as tests, proof checkers, and solvers. It stores improvements with the original and corrected actions, checked outcomes, and conditions for reuse. A learned memory-use policy selects a retrieved record or skips memory to balance task success and interaction cost, while the base LLM remains fixed. Both memory and policy are frozen during held-out evaluation. We evaluate COUNTERMEM on 12 benchmark settings across six domains. With gpt-oss-120b, COUNTERMEM improves both ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a gain of 12.6 percentage points over their unaugmented versions. In the four-domain comparison across two backbones, task-run tokens decrease by 7.7-42.0%, excluding offline selector-training costs. Further analyses show that removing verification or persistent storage weakens the gains, while applying verified corrections to unsuitable decisions can reverse them. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出COUNTERMEM框架，通过可执行世界模型在失败后生成并验证反事实记忆，以低成本提升智能体在多种基准上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有代理记忆框架主要依赖实际交互获取反馈，难以有效构建“如果采取不同行动会怎样”的反事实记忆，且直接在活跃环境中获取此类数据成本高昂且可能改变状态。
AI.method: 引入COUNTERMEM，一种强化学习框架。在动作失败后，利用可执行世界模型（如测试、证明检查器、求解器）评估原始状态的副本或重置状态下的局部替代方案。存储改进后的记录及复用条件，并通过学习到的记忆使用策略平衡任务成功与交互成本。
AI.result: 在6个领域的12个基准测试中，基于gpt-oss-120b的COUNTERMEM使ReAct和Reflexion的性能平均提升了12.6个百分点；在双骨干网的四领域比较中，任务运行token减少了7.7-42.0%。
AI.conclusion: 验证性记忆存储显著提升了智能体性能，移除验证机制或在不适用决策上应用校正会削弱甚至逆转收益。代码将在接收后发布。

title: Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning
summary: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出NashEval框架，通过构建去偏的支付矩阵和利用正交损失函数，解决基于离线反馈进行上下文相关代理人评估中因数据稀疏导致的偏差问题，从而在异构人类偏好下鲁棒地识别各语境下的最优代理集合。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的模型（如Bradley-Terry）假设偏好具有传递性，无法反映人类判断异质性导致的集体偏好非传递性问题；且直接估算上下文特定的纳什均衡易因离线日志中每语境仅覆盖部分代理人而产生偏差。
AI.method: 受社会选择理论启发，将评估建模为双人博弈：每个玩家选择代理人分布策略以获取更高集体偏好，纳什均衡支撑集定义语境特定赢家。提出NashEval框架：1. 构建去偏的语境支付矩阵估计值；2. 使用定制的正交损失函数学习从语境到均衡的映射，避免逐语境求解游戏。
AI.result: 理论上证明支付矩阵底层噪声函数误差对均衡风险（可被利用性）的影响仅为高阶项；实验中NashEval提高了均衡学习的鲁棒性，并一致跨语境识别出表现最佳的代理集合。
AI.conclusion: NashEval提供了一种通用的、鲁棒的上下文均衡学习方法，有效解决了异构偏好下的离线评估难题，能够准确捕捉语境相关的代理人优劣关系。

title: Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization
summary: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出Choir协议，实现AI定理形式化的分布式协作。通过将任务分解给独立贡献者各自运行LLM，并通过GitHub协调及确定性门控检查质量，支持Lean 4等主流形式化系统。
AI.motivation: 解决现有AI代理进行数学定理形式化工作时通常由单一团队集中运营、承担全部计算成本的问题，旨在通过分布式架构降低参与门槛并促进开放参与。
AI.method: 设计名为Choir的开放协议，将形式化项目分解为可由独立贡献者使用自有LLM订阅完成的任务；贡献者完全通过GitHub仓库进行协调；引入确定性门控机制对所有合并前贡献进行质量检查；协议开源模块化，兼容Lean 4、Isabelle和Rocq。
AI.result: 实现了去中心化的AI辅助形式化验证流程，允许外部人员利用自有资源参与大型教科书或主要定理的形式化工作，同时确保代码合并前的确定性与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: Choir证明了分布式协作在AI数学形式化领域的可行性，为降低大规模形式化验证的计算成本和人力门槛提供了可扩展的基础设施框架。

title: EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks
summary: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了EmailBench，一个包含206个邮件和生产力场景的基准测试，旨在评估企业级AI代理在多步骤邮件工作流中的表现。研究发现，尽管工具调用成功率高达99.7%，但最佳模型的通过率仅为33.5%，揭示了有效工具执行不等于任务完成的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的代理基准测试多关注通用生产力任务，缺乏针对特定类型邮件工作流在自包含环境中的全面评估。企业级邮件代理需要结合信息检索、结构化状态变更、时间推理和多步协调，因此需要一个专门的基准来检验其端到端能力。
AI.method: 构建了EmailBench基准，包括16类任务类别下的206个场景。该基准结合了类型化的邮件API规范、与提供商无关的命名方式、基于Enron启发的确定性合成语料库，以及由交互式原型遥测数据指导的情景套件。采用混合评估协议，包含258个可执行的静态断言和211个LLM评分标准，并对八种LM配置进行了单用户语料库上的评估。
AI.result: 最佳模型在所有场景中仅通过33.5%。值得注意的是，该模型的工具调用中99.7%没有观察到API故障，说明工具层面的成功并不保证任务层面的成功。不同任务类别间的通过率存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: EmailBench提供了一个自包含的环境用于端到端邮件代理评估，指出了当前大模型在复杂邮件工作流处理上的不足。未来工作方向包括更广泛的工具覆盖、多角色扮演测试以及重复运行评估。

title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.

AI.tldr: 提出MedCode框架，通过让大语言模型生成可执行代码来解决医疗计算任务中的数值准确性问题，显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs在医学考试和问答基准上表现良好，但在需要精确数值输出的医疗计算任务中不可靠，而这些计算涉及给药剂量、器官功能评估等高 stakes 临床决策，微小错误可能导致严重后果。
AI.method: 1. 构建MedCode框架：模型识别计算器、提取输入变量并生成脚本，由确定性解释器执行以返回带单位的结果；2. 从MedCalc基准和ICU场景构建监督微调（SFT）和偏好数据集；3. 提出加权直接偏好优化（wDPO），自适应强调难以区分的偏好对。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B上的实验显示，绝对准确率提升了20--30个百分点，证明了嵌入式代码生成在医疗计算中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合代码生成与确定性的算术运算执行，LLMs能够更可靠地完成高风险的医疗计算任务。

title: BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出BioDyad，通过蒙特卡洛图搜索中的双层结构协调生物医学发现与ML工程，在76项任务的基准测试中取得最高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有系统虽连接了生物医学证据获取和可执行程序搜索的能力，但在整个程序搜索过程中协调二者仍具挑战；新证据需引导候选构建，执行结果需指导后续发现与复用，且验证需求需适应搜索预算。
AI.method: 引入BioDyad，利用蒙特卡洛图搜索中的两个层级耦合生物医学发现与ML工程：科学层级结合先验生物医学指导与迭代发现，并将计划链接至内存以跨候选复用；工程层级管理候选程序从冒烟执行、训练/验证评估到全数据重训练的流程。
AI.result: 在BioXArena基准的76个任务上（每个任务两小时预算，三种匹配的LLM后端），BioDyad在所有四种代理方法和一个单样本基线中实现了最高的惩罚后总分和任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 协调生物医学发现与ML工程可将外部知识整合到异构生物医学任务的可执行程序中，有效提升了自主系统的性能。

title: Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination
comment: A preliminary version of this work was published as an extended abstract in the Proceedings of AAMAS 2026
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains.
  We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入符号指导分类法（SGT），研究发现对大语言模型代理赋予中等程度的自主性（部分伪代码指导）比完全自由推理或完全受控执行更能提升多智能体分布式协调的性能，提出“自主性调节”是关键设计原则。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多智能体系统中作为自主代理运行时，其在执行分布式协调协议方面的能力尚不明确。尽管现有基准框架如AgentsNet支持这种协调，但赋予代理完整的推理自主权往往导致在复杂领域中表现不一致或性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了“符号指导分类法”（Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy, SGT），该分类法描述了一个从开放式自然语言推理到完全规定的算法执行的自主性谱系，其中包括提供部分伪代码指导的中间层级。研究旨在通过在SGT不同层级上测试代理来验证通过基于算法的符号引导来调节自主性是否能改善协调效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，处于中间自主性水平（即接受部分伪代码指导）的代理一致地优于无引导的代理和完全规定规格的代理。
AI.conclusion: 自主性调节是大语言模型基于分布式协调的关键设计原则。通过结合结构化算法指导与适度的推理自主性，可以显著提升多智能体系统的协作可靠性。

title: Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study
summary: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文展示了使用现成的大语言模型代码代理（Codex和Claude Code）自主优化固定半径最近邻搜索算法的性能，证明了这些代理可以在无需预设代码转换策略的情况下，仅通过执行目标约束，独立移除依赖、进行实验并实现显著的速度提升。
AI.motivation: 目前关于通用代码代理能否执行严谨的科学性能工程优化尚缺乏充分证据，需要验证其在实际大规模仓库场景下的自主优化能力。
AI.method: 构建一个基于PyTorch的CUDA实现案例，设定包含精确正确性测试、性能剖析要求和验收标准的可执行目标，引导Codex和Claude Code代理自主移除PyTorch依赖、设计假设驱动的实验并进行代码优化，最终生成独立的C++/CUDA库。
AI.result: 代理生成的独立库在保持结果精确复现的前提下，其同步NumPy接口相比原始GPU驻留PyTorch接口实现了1.6倍加速；该加速效果在不同GPU架构和软件栈中均得到验证；另一次独立优化的重运行采用了不同的假设序列，达到了更优的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 具备目标持久性的编码代理可以作为实验性性能工程师发挥作用，但必须依靠可执行的科学契约（contracts）来有效引导和优化过程，并对最终结果进行严格验证。

title: CSI-Agent: LLM-Assisted Few-Shot Adaptation for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi CSI Sensing
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to INFOCOM
summary: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) has enabled device-free sensing applications such as human activity recognition. However, CSI sensing models remain brittle in cross-domain deployment, where changes in users or environments can produce incorrect predictions. Existing solutions usually treat this problem as an offline model-design problem, by pretraining a stronger representation or applying one fixed adaptation method to the entire target domain. In practice, labeled target data are scarce and different classes may fail in different ways under the same domain shift. To address this, we propose CSI-Agent, an evidence-seeking LLM agent that reformulates cross-domain CSI adaptation as a deployment-time decision-making problem. Rather than processing raw CSI or making sample-level predictions, CSI-Agent summarizes target-domain behavior into sensing-grounded class-level evidence. It establishes a strong target-adaptive default from complementary CSI views and uses an LLM planner to determine whether each class should retain the default or invoke a specialized action. Deterministic verification and bounded execution further reduce unreliable interventions. We evaluate CSI-Agent on four public datasets using five cross-domain splits covering device, user, environment, and compositional shifts. Under 1-shot adaptation, CSI-Agent achieves the best target-domain performance across all splits and improves the average Macro-F1 by about 16\% compared to the strongest baseline method.

AI.tldr: 提出CSI-Agent，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体，用于解决Wi-Fi信道状态信息（CSI）在跨域部署中因用户或环境变化导致模型失效的问题。通过将适应过程转化为部署时的决策问题，利用LLM规划器针对每个类别动态选择保留默认策略或调用专门行动，实现了在标签稀缺情况下的高效自适应。在四个公开数据集的五种跨域场景下，仅需单样本适应即可达到最优性能，平均Macro-F1提升约16%。
AI.motivation: 现有的CSI感知模型在跨域部署中表现脆弱，传统方法通常采用离线模型设计（如预训练更强表征或使用固定的自适应方法），但在实践中面临目标域标注数据稀缺、且不同类别在同一域偏移下失败方式各异的问题，导致难以一概而论地应用统一适配策略。
AI.method: 提出CSI-Agent，将跨域CSI适应重构为部署时的决策问题。该方法不直接处理原始CSI或进行样本级预测，而是总结目标域行为以形成与传感相关的“类别级证据”。通过建立基于互补CSI视图的强大目标自适应默认值，并利用LLM规划器决定每个类别是保留默认值还是调用专门动作。同时引入确定性验证和有限执行机制以降低不可靠干预的风险。
AI.result: 在四个公共数据集的五个跨域划分（涵盖设备、用户、环境和组合偏移）上进行了评估。在1-shot（单样本）适应条件下，CSI-Agent在所有分割任务中均取得了最佳的目标域性能，相比最强的基线方法，平均Macro-F1提升了约16%。
AI.conclusion: CSI-Agent成功证明了将跨域自适应视为部署时动态决策问题的有效性。通过结合LLM智能体的规划能力与传感领域的特定约束，该方法能够在数据稀缺的跨域场景中显著提升模型鲁棒性和分类精度，为设备无关感知的实际应用提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Plan to submit to SenSys Phase 2
summary: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition. Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route. This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出SenseAgent，一种由大语言模型（LLM）引导的运行时规划代理，用于解决跨领域惯性测量单元（IMU）活动识别中的域偏移问题。该代理通过整合源域经验、在线目标记忆和验证器，构建无标签诊断报告，动态选择重力感知、原型迁移等传感工具，实现闭环自适应 sensing，无需重新训练骨干网络即可应对用户、设备或姿态变化带来的性能下降。
AI.motivation: 现有的IMU模型在新用户、新设备或新身体位置上表现不可靠。传统方法通常将跨领域问题视为静态模型设计任务（如预训练、数据增强或在部署前选择单一适配方法），但在实际场景中，目标域是逐渐观察到的，标签稀缺，且不同的域偏移需要不同的传感操作。因此，需要将固定推理流程转化为能动态诊断和适应域变化的过程。
AI.method: SenseAgent利用LLM作为运行时规划器，管理传感工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆和验证器。其工作流程包括：1. 从目标流构建无标签诊断报告；2. LLM根据报告决定保持原始推理或调用专门工具（如重力感知传感、原型迁移、风格标准化）；3. 验证器检查源域校准、目标记忆可靠性和无害标准，以拒绝高风险的工具决策；4. 支持在缺乏重训练的情况下通过有限反馈进行自适应。
AI.result: 在多个IMU数据集和部署偏移上评估SenseAgent。结果表明，经过验证的路径选择提高了跨领域感知的准确性，特别是在更难的放置位置和复合偏移下表现更佳。此外，该方法还能从有限的用户反馈中受益，进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: SenseAgent成功将跨领域IMU感知从固定的推理管道转变为闭环传感过程。它能够通过诊断目标域偏移、选择合适的传感动作并拒绝不安全的适应来有效解决域偏移问题，证明了LLM在动态感知任务中作为运行时规划器的有效性。

title: What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.

AI.tldr: LoRA的秩r并非简单的容量控制工具。在硬每因子范数预算下，所有秩r≥1的模型类等价，复杂度与秩无关。秩的实际作用在于决定可达更新范围及光谱抵消代价，而非限制模型容量。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为LoRA中的秩$r$用于控制模型容量，较小的秩被认为能带来更简单的模型和更好的泛化性能。本研究旨在验证这一直觉在理论层面的有效性，特别是针对实践中常用的权重衰减和范数控制技术。
AI.method: 构建线性读出模型类，分析在硬每因子范数预算（核范数球内秩至多$r$的矩阵集合）下的复杂度度量；通过比较不同秩$r \ge 1$时的Rademacher复杂度、源分布位移界限，以及探讨联合预算对复杂度的影响；最后从光谱角度分析秩在抵消预训练权重主导奇异方向中的作用，并推导实现特定源-目标对齐所需的最小秩界限。
AI.result:
1. 在硬每因子范数预算下，LoRA可达更新集由核范数球内的低秩矩阵构成，复杂度函数在此集合上由秩一更新最大化，导致秩约束从不生效。
2. 对于任意$r \ge 1$，线性读出模型类完全相同，其Rademacher复杂度不依赖于$r$，且适应过程移动源分布的距离具有与秩无关的尖锐上界。
3. 若采用产品上的联合预算而非每因子预算，可获得数据依赖且对秩敏感的复杂度界限，但仅适用于特征分布广泛的情况，最坏情况仍与秩无关。
4. 光谱分析显示，秩决定了适应的成本：要抵消预训练权重的主导奇异方向，需要足够的秩和预算；研究给出了实现期望源-目标对齐所需最小秩的上/下界，在两侧重谱衰减假设下匹配。
AI.conclusion: 秩$r$在LoRA中并不控制模型容量，而是决定哪些更新是可达的以及光谱抵消的代价。传统将秩视为容量控制的直觉在核范数预算框架下失效，应重新理解其作用机制为可达性与经济性的约束。

title: Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.

AI.tldr: 提出DMM（去中心化大师模式），通过多轮通信迭代细化动作意图来解决多智能体路径规划中的联合行动协调问题，在1600个MovingAI任务中取得最高覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 解决在多智能体路径规划中，独立采样导致局部有效但全局不兼容的联合动作的问题，即使单智能体策略学习正确，最终采样机制仍可能失败。
AI.method: 采用受扩散模型去噪启发的离散迭代细化机制；初始随机动作意图，通过本地通信在多个回合中耦合并 refining 选择；结合模仿学习与无批评器组相对强化学习方法MICPO进行训练优化。
AI.result: 在1,600个MovingAI任务中，微调后解决1,598个，覆盖率和解决方案成本均优于基线方法；可扩展至含障碍环境中超过一百万个同时运行的智能体。
AI.conclusion: 基于回合的动作意图细化能有效提升联合行动协调性，同时保持去中心化执行能力，显著优于现有可学习基线方法。

title: A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards. The human review indicated that synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with the NGSS standards, indicating the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development, the need to explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge, and the need to extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.

AI.tldr: 为解决K-12科学教育中缺乏与NGSS标准对齐的LLM评估工具的问题，研究构建了一个基于合成数据管道和多判官验证的综合基准。九种开源LLM在多个学科上表现优异，但模型大小并非性能的决定性因素。人工复核揭示了合成题目与标准的偏差，强调了人机协作及扩展交互式反馈能力评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM基准主要侧重通用语言能力或高级科学推理，缺乏针对中学（K-12）核心科学课程内容且严格对齐NGSS（下一代科学标准）的评估工具，导致教育工作者难以有效评估LLM在该领域的实际效能。
AI.method: 开发了一套综合性的NGSS对齐基准，涵盖初中和高中科学领域。方法包括：1) 使用严格的合成数据流水线生成题目；2) 采用多判官机制进行验证；3) 执行题级心理测量学分析。随后，系统评估了九个开源加权LLM的性能，并引入人类评审员对LLG生成的题目进行NGSS标准一致性复核，以探究“人在回路”的价值。
AI.result: 评估显示，多个较小规模的本地可部署模型在不同科学领域和题型上均实现了高准确率。研究发现模型大小并不总是预测性能的关键指标。然而，人工审查表明，纯合成生成的题目与NGSS标准并未完全一致，证实了人工介入的必要性和优势。
AI.conclusion: 虽然小型LLM在教育场景中具有潜力，但内容准确性仍需人工把关。未来研究需关注内容与教学知识的结合，并将基准扩展至评估LLM提供交互式、基于证据的教育反馈的能力，以实现更安全、有效的教育部署。

title: Reasoning Concentrates Errors, and Self-Consistency Never Notices
summary: Self-consistency assumes that independent samples disagree when a model is unsure, so agreement is evidence of correctness. Holding weights fixed and toggling only a reasoning mode, over five benchmarks and 74,944 samples, we show that reasoning concentrates a model's errors: the probability that two independently drawn wrong answers coincide rises in all ten dataset-scale comparisons (p = 0.00098), and in nine of nine after restricting both arms to the problems each gets wrong. Where the answer space is unbounded, reasoning cuts the distinct answers produced to 0.43-0.65 of the non-reasoning count; where it is bounded, both arms hold an identical option set and reasoning concentrates mass on it instead, which no positional prior can explain at fixed weights. The aggregate cost is smaller than the mechanism predicts, because reasoning also shrinks the set of problems where answer diversity can decide anything, in ten of ten cells and by 2.7x; normalized for available headroom, both arms convert a quarter of it in domain. Confidence weighting does not recover what is left. Across 280 method-dataset-model combinations on eight models and five benchmarks, not one beats plain majority voting after correction; weighted voting agrees with it on 98.5% of problem-method pairs and is right 56.3% of the time on the rest; and a signal's direction can invert within fixed weights, with answer log-probability predicting correctness when reasoning is off and error when it is on. A learned six-signal combination gains nothing out of domain. Confidence signals should be evaluated on decisions, not on discrimination.

AI.tldr: 研究反驳了“推理模式提升自洽性”的假设，发现固定权重下开启推理模式反而导致错误答案高度重合（错误集中），显著降低多样性且未提升准确率；简单的多数投票已是最优策略，置信度加权信号无效。
AI.motivation: 验证LLM中“自洽性”假设的有效性，即检验模型在不确定时独立采样是否会产生分歧，以及开启推理模式是否能通过增加多样性或提高共识来增强回答的正确性。
AI.method: 保持模型权重固定，仅在“非推理模式”和“推理模式”之间切换，涵盖8个模型、5个基准测试及74,944个样本。对比两种模式下的答案多样性、错误集中程度，并评估多种投票策略（简单多数投票、置信度加权投票）的性能差异。
AI.result: 1. 开启推理模式后，两个独立抽取的错误答案重合概率显著上升，证明错误被集中而非分散。2. 在无限答案空间中，推理将不同答案数量降至非推理状态的0.43-0.65倍；在有限空间中，推理集中质量分布，无法用位置先验解释。3. 推理模式不仅减少答案多样性，还大幅缩小了可通过多样性判断的问题集合（缩小2.7倍）。4. 校正偏差后，无任何方法优于简单多数投票；加权投票与多数投票在98.5%的情况下结论一致，且在剩余情况中仅正确56.3%。5. 答案对数概率在未开启推理时预测正确，开启后则预测错误。
AI.conclusion: 推理模式并未如预期那样通过自洽性提升准确性，反而导致错误集中和多样性丧失。简单的多数投票策略在当前设定下表现最佳，依赖置信度信号进行加权改进是无效的。置信度信号应针对决策效果进行评估，而非单纯的分类区分能力。

title: Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack
summary: Multi-agent systems distribute large contexts across agents that communicate to solve a task. Text messages are compact but require decoding and may omit evidence the receiving agent needs. Recent latent communication instead transfers KV caches. This avoids text generation and can improve accuracy and latency. However, a full KV cache grows linearly with both the context an individual agent processes, and the number of agents that coordinate together. This raises memory and context costs, often far exceeding available GPU resources and context window sizes. Our key observation is that agents need only send what the receiving agent requires for its local task -- which we call receiver-conditioned communication. The receiver agent passes the sender a small description of its information needs, which serves to filter and compress the sender agent's KV cache. CacheBack is a simple, robust, training-free instance of receiver conditioning based on the sender's attention weights. On FanOutQA, CacheBack with Qwen 3 removes 75% of the state the agent would otherwise receive, improving accuracy by 14.7 percentage points and reducing median task-completion latency by 3.2x relative to text communication. We show comparable improvements across model families that span dense Transformers, Mamba-attention hybrids, and sliding-window attention.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CacheBack的训练-free通信机制，通过接收方条件（receiver-conditioned）过滤和压缩KV缓存，大幅减少多智能体系统中的内存开销、提高准确率并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体系统中，全量KV缓存传输会导致内存和上下文成本线性增长，远超GPU资源和上下文窗口限制；而纯文本消息虽紧凑但可能遗漏关键证据且需解码，影响效率与准确性。
AI.method: 基于发送方的注意力权重（attention weights），由接收方提供小规模信息需求描述，对发送方的KV缓存进行动态过滤和压缩，形成一种简单的接收方条件通信机制。
AI.result: 在FanOutQA数据集上（使用Qwen 3模型），该方法移除了75%的传输状态，使准确率提升14.7个百分点，中位任务完成延迟降低3.2倍；且在稠密Transformer、Mamba-混合架构和滑动窗口注意力等不同模型族中均表现出可比的改进。
AI.conclusion: 接收方条件的KV缓存通信能高效解决多智能体系统中的上下文扩展瓶颈，无需训练即可显著提升性能与效率，具有广泛的模型兼容性。

title: EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproduction suite: https://github.com/bpoti001/epigraph
summary: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.

AI.tldr: 提出EngramRAG，一种基于互补学习系统（CLS）原则的自适应记忆架构，通过结合快速唤醒状态和异步梦境巩固周期，解决传统LLM智能体在长期对话中面临的关联盲区、支架遗忘和静态拓扑停滞问题。该方法显著提升了召回率和排序指标，并有效抑制了幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有内存架构在多会话环境中存在三大缺陷：1) 关联性盲区（无法遍历多跳关系依赖）；2) 支架性失忆（时间衰减导致核心人格不变量被驱逐）；3) 静态拓扑停滞（不可变图忽略使用动态）。旨在克服这些限制以优化长时记忆和多步推理能力。
AI.method: 1. U-PPR：通过Hebbian可塑性调整转移概率，促进持久实体成为高中心度的“认知宏枢纽”；2. CATD：根据拓扑负载权重而非时间远近缩放保留半衰期，辅以冷启动宽限期；3. SUPERSEDES DAG过滤：在事实突变期间抑制过时状态；4. 三重源混合检索：融合密集向量、BM25和U-PPR的动态RRF机制。评估基准为LoCoMo的1982个QA对。
AI.result: 相比密集向量RAG，Recall@5相对提升38.9%（53.21% vs 38.29%，p < 0.001），MRR提升43.1%（0.4203 vs 0.2937）；显著优于Okapi BM25（48.66%）和静态图检索（8.50%）。时间推理Recall@5达62.33%（比密集向量高16.67点）。SUPERSEDES将分裂大脑幻觉从70.0%降至0.0%；90天模拟显示交互检索反射延迟仅26.21ms且保持100%支架保留率。
AI.conclusion: EngramRAG通过模仿生物记忆的巩固机制，成功解决了长期对话中的记忆衰退和多步推理失效问题，提供了高效、稳定且抗幻觉的智能体记忆解决方案。

title: Contract monitoring: governing AI via separation of powers
summary: We propose an AI safety framework that binds worker agents to contracts specifying their permitted actions. We show how these contracts can be enforced and specified by assigning distinct responsibilities to monitor agents and judges, and asymmetric computational resources to monitors and workers. Our framework allows us to empirically measure statistical safety guarantees. The framework applies to a wide range of settings, including code security and escape-the-box scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种AI安全框架，通过合同约束智能体行为，利用监控者和法官的角色分工及非对称计算资源实现强制，并支持在代码安全和防逃逸等场景中验证统计安全性。
AI.motivation: 为解决AI智能体在执行任务时可能产生的不可控或有害行为问题，需要一种机制来明确限制和验证其允许的操作范围，从而提升系统安全性。
AI.method: 构建一个基于合同的框架，将工人智能体（worker agents）与执行操作的范围绑定；通过分配不同的责任给监控智能体（monitor agents）和法官（judges），并利用不对称的计算资源来强制执行这些合同规范。
AI.result: 该框架能够被实际执行和指定，并在实证研究中提供了统计安全保障（statistical safety guarantees）。它适用于多种场景，包括代码安全和“跳出盒子”（escape-the-box）情景。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于合同的AI安全框架是一种有效的方法，能够通过角色分工和资源分配来实现对智能体行为的严格约束，并为广泛的应用场景提供可量化的安全保障。

title: Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs
summary: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting outputs, with the goal of describing the snippet's true functionality. By treating the code snippets as external tools that must be understood via interaction alone, PAU studies the more general problem of unsupervised tool understanding, specifically for tools implemented as Python methods. Despite recent progress in coding agents, even frontier models struggle to achieve high performance on PAU, with the best model (Claude-4-Opus) failing to understand over 45% of the PAU test set. An investigation into the common error modes reveals that models are overconfident; they often overrate the quality of their current hypothesis, leading to insufficient exploration and premature termination. Finally, we take inspiration from the Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) paradigm, frequently used in robot learning, to post-train models for interactive code understanding. Models trained with AAC conduct more active exploration of the APIs, with an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B model matching the performance of GPT-5-mini.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAU基准，评估语言模型在仅通过交互（黑盒API调用）理解Python代码时的能力。研究发现现有顶尖模型表现不佳，主要因过度自信和探索不足。作者借鉴非对称演员-评论家（AAC）范式对模型进行后训练，显著提升了模型的主动探索能力和理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码生成与理解系统通常假设模型拥有代码的读取权限，但这一假设在处理外部API或黑盒代码时不成立。为了研究更通用的“无监督工具理解”问题，特别是针对作为Python方法实现的工具，需要一种新的评估基准和方法。
AI.method:
1. 构建PAU（Python API Understanding）基准：向模型提供黑盒、API级别的代码访问权限，模型需通过发送探索性输入并分析输出来推断代码的真实功能。
2. 错误模式分析：调查当前模型在PAU上的常见错误，发现模型往往过于自信，高估当前假设的质量，导致探索不足和过早终止。
3. 应用AAC范式：借鉴机器人学习中常用的非对称演员-评论家（Asymmetric Actor Critic, AAC）范式，对模型进行后训练以增强其交互式代码理解能力。
AI.result:
1. 即使是最先进的模型（如Claude-4-Opus）也无法理解PAU测试集中超过45的代码片段。
2. 经过AAC微调的Qwen3-8B模型在执行更积极的API探索后，其性能达到了GPT-5-mini的水平。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在面对黑盒API时的代码理解能力仍有巨大提升空间，现有模型常因缺乏充分探索而失败。通过模仿机器人学习中的AAC范式进行后训练，可以有效提升模型在交互式工具理解任务中的表现。

title: Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents
comment: Conditionally accepted to Middleware 2026. Extended version
summary:
AI agents are stateless across sessions by default and therefore operationally amnesic: each session begins with little durable knowledge of prior failures, repairs, preferences, or successful strategies. As a result, agents repeat the same mistakes and discard hard-won experience. The dominant fix is \emph{bespoke memory}---retrieval, persistence, and learning logic hand-wired into one agent and bound to one storage engine. This creates a fragmented landscape where memory cannot be swapped, shared, isolated, or reasoned about independently of the agent that owns it. We argue that this is a middleware problem: agent memory deserves a first-class, pluggable layer, just as data access, messaging, and persistence each became middleware concerns.
  We develop this vision through six systems challenges: two-sided pluggability, host-native interposition, multi-tenant isolation, write-path consistency, federated sharing with provenance, and lifecycle governance. We present ALTK-Evolve, a reference implementation of memory middleware for self-improving agents, and use it to motivate a broader research agenda for future memory middleware.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前AI代理因缺乏持久记忆而重复犯错，现有专有记忆方案导致系统割裂。作者提出将代理记忆构建为第一类的可插拔中间件层，并基于此愿景识别出六大系统挑战（如双向可插拔性、多租户隔离等），提出了参考实现ALKT-Evolve，旨在推动未来记忆中间件的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 默认情况下AI代理在会话间是无状态的（操作失忆），导致无法保留之前的失败经验、修复策略或偏好，从而重复错误并丢弃宝贵经验。现有的“专属记忆”解决方案是通过硬编码逻辑与特定存储引擎绑定，造成了记忆模块无法互换、共享或独立推理的碎片化局面。
AI.method: 1. 理论论证：提出代理记忆应被视为一种中间件关注点，具备“第一类”和“可插拔”的特性。2. 挑战识别：系统梳理了实现该愿景面临的六个系统级挑战（双向可插拔性、主机原生拦截、多租户隔离、写路径一致性、带有溯源的联邦共享、生命周期治理）。3. 原型验证：开发了名为ALKT-Evolve的参考实现，作为自我改进代理的记忆中间件实例。
AI.result: 确认了传统专属记忆模式的局限性，确立了记忆作为中间件的架构必要性；通过ALKT-Evolve证明了该架构在支持自我改进代理方面的可行性，并明确了未来研究需重点解决的六大技术挑战。
AI.conclusion: AI代理的记忆机制应当从紧耦合的专有模块转变为标准化、可插拔的中间件服务。这不仅解决了信息孤岛问题，还为构建能够持续学习和共享经验的智能体系统奠定了架构基础。

title: GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games
summary: Powered by expert guidance, agents can operate in interactive environments; however, it is unclear whether they can learn autonomously from their own experience. To evaluate such self-improvement methods, we introduce GameBoyWorlds, a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games. GameBoyWorlds-Execution evaluates task execution on a collection of 5 distinct game series. Agents are allowed access to dedicated training games but are provided no demonstrations, documentation, or rewards. Agents must ground themselves in the environment through self-directed exploration and by inferring actionable knowledge from their own experience. At test time, agents must complete short-horizon tasks that evaluate their ability to navigate, interact, and engage with game-specific mechanics in unseen games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of the 500 tasks due to failures in multimodal grounding, establishing that self-improvement methods have room to push performance. We demonstrate that contemporary approaches to self-improvement are lacking, with world modelling and autonomous skill discovery failing, and a novel strategy that uses curiosity-based exploration to write guides achieving only partial success. GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough tests end-to-end game completion in two fan-made Pokémon games. We show that while frontier models have been pre-exposed to official releases such as Pokémon Red, they lack essential information on the games in our testbed. Instead of relying on their parametric knowledge to succeed, agents must learn from their own experience and autonomously improve over the course of the playthrough. We show that a sophisticated agentic pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach even the first major milestone in both games, establishing GameBoyWorlds as an ambitious target for self-improving agents.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍了GameBoyWorlds基准测试，旨在评估智能体在无先验知识和示范的情况下，从自身经验中自主学习和改进的能力。结果显示当前前沿模型在该任务上表现不佳，突显了自改进方法的不足和研究空间。
AI.motivation: 尽管在专家指导下智能体能在交互式环境中运作，但其能否从自身经验中自主学习尚不清楚。现有方法缺乏有效的评估基准来衡量这种“自我提升”能力。
AI.method: 构建GameBoyWorlds测试集，包含两个主要部分：1) GameBoyWorlds-Execution：5个游戏系列，无示范/文档/奖励，要求智能体通过自主探索建立环境认知并执行短视界任务；2) GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough：两个粉丝自制《口袋妖怪》游戏，测试端到端通关能力及对非预训练数据的适应力。测试涵盖前沿模型、世界建模、技能发现及基于好奇心的引导生成策略。
AI.result: 1. 开箱即用前沿模型在500个任务中完成率低于50%，主要失败原因为多模态接地失败。2. 现有的自我提升方法（如世界建模和自主技能发现）均告失败；基于好奇心探索生成指南的策略仅取得部分成功。3. 即便前沿模型熟悉官方版《口袋妖怪》，在面对测试集中的粉丝自制版本时仍缺乏关键信息；带有分层子目标和多模态记忆的复杂智能体管道甚至未能达成首个重大里程碑。
AI.conclusion: 当前的自我提升方法存在显著缺陷，智能体难以仅凭自身经验在非预训练环境中有效学习。GameBoyWorlds确立了一个极具挑战性的目标，表明自改进智能体仍有巨大的性能提升空间。

title: Residual Streams Read, Recurrent States Remember: The Global Workspace in Mamba Models
summary: Can the global-workspace account of transformer representations extend to state-space language models? We fit Jacobian lenses to the residual streams and recurrent states of Mamba-1, Mamba-2 and Mamba-3, using the original 1000-prompt recipe. Joint residual--state readouts improve recovery of known intermediate concepts over the residual lens on at least five of six task families in every tested Mamba checkpoint. On Mamba-2, state alone exceeds residual and logit lenses on all six families; a normalised joint readout improves on both components on five. Temporal maps and word-list experiments show earlier content remaining state-readable as residual visibility changes. We also propose sign-guarded steering, which improves target top-five success over coordinate exchange on matched verbal-report trials in five models. Recurrent state alone supports this verbal access. These gains do not extend consistently to relational answers: guarded edits often output the edited concept itself, and Mamba-3's joint edits can disrupt successful state-only redirection. Recurrent state thus provides a complementary carrier of workspace content, whose recovery, persistence and causal uses require separate measurements.

AI.tldr: 研究验证了全局工作空间理论是否适用于状态空间语言模型（Mamba系列）。通过Jacobian lens分析发现，Mamba模型的循环状态（recurrent states）与残差流（residual streams）共同构成了互补的内容载体。联合读取提升了中间概念恢复及口头报告追踪能力，但关系型答案的处理仍存在挑战。
AI.motivation: 探索Transformer架构之外的状态空间模型（如Mamba）是否具备类似的全局工作空间特性，即模型内部是否存在可解释、可操纵的信息存储与工作空间机制。
AI.method:
1. 对Mamba-1, Mamba-2和Mamba-3应用Jacobian lenses分析残差流和循环状态；
2. 使用联合残差-状态读取策略进行中间概念恢复评估；
3. 通过时间映射和词列表实验验证信息的时间可访问性；
4. 提出“符号保护引导”（sign-guarded steering）方法以追踪口头报告相关的神经信号。
AI.result:
1. 在大多数任务家族中，联合读取优于单独的残差或logit透镜读取；在Mamba-2上，单独的状态读取已超越残差和logit透镜；
2. 符号保护引导显著提高了目标前五项成功率，且仅需循环状态即可支持口头访问；
3. 在处理关系型答案时，受保护编辑常直接输出被编辑概念本身，且Mamba-3的联合编辑可能干扰基于状态的定向。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态提供了全局工作空间内容的互补载体。其内容恢复、持久性及因果用途需要与残差流分开测量和分析，揭示了状态空间模型内部信息处理的独特机制。

title: Escaping Alignment: A Physical Trap Model of Best-of-N Jailbreaking
summary: Best-of-$N$ jailbreaking (BoN) bypasses safeguards of aligned models by drawing $N$ independent augmentations of an unsafe prompt and sampling $M$ completions of each. Previous works have shown that the attack success rate (ASR) seems to follow a power-law in $N$, which we challenge. The exponent drifts with $N$, with an exponential crossover which is a finite-size artifact of the adversarial dataset. Little work has been done to explore the entire two-budget ($N, M$) attack surface as well as its dependence on the generation temperature $T$. We introduce a simple barrier model where each prompt has a baseline safety level and each augmentation a random thermally activated barrier. Then four numbers, each backed by an interpretable safety mechanism, determine the entire ($N, M$) attack surface. They extrapolate predictions from $N \leq 100$ to $N = 10^4$, collapse five distinct models on the same scaling function and predict ASR at different temperatures from the one they were fitted at.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了Best-of-N（BoN）越狱攻击成功率（ASR随N呈幂律分布）的传统观点，提出了一个基于随机热激活势垒的简化壁垒模型。该模型揭示了ASR实际遵循指数交叉规律，且仅通过四个可解释参数即可完整描述整个(N, M)攻击面并预测不同温度下的ASR。
AI.motivation: 纠正以往认为BoN攻击成功率遵循简单幂律的错误认知；填补对完整双预算（N, M）攻击面及其与生成温度T依赖关系的研究空白。
AI.method: 引入“简单壁垒模型”（simple barrier model），假设每个提示词具有基线安全水平，每个增强样本具有随机热激活势垒；通过分析有限尺寸伪影和指数交叉现象，提炼出决定攻击面的关键参数。
AI.result: 1. 证实ASR随N的变化存在漂移，呈现由对抗数据集有限尺寸效应导致的指数交叉特征，而非固定幂律；2.提出的模型能将N≤100的数据外推至N=10^4；3.实现了五种不同模型在相同缩放函数下的数据坍缩；4.能够根据单一拟合温度下的数据预测不同温度下的ASR。
AI.conclusion: BoN越狱攻击的风险评估不能仅依赖简单的幂律拟合，需考虑复杂的动态机制；所提出的壁垒模型为理解及预测对齐模型的安全性提供了统一且高效的理论框架。

title: READ-Bench: Benchmarking Historical Instance Retrieval for Time-Series Diagnosis
summary: Time-series diagnostic systems rarely rely on retrieving relevant historical cases, and when they do, retrieval is evaluated only indirectly through downstream prediction. We introduce READ-Bench, a benchmark for historical-case retrieval across 12 diagnostic datasets, centered on multivariate time series, that defines relevance by shared fault or event type rather than signal shape, so visually different traces of the same fault count as relevant while similar-looking traces of different faults do not. Treating retrieval as a base retriever followed by a reranker, we evaluate classical distances, symbolic retrievers, self-supervised and foundation-model embedders, and their fusion, plus label-aware and language-model rerankers, under one protocol that varies supervision, pollution, and corpus scale with significance testing. Under a common channel-independent interface, pretrained representations offer no statistically detectable advantage over strong classical and symbolic baselines for search alone. The decisive factor is a small amount of resolved-case supervision at reranking, namely a Gaussian-process reranker that propagates a few neighbor labels in embedding space, which helps far more than more sophisticated representations or language-model reasoning and holds under pollution and at full corpus scale. Guided by these findings, we fuse a normal-residual-scored embedder with a dynamic time warping leg via reciprocal-rank fusion, then rerank with the Gaussian-process reranker, improving NDCG@10 over its own search stage on all 12 datasets, by +0.11 from reranking and +0.16 over the strongest single base retriever.

AI.tldr: 提出READ-Bench基准，证明在多元时间序列诊断中，检索相关性应基于故障/事件类型而非信号形状。研究发现 pretrained 表示并不优于经典基线，关键优势来自重排序阶段少量监督下的高斯过程重排器，最终通过融合嵌入与时序对齐再经重排序显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列诊断系统很少利用历史案例检索，且检索效果仅通过后下游预测间接评估，缺乏对“何为相关”的明确定义和公平比较基准。
AI.method: 构建涵盖12个数据集的READ-Bench基准；将检索分为基础检索器与重排器两步；评估各类距离度量、符号检索器、自监督/基础模型嵌入器及其融合，以及标签感知和大语言模型重排器；在统一协议下测试不同监督强度、数据污染和语料规模，并进行显著性检验。
AI.result: 预训练表示在纯检索任务上相比强古典/符号基线无统计显著优势；决定性能的关键是重排序阶段引入少量已解决案例的监督（高斯过程重排器），该策略在污染条件下和在完整语料规模下均稳健；最终方法（正常残差得分嵌入器 + DTW分支 + 互位秩融合 + GP重排）在所有12个数据集上将NDCG@10较自身搜索阶段提升+0.11，较最强单一基础检索器提升+0.16。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列诊断中的历史案例检索应以语义一致性（共享故障/事件类型）为相关性标准；轻量级、受监督的重排序机制比复杂表示或语言推理更能有效提升检索质量；所提融合架构提供可扩展、鲁棒的高精度检索方案。

title: PastForward: Faster On-Device GUI Agents via Computational Experience Reuse
summary: Running GUI agents on edge devices can keep sensitive screens and interaction histories local, but the computational cost of inference at every action step makes deployment challenging. Existing GUI agent systems either perform full vision-language model (VLM) inference at each action step or reuse coarse-grained knowledge matched to prior tasks. However, dynamic mobile environments and user tasks make it difficult to fully utilize prior task executions without additional fine-tuning or task-specific offline exploration. To address this challenge, we present PastForward, a system that accelerates GUI agents through validated, fine-grained reuse of computational experience accumulated during ordinary task execution. During decoding, PastForward retrieves prior output sequences as device-adaptive multi-token proposals and verifies them in a single VLM forward pass. Across action steps, it uses prior GUI transitions to begin next-step inference while the device executes the current action, retains the early computation only when the predicted screen matches the observed screen, and carries reusable KV states forward. We evaluate PastForward on AndroidWorld workloads derived from real mobile usage patterns using multiple VLM backbones across server and edge platforms. On device, PastForward achieves action-step latency speedups of 1.63-2.36$\times$ while maintaining task success rates.

AI.tldr: PastForward是一种针对边缘设备上GUI智能体加速的系统，通过细粒度复用历史计算经验（多token提议和KV状态）来降低推理延迟，无需额外微调即可实现1.63-2.36倍的延迟加速。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备上运行GUI智能体可保护隐私，但每一步动作的全量视觉语言模型（VLM）推理导致计算成本高、部署困难；现有系统要么全量推理，要么粗粒度重用先验知识，难以适应动态移动环境和用户任务，缺乏细粒度的计算经验重用机制。
AI.method: 提出PastForward系统：在解码阶段，检索历史输出序列作为设备自适应的多token提议，并通过单次VLM前向传播进行验证；在行动步骤间，利用先前的GUI转换提前开始下一步推断，仅当预测屏幕与观察屏幕匹配时保留早期计算，并向前传递可复用的KV状态。
AI.result: 在AndroidWorld工作负载（基于真实移动使用模式）上，使用多种VLM骨干网络在服务器和边缘平台进行评估；在设备上实现了1.63至2.36倍的行动步延迟加速，同时保持了任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: PastForward通过有效且细粒度地重用普通任务执行中积累的计算经验，成功解决了边缘设备GUI智能体的推理效率问题，提供了低延迟且保持性能的智能体执行方案。

title: Noisy Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Code LLMs
comment: This paper has been accepted by EMNLP 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various code-related tasks. However, unlike carefully curated datasets that are typically high-quality and error-free, real-world user instructions are often vague and error-prone, posing significant challenges to the robustness of code LLMs. Furthermore, robustness-oriented fine-tuning relies on paired clean-noisy samples, which are costly to curate and require sophisticated noisy simulation techniques. To address these challenges, we propose the Noisy Test-time Reinforcement Learning framework (NTRL-Code), which enables robust self-evolution of code LLMs using only unlabeled noisy data during the testing stage. Specifically, NTRL-Code uses conservative self-denoising to obtain a cleaner semantic anchor for target estimation, and employs an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-based structural aggregation mechanism to estimate a proxy target from multiple candidate programs. The policy is then optimized on the original noisy prompts with a hybrid reward that combines format validity, code similarity, and anti-repetition signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks, each incorporating character-level, word-level, and paragraph-level perturbations, demonstrate that NTRL-Code yields robust and consistent improvements, stabilizing the predictions of various base models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xikai97/NTRL-Code.

AI.tldr: 提出NTRL-Code框架，利用测试时无标签噪声数据实现代码大模型的鲁棒性自我进化，无需昂贵的人工标注。
AI.motivation: 解决真实用户指令模糊且易错导致代码LLM鲁棒性不足的问题；克服传统鲁棒微调依赖昂贵且复杂的“干净-噪声”配对样本收集的局限。
AI.method: 提出测试时强化学习框架（NTRL-Code）：1. 采用保守自去噪获取更清洁的语义锚点以估计目标；2. 基于抽象语法树（AST）的结构聚合机制从候选程序中估算代理目标；3. 结合格式有效性、代码相似性和抗重复信号混合奖励对策略进行优化。
AI.result: 在包含字符级、词级和段落级扰动的三个基准测试上，NTRL-Code实现了稳健且一致的改进，稳定了多种基座模型的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: NTRL-Code是一种有效的测试时适应方法，能够在不依赖额外标注数据的情况下显著提升代码LLM对噪声输入的鲁棒性。

title: AI Harness: Certification under Proposal-Conditioned Information for Foundation-Model Agents
summary: Foundation-model agents are often modeled as policies over an observed state. In deployed systems, however, a runtime may intervene only after the model has emitted a semantic proposal, making the proposal both an action candidate and a decision-time observation generated by a history-conditioned process. We show that collapsing this structure into a state-only proposal envelope can preserve proposal coverage while destroying certifiability. In a finite robust interface, the viability kernel of the collapsed model is contained in the physical projection of the history-augmented kernel, and the collapse is lossless exactly when every proposal-conditioned collapsed fiber retains a common robust-safe intervention. This gap can be maximal even with constant-size proposal and history alphabets. The same common-action condition yields a dual result: observing the current proposal can restore robust feasibility when it separates latent modes requiring incompatible interventions. We extend these one-step results over time using exact finite beliefs and standard safety and reachability fixed points, separating indefinite operational viability from finite worst-case verified progress. Controlled model-in-the-loop tests reproduce the predicted obstructions when telemetry or effect verification is removed or intervention authority is restricted. Thus, our contribution is not a new fixed-point calculus, but a characterization of when proposal--history correlation at the model--tool boundary is necessary for certification.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了在基础模型代理中，将“历史”与“提案”分离会导致系统失去可认证性。只有当提案-历史相关性被保留，且存在共同的鲁棒安全干预措施时，才能确保证明系统的可行性。
AI.motivation: 在部署的基础模型代理系统中，运行时干预通常发生在模型发出语义提案之后。这种结构使得提案既是行动候选者，也是基于历史生成的决策时间观测值。研究旨在解决这种复杂结构在简化为仅状态提案时可能带来的安全性和可认证性问题。
AI.method: 通过构建有限鲁棒接口数学模型，分析“折叠模型”（collapse model）与“历史增强核”（history-augmented kernel）之间的可行域包含关系。利用精确有限信念、标准安全性和可达性固定点算法，扩展单步结果至时间维度。最后通过受控的模型内环测试模拟遥测数据移除或干预权限受限的场景进行验证。
AI.result:
1. 将历史-提案结构简化为仅状态提案会破坏系统的可认证性，尽管可能保持提案覆盖率。
2. 折叠模型的可行性核包含于物理投影的历史增强核之中；仅当每个提案条件下的折叠纤维都保留共同鲁棒安全干预时，折叠才是无损的。
3. 即使提议和历史字母表大小恒定，这一差距仍可能是最大的。
4. 观察到当前提案可以在其分离需要不兼容干预的潜在模式时，恢复鲁棒可行性。
5. 模型内环测试复现了预测的障碍。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献并非提出新的固定点演算方法，而是对模型-工具边界处“提案-历史相关性”在认证过程中的必要性进行了明确刻画。只有在特定条件下（即存在共同的安全干预策略），才能确保系统在简化结构下仍具备可验证的推进能力和无限期操作活力。

title: CoMemBench: Benchmarking Collaborative Memory Boundaries across Multi-Agent Workflow Topologies
summary: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated. We call this task-conditioned scope of information a collaborative memory boundary. Workflow topology determines which intermediate artifacts are applicable to which downstream workers and when they cease to be valid, thereby providing a structural stress dimension for sharing and isolation. Existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate retention and retrieval, whereas multi-agent benchmarks emphasize coordination and end-to-end completion, leaving topology-conditioned memory boundaries largely unmeasured. We introduce CoMemBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for collaborative memory sharing and isolation across multi-agent workflow topologies. It constructs 800 composite workflows across four domains from source-grounded dependency graphs, with node-local specifications, verifiable artifact handoffs, native evaluators, and matched isolation challenges. CoMemBench measures workflow completion, verified node progress, required-handoff reliability, isolation robustness, and token cost. Experiments reveal a sharing-isolation trade-off: broader context improves information availability but can weaken isolation, while system rankings shift across topologies and artifact violations.

AI.tldr: 提出CoMemBench，一个针对多智能体工作流中协作记忆共享与隔离的执行基准，解决现有基准未充分测量拓扑条件记忆边界的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准主要评估保留和检索，多智能体基准强调协调和端到端完成，未能充分衡量由工作流拓扑决定的“任务条件性信息范围”（即协作记忆边界）中的共享与隔离机制。
AI.method: 构建包含800个跨四个领域的复合工作流程的基准测试CoMemBench。该基准基于源依赖图，具备节点局部规范、可验证工件交接、原生评估器和匹配隔离挑战，旨在评估共享与隔离。
AI.result: 实验揭示了共享与隔离之间的权衡：更广泛的上下文提高了信息可用性但可能削弱隔离性；不同工作流拓扑下，系统排名发生变化，且存在工件违规现象。CoMemBench成功测量了工作流完成度、节点进度、交接可靠性和隔离鲁棒性等关键指标。
AI.conclusion: CoMemBench为评估多智能体系统中基于拓扑结构的记忆共享与隔离提供了必要的执行级基准，揭示了扩大上下文对隔离性的负面影响及系统性能对拓扑结构的依赖性。

title: Instruct, Not Answer: Using Instruction Privileges in On-Policy Context Distillation
summary: On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) has recently emerged as a powerful technique for transferring context to student models and for self-improvement. In OPCD, the teacher is conditioned on privileged information, and the goal is to minimize the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the privileged teacher and the student, evaluated on student-generated tokens. Many existing studies show that using instance-specific gold answers or gold demonstrations as the default privilege can hurt training performance, especially out-of-distribution (OOD). In this work, we instead design general instructions that target common student mistakes observed on the training samples, and show that such simple instructions can outperform gold as the OPCD privilege. In autoformalization tasks, using a matched formatting instruction as the privilege could outperform gold in OOD accuracy by a large margin. In 7 out of 8 experiments using ProverQA, ProofWriter, and ProntoQA as datasets, and Qwen3-Thinking and Olmo3-Thinking families as models, matched instruction privileges outperform gold in OOD by 4 to 17 points, while remaining on par with gold in-domain. Each instruction is only a few sentences (and thus contains much less information compared to all instance-specific gold) and is applied uniformly to every training sample. These results indicate that a general instruction, which applies equally to source and target domain examples, can be substantially more transferable than instance-specific gold in OPCD while maintaining in-domain performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出在On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD)中，使用通用的、针对常见错误的“匹配指令”作为特权信息，比传统的特定样本的“黄金答案/演示”更能提升学生模型的分布外（OOD）泛化能力，同时在域内性能上保持同等水平。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，在OPCD中将特定实例的黄金答案或演示作为默认特权信息会损害训练性能，特别是在分布外（OOD）场景下。本研究旨在探索更有效的特权信息设计以提升模型泛化能力。
AI.method:
设计并测试通用指令作为OPCD特权：
1. 指令基于训练样本中观察到的常见学生错误设计。
2. 相比实例特定的黄金数据，指令更简短且统一应用于所有训练样本。
3. 在autoformalization任务及ProverQA, ProofWriter, ProntoQA等数据集上，使用Qwen3-Thinking和Olmo3-Thinking系列模型进行实验。
