AI.conclusion: 该方法有效地利用冻结的LLM和累积的工程经验来自动化和优化复杂的OPC配方制定过程。通过迭代式的“提出-评估-反思-检索”循环，系统在不需要重新训练模型权重的情况下，实现了显著的工艺精度提升和经验知识的有效复用。

title: From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially improved mathematical reasoning. However, terminal correctness alone provides limited insight into the quality of high-level strategies, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, when considered separately from their subsequent execution. This paper studies strategy utility, which is defined as the likelihood that a strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor. We introduce SURE, a framework for learning and leveraging relative strategy utility. In this framework, high-level strategies are separated from their detailed reasoning. Based on the pairwise preferences constructed from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, a Strategy Reward Model is learned to estimate relative strategy utility. During reinforcement learning, the frozen reward model reads only the extracted strategy, whose score is combined with the correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Compared with outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, experiments show that SURE improves average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% across three policy backbones. Our method also achieves competitive or better accuracy than stronger reward baselines while requiring substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.

AI.tldr: 提出SURE框架，通过分离高层策略与详细推理，利用学习到的策略奖励模型评估策略效用，在强化学习中结合正确性和格式奖励，显著提升了数学推理性能并降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖终端正确性无法充分评估高层策略（如定理选择和子目标分解）的质量，需要一种机制来独立衡量策略对后续正确解的支持程度（即策略效用）。
AI.method: 引入SURE框架：1) 将高层策略从详细推理中分离；2)基于策略条件 rollout 和教师生成对比构建成对偏好，训练策略奖励模型以估计相对策略效用；3) 在RL阶段使用冻结的奖励模型读取提取的策略分数，并结合正确性和格式奖励组成序列级GRPO目标。
AI.result: 相比基线方法，SURE在三种策略骨干上平均pass@1分别提升了1.87%、2.64%和2.93%，且在精度上优于或持平更强的奖励基线，同时大幅降低了GRPO阶段的计算量。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模和利用策略效用，该方法能有效提升大语言模型在数学推理任务中的表现，同时保持高效的学习效率。

title: Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.

AI.tldr: 提出DMD-EEG模型，通过分离头皮和脑源空间的专家视图，利用低秩稀疏变形建模脑部疾病状态，实现跨三种精神/神经疾病的精准、可解释的脑区-频率-时间滞后定位。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG闭环神经调控需要主体特定的结构化状态（指定异常脑区、频率和滞后），而现有方法要么保留诊断证据但缺乏解剖信息（传感器空间模型），要么提供解剖信息但损失预测信号（源空间模型），或事后归因脱离预测过程。
AI.method: 提出DMD-EEG（双视图多尺度变形EEG），将诊断与源状态表示分离：保留固定的头皮谱特征用于诊断，同时将源空间疾病相关表示建模为46个感兴趣区域×5个频率×4个滞后（自相关时间尺度）空间中健康神经动力学先验的低秩、稀疏迭代变形。两个专家仅在固定决策层融合。
AI.result: 在重度抑郁症（MDD）、首发精神病（FEP）和帕金森病（PD）中：1) 决策级融合在MDD和FEP上匹配最强单一专家，在PD上超过源分支；2) 在FEP中源专家表现最强，且变形贡献最大；3) 最高显著性坐标与已知疾病回路一致（如MDD的前额-边缘-颞叶区域，PD的运动皮层β频带）；4) MDD状态在不同蒙太奇记录的新队列中具有可转移性。
AI.conclusion: DMD-EEG提供了一种解剖学协调的可读预测表示，其源状态定义了明确的ROI-频率-滞后归因，直接生成假设并优于传统单一视图方法，为EEG闭环神经调控提供了精确的结构化状态指标。

title: Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling
summary: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出Lev（杠杆分数采样）方法，解决语言模型预训练中数据筛选质量与多样性的冲突。通过计算效率高的杠杆分数最大化嵌入数据的行列式体积，避免昂贵的矩阵重计算。在CommonCrawl和StarCoderData上显著提升了下游任务准确率（最高+1.31%）和数据多样性（Vendi分数提升9.2%），并加速了72倍选择过程。
AI.motivation: 现有高质量过滤方法导致“多样性坍塌”，排除了代表性不足领域的数据；而现有的多样化选择方法要么间接优化，要么因协方差矩阵重计算成本高而无法扩展。旨在解决这一矛盾，实现可扩展且高效的多样性增强数据筛选。
AI.method: 引入杠杆分数采样（Leverage Score Sampling, Lev）。该方法迭代选择能最大化嵌入数据行列式体积的样本。利用杠杆分数作为计算高效的判别标准，消除了矩阵重计算的需求，从而实现可扩展的数据选择。
AI.result:
1. 性能提升：相比强基线DiSF，Lev使选择速度提升高达72倍，数据集多样性（Vendi分数）提高9.2%。
2. 下游效果：在CommonCrawl数据上，Lev在七个下游任务中将准确率提高高达1.31%。
3. 代码领域优势：在StarCoderData上，Lev选出的子集比DiSF降低3.08%的每字节位数（bits-per-byte），且在代码相关性能上优于由DCLM-fastText过滤的高质量数据，揭示了跨领域的质量过滤坍塌现象。
AI.conclusion: 应在语言模型预训练的数据筛选中整合关注多样性的实践，以克服纯质量过滤带来的局限性，实现更有效的数据策展。Lev提供了一种高效、可扩展的无监督/多样化选择方案。

title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示在三角模态视觉问答（VQA）中，最能误导模型的不可靠辅助文本并非最缺乏事实依据的，而是那些与问题一致、与图像矛盾且支持特定错误选项的文本。为此，提出“文本可靠性阶梯”诊断协议及无需训练的推理时干预方法，显著降低因文本误导导致的预测错误。
AI.motivation: 尽管辅助文本常用于增强VQA任务，但其可靠性往往未加控制。现有研究虽涉及模态冲突，但尚不清楚在固定图像-问题-选项情境下不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何具体影响答案选择。
AI.method: 1. 提出“文本可靠性阶梯”（Textual Reliability Ladder），从图像一致性、问题相关性和选项支持性三个维度分解辅助文本；2. 在ScienceQA、VCR等多个数据集及最新视觉语言模型上进行评估；3. 提出一种无需训练的推理时干预方法，通过噪声稳定性导向（noise-stability steering）和动态接地（dynamic grounding）来对抗误导效应。
AI.result: 发现支持错误选项的辅助文本会导致最大的准确率下降（高达53.1%），并使错误集中在特定选项上。提出的干预方法能有效减少重定向错误，同时在忠实文本情况下保持性能基本不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 辅助文本的可靠性必须在决策层面而非仅通过事实正确性来理解。该研究提供了通向更稳健三角模态推理的实用路径，强调了控制辅助文本对模型预测方向性影响的重要性。

title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks.
  To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving.
  Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大型语言模型多智能体系统（LLM-based MASs）在应对需求逐步明确的任务时存在的不足，提出了RepoMAS框架及ProgSpec基准测试。RepoMAS通过记录问题作为结构化“Issue”来动态修正任务规范和执行结构，在多个基准上取得了最佳性能，证明了在执行过程中修订任务需求表示的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM多智能体系统通常假设任务需求在执行前已充分明确，但在实际应用中，用户请求往往是不完整的，额外需求可能在推理、工具使用或执行过程中才逐渐显现（即“逐步指定的任务”）。现有方法缺乏对这种动态需求变更的系统性处理和评估机制。
AI.method:
1. 提出ProgSpec基准：评估标准不仅包括初始请求中的显式要求，还涵盖由可用任务证据支持的新增要求。
2. 提出RepoMAS框架：受开源项目管理启发的驱动型多智能体框架。它将新发现的需求、冲突和失败记录为结构化的“Issues”，并利用这些Issue在执行过程中动态修订任务规范和执行结构。
AI.result: 在ProgSpec基准以及另外五个现有基准测试中，RepoMAS均取得了最佳性能。进一步分析表明，其基于Issue的修订机制和仓库维护机制对性能提升有持续贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果强调了允许多智能体系统在执行期间不仅修订任务的解决方式，还要修订其对任务需求的显式表示的重要性。这为解决具有逐步明确需求的复杂任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
summary: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARO框架，联合优化任务指令、可复用技能块和路由规则，通过反事实评估确定故障根源并针对性突变，在多个基准上优于单一提示或技能优化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理优化方法仅关注设计空间的一部分（如单独优化提示或诱导技能），缺乏在处理失败时决定更新哪些组件的原则性机制，且未在统一框架内协同优化提示、技能和技能使用策略。
AI.method: 提出SPARO（Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization）框架，执行受控的反事实评估，将示例的影响转化为针对提示、技能和路由组件的概率责任分布，据此采样一个组件并进行定向突变优化。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试和五种工作者模型上，SPARO一致优于基于提示和基于技能的优化基线，证明了结构化、可复用和选择性激活的任务知识优化方式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不仅取决于发现有用的任务知识，还取决于决定将这些知识存储在哪里以及在何时激活它们；SPARO提供了一种结构化的联合优化路径。

title: DAAF: From Failure Localization to Editable System Assets in LLM Agents
summary: Deployed LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent, versioned system assets such as routing rules, knowledge segments, prompt instructions, and reusable skills. Failure-localization methods can identify where an error manifests in an agent or execution trace, but repair requires a different decision: which editable system asset should be changed, and is that change expected to improve the task outcome? We study this gap through component-attribute failure attribution, where diagnosis targets versioned, addressable items rather than execution locations. We propose the Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF), which learns the effects of valid attribute replacements and amortizes this intervention evidence into deployment-time diagnosis. DAAF combines sparse and noisy failure signals to decide whether intervention is warranted, learns component-type-conditioned replacement effects from controlled replays evaluated by executable task outcomes, and shares supervision across requests with compatible intervention responses. At diagnosis time, DAAF uses only the observed execution, registered candidates, and available failure signals; it requires neither counterfactual replay nor task reward and returns no_change, a repair target, or an unresolved decision when evidence is insufficient. On held-out tau^2-bench Telecom tasks, DAAF achieves 80.72% attribute Hit@1, recovers 62.65% of failed executions while limiting clean-task regression to 3.23%, and reaches 71.93% overall task success. These results show that intervention-grounded attribute attribution can connect failure localization to executable system repair.

AI.tldr: 提出DAAF框架，通过组件属性失败归因，利用版本化系统资产的可编辑性，实现从故障定位到自动修复的闭环，显著提升LLM代理任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有故障定位方法仅能识别错误发生位置，但无法决定应修改哪个可编辑的系统资产（如路由规则、提示词）以改善结果，存在“定位”与“修复”之间的决策鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出检测感知的归因框架（DAAF），学习有效属性替换的影响并将干预证据摊销至部署时诊断；结合稀疏和噪声故障信号判断是否干预；通过可控回放学习组件类型条件化的替换效应，并在具有兼容干预响应的请求间共享监督。
AI.result: 在tau^2-bench电信任务中，DAAF达到80.72%的属性Hit@1准确率，恢复62.65%的失败执行，将干净任务回归限制在3.23%，整体任务成功率达71.93%。
AI.conclusion: 基于干预的属性归因能有效连接故障定位与可执行系统修复，为LLM代理提供无需反事实回放或任务奖励的自动化修复方案。

title: TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry
summary: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors. We propose TreeRef, a tree-based molecular representation that assigns molecular topology and topology-dependent local 3D geometry to a naturally variable-size tree. RingRef nodes encode ring closures while preserving the tree structure, while Null nodes allow molecular size to emerge directly from node occupancy. Based on TreeRef, we develop TreeRef-BFN, a Bayesian Flow Network with a standard Transformer backbone that globally couples these locally defined variables and jointly generates discrete molecular variables and continuous local geometry. A single pretrained TreeRef-BFN supports unconditional generation and variable-size structure-conditioned 3D generation through masking alone, without retraining. Empirical studies demonstrate strong chemical validity, molecular stability, and diversity, accurate local geometric distributions, fast sampling, and competitive property-conditioned generation, establishing TreeRef-BFN as an efficient and flexible framework for 3D molecular generation.

AI.tldr: 提出TreeRef-BFN框架，通过树状分子表示（TreeRef）和贝叶斯流网络，实现无需重训练的可变尺寸3D分子生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在多采样大小后生成笛卡尔坐标，限制了片段补全等可变条件任务；内部坐标方法虽避免冗余但需已知分子图或自回归构建，易累积误差。
AI.method: 开发基于树的分子表示TreeRef，将拓扑与局部几何映射到可变大小树中；结合Transformer骨干的贝叶斯流网络TreeRef-BFN，联合生成分散变量与连续局部几何。
AI.result: 在化学有效性、分子稳定性、多样性方面表现强劲，能准确模拟局部几何分布，采样速度快，且性质条件生成具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TreeRef-BFN是一个高效、灵活且统一的3D分子生成框架，仅需掩码即可支持无条件及结构条件生成。

title: Learning from Others, Acting for You: Cross-User Memory Sharing for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents serving different users often solve related tasks, yet separate user histories can leave reusable experience inaccessible to other agents. Pooling memories expands access but risks transferring preferences that conflict with the receiving user's requirements. We introduce ShareMem, a memory architecture that shares reusable experience while grounding its application in the receiving user's own preferences. Shared experiences indicate how to act and which preferences to consult; the receiving user's memory supplies their concrete values. Two-stage consolidation refines experience locally before integrating accepted edits into a shared pool. During execution, scope-first retrieval jointly selects local and shared experiences under a common entry budget, while a user-bound channel supports initial and agent-initiated preference retrieval. We evaluate ShareMem across web navigation (Mind2Web), online personalized interaction (VitaBench~2.0), and multi-session coding (MemoryCode) with four backbone models. It improves step success, average task success, and dialogue-macro coding scores, respectively, over matched user-local memory across all four models. Ablations favor two-stage consolidation for smaller shared pools, lower induction token usage, and better downstream performance, and support complementarity between experience guidance and active preference retrieval. Further analyses show that sharing helps most when relevant local experience is scarce, while source quality and cross-user preference interference limit useful transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出ShareMem架构，通过两阶段巩固和范围优先检索，在共享LLM代理经验的同时保护用户偏好独立性，提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 解决多用户LLM代理场景中，独立用户历史导致可复用经验无法共享的问题；同时避免直接合并记忆引发的用户偏好冲突风险。
AI.method: 构建ShareMem内存架构：1）两阶段巩固机制在地 refined 经验后集成至共享池；2）执行时采用范围优先检索联合选择本地与共享经验；3）引入用户绑定通道支持偏好检索。
AI.result: 在Mind2Web、VitaBench~2.0和MemoryCode三个基准测试中，相比单一用户本地记忆模型，显著提升了步骤成功率、平均任务成功率和代码生成评分，且在小规模共享池下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: ShareMem有效平衡了经验共享与偏好保护，当本地相关经验稀缺时共享收益最大，但受限于源数据质量和跨用户偏好干扰。

title: From Anomalies to Failures: Constructing Causal Error Graphs for Agentic Trace Diagnosis
summary: LLM-driven agents are increasingly deployed in complex applications, where long agentic traces make failures difficult to diagnose. Existing trace diagnosis methods often conflate anomalies, errors, and failures, making diagnostic targets ambiguous; they also lack structured modeling of how causally relevant errors propagate and amplify into final task failures, resulting in unreliable failure attribution. To address these problems, we propose CEG-Agent, a tool-augmented agentic framework for causal diagnosis of agentic traces. Specifically, CEG-Agent introduces an explicit taxonomy of anomalies, errors, and failures, and constructs Causal Error Graphs (CEGs), a unified typed representation that links execution events, diagnostic nodes, and failure outcomes through causal relations. To evaluate causal trace diagnosis, we further construct CEG-Bench, a fully agent-annotated benchmark with high-confidence, consensus-derived CEG annotations obtained through an Adversarial Agentic Adjudication Protocol (AAAP). We validate the resulting annotations against an expert-curated human gold set, which shows close agreement with the automatic annotations. Experiments on CEG-Bench demonstrate that CEG-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance under both semantically relaxed and structurally exact evaluation criteria. Our code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出CEG-Agent框架，通过构建因果错误图（CEGs）解决LLM代理追踪诊断中目标模糊和归因不可靠的问题，并在自建基准CEG-Bench上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法混淆异常、错误和故障，缺乏对因果相关错误如何传播并放大为最终任务故障的结构化建模，导致诊断目标模糊且归因不可靠。
AI.method: 1. 引入异常、错误和故障的显式分类体系；2. 构建因果错误图（CEGs），以统一类型化表示链接执行事件、诊断节点和故障结果；3. 采用对抗性代理仲裁协议（AAAP）构建CEG-Bench基准并进行人工验证。
AI.result: 在CEG-Bench基准测试中，CEG-Agent在语义宽松和结构精确两种评估标准下均取得了最先进的性能（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: CEG-Agent提供了更可靠的代理追踪因果诊断工具，其自动化标注与专家手动标注高度一致，为复杂应用中长追踪失败的诊断提供了有效解决方案。

title: LocalProp: Neuro-Localized Memory-Efficient Backpropagation
summary: The current deep learning training paradigm employs end-to-end backpropagation, regardless of the training stage, i.e. pre-training or fine-tuning. However, backpropagating through the entire model is neither biologically plausible nor memory efficient, since learning inside the brain is highly localized. Therefore, we propose LocalProp, a training procedure that locally updates the weights of a model. Our neuro-localized weight updates follow the "pre-training then fine-tuning" paradigm, where the pre-training is based on I-JEPA. After locally updating the weights, a pruning operation is performed, followed by a short final fine-tuning phase. Pruning helps by sending the learning signal from higher blocks to lower blocks. We perform experiments on several datasets, including large-scale benchmarks such as ImageNet, and empirically show that LocalProp reaches good performance at a fraction of GPU peak memory. By varying the number of jointly optimized blocks, we identify gradient-propagation span as a practical control over the accuracy-memory trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出LocalProp，一种基于局部权重更新和剪枝的高效训练范式，在大幅降低GPU显存占用的同时保持良好性能，解决了传统反向传播内存效率低及生物学不合理的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端反向传播范式（包括预训练和微调）不仅缺乏生物学合理性（与大脑局部学习机制不符），且内存效率低下，无法充分利用硬件资源。
AI.method: 提出LocalProp训练流程：1) 基于I-JEPA进行预训练；2) 对模型权重执行局部更新而非全局反向传播；3) 执行剪枝操作以将高层的学习信号传递至底层块；4) 进行短暂的最终微调阶段。通过调整联合优化的块数量来控制梯度传播范围。
AI.result: 在ImageNet等大规模基准数据集上的实验表明，LocalProp能以极低的峰值GPU显存消耗达到良好的性能表现。梯度传播跨度可作为控制精度与显存占用之间权衡的有效参数。
AI.conclusion: LocalProp通过结合局部更新、剪枝和分层微调，实现了在显著减少内存需求的同时保持高准确率，为高效且生物学合理的深度学习训练提供了新范式。

title: STR: Supervised Transcoder Replacement for Reducing Steering Side Effects
summary: Model steering can strengthen a target behavior while degrading other useful behaviors. We introduce Supervised Transcoder Replacement (STR) to reduce these side effects for existing steering methods, including those fitted without a protection objective. STR learns a replacement for the multilayer perceptron (MLP) computation at the steering layer through supervision for target control, non-target preservation, and fidelity without steering. Selected steering methods then fit directions on the frozen replacement while retaining their own fitting objectives. We evaluate three steering methods across Gemma and Llama models using Corrigibility preferences and four harmful-request safety datasets. SALAD-Bench supplies protection training data and a separate in-distribution evaluation split; HarmBench, AdvBench, and StrongREJECT are reserved for out-of-distribution testing. STR substantially reduces steering side effects on the in-distribution evaluation and extends this protection to the unseen safety datasets while retaining effective target control. For target-only supervised steering vectors, pooled out-of-distribution attack success rate falls from 42.46% to 14.42% on Gemma-3-4B and from 34.97% to 12.91% on Gemma-3-12B. These results show that replacement training can benefit steering methods fitted without protection objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出监督转码器替换（STR）方法，通过冻结 MLP 计算并重定向方向拟合，有效减少模型导向（steering）带来的副作用，在保持目标控制的同时显著提升未分布安全数据集的保护效果。
AI.motivation: 现有模型导向技术虽能增强特定行为，但往往会损害其他有用的行为或导致副作用；即使是针对无保护目标的导向方法，也缺乏对副作用的控制机制。
AI.method: 引入监督转码器替换（STR），通过学习替代层来监督目标控制、非目标保留和无导向下的保真度；随后在冻结的替代层上拟合方向，同时保留原有的拟合目标。使用 SALAD-Bench进行分布内评估与数据提供，HarmBench, AdvBench, StrongREJECT进行分布外测试。
AI.result: STR 显著减少了分布内评估中的导向副作用，并将保护扩展至未见的安全数据集。在 Gemma-3-4B 和 Gemma-3-12B 上，针对仅目标导向向量，分布外攻击成功率分别大幅下降至 14.42% 和 12.91%，同时保留了有效的目标控制能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于替换的训练机制能够有效优化现有的导向方法，特别是对于没有内置保护目标的导向策略，也能显著降低副作用并提升安全性。

title: MemAgent: Learning to Manage Heterogeneous Memory Providers for LLM Agents
summary: Current agents remain largely stateless across tasks, limiting their ability to continually improve from prior interactions and making memory essential for long-horizon agentic behavior. Existing memory methods seek to reuse past experience, but most rely on a single memory representation (e.g., trajectories, reflections, skills, structured knowledge) whose effectiveness varies across task distributions. Rethinking this design space, we evaluate 13 memory methods and find that no single method generalizes across benchmarks, revealing the potential of managing heterogeneous memory providers. We formulate agent memory as a routing problem in which a memory agent decides which memory provider to retrieve from, whether to inject short-term memory, and which providers should store the resulting experience. Based on this perspective, we propose MemAgent, featuring a content-aware routing architecture and a training-data synthesis pipeline. The routing architecture combines content-aware probing before retrieval, short-term memory gating during execution, and selective multi-provider storage, while the training pipeline synthesizes phase-specific supervision for routing decisions. Across GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DS, MemAgent improves average accuracy by 10.0% and outperforms every individual memory method across all three benchmarks. These gains come with less than 0.3% routing overhead and a 12% reduction in average task steps.

AI.tldr: 提出了MemAgent，一种基于路由记忆的代理框架。通过内容感知路由机制动态选择最佳记忆提供者（包括短期记忆注入和多Provider存储），解决单一记忆表示泛化能力差的问题，在多个基准测试中显著提升准确率并降低任务步骤。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体多为无状态，且主流记忆方法依赖单一记忆表示形式，在不同任务分布下有效性差异大，无法通用。旨在探索异构记忆提供者的组合潜力，提升长期智能体行为的表现。
AI.method: 将代理记忆建模为路由问题，提出MemAgent：1）内容感知的路由架构，包含检索前的内容探针、执行中的短期记忆门控、以及选择性多提供者存储；2）训练数据合成流水线，为路由决策生成特定阶段的监督信号。
AI.result: 在GAIA、WebWalkerQA和xBench-DS三个基准上，平均准确率提升10.0%，全面超越所有单一记忆方法。同时带来极低的路由开销（<0.3%）和平均任务步骤减少12%的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 单一记忆表示存在局限，管理异构记忆提供者并通过路由机制动态分配记忆使用是有效策略。MemAgent证明了该设计在提升泛化能力和效率方面的巨大潜力。

title: Beyond Dyadic Memory: Interaction-Aware Multimodal Memory with Adaptive Agentic Retrieval for Multi-Party Spoken Conversations
summary: Long-term memory enables agents to accumulate information and reason across sessions, yet existing research primarily focuses on dyadic text or image-text conversations, leaving long-term memory for multi-party spoken conversations underexplored. This setting requires preserving conversational content, identifying participants across sessions, and retaining who speaks to whom. To this end, we propose VoxPolyMem, an interaction-aware multimodal memory framework combining incremental speaker identification with a memory hierarchy comprising interaction memory, fact memory, and participant profiles. We formulate retrieval as sequential decision-making, where an agent rewrites queries and selects retrieval tools and memory layers based on accumulated evidence to address information gaps. We further introduce Evidence-Gain GRPO (EG-GRPO), which uses round-wise credit assignment to encourage complementary evidence acquisition. We also construct VoxPolyBench to evaluate memory evolution, personalized answering, memory retrieval and reasoning, and interaction reasoning and attribution in multi-party spoken conversations. VoxPolyMem achieves an overall score of 85.0 on VoxPolyBench, surpassing the strongest evaluated baseline by 23.6 points. On Mem-Gallery and H2HMem-Multi, it scores 89.6 and 74.4, respectively, exceeding the strongest evaluated public memory baselines by over 8 points each. These results highlight its potential for persistent, personalized assistance in multi-party multimodal interactions. Code and datasets are available at https://voxpolymem.github.io/VoxPolyBench/demo/

AI.tldr: 提出VoxPolyMem框架，通过增量说话人识别和分层记忆（交互、事实、参与者档案）解决多方口语对话的长期记忆问题，结合EG-GRPO优化检索策略，在多项基准测试中显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 针对当前研究主要关注双边文本或图文对话，忽略多方口语对话中长期记忆的复杂性问题，特别是需保持对话内容、跨会话识别参与者及记录交互关系的挑战。
AI.method: 1. 构建VoxPolyMem多模态记忆框架，整合增量说话人识别与分层记忆结构；2.将检索建模为序列决策过程，通过重写查询和选择工具/层级填补信息缺口；3.引入证据增益GRPO（EG-GRPO）利用轮次信用分配促进互补证据获取；4.建立VoxPolyBench评估体系涵盖记忆演变、个性化回答及推理等维度。
AI.result: 在自建VoxPolyBench基准上得分85.0，比最强基线高出23.6分；在Mem-Gallery和H2HMem-Multi上分别获得89.6和74.4分，均超过最强公开基线8分以上。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效支持了多方多模态交互中的持久化、个性化辅助，证明了其在复杂长程记忆任务中的潜力。

title: AmbiModBench: Benchmarking Gene Perturbation Prediction Beyond Shared Responses
summary: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations helps prioritize experiments in single-cell genomics, where exhaustive measurement is infeasible. While computational models increasingly predict these responses, three evaluation deficiencies obscure what their scores demonstrate. First, absolute metrics cannot separate target-specific predictions from a shared background response. Second, common metrics remain high under gene shuffling, so gene-level accuracy is never verified. Third, a score at one training size says nothing about coverage, which depends on representation-space proximity and response-constraining power. We propose AmbiModBench, a specificity-aware, gene-resolved and coverage-aware benchmark. It pairs every score with a training-mean reference fitted on the same split, screens each readout by gene-coordinate permutation, and links embedding distance to response variation. Across K562, RPE1 and Norman, strong absolute scores largely reflect shared background rather than target-specific learning. Widely used readouts track response magnitude distributions rather than the affected genes. Detectable gain follows representation-space coverage rather than training-set size. Nonetheless, on RPE1 the protocol yields a reproducible target-specific gain across five additional splits and three gene selections, which absolute scores alone cannot distinguish from shared background.

AI.tldr: 提出AmbiModBench基准，通过特异性感知、基因解析和覆盖度感知指标，纠正当前细胞遗传扰动预测模型评估中的三大缺陷（混淆背景响应、缺乏基因级验证、忽视表示空间覆盖），揭示强绝对得分多源于共享背景而非目标特异性学习。
AI.motivation: 现有计算模型在预测单细胞基因组中细胞对遗传扰动的反应方面日益增多，但其评估指标存在严重不足：1）绝对指标无法区分目标特异性预测与共享背景反应；2）常见指标在基因洗牌后仍保持高位，导致从未验证基因级准确性；3）单一训练规模下的得分无法反映依赖于表示空间接近度和反应约束力的覆盖度。这些缺陷模糊了模型评分的实际意义。
AI.method: 提出AmbiModBench基准测试，包含三个核心机制：1）将每个分数与在同一数据分割上拟合的训练均值参考配对，以分离背景效应；2) 通过对基因坐标进行置换来筛选每个输出指标，验证基因级特异性；3) 将嵌入距离与反应变化联系起来，评估表示空间覆盖度。在K562、RPE1和Norman数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在K562和RPE1等数据集中，强大的绝对得分主要反映了共享背景反应而非目标特异性学习；广泛使用的读取指标追踪的是反应幅度分布而非受影响的基因；可检测的性能提升遵循表示空间覆盖度而非训练集大小。然而，在RPE1数据集中，该协议在五个额外分割和三种基因选择下产生了可重复的目标特异性增益，而仅凭绝对得分无法将其与共享背景区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 现有的评估指标严重高估了模型的目标特异性学习能力，因为它们混淆了背景噪声。AmbiModBench提供了更严谨的评估框架，证明真正有效的预测能力依赖于对表示空间的充分覆盖和基因级的特异性捕捉，而非单纯的训练数据量或总体绝对得分。

title: Fail Loudly: An Auditable Runtime for Agentic Data Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled data-science agents to automate multi-step analyses over heterogeneous files. However, incorrect choices regarding data sources, scope, or statistical definitions often lead to silent errors: computations execute successfully but produce plausible yet incorrect outputs that fail to answer the intended question. To mitigate this, we present RADAR, an auditable runtime that makes an agent's analytical choices inspectable and supports their revision through execution feedback. RADAR operates through three core mechanisms. First, an evidence-preserving exploration module retrieves task-relevant content while retaining source locations and observation coverage. Next, the runtime uses typed operators to record the agent's declared inputs, operation arguments, and resulting observations. Finally, runtime validation checks proposed operations against these observations. When a conflict is detected, the runtime rejects the operation or provides diagnostic feedback, allowing the agent to revise its choices before errors propagate. This design enables agents to fail loudly while leaving semantic interpretation to the LLM. On KramaBench, RADAR achieves overall scores of 0.723 with full source retrieval and 0.747 with gold sources supplied, corresponding to relative gains of 35.9% and 28.8% over the strongest baselines. Beyond KramaBench, RADAR achieves relative performance gains of 14.0% on DA-Code and 59.3% on DABStep, demonstrating its applicability across diverse agentic data-analysis workflows.

AI.tldr: RADAR是一个面向大语言模型（LLM）数据科学代理的可审计运行时系统，通过记录和分析代理的决策过程来防止“静默错误”，显著提升多步骤数据分析任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的数据科学代理在自动化多步分析中，常因对数据源、范围或统计定义的误选导致“静默错误”——即计算成功执行但输出看似合理实则错误的结果，无法回答核心问题。需要一种机制使代理的决策过程可检查且可修正。
AI.method: RADAR采用三个核心机制：1) 证据保留探索模块，检索相关内容并保留来源位置和观察覆盖度；2) 使用类型化操作符记录代理的输入、参数及观察结果；3) 运行时验证，将提议的操作与观察结果进行比对，发现冲突时拒绝操作或提供诊断反馈，允许代理在错误传播前修正选择。
AI.result: 在KramaBench上，RADAR全源检索得分0.723（相对基线提升35.9%），黄金源供给下得分0.747（提升28.8%）。在DA-Code和DABStep数据集上分别取得14.0%和59.3%的相对性能增益。
AI.conclusion: RADAR通过实现“大声失败”（fail loudly）并让LLM负责语义解释，有效降低了数据流中的潜在错误风险，证明了其在多样化智能体数据分析工作流中的适用性和有效性。

title: LLMAdBench: A Human Preference Benchmark for Advertising in LLM Responses
summary: Inserting advertisements (ads) into consumer-facing LLM output is emerging as a new business model, but there is little shared evidence on how such ad insertion should be evaluated or how it affects user preferences. We introduce LLMAdBench, a human-preference benchmark for studying advertising in LLM-generated content. The benchmark isolates a simple but practically important decision: given a user conversation, an LLM response, and a matched advertisement, where should the ad be placed? Our dataset compares pairs of responses that differ only in ad position while holding all other conditions fixed including the user query, base answer, advertisement, and disclosure condition. Human annotators evaluate each pair based on six criteria from both advertiser's and user's perspectives. The resulting benchmark contains more than 18000 human judgments across two disclosure conditions: explicitly labeling the ad as sponsored and merging it into the response without disclosure. We use LLMAdBench to evaluate eight frontier LLMs as preference judges and find that they are not reliable substitutes for human evaluation. Even the most stable models reverse roughly one quarter of their decisions when the presentation order is swapped, agreement across models is low, and their placement preferences differ systematically from those of human annotators. Moreover, LLMAdBench contains substantial learnable signal. In particular, a Qwen3-8B model fine-tuned on the human preferences improves substantially over its base model and outperforms all zero-shot frontier judges on the held-out prediction task. Beyond model evaluation, LLMAdBench provides quantitative evidence on the advertiser-user trade-off and shows that the sponsorship disclosure systematically changes users' preference over ad placement.

AI.tldr: 提出了LLMAdBench基准，用于研究LLM生成内容中的广告插入评估及对用户偏好的影响。该基准包含18000+人类判断数据，揭示了现有前沿LLM作为偏好判断代理的不可靠性，并证实微调模型能有效提升预测性能，同时量化了赞助披露对广告位置偏好的系统性影响。
AI.motivation: 解决目前关于在消费者面向的大语言模型（LLM）输出中插入广告缺乏共享证据的问题，特别是关于如何评估广告插入以及如何影响用户偏好这一关键空白。
AI.method: 构建了LLMAdBench基准数据集，通过控制变量法（仅改变广告位置，保持查询、基础回答、广告内容和披露条件不变），收集人类标注者针对六个维度的偏好判断，涵盖“显式标记为赞助”和“无披露混合”两种条件。利用该基准评估八个前沿LLM的偏好判断能力，并对Qwen3-8B进行微调以测试其学习人类偏好的潜力。
AI.result:
1. 现有前沿LLM并非人类评估的可靠替代品：最稳定模型在展示顺序交换时约有25%的决定被反转，模型间一致性低，且其放置偏好与人类存在系统性差异。
2. LLMAdBench包含可学习的信号：经微调的Qwen3-8B模型在保留预测任务上大幅超越基础模型，并以零样本方式优于所有前沿判断模型。
3. 提供了广告主-用户权衡的量化证据，表明赞助披露会系统性地改变用户对广告位置的偏好。
AI.conclusion: LLMAdBench不仅揭示了当前LLM在模拟人类广告偏好判断方面的局限性，证明了微调对于捕捉人类偏好的有效性，还为理解广告披露机制对用户选择的影响提供了重要的实证依据，为未来LLM广告策略的设计和优化提供了基准支持。

title: Interpretable Physics Informed WiFi Indoor Localization: Learning an Effective Access Point Geometry and Using It to Prune
summary:
Deep learning models can achieve high accuracy for indoor localization, but their black-box nature limits interpretability and the reuse of learned information. We propose a hierarchical deep learning framework for WiFi fingerprint-based indoor localization that jointly predicts user location and learns an effective geometry of the surrounding access points (APs). Physics-informed decoders infer this geometry directly from RSSI measurements and labelled user positions, without requiring the true AP coordinates during training. The learned geometry is then used to rank and prune APs.
  On the UJIIndoorLoc dataset, the proposed chained model achieves a mean 3D localization error of 7.07 m, reducing error by 26% to 36% compared with baseline models. Previously published methods evaluated on the same official split report errors 10.6% to 31.0% higher. Pruning 35% or 50% of the APs causes only a small loss in localization accuracy. The inferred geometry also enables Fisher-information-based AP ranking even when fingerprint databases do not contain surveyed AP coordinates. Experiments on the Tampere/TUT and UTSIndoorLoc datasets show that geometry-guided AP selection performs comparably to selectors built directly from labelled data. These results show that physics-informed interpretability can improve indoor localization while also supporting effective feature selection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于WiFi指纹的层次化深度学习框架，通过物理信息解码器推断无坐标场景下的AP几何结构，利用该几何信息对AP进行排序和剪枝，从而提升室内定位的可解释性、准确率及特征选择效率。
AI.motivation: 解决深度学习和黑箱模型在室内定位中可解释性差以及难以复用学习信息的问题；同时应对缺乏真实接入点（AP）坐标数据时特征选择的困难。
AI.method: 提出层级化深度学习框架，结合联合预测用户位置和推断AP有效几何结构；使用物理信息解码器仅从RSSI测量值和标注的用户位置中学习几何结构，无需真实AP坐标；利用学到的几何结构进行AP的排序和剪枝，并支持基于Fisher信息的AP排序。
AI.result: 在UJIIndoorLoc数据集上，所提模型实现平均3D定位误差7.07米，比基线模型降低26%-36%，比此前发表的方法误差低10.6%-31.0%；剪枝35%-50%的AP仅导致微小的精度损失；在Tampere/TUT和UTSIndoorLoc数据集上，几何引导的AP选择效果与基于标注数据的直接选择相当。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息驱动的可解释性不仅能提高室内定位性能，还能支持有效的特征选择，证明了无需真实AP坐标即可学习并利用几何信息进行优化定位的有效性。

title: Porimon: An LLM-Based Pokémon Battle Agent Enhanced by Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation
summary: In this paper, we use Pokémon Battles as a case study to investigate how to improve the performance of LLM-based agents in tasks that require opponent-aware planning without additional fine-tuning. We propose Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation (LSTKAG), a mechanism that enables LLM-based agents to leverage past states of the current task and retrieve experience summaries from similar previous task instances based on the current state. Based on LSTKAG, we design Porimon, an LLM-based agent structure for Pokémon Battles. For optimization, we introduce an external API for precise damage calculation and more detailed information about the game. We conduct tournament-like evaluation experiments comprising 15,000 battles for hyperparameter optimization, ablation studies, and performance evaluation. The results indicate that Porimon-based players with hyperparameter optimization significantly outperform players based on PokéLLMon, an LLM-based agent structure proposed in previous research, and the rule-based heuristic player. Furthermore, our ablation study shows that Porimon variants outperform the one without extension in game information retrieval, which shows the contribution of that extension. However, the current experiment results are inconclusive regarding the contribution of Long-Term KAG. These results suggest that introducing external resources, information from previous states of the current task, and experience summaries from similar previous task instances could elevate the performance of LLM-based agents designed for tasks requiring opponent-aware planning.

AI.tldr: 本文以宝可梦对战为案例，提出长短期知识增强生成机制（LSTKAG）及Porimon智能体结构，通过利用当前任务状态历史和经验总结优化LLM智能体性能，无需额外微调即可显著提升对手感知规划能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究如何在不进行额外微调的情况下，提升基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在需要“对手感知规划”（opponent-aware planning）任务中的表现。
AI.method:
1. 提出长/短期知识增强生成（LSTKAG）机制，利用当前任务的历史状态检索相似任务的经验摘要；
2. 设计基于此机制的Porimon智能体结构；
3. 引入外部API用于精确伤害计算和更详细的游戏信息获取；
4. 通过包含15,00场对战的类锦标赛实验进行超参数优化、消融研究和性能评估。
AI.result:
1. Porimon玩家经超参数优化后，性能显著优于之前的PokéLLMon智能体结构及基于规则的启发式玩家；
2. 消融研究表明，扩展游戏信息检索功能对性能提升有贡献；
3. 长期知识增强（Long-Term KAG）的具体贡献尚不明确，结果具有不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 引入外部资源、当前任务的历史状态信息以及来自相似过往任务的經驗总结，能够有效提升面向对手感知规划任务的LLM智能体的性能。

title: Are Vision-Language-Action Models Robust to One-Step Observation Perturbations?
summary: Understanding the safety risks of vision-language-action (VLA) models is essential for their deployment in the physical world. Existing safety research has mainly considered persistent perturbations that are applied continuously to observations throughout an episode. However, momentary observation corruption, in which observations are severely perturbed only briefly within an episode, remains an underexplored safety threat. To address this gap, this work investigates robustness to one-step perturbations applied at a single time step per episode. Our experiments reveal that these perturbations substantially degrade VLA performance and that their impact depends on the action chunk execution length. Based on them, we propose CARE, which dynamically selects the execution length based on consistency with the previously predicted action chunk. CARE improves robustness with low computational overhead while preserving clean performance by selecting shorter execution lengths only under perturbations.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉语言动作(VLA)模型在单步瞬时观测扰动下的鲁棒性问题，研究揭示了性能下降现象，并提出了CARE方法，通过动态选择执行长度来提升鲁棒性且保持低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA安全研究主要关注持续性的环境扰动，而针对仅在episode中短暂发生的“瞬时观测污染”(momentary observation corruption)这一安全隐患的研究尚属空白。理解并解决此类单步扰动对物理世界部署中的VLA模型至关重要。
AI.method: 1. 实验分析：评估单步扰动对VLA性能的影响，发现其显著降低表现且影响程度依赖于动作块执行长度(action chunk execution length)。2. 提出CARE算法：一种动态选择机制，根据当前预测与之前预测动作块的一致性来决定执行长度；在检测到扰动时自动缩短执行长度以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 1. 单步扰动会大幅削弱VLA模型的 performance。2. CARE方法能有效提升模型在面对瞬时扰动时的鲁棒性。3. 该方法仅在受到扰动时启用更短的执行策略，因此在干净环境中保持了原有的性能水平，且增加了极低的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 瞬时观测污染是VLA模型的一个被低估的安全威胁。通过结合对单步扰动的分析与基于一致性检查的动态执行长度选择（CARE），可以在不牺牲正常表现的前提下显著提升模型在物理环境中的鲁棒性。

title: Artificial intelligences and human scientists exhibit complementary strengths in theory building
summary: We investigate the effectiveness of artificial intelligences (AI)-specifically large language models (LLMs)-relative to human scientists at high-level cognitive tasks in social science such as theory formulation, predictions of novel empirical results, and theory revision in response to new evidence. The research domain was academic discourse regarding gender and race inequality. Our findings, comparing 25 LLMs with 13 senior researchers and 60 doctoral scholars, reveal that the AIs outperformed most humans individually on most of the present tasks, while human theories were more diverse and exhibited greater gains in predictive accuracy from aggregation. AI-generated theories were more extensively elaborated, involving additional theoretical paths and latent variables, and were rated as higher quality than human theories by independent raters blinded to source. However, this theoretical complexity was in part ornamental, in that it was not associated with more accurate predictions about empirical patterns in data; in contrast, human scientists achieved greater predictive efficiency with simpler theories. The AIs were significantly more likely than human scientists to revise their theories to incorporate new evidence; human scientists updated their beliefs in a selective way that is sensitive to prior prediction errors. We speculate that the superior processing capacity of artificial intelligences makes them especially well-suited to tasks requiring grappling with complexity, but that the greater diversity of human ideas is essential to wise crowds and collective creativity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现25个大语言模型（LLM）在理论构建、预测和修订等社会科学高阶认知任务中，个体表现优于大多数人类研究者。AI生成的理论更复杂且质量评分更高，但存在“装饰性”冗余，预测效率低于人类；AI在整合新证据方面更具适应性，而人类依赖选择性信念更新。结论指出AI擅长处理复杂性，而人类的多样性对集体智慧至关重要。
AI.motivation: 探究人工智能（特别是大语言模型）与人类科学家在社会科学高阶认知任务（如理论构建、预测、基于新证据的理论修订）中的相对有效性，以评估AI在学术话语领域的能力边界。
AI.method: 研究聚焦于性别与种族不平等的学术话语领域。比较了25个大语言模型、13名资深研究人员和60名博士研究生的表现，通过独立盲评专家对理论质量进行打分，并分析其理论复杂度、预测准确性及对新证据的修订机制。
AI.result: 1. AI在个体层面普遍优于多数人类参与者在大部分任务上的表现。2. AI生成的理论阐述更详尽、涉及更多潜变量，且被评级为高质量，但这种复杂性是“装饰性”的，与更高的预测准确性无关联。3. 人类科学家用更简单的理论实现了更高的预测效率，且群体聚合带来更大的预测精度提升。4. AI更倾向于全面修订理论以纳入新证据，而人类科学家则根据先前的预测误差进行选择性信念更新。
AI.conclusion: AI强大的处理能力使其特别适合应对复杂性任务，但人类思想的多样性对于实现群体智慧和集体创造力不可或缺。两者各具优势，应在不同场景下发挥各自特长。

title: ProTTT: Learning to Learn Semantic User Memory with Test-Time Training
summary: Personalization requires language models to capture user-specific knowledge from a growing user history. Existing context-based approaches incur increasing inference costs as user history accumulates and rely on separate retrieval or summarization stages, while parametric-based approaches often require reconstructing user representations when new user data is added. We introduce ProTTT, a profile-supervised meta-learning framework for learning semantic user memory. The memory construction starts from a shared initialization and is updated for each user through test-time training on user history, allowing it to evolve continuously as the history grows. However, since test-time training alone does not explicitly encourage the memory to capture semantic user knowledge necessary for personalization, we learn this shared initialization using textual user profiles as supervision, so that test-time training on user history captures semantic knowledge more effectively. ProTTT consistently outperforms both full history ICL and all parametric baselines across diverse benchmarks, while substantially reducing inference cost by compressing user history into a lightweight parameterized memory. Our analysis also shows that profile supervision is a reliable objective for learning semantic user knowledge and that the resulting memory can track and retain evolving user preferences, while remaining robust across different history sizes. Overall, we demonstrate the effectiveness of test-time training for personalization and establish ProTTT as a baseline for continuously evolving user memory.

AI.tldr: 提出ProTTT框架，通过测试时训练和文本用户画像监督，将不断增长的用户历史压缩为轻量级参数化记忆，以解决现有个性化方法推理成本高或重构困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于上下文的方法随用户历史增长推理成本增加且需额外检索阶段；基于参数的方法在新增数据时需重构用户表示，难以持续演化。
AI.method: 构建Profile-Teacher Test-Time Training (ProTTT)框架。从共享初始化开始，利用测试时训练（Test-time training）根据用户历史更新每个用户的记忆；引入文本用户画像作为监督信号来学习共享初始化，以强化对语义知识的捕捉。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试中优于全历史In-Context Learning (ICL)及所有参数基线方法；显著降低推理成本，因为用户历史被压缩为轻量级参数化记忆；证明画像监督是有效的学习目标，记忆能追踪偏好变化并适应不同历史大小。
AI.conclusion: 证明了测试时训练在个性化任务中的有效性，确立了ProTTT作为持续演化用户记忆的基线模型。

title: CUE-Mem: Benchmarking Long-Term User Memory via Implicit Cues in Multimodal Conversations
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Code: https://github.com/yulinlp/CUE-MEM. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kkryptonite/CUE-Mem
summary: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents that interact with users across sustained conversations. However, user memories are not always explicitly stated: they may also be implied by recurring background objects in images, ambient sounds in audio, or other peripheral multimodal cues. Existing benchmarks largely focus on text-only memory or explicit multimodal evidence, leaving implicit multimodal cues underexplored. We introduce CUE-Mem, a text-image-audio benchmark for evaluating long-term user memory from implicit cues. CUE-Mem contains 2,674 questions across explicit and implicit evidence settings and covers four tasks: Entity Recall, Long Pattern, Personalized Recommendation, and Answer Refusal. Across textualized memory systems, implicit performance remains far below oracle evidence, locating the main bottleneck in preserving and retrieving subtle cues rather than question answerability. Increasing caption detail recovers more of this evidence, but brings uneven gains and rapidly growing token costs, motivating native multimodal access. Yet native access does not uniformly resolve the bottleneck: evidence use depends strongly on the backbone, while multimodal indexing introduces substantial retrieval noise. CUE-Mem provides a testbed for memory systems that selectively retain, retrieve, and use subtle multimodal evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CUE-Mem基准，旨在评估多模态智能体从图像和音频等隐含线索中回忆长期用户记忆的能力，揭示了当前系统在保留和检索微妙线索方面的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要集中在纯文本记忆或显式多模态证据，忽略了大量存在于背景物体、环境声音等隐含多模态线索中的用户记忆需求。
AI.method: 构建包含2,674个问题的文本-图像-音频基准CUE-Mem，涵盖实体回忆、长模式识别、个性化推荐和答案拒绝四个任务，对比显式与隐含证据设置下的性能差异。
AI.result: 1. 在基于文本的记忆系统中，隐含线索的性能远低于理想情况，证明主要瓶颈在于细微线索的保留与检索；2. 增加caption细节可提升性能但带来高token成本和收益不均；3. 原生多模态访问并非万能，受骨干网络影响大且引入检索噪声。
AI.conclusion: CUE-Mem为开发能够选择性保留、检索和利用微妙多模态证据的记忆系统提供了测试平台，推动了从显式到隐含线索的多模态记忆研究。

title: EMIR$^2$: Evolution-Aware Memory with Intent-Guided Multi-Round Retrieval
summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to leverage historical interactions for future tasks. However, existing memory systems struggle to utilize continuously evolving historical information, as they often rely on static memory representations and single-round retrieval strategies, failing to track factual changes or integrate distributed evidence across long-term interactions. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$, an \textbf{E}volution-Aware \textbf{M}emory framework with \textbf{I}ntent-Guided Multi-\textbf{R}ound \textbf{R}etrieval, enabling LLM agents to maintain evolving historical knowledge and adaptively retrieve relevant evidence. Specifically, \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ constructs a State-Evolving Memory Graph (SEMG) that represents long-term memory as evolving knowledge states supported by temporal event trajectories and evidential associations. By maintaining semantic states through evidence-based updates, SEMG preserves historical evolution and enables evidence tracing under complex and conflicting scenarios. Building upon this, we introduce an intent-guided multi-round retrieval mechanism that iteratively identifies missing evidence and expands retrieval based on accumulated information. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemConflict demonstrate that \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ improves long-term memory utilization, dynamic and static conflict handling, and complex retrieval performance, achieving relative improvements of more than 12\% in certain categories. These results highlight the effectiveness of jointly modeling memory evolution and adaptive evidence acquisition for long-term agent interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出EMIR²框架，通过状态演化记忆图（SEMG）和意图引导的多轮检索机制，解决LLM代理长期记忆中静态表征无法追踪事实变化及证据分散的问题，显著提升长程交互中的记忆利用与冲突处理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体记忆系统常依赖静态记忆表征和单轮检索策略，难以有效利用持续演变的历史信息，导致无法追踪事实变更或整合长周期交互中分散的证据。
AI.method: 构建状态演化记忆图（SEMG），利用时序事件轨迹和证据关联将长期记忆表示为不断演化的知识状态；引入意图引导的多轮检索机制，迭代识别缺失证据并基于累积信息扩展检索范围。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和MemConflict数据集上的实验表明，EMIR²改善了长程记忆利用、动态/静态冲突处理及复杂检索性能，部分类别性能提升超过12%。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模记忆演化过程与适应性证据获取策略，对于增强LLM智能体在长期交互中的表现具有显著有效性。

title: MA-FPPO: Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-agent flow policies learn cooperative behavior from fixed offline datasets, but often struggle to complete tasks in situations not covered by the offline data. In these situations, agents must both adapt to changes in the environment and coordinate with one another, yet action patterns learned offline are often insufficient for effective adaptation and coordination. To address this problem, we propose Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization (MA-FPPO), which uses online fine-tuning to improve the cooperative behavior of models pretrained with flow matching through new interactions with the environment. Building on the behavior learned during pretraining, we construct policies with explicit action likelihoods for discrete and continuous action spaces. We then update the pretrained model using shared team advantages to further improve coordination based on team performance. Our method achieves, on average, relative gains of 52.8% over the strongest listed offline baselines across 30 settings and 29.8% over purely online learning across 38 comparisons with matched online budgets and evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出MA-FPPO方法，通过在线微调解决多智能体在离线数据覆盖范围外环境中协作适应困难的问题，显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于固定离线数据集的多智能体流策略在面对未见环境时，难以有效适应变化并协调行动，导致任务完成率低。
AI.method: 提出多智能体流预训练策略优化（MA-FPPO），利用在线交互对基于流匹配预训练的模型进行微调；构建具有显式动作似然度的策略以支持离散和连续动作空间，并利用共享团队优势更新模型以增强基于团队表现的协调性。
AI.result: 在30个设置中，平均较最强离线基线提升52.8%；在38次对比中，在预算和评估协议匹配的情况下，纯在线学习方法性能提升29.8%。
AI.conclusion: MA-FPPO通过结合预训练知识与在线微调，能有效提升多智能体在复杂未见过情境下的协作适应能力与整体性能。

title: CUA-SWE: When Computer-Use Agents Meet Visual Software Engineering
summary: Software development requires more than editing code: developers repeatedly run software, interact with its interfaces, visually inspect its behavior, and use these observations to decide what to change next and whether a change works. Existing coding agents and computer-use agents are largely studied in isolation, leaving this integrated development process underexplored. Diagnosing a runtime interaction failure requires agents to connect visual observations with the responsible code, then use the application again to verify the repair. We introduce CUA-SWE, a benchmark, environment, and evaluation pipeline for software engineering with computer use. Beyond studying how GUI feedback supports diagnosis and repair, we ask whether agents can complete software engineering tasks when required specification or operational information is available only through the running application's visual interface. CUA-SWE spans four software engineering domains and requires agents to modify code and configuration, execute commands, interact with running software, and inspect visual feedback within the same task. Each task includes deterministic, task-specific tests that verify whether the resulting software satisfies the requirements and preserves specified behavior. Our evaluation characterizes how frontier agents combine source-level execution with application screenshots and graphical interaction to produce verified software changes. We examine performance across domains and task information requirements, alongside the development behaviors associated with successful repairs. CUA-SWE provides a unified testbed for studying how agents use visual feedback and interaction to guide software engineering, with executable correctness criteria for the resulting software.

AI.tldr: CUA-SWE是一个面向软件工程的计算机视觉基准，旨在评估智能体在需要结合代码修改、程序执行与GUI视觉反馈进行交互诊断和修复的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体和计算机使用智能体大多孤立研究，缺乏对包含“运行-观察-诊断-修复”完整闭环的集成开发流程的研究。特别是在运行时失败场景中，智能体需连接视觉观察与相关代码并验证修复效果，这一过程尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出CUA-SWE基准、环境和评估流水线。涵盖四个软件工程领域，要求智能体在同一任务中修改代码/配置、执行命令、与运行中软件交互并检查视觉反馈。每个任务包含确定性、任务特定的测试用例，以验证软件是否符合要求并保持指定行为。
AI.result: 评估了前沿智能体如何结合源码级执行、应用截图和图形交互来生成经过验证的软件更改。分析了不同领域、不同信息需求下的性能表现，以及成功修复背后的开发行为模式。
AI.conclusion: CUA-SWE提供了一个统一的测试平台，用于研究智能体如何利用视觉反馈和指导交互来进行软件工程实践，并提供了可执行的正确性标准来检验最终软件成果。

title: "You're Right, Let Me Fix It": How LLM Agents Damage Correct Work When Falsely Accused
summary: LLM agents increasingly keep working after a task succeeds as they resume after compaction or take over handoffs. Their finished work keeps receiving follow-up input that sometimes falsely accuses it for later failures. We call an agent's acceptance of such a false accusation gaslight sycophancy, and destructive over-correction when acting on it damages previously correct work. We introduce CAVE-Bench, a benchmark of 365 agentic tasks across six domains built around opaque tasks. Every scored run first reaches a verified correct state, whose supporting rationale and history stay in the workspace while the facts that would settle the accusation lie in external or runtime state beyond the agent's reach. The agent cannot confirm or refute the claim with a local check, so the right response should keep the work and ask for the missing evidence. Each task either hands the agent correct work with saved evidence or let it build and verify that work first, and five risk factors set how the accusation enters the workflow. We score accusation acceptance and evidence use from the trajectory and measure harm by deterministic replay of downstream events. Across 14 of the latest models in Claude Code, false accusations damage correct work in up to 60.06% of runs, and stronger models often do so after recovering the supporting evidence. The same model behaves differently across OpenCode, Codex, and Hermes, and a harness gate driven by the benchmark's live signals cuts replayed harm by 74%. These results show that preserving already-correct work under unsupported accusation is a distinct safety challenge for long-lived agents. Our project is in https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-over-correction/.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM Agent在任务完成后仍接收错误指控并破坏已有正确工作的问题，提出了“煤气灯式顺从”（Gaslight Sycophancy）和“破坏性过度修正”概念，并构建了CAVE-Bench基准测试。研究发现，主流模型在面对缺乏证据的指控时极易损害正确工作，最高受损率达60.06%。通过引入基于基准实时信号的闸门机制，可将后续损害降低74%，证明了保护既有正确成果是长寿命Agent的重要安全挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM Agent在任务成功后继续运行或接管交接，其已完成的工作常受到后续输入的错误指控。Agent接受此类虚假指控并进行“过度修正”，往往会破坏原本正确的工作成果。目前缺乏评估这种特定行为及其危害的标准化基准。
AI.method: 作者引入了CAVE-Bench基准，包含6个领域共365个围绕“不透明任务”设计的智能体任务。每个评分流程首先达到经验证的正确状态，相关理据保留在工作区，而能驳斥指控的事实位于外部或运行时状态中，使Agent无法本地确认或反驳。任务设定让Agent要么接手带保存证据的正确工作，要么自行构建并验证。通过轨迹分析评分指控接受度和证据使用情况，并通过下游事件的确定性重演测量危害。
AI.result: 在14款最新Claude Code模型中，虚假指控导致正确工作受损的比例高达60.06%；且更强的模型在恢复支持证据后往往仍会进行破坏性修正。同一模型在不同环境（OpenCode, Codex, Hermes）下表现差异显著。利用基准中的实时信号驱动的闸门机制，可将重演损害减少74%。
AI.conclusion: 在不支持指控的情况下保留已正确的工作成果，是长寿命智能体面临的一个独特的安全挑战。研究结果强调了防止“煤气灯式顺从”和破坏性过度修正的重要性，并为提升Agent鲁棒性提供了基准和解决方案方向。

title: SWE-MILE: Asynchronous Potential-Induced Milestone Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents
summary: Long-horizon software engineering (SWE) agents trained with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically receive only terminal outcome supervision, making it difficult to distinguish productive actions from redundant exploration or functional regressions. We propose SWE-MILE, an asynchronous potential-induced milestone credit assignment framework that derives fine-grained process supervision from workflow runtime, without auxiliary reward models or external evaluators. SWE-MILE quantifies task-relevant file exposure and test-state alignment as navigation and verification potentials, respectively. Differences in these potentials attribute milestone progress and regressions to individual actions, while discounted backward credit propagates supervision to preceding steps. To efficiently acquire intermediate verification states, SWE-MILE further introduces asynchronous shadow probing, which replays repository-changing actions in an isolated sandbox and runs verification in parallel with the agent's primary interaction, largely hiding verification latency. The resulting process credit augments terminal outcome advantages and provides informative learning signals. Experiments on two representative long-horizon SWE tasks demonstrate substantial improvements in agent performance, highlighting workflow runtime signals as a practical source of process supervision for long-horizon SWE agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 SWE-MILE 框架，通过异步影子探测和潜在信用分配，利用工作流运行时数据为长期软件工程代理提供细粒度的过程监督信号。
AI.motivation: 解决基于 RLVR 训练的长期软件代理仅依赖最终结果反馈，导致难以区分有效行动、无效探索或功能退化，且缺乏中间状态反馈的问题。
AI.method: 提出 SWE-MILE：1) 定义文件暴露度和测试状态对齐度为导航与验证潜力；2) 通过潜力的差异归因步骤进展/退化，利用折扣反向信用传播机制生成过程监督信号；3) 采用异步影子探测在隔离沙箱中并行执行验证以掩盖延迟。
AI.result: 在两个代表性长期软件工程任务上实验表明，该框架显著提升了代理性能，证实了利用工作流运行时信号作为过程监督的可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 无需辅助奖励模型或外部评估器，SWE-MILE 能有效从运行态提取过程信号，增强强化学习中的学习反馈，适用于长期软件开发场景。

title: Can Open-Weight Large Language Models (LLMs) Simulate Human Survey Populations? A Cross-Instrument Calibration Study
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate synthetic survey respondents and digital twins of real people, but whether their output preserves real human statistical structure, rather than surface plausibility, remains unresolved, and most existing evidence comes from proprietary models rather than open-weight ones. We evaluate three open-weight LLM families on a cross-instrument calibration task: conditioning personas on real respondents' verbatim answers to one psychometric instrument and measuring them on a second, construct-distance-controlled instrument, checked against a 2,058-person human panel. Across a 139-pair grid, the simulated cross-instrument correlation tracks the real human correlation at r = 0.70 - 0.73 in every model, driven mainly by correct sign rather than precise magnitude and concentrated in pairs of moderate construct distance. A correlation of this magnitude, obtained from untuned open-weight models conditioned only on individual-level survey data, is a substantively encouraging result for LLM-based behavioral simulation and digital-twin applications: specific model families and releases already reproduce a meaningful share of real human cross-instrument structure without any fine-tuning. This capability does not, however, improve monotonically across model releases: on a matched panel, the newest of three tested Llama releases performs worst on two of three headline metrics, so realizing its promise in practice requires release-specific, distance-aware verification rather than a one-time benchmark.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了开源大语言模型（LLM）生成合成受访者的能力，发现模型在跨量表校准任务中能维持0.70-0.73的相关性，有效模拟真实人类统计结构。但该能力并非随模型迭代单调提升，最新模型表现甚至最差，强调需针对特定版本进行验证。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs被广泛用于生成合成调查响应者和数字孪生，但其输出是否真正保留了人类的深层统计结构而非仅表面合理性尚不明确。此外，现有证据多来自封闭权重模型，缺乏对开源模型的系统性评估。
AI.method: 选取三个开源LLM家族，在跨仪器校准任务上进行评估：以真人生成的问卷回答为条件设定角色 Persona，并使用另一构造距离受控的量表测量他们，最后与2058人的真人小组数据对比。涵盖139个配对组合的分析网格。
AI.result: 所有模型生成的模拟跨仪器相关性均与真实人类相关性高度一致（r = 0.70 - 0.73）。这种相关性主要由正确的符号驱动而非精确的大小，且集中在构造距离中等的配对中。未经微调的开源模型已能复现有意义的人类跨仪器结构比例。
AI.conclusion: LLM在行为模拟和数字孪生应用中具有实质性潜力，但能力未随模型发布单调改进（如最新的Llama版本表现最差）。实际应用需要基于特定发布的、考虑构造距离的验证机制，而非一次性基准测试。

title: Business Compromise Detection with Agentic AI and LLM-driven Knowledge Discovery
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 13 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables
summary: Detecting compromised business ad accounts is a challenge in digital advertising, as attackers exploit hijacked accounts to launch fraudulent campaigns. Large Language Model (LLM) agents show promise for integrity enforcement, but hallucinated mistakes on hard cases create business friction. In a study we find the autonomous agent is a strong, recall-heavy signal extractor but an unreliable final arbiter, conceding precision on ambiguous decisions. We therefore keep the agent as an investigator that emits a structured, interpretable signal vector, and delegate the verdict to a neuro-symbolic stage: symbolic rules discovered by Inductive Logic Programming (FOIL-IE), a Naïve Bayes calibration layer, and a data-tuned contradiction layer. Evaluating on a compromise-over-sampled population and a realistic low-prevalence sample with subject-matter-expert labels, this arbiter substitution raises MCC from 0.295 to 0.435 (ΔMCC +0.139, 95% CI [+0.026, +0.245], p=0.018, paired bootstrap), lifting precision from 0.250 to 0.446 (1.8x) at a recall cost (0.920 to 0.660). Benchmarked under identical conditions, it also edge tree ensembles (0.386).The rules encode domain w labels while remaininginterpretable and auditable.

AI.tldr: 为解决LLM在检测被入侵广告账户时因幻觉导致的误判问题，该研究提出将LLM作为“调查员”提取结构化信号，并引入基于归纳逻辑编程（FOIL-IE）规则、朴素贝叶斯校准和数据驱动的矛盾层的神经符号仲裁机制。该方法显著提升了精确率和Matthews相关系数（MCC），优于传统树集成模型，同时保持了决策的可解释性和审计能力。
AI.motivation: 在数字广告中检测被入侵的商业广告账户是一项挑战，攻击者利用劫持的账户发起欺诈活动。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在维护完整性方面显示出潜力，但在复杂案例中的幻觉错误会造成业务摩擦，且其作为最终裁决者时可靠性不足，容易在模糊决策中牺牲精确率。
AI.method: 构建了一个混合架构：1) 使用自主LLM智能体作为“调查员”，输出结构化的、可解释的信号向量；2) 采用神经符号阶段作为最终裁决者，包含三个核心组件：通过归纳逻辑编程（FOIL-IE）发现的符号规则、朴素贝叶斯校准层以及数据调优的矛盾层。
AI.result: 在包含专家标签的真实低流行度样本上进行评估，相比基线，该方法的Matthews相关系数（MCC）从0.295提升至0.435（p=0.018），精确率从0.250提升至0.446（提升1.8倍），尽管召回率从0.920降至0.660。此外，该架构在相同基准测试下优于树集成模型（MCC为0.386）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将LLM从最终裁决者转变为信号提取器，并结合神经符号系统，可以有效平衡检测性能与业务需求。该方法不仅提高了识别广告的准确性和鲁棒性，还保留了规则的可解释性和可审计性，解决了纯LLM方案在关键决策中缺乏可靠性的问题。

title: From Scene Graphs to Answers: Selective Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous-driving question answering requires reasoning over structured scene information, yet existing vision-language approaches largely delegate heterogeneous reasoning operations to a single neural inference process. We argue that this uniform strategy overlooks a fundamental distinction: some queries admit exact symbolic solutions, while others require semantic interpretation. We introduce a query-adaptive neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that explicitly allocates computation according to the nature of the query. At its core is a hierarchical Spatiotemporal Scene Graph (STSG) that separates persistent object identities from frame-specific states and represents spatial relations and temporal transitions as explicit directed structures. Given a query, a symbolic executor first attempts to resolve it through exact graph operations; only when symbolic execution abstains is an LLM invoked for semantic reasoning. For these unresolved queries, query-conditioned graph retrieval and evidence filtering preserve relation direction, temporal locality, and object semantics, providing the LLM with compact and verified task-relevant evidence. This design shifts the role of the LLM from a universal reasoning engine to a targeted semantic reasoner, while allowing deterministic computation to be handled exactly and efficiently. We evaluate the framework on 5,916 NuScenes-QA questions across all ten scenes of nuScenes v1.0-mini under an oracle-perception setting. The complete system achieves 80.63 percent overall accuracy with GPT-5.4-mini, improving over the corresponding LLM-only configuration by 5.48 percentage points; with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the improvement reaches 6.64 points. The largest gains occur on counting questions, with improvements of 10.20 and 12.61 points, respectively. These results show that selective reasoning improves both accuracy and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种查询自适应的神经符号推理框架，通过分层时空场景图（STSG）将精确符号求解与大语言模型（LLM）语义推理分离，仅在符号执行失败时调用LLM，显著提升了自动驾驶问答在准确率和效率上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言方法通常将异构推理操作统一委托给单个神经推断过程，忽略了某些查询可通过精确符号解解决，而另一些则需要语义解释这一根本区别。这种单一策略未能充分利用确定性计算的效率和精确性。
AI.method:
1. 构建分层时空场景图（STSG），区分持久对象身份与帧特定状态，并以有向结构表示空间关系和时间转换。
2. 采用符号执行器尝试通过精确图操作解决查询；若符号执行“弃权”，则调用LLM进行语义推理。
3. 对于未解决的查询，使用查询 conditioned 的图检索和证据过滤，保留关系方向、时间局部性和对象语义，为LLM提供紧凑且经过验证的相关证据。
AI.result:
在nuScenes v1.0-mini的全部十个场景及5,916个NuScenes-QA问题上评估：
- 使用GPT-5.4-mini时，整体准确率达到80.63%，比纯LLM配置提升5.48个百分点。
- 使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash时，提升达6.64个百分点。
- 在计数类问题上增益最大，分别提升10.20和12.61个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 选择性推理机制通过将LLM的角色从通用推理引擎转变为定向语义推理者，并利用确定性计算处理精确问题，不仅提高了准确性，还增强了推理效率。

title: Prediction Limits and Koopman Closure of Geometry-Induced Soft State Abstractions
summary: We study when geometry-induced soft state abstractions admit accurate finite-dimensional linear dynamics. Each state is represented by simplex-valued coordinates obtained from class-specific Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) reconstruction scores, and a matrix is used to predict the next-state coordinates. Our main result is a computable lower confidence bound on the minimum root-mean-square prediction error over all matrices satisfying a prescribed spectral-norm limit. The bound combines within-class variation of successor coordinates with the deviation of soft coordinates from their one-hot reference labels, and can be evaluated from independent state-successor pairs without fitting a prediction matrix. For fixed coordinates and evaluation distribution, the certificate converges almost surely to a population lower bound as the sample size grows; any tolerance below this limit is eventually certified unattainable. Reconstruction-score margins further control the soft-to-hard assignment error. Under deterministic dynamics and exact coordinate closure, eigenvectors of the closure matrix and its reduced transpose induce Koopman and adjoint Koopman eigenfunctions, respectively. A four-state KAHM construction shows that identical soft coordinates can permit exact closure under one dynamics map yet force positive prediction error under another. Experiments on Duffing, Van der Pol, CartPole, MountainCar, and Acrobot compare direct soft-coordinate prediction with state-space DMD/EDMD baselines and report prediction, representation-variation, and spectral diagnostics. The benchmarks assess fitted models but do not numerically evaluate the exclusion certificate.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于几何诱导的软状态抽象如何获得准确的有限维线性动力学模型。通过Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) 重构得分表示状态，并提出了计算最小均方根预测误差的下置信界作为证书，证明了在特定条件下该下限的一致性，并通过多个基准实验比较了直接软坐标预测与DMD/ED基线方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 旨在研究何时几何诱导的软状态抽象（soft state abstractions）能够支持准确的有限维线性动力学近似，以解决从高维或连续状态空间到低维线性模型的映射精度问题。
AI.method:
1. 使用类特定的Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) 重构得分生成单单纯形值的坐标来表示每个状态。
2. 利用矩阵预测下一状态的坐标。
3. 推导并计算满足谱范数限制的所有矩阵中，最小均方根预测误差的可计算下置信界。
4. 该边界结合了后继坐标的类内变异性与软坐标偏离其独热参考标签的程度。
5. 在确定性动力学和精确坐标闭包假设下，分析闭合矩阵的特征向量与Koopman及伴随Koopman特征函数的关系。
6. 构建四状态KAHM示例展示不同动力学映射对闭合性和预测误差的影响。
7. 在Duffing, Van der Pol, CartPole, MountainCar, 和 Acrobot系统进行实验，对比直接软坐标预测与状态空间DMD/EDMD基线。
AI.result:
1. 提出的下置信界可作为预测误差不可低于某一阈值的“证书”，且随着样本量增加几乎必然收敛到总体下界。
2. 重构分数边际控制了软分配到硬分配的误差。
3. 示例表明相同的软坐标在不同动力学映射下可能实现精确闭包或导致正预测误差。
4. 实验评估了预测性能、表示变异性和光谱诊断指标，但未对排除证书进行数值评估。
AI.conclusion: 几何诱导的软状态抽象在一定条件下可以实现准确的有限维线性动力学建模；提出的下置信界提供了一种无需拟合预测矩阵即可评估预测精度的理论工具，尽管实验验证主要集中于性能对比而非证书本身的数值评估。

title: MixBench-TS: A Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Benchmark Where Channel Mixing Pays Off
summary: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF) models that mix information across channels assume that the past of one channel carries information about the future of another. Yet they are evaluated on a small fixed set of standard datasets whose cross-channel structure is rarely examined. We ask two questions: "How can we reliably measure lagged, non-linear, and joint coupling in MTSF datasets?" and "Do the standard datasets actually have such coupling?" To answer the first, we test four candidate measures on synthetic datasets with planted ground-truth coupling: Granger Causality (GC), Transfer Entropy (TE), lagged Mutual Information (MI), and the CD gain, a model-based measure we introduce that compares a channel-dependent (CD) model to its channel-independent (CI) variant. Only lagged MI and the CD gain recover every planted coupling. For the second question, the answer is a definite no, as the standard datasets have a median of only 23% lagged-coupled channel pairs and a median CD gain of -4.9%, compared to 78% and +4.6% on chaotic ODE systems. We therefore propose MixBench-TS, a benchmark of 10 real-world datasets with a median of 55.5% lagged-coupled pairs and a median CD gain of +1.7%. Across six state-of-the-art models tuned under one protocol, CI models win on 10/10 (MSE) and 8/10 (MAE) standard datasets, but on only 3/10 and 2/10 MixBench-TS datasets. We recommend using our benchmark for evaluating new CD models. Moreover, we propose profiling new datasets with lagged MI and the CD gain before using them to evaluate multivariate models. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mixbench-ts-B027.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑主流多变量时间序列预测（MTSF）模型对跨通道信息的假设，指出标准数据集缺乏显著的滞后耦合，并提出了一个新的基准MixBench-TS以评估依赖通道的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的MTSF模型假设不同通道间存在信息混合，但缺乏对标准数据集跨通道结构的有效评估和可靠测量方法。
AI.method: 测试了格兰杰因果、转移熵、滞后互信息（MI）及提出的CD增益四种指标在合成数据上的表现；分析标准数据集与混沌ODE系统的耦合情况；构建包含10个真实世界数据集的MixBench-TS基准，并在该基准上对比通道依赖（CD）与通道独立（CI）模型的性能。
AI.result: 滞后MI和CD增益能准确恢复合成数据中的耦合；标准数据集仅有23%的成对滞后耦合且CD增益为负；MixBench-TS具有55.5%的耦合率；在标准数据集上CI模型占优，而在MixBench-TS上CD模型表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 建议在新数据集用于评估多元模型前，使用滞后MI和CD增益进行画像分析；推荐将MixBench-TS作为评估新型通道依赖模型的基准。

title: World Models with Predictable Long-Horizon Marginals
summary: Accurate one-step predictions do not ensure that a world model's rollouts retain the data distribution. We make the model's decoded stationary law explicit by learning a decoder of a fixed Gaussian reference and constraining the behaviour-averaged transition to preserve that reference. For controlled systems, a joint transition uses a conditional action chart to preserve behaviour occupancy without requiring invariance at each fixed action. Joint state--action rotations and parallel Gaussian noise give an exactly preserving transition with a tractable conditional density. We derive an absolute convergence bound from finite initialization banks and control departure from the reference through conditional action-space divergence. Across $216$ fitted pixel checkpoints on twelve control tasks, the occupancy model with a reference mixture retains every evaluated chain at $10^5$ steps in all $36$ task--seed cells, with a rollout-minus-reference energy-statistic difference of $-0.0002\pm0.0003$ (training-seed standard error). Each of the four nonpreserving comparison arms loses chains, although the Gaussian arm is more accurate at ten steps. An offline DreamerV3 reference also achieves better short-horizon accuracy. These results distinguish three properties of a world model: the distribution it approaches, the rate of approach, and the conditional dynamics it learns.

AI.tldr: 针对世界模型滚动预测分布偏移问题，提出通过固定高斯参考解码器约束转移行为的方法。该方法利用联合旋转和噪声保持行为占用率，在216个像素检查点和12个控制任务中实现了长周期（$10^5$步）的稳定性和极低能量统计差异，优于基准模型。
AI.motivation: 解决现有世界模型中单步准确预测无法保证长期滚动输出保持数据分布一致的问题，旨在确保模型生成的轨迹在长时程内仍符合原始数据分布特性。
AI.method: 构建一个基于固定高斯参考的显式平稳律解码器，并约束行为平均转移以保留该参考；对于受控系统，采用条件动作图表维持行为占用率，结合状态-动作旋转和平行高斯噪声实现精确保持转移及可处理的条件密度推导；通过有限初始化库和条件动作空间发散度量化偏离。
AI.result: 在12个控制任务的216个像素检查点上，所有36个任务-种子组合中的评估链在$10^5$步长内均被保留， rollout与参考的能量统计差异为 $-0.0002\pm0.0003$。相比之下，所有非保持对比组均出现链条丢失，其中仅高斯组在10步时精度较高，离线DreamerV3仅在短视距准确率上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 成功区分了世界模型的三个关键属性：趋向的分布、收敛速率以及学习的条件动力学。研究证明了通过引入参考混合分布并保持行为占用率，可以有效提升世界模型在长时程预测中的分布稳定性。

title: Contract Memory Compiler: Resolve, Then Traverse
summary: External memory lets language-model agents answer questions about histories too long for the answer model's context window. Updates create a harder problem than retrieving a recent fact: changing one relation can redirect a multi-hop question to records about an entity absent from the question. We study this update-dependent evidence selection problem and introduce the Contract Memory Compiler (CMC). Before seeing a question, CMC uses a language model to identify relations in the history and record where each one was stated. It applies later updates to determine the current relations, follows them from entities named in the question, and passes the corresponding original records to the answer model in one call. Thus the current state determines which evidence is read, rather than merely refreshing values in a previously selected context. To the best of our knowledge, CMC achieves state-of-the-art multi-hop accuracy on FactConsolidation, reaching 78.25% overall and 61.0% at 262K. With the extracted relations and answer model held fixed, selecting evidence before resolving updates reduces multi-hop accuracy to 21.50%. We also introduce MQuAKE-MemStream, a derived dataset of ordered memory streams built from MQuAKE-Remastered counterfactual cases.

AI.tldr: 提出Contract Memory Compiler (CMC)，通过先提取历史关系再应用更新来解决长上下文中的动态证据选择难题，在FactConsolidation数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有外部存储机制在处理长历史时面临挑战：简单的记录刷新无法应对因关系变更导致的跨跳（multi-hop）问题重定向，即一个问题可能指向原本未在问题中提及的实体记录。
AI.method: 引入CMC方法：1) 预先使用语言模型识别历史中的关系及其位置；2) 应用后续更新以确定当前关系状态；3) 根据问题中命名的实体跟随当前关系，将对应的原始记录一次性传递给回答模型。
AI.result: 在FactConsolidation数据集上达到78.25%的整体多跳准确率，在262K长度下达到61.0%，为当前SOTA。相比之下，若在未解决更新前选择证据，准确率降至21.50%。同时推出了MQuAKE-MemStream数据集。
AI.conclusion: 基于当前状态确定证据读取方式优于静态上下文刷新，该方法能有效解决长上下文中的动态证据选择问题，显著提升多跳推理准确性。

title: Learning from a Thoughtful Teacher: Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a question-only student with token-level feedback from a teacher given training-only privileged information (PI). OPSD therefore provides dense, on-policy supervision, and is free of a larger external teacher, but its effectiveness rests on how PI is designed and utilized. Our preliminary diagnostics suggest a significant gap between teacher utility and student learnability, where a small fraction of high-disagreement tokens dominate the distillation signal, and short teacher continuations at these positions further expose more explicit PI leakage than transferable correction cues, indicating a strong intent on injecting PI-conditioned shortcuts. We propose Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation (AOPSD), which adapts what information the teacher receives and how strongly its feedback influences learning. AOPSD encodes each solution as a reasoning DAG, orders problems by the student's evolving capability, and reveals only the affordable subgraph and its next frontier as PI. For high-disagreement tokens, AOPSD utilizes short teacher continuations as probes to encourage useful guidance while mitigating PI-conditioned shortcuts among teacher supervisions. On HMMT25, AIME24, AIME25, and BRUMo25, AOPSD achieves 72.5% Pass@8, which is 6.7 percentage points above OPSD and 4.2 above the strongest competing baseline while reducing 15 percentage points of training time at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应在线策略自蒸馏（AOPSD），通过推理有向无环图和问题难度排序解决原有方法中的教师信息泄露问题，显著提升了数学推理任务的性能并降低了训练成本。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）虽然提供了密集的监督信号且无需外部大模型，但其有效性高度依赖特权信息（PI）的设计。初步诊断发现，师生之间存在巨大的可学习性差距：少数高分歧token主导了蒸馏信号，且简短的教师续写导致明显的PI泄露而非可迁移的纠正线索，表现为过度依赖PI条件的捷径。
AI.method: 提出AOPSD方法：1) 将每个解决方案编码为推理有向无环图（DAG）；2) 根据学生不断发展的能力对问题进行排序；3) 仅作为PI揭示可负担的子图和下一个前沿；4) 针对高分歧token，利用简短的教师续写作为探针，以鼓励有用指导并减轻PI条件捷径。
AI.result: 在HMMT25, AIME24, AIME25和BRUMo25基准上，AOPSD实现了72.5%的Pass@8准确率，比OPSD高出6.7个百分点，比最强基线高出4.2个百分点，同时将训练时间减少了15个百分点，且成本更低。
AI.conclusion: AOPSD通过自适应地调整教师接收的信息及其反馈对学习的影响强度，有效解决了OPSD中的信息泄露和捷径依赖问题，在保持高效的同时显著提升了复杂推理任务的性能。

title: Refinement Symmetry in Multimodal Transformers
summary: Attention weights depend on token counts, which change with the representation of a signal. We study refinement symmetry: splitting a representation while preserving content, position, visible context, and total mass should preserve its contribution. Building on proportional and quadrature attention, we show that split invariance forces the local mass factor to be linear for any fixed positive attention kernel, provided that factor is nondecreasing. For changed representations, a physical coupling bounds attention error by separating feature change from weight reallocation. In Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, duplicating half the visual tokens threefold changes 255 of 3,586 MVBench answers under standard attention; measure weighting preserves every answer under matched visibility. Under natural frame resampling, it reduces distributional drift. At twofold merging of a frozen video encoding, a five-seed evaluation shows an all-partition-correct accuracy gain of 1.04 percentage points over global count weighting (average group mass) and 0.93 points over standard attention.
