On Qwen3-14B, RelaxKV provides a stronger quality-TTFT trade-off than ProphetKV across a 5%-30% anchor-ratio sweep, and achieves the best selective results on RULER-MV and LV-Eval at 16K and 32K context lengths. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the importance of recomputation context selection.

AI.tldr: 提出RelaxKV方法，通过联合优化缓存修复目标和重构上下文，解决现有跨请求KV缓存无法捕捉块间交互的问题，显著降低RAG预填充成本并提升长文本处理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Prefix缓存限制了跨请求复用，而位置独立缓存（PIC）忽略了块间交互；现有选择性重构方法虽修复状态但固定使用完整因果前缀作为重构上下文，导致注意力计算冗余。
AI.method: 将选择性缓存修复建模为关于修复目标与重构上下文的联合分配问题。基于用户查询定位层级特定的修复目标，并将重构范围限制在相关上下文内，从而减少注意力计算开销。
AI.result: 在四个解码器模型上，RelaxKV在15%锚点比例下优于ProphetKV的LongBench综合性能；在Qwen3-14B上提供更优的质量-TTFT权衡；在16K/32K长度下的RULER-MV和LV-Eval中取得最佳选择性结果。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化修复目标与上下文选择能有效平衡计算效率与生成质量，证明了重构上下文选择在缓存机制中的关键作用。

title: When Evidence Changes the Subject: Subject-Typed Claim Licensing for Learned Routing
summary: Modern learned systems increasingly combine learned components with search, repair, or external solvers. Benchmarks often measure the resulting end-to-end system, while scientific claims may concern only one component, creating an attribution problem: evidence can fail to support the requested component-level claim while still supporting a positive conclusion about the larger system. Existing evidence-to-claim methods primarily calibrate claim strength. We argue that composite systems require a second dimension: scientific subject. We address this problem with subject-typed claim licensing, which separates weaker conclusions about the requested subject from positive but non-substitutive credit about another subject. We instantiate this idea in SCOPE-Routing for preference-conditioned multigraph routing. Non-authors reproducibly apply the declared semantics; held-out review yields fewer reference-relative upward deviations than unstructured review, while the difference from a strong evidence checklist remains unresolved; and a controlled routing study shows that score-optimal and claim-eligible methods can differ while valid hybrid-system credit is preserved. These results motivate treating claim strength and scientific subject as distinct dimensions of evidence-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 针对混合系统中组件归因问题，提出基于“科学主体”维度的声明许可方法（Subject-typed claim licensing），区分对请求主体的弱结论与其他主体的非替代性认可。
AI.motivation: 解决现代学习系统中证据归属（attribution）难题：现有基准通常评估端到端系统，但科学主张可能仅针对单一组件，导致现有基于证据的声明校准方法无法准确支持特定组件级别的科学主张。
AI.method: 引入“科学主体”作为证据评估的第二维度，实施主体类型声明许可（subject-typed claim licensing）。具体实例化为 SCOPE-Routing 偏好条件多图谱路由方案，通过结构化审查分离不同主体间的证据效力。
AI.result: 1. 非作者可复现所声明的语义；2. 相对于非结构化审查，保留部分审查减少了参考相关向上偏差（尽管与强证据清单的差异尚未解决）；3. 控制实验显示，得分最优方法与声明合格方法可以不同，同时保持有效的混合系统信用。
AI.conclusion: 证明应将“声明强度”和“科学主体”视为基于证据的评估中两个独立的维度，以更准确地评估复合系统中的各组成部分贡献。

title: What Happens During Autonomous Deep Research After the User Steps Away?
summary: In autonomous deep research, a user provides a task and relevant background, then leaves the agent to conduct an extended investigation without further human intervention. We study how this initial user information is reflected in intermediate actions and how these actions relate to final recommendations. We introduce DRaligned, a counterfactual behavioral evaluation framework built on PDR-Bench. By varying one task-relevant user factor while keeping the remaining context fixed, we compare acquisition requests, working drafts, and final reports. Source-grounded extraction, blinded local judgments, and deterministic aggregation yield coarse directional measurements while leaving ambiguous cases unresolved. Our experiments show that strong user-specific delivery can emerge from a largely shared research process: agents investigate similar broad questions but allocate requests differently, and final recommendations distinguish user conditions more clearly than explicit requests do. Reports can also integrate user factors that were not jointly visible during acquisition. In readable draft-to-report comparisons, recommendations often retain their coarse user-specific direction despite substantial rewriting. Final directional differences recur across tested agent models, execution harnesses, and evaluator models, even as execution paths vary. These findings describe how initial user information shapes autonomous research and clarify the relationship between the process an agent follows and the recommendations it delivers.

AI.tldr: 本文引入DRaligned框架，评估自主深度研究中初始用户信息如何影响中间行为和最终建议。实验表明，尽管研究过程相似，但代理能根据用户差异调整请求并生成具有用户特定方向性的最终报告。
AI.motivation: 在自主深度研究中，需探究初始用户信息（任务和相关背景）如何在代理的中间行动中体现，以及这些行动与最终推荐之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出DRaligned框架（基于PDR-Bench），通过固定其他上下文仅改变一个相关用户因素，对比获取请求、工作草稿和最终报告。采用源接地提取、盲审本地判断和确定性聚合进行分析。
AI.result: 1. 强烈针对用户的交付可从大部分共享的研究过程中涌现；2. 代理调查广泛问题相似，但分配请求不同；3. 最终推荐比显式请求更清晰地区分用户条件；4. 报告可整合获取时未共同可见的用户因素；5. 即使重写，粗粒度的用户特定方向性仍保留；6. 不同模型和环境中最终的方向性差异复现。
AI.conclusion: 初始用户信息塑造了自主研究过程，阐明了代理遵循的过程与其交付推荐之间的关系。

title: PPG-LM: A Photoplethysmography-Language Model with Multi-Level Clinical Alignment
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely recorded by clinical monitors and consumer wearables, providing a scalable source of continuous physiological information. These recordings offer an opportunity for physiological assessment at scale, but realizing this potential requires models to learn from both signal-derived physiological supervision and broader clinical context captured in electronic health records (EHRs). This involves aligning information spanning local observations, care events, and entire visits with PPG representations at corresponding temporal scales. However, existing PPG foundation models primarily rely on task-specific prediction heads, while the medical knowledge of large language models does not necessarily translate into waveform understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce PPG-LM, the first PPG-language model family to learn physiological representations from both signal-derived supervision and broader clinical context captured in EHRs. To construct clinically grounded captions, we develop an automatic captioning pipeline that generates segment-, event-, and visit-level descriptions from signal measurements and structured EHR records. We then learn from these pairs through a two-stage framework that first establishes segment-language correspondence through contrastive learning and waveform-conditioned captioning, then extends alignment to events and visits through time-aware aggregation and temporal statement matching. Pretrained on approximately 73k hours of PPG, PPG-LM supports language-based recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and segment captioning. Experiments on MC-MED, MIMIC-III, and VitalDB show improved retrieval and caption factuality over language-model baselines and gains over PPG and time-series foundation models on multiple clinical prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PPG-LM，首个融合心电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号与电子健康记录（EHR）临床语境的图文基础模型，通过自述标签和两阶段对齐学习，实现多尺度生理表征，在检索、描述生成及临床预测任务上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有PPG基础模型主要依赖特定任务的预测头，缺乏对广泛临床上下文的理解；而大语言模型的医学知识难以直接转化为对波形信号的理解。为了利用PPG提供的可扩展连续生理信息潜力，需要建立局部信号观测、护理事件及整体就诊记录与PPG表示在多时间尺度上的对齐。
AI.method: 1. 构建基于自动标注管道生成的临床 grounded captions（从信号测量和结构化EHR生成段级、事件级、就诊级描述）。2. 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段通过对比学习和波形条件captioning建立段-语言对应关系；第二阶段通过时间感知聚合和时间语句匹配将对齐扩展至事件和就诊层面。
AI.result: 在约73k小时PPG数据上预训练。实验显示，在MC-MED、MIMIC-III和VitalDB数据集上，相比语言模型基线，提升了检索能力和描述的事实准确性；相比PPG和时间序列基础模型，在多项临床预测任务中取得了性能增益。
AI.conclusion: PPG-LM成功 bridging 了PPG信号与临床语境之间的鸿沟，证明了结合信号监督与EHR上下文进行多尺度对齐的有效性，为大规模生理评估提供了新工具。

title: EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research
summary: Self-evolving agents aim to turn research feedback into reusable skills, tools, and research rules. Whether these accumulated capabilities continue to improve later research requires controlled evaluation. Long-horizon alpha discovery provides a state-dependent setting: once a new factor enters the portfolio, the predictive information already covered changes, so the value of the same candidate or experience may change over time. We introduce EverMine, an empirical framework for studying self-evolving research capabilities in long-horizon alpha discovery. EverMine decomposes the research state into history (Hist), the current factor portfolio (Frontier), and reusable capabilities (Cap). Under matched resource limits, we compare complete runs with fixed or evolving Cap, and replace Cap while holding Hist and Frontier fixed to estimate the conditional value of accumulated capabilities. We also combine full trajectories with historical-state replay to examine how experience-based decisions affect candidate selection and portfolio outcomes. Across 18 long-horizon trajectories, end-to-end comparisons show no consistent gain from Cap evolution. Across 48 continuation branches from shared Hist and Frontier states, accumulated Cap also does not consistently outperform the initial Cap. Parameter tuning of existing factor structures can still improve the portfolio. In an exploratory replay of two screening batches from one Evolving trajectory, some screened-out candidates have positive marginal value at the original state, yet submitting all screened-out candidates sequentially slightly lowers final portfolio IC in both batches. These results show that candidate value depends on the evolving portfolio and submission order, and motivate evaluating self-evolving research capabilities through end-to-end outcomes, conditional capability value, and the consequences of experience-based decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了EverMine框架，用于在长周期Alpha发现中评估自演进研究能力。实证结果显示，无论是端到端对比还是条件价值评估，累积的演进能力（Cap）并未带来持续优势，且受筛选顺序影响较大，表明需通过综合指标全面评估自演进机制的有效性。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决如何控制评估自演进智能体将研究反馈转化为可复用技能、工具和规则的效果问题，特别是在长周期Alpha发现这种状态依赖设置下，因子进入组合会改变预测信息覆盖范围，导致同一候选经验的价值随时间变化。
AI.method: 提出EverMine实证框架，将研究状态分解为历史（Hist）、当前因子组合（Frontier）和可复用能力（Cap）。在资源匹配限制下，比较固定与演进的Cap的完整运行；固定Hist和Frontier替换Cap以估计条件价值；结合完整轨迹与历史状态重放，考察基于经验的决策对候选选择和组合结果的影响。
AI.result: 18个长周期轨迹的端到端比较显示，Cap演化未带来一致性的增益；48个共享Hist和Frontier状态的分支延续中，累积Cap也未 consistently 优于初始Cap；参数调优现有因子结构仍可有效提升组合表现；部分被剔除候选在原状态具有正向边际价值，但按序提交所有被剔除候选略微降低了最终组合IC。
AI.conclusion: 候选因子的价值取决于不断演进的投资组合及提交顺序，因此评估自演进研究能力应综合考虑端到端结果、条件能力价值以及基于经验的决策后果。

title: Reasoning on the Simplex: Geometric Fixed-Point Models
summary: Looped reasoners spend test-time compute by iterating a weight-tied map, but a small residual does not mean the state is a fixed point when that map lives in unconstrained latent space. We propose Geometric Fixed-Point Reasoning (GFPR), in which the iterated state is the prediction itself: a field of categorical beliefs on a product of simplices, whose argmax is the answer at every step. Because the state is a belief, task structure can be imposed through compact convex relaxations, either as structured readouts or directly in the recurrent state; in the latter case the update remains a continuous self-map, so a fixed point exists for any parameters. At about 7M parameters, GFPR reaches 95.1% exact match on Sudoku-Extreme, 92.0% on Maze-Hard, and 100% sequence accuracy on S_5 length 128, above the published FPRM numbers at the same scale. The same update also trains a 201M language model on FineWeb-Edu in which each site is a distribution over the vocabulary; with 24 Picard steps it is above GPT-2 small on four zero-shot multiple-choice tasks and above GPT-2 medium on ARC-Easy.

AI.tldr: 提出几何不动点推理（GFPR），通过将迭代状态定义为单纯形上的分类信念场，利用凸松弛约束确保固定点的存在性，显著提升了逻辑推理和语言模型的零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 解决循环推理器在不受限的潜在空间中进行权重共享映射迭代时，微小的残差并不保证状态收敛为不动点的问题。
AI.method: 提出几何不动点推理（GFPR），将迭代状态设定为预测本身（即产品单纯形上的分类信念场）。通过结构化读出或在递归状态中直接引入紧凸松弛，将任务结构融入模型，确保更新保持为连续自映射，从而保证任意参数下均存在固定点。
AI.result: 在约7M参数规模下，GFPR在Sudoku-Extreme达到95.1%精确匹配率，在Maze-Hard达到92.0%，在S_5长度128的任务上达到100%序列准确率，优于同规模的FPRM。此外，在201M语言模型训练（FineWeb-Edu）中，经24步Picard步骤后，在四个零样本多项选择题任务上超越GPT-2 small，在ARC-Easy上超越GPT-2 medium。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何约束将信念场作为状态，有效解决了循环推理中的收敛性问题，并在保持模型轻量级的同时实现了卓越的复杂逻辑推理能力和语言建模能力。

title: OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning
summary: Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. We introduce observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC), a framework that defines an admissible class through marginal preservation, information-state safety, branch-local policy randomness, semantic event alignment, and trace-before-oracle replay. We derive a gradient-aware coupling criterion showing that, for marginal-preserving couplings, policy-gradient noise changes are determined by policy-Jacobian-weighted off-diagonal return covariance. This motivates OSCC-Select, a calibration-only selector that chooses among independent, root-only, continuation-only, and fully coupled rollouts using separate safety and gain certificates. Its gain target combines projected gradient noise with measured physical sampling cost and falls back to independent sampling whenever a simultaneous lower confidence bound does not certify improvement. On 100,000 fixed-root Leduc comparisons, the fully coupled CP-GRPO instantiation reduces return-contrast variance from 41.1158 to 18.1441, a 55.87% reduction, while preserving the declared branch marginals. With three actions, OSCC-Select chooses continuation coupling and attains gradient-noise trace 0.0783 versus 0.0917 for return-variance selection. Increasing calibration from 64 to 2,048 groups raises certification from 0.327 to 0.995.

AI.tldr: 提出观察安全的反事实耦合（OSCC）框架，解决非完美信息环境下的策略优化噪声问题。通过梯度感知准则和OSCC-Select选择器，在保持边缘分布安全的前提下显著降低回报对比方差和梯度噪声。实验显示方差降低55.87%，且在多动作场景中优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 标准公共随机数构建在非完美信息环境中存在两大缺陷：一是无效耦合可能暴露隐藏状态、同步内生策略随机性或错配机会事件；二是多动作策略优化中，单纯降低回报对比方差不足以作为目标，优化器依赖于局部策略梯度几何投影后的回报协方差矩阵。现有方法未能有效兼顾这些信息安全性与梯度噪声最小化。
AI.method: 1. 提出观察安全的反事实耦合（OSCC）框架，定义合法耦合类，包含边际保持、信息状态安全、分支局部策略随机性、语义事件对齐和前oracle重放等约束。2. 推导梯度感知的耦合准则，指出对于边际保持的耦合，策略梯度噪声变化由策略雅可比加权的离对角回报协方差决定。3. 设计OSCC-Select选择器，基于独立采样、根耦合、持续耦合和完全耦合四种 rollout，利用安全和增益证书进行选择，目标函数结合投影梯度噪声和物理采样成本，并在无法保证置信下界改进时回退到独立采样。
AI.result: 在100,000次固定根Leduc比较实验中，完全耦合CP-GRPO实例将回报对比方差从41.1158降至18.1441（降低55.87%），同时保持声明的分支边际分布。在三动作场景下，OSCC-Select选择持续耦合，梯度噪声迹为0.0783，优于仅基于回报方差选择的0.0917。校准组数从64增加到2,048时，认证成功率从0.327提升至0.995。
AI.conclusion: OSCC框架通过严格的信息安全和梯度感知准则，有效解决了非完美信息环境下策略优化的噪声问题。OSCC-Select选择器能动态适配最优耦合策略，显著提升样本效率和优化稳定性，为复杂决策环境中的强化学习提供了更鲁棒的 primitives。

title: Dr. Free: You Don't Need Difficulty Rewards for Self-Evolving Search Agents
summary: A central limitation of current data-free self-evolution methods for training search agents is their reliance on difficulty-based proposer rewards. These methods reward a proposer for generating questions that challenge a co-evolving solver, using solver difficulty as a proxy for question quality. Yet difficulty alone is insufficient to distinguish questions that require cross-passage evidence from those that are answerable via simpler shortcuts. In addition, measuring difficulty demands repeated solver rollouts for every candidate question, leading to substantial computational costs. In this paper, we introduce \methodname, the first self-evolving search framework that eliminates difficulty-based proposer rewards and directly optimizes for evidence necessity relative to shortcut contexts. Dr. Free samples relational chains from a knowledge graph and pairs them with aligned passages, giving question generation an explicit multi-hop structure. A generated question receives a positive information-gain reward only when the likelihood of the target answer under the complete evidence passages exceeds the maximum likelihood under all evaluated shortcut contexts. Because this signal is computed from teacher-forced likelihoods, it removes the need for pass-rate estimation and reduces proposer training time by over $7\times$. Experiments on seven open-domain QA benchmarks show that Dr. Free outperforms prior data-free search agents and the supervised baseline, with large improvements on multi-hop QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Dr. Free 是一种新的免数据自我演化搜索框架，通过基于证据必要性的直接奖励机制替代传统的难度反馈，利用知识图谱生成多跳结构问题，显著降低计算成本并提升多跳问答性能。
AI.motivation: 解决现有免数据自我演化方法依赖“难度”作为提议者奖励代理指标的局限性：1）仅凭难度无法区分需要跨段落证据的问题与可利用捷径回答的问题；2）测量难度需对每个候选问题进行多次求解器试错（rollouts），导致高昂的计算成本。
AI.method: 提出 Dr. Free 框架，核心创新包括：1）消除基于难度的奖励，转而优化相对于捷径上下文的证据必要性；2）从知识图谱中采样关系链并与对齐的段落配对，赋予问题生成显式的多跳结构；3）设计信息增益奖励：仅当完整证据段落下目标答案的似然度高于所有评估过的捷径上下文中的最大似然度时，才给予正向奖励；4）利用教师强制（teacher-forced）似然度计算信号，无需通过率估计。
AI.result: 在七个开放域问答基准测试中，Dr. Free 优于现有的免数据搜索代理和监督基线；特别是在多跳问答基准上取得了显著提升；Proposer 训练时间减少超过 7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于证据必要性的直接优化策略和利用知识图谱的多跳结构引导，Dr. Free 有效解决了传统方法中难度指标混淆和计算效率低下的问题，证明了其在复杂推理任务中的优越性。

title: OpenFC: Learning Verification Policies towards Open-Search Fact Checking
summary: Open-search fact checking is not merely retrieval followed by classification, but a sequential decision problem in which every query, source visit, and stopping decision reshapes the evidence available for verification. Yet existing systems often distribute these decisions across predefined pipelines or separately prompted modules rather than learning them as a unified task-specific policy. We introduce \textbf{OpenFC}, a unified verification-policy training framework that post-trains Qwen3-8B as a compact next-action controller over reasoning, evidence acquisition, and stopping. OpenFC learns this policy in two stages. \textbf{Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start (SCCS)} uses a strong training-time supervisor to review post-initial reasoning, tool-use, and stopping proposals before execution, producing reliable trajectories for supervised fine-tuning without access to gold verdicts. \textbf{Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning (VA-RL)} then improves the cold-start policy on unresolved claims through budget-aware tool rewards, label-aware advantage reweighting, and localized response masking. Across six fact-checking benchmarks, OpenFC achieves 70.39\% average accuracy and 63.30\% macro-F1, the highest overall averages among the evaluated methods. Stage-wise ablations further show that SCCS and VA-RL provide complementary gains, supporting the design of the two-stage training framework. These results position OpenFC as a strong and effective framework for open-search fact-checking. We will open-source our code and release the model checkpoints to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenFC框架，通过两步训练法（SCCS冷启动+VA-RL强化学习）将Qwen3-8B优化为统一的事实核查策略控制器，在六个基准测试中取得最高准确率（70.39%）和宏F1（63.30%）。
AI.motivation: 现有开放搜索事实核查系统将检索与分类分离或作为预定义流水线处理，未能将查询、来源访问及停止决策视为统一的任务特定策略进行联合学习。
AI.method: 引入OpenFC框架对Qwen3-8B进行后训练：1) 逐步校准冷启动 (SCCS)，利用强监督者在执行前审查推理、工具使用和停止提议以生成可靠轨迹进行监督微调；2) 验证感知强化学习 (VA-RL)，通过预算感知工具奖励、标签感知优势重加权和本地化响应掩码优化未决声明的冷启动策略。
AI.result: 在六个事实核查基准上实现70.39%平均准确率和63.30%宏观F1分数，均为所评估方法中的最高水平；消融实验证明SCCS和VA-RL提供互补增益。
AI.conclusion: OpenFC是面向开放搜索事实核查的强大且有效的框架，其代码和模型检查点将开源以支持可重复性研究。

title: JustQuant: You Don't Need Smoothing, SVD, or Rotation for 4-Bit Activation Quantization
summary: Recent generative models have become increasingly powerful, but their inference cost continues to grow. Model quantization offers a promising way to compress these models and accelerate inference. However, at 4 bits, activation quantization is substantially more challenging than weight quantization. Recent post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) methods have made progress in 4-bit activation quantization by introducing smoothing, SVD branches, rotations, mixed precision, or advanced formats such as NVFP4. These additional operators and data types impose demanding requirements on inference engines and hardware, limiting the broad adoption of low-precision models. Can quantization be achieved using only plain low-bit operators? To answer this question, we propose JustQuant, a simple yet effective framework that moves the complexity of low-bit quantization from deployment-time operators into the training process. We first revisit model quantization from the perspective of knowledge distillation and show that a key reason existing PTQ and QAT methods fail is that they typically exploit supervision at only a single level. We then introduce Theseus QAD, a quantization-aware distillation method that progressively applies multi-level supervision, analogous to the gradual replacement process in the Ship of Theseus. Extensive experiments on DiT and diffusion large language models show two distinct regimes. For smaller models, Theseus QAD can serve as a lightweight warm-up stage that substantially improves subsequent QAT with plain operators, while naive QAD may collapse in the same setting. For larger models, Theseus QAD provides a stronger distillation training path than ordinary QAD. Across both regimes, JustQuant improves low-bit quantization quality while avoiding the complex operators required by many existing PTQ methods.

AI.tldr: 提出JustQuant框架和Theseus QAD方法，通过知识蒸馏的多层级监督解决低比特激活量化难题，避免部署时复杂算子。
AI.motivation: 现有4位激活量化方法依赖平滑、SVD分支、旋转或混合精度等复杂算子，对推理引擎和硬件要求高，限制了低精度模型的广泛采用；旨在实现仅使用普通低比特算子的量化。
AI.method: 提出JustQuant框架，将低比特量化复杂度从部署时转移至训练过程。引入Theseus QAD（基于Ship of Theseus渐进式替换理念的量化感知蒸馏方法），通过逐步应用多层级监督来解决单级监督导致的优化失败问题。
AI.result: 在DiT和扩散大语言模型上验证：对于较小模型，Theseus QAD作为轻量级预热阶段显著提升后续普通算子QAT效果（防止坍塌）；对于较大模型，提供比普通QAD更强的蒸馏训练路径。整体提升了低比特量化质量并规避了复杂PTQ算子。
AI.conclusion: Theseus QAD能有效改进低比特量化质量，通过简化推理时的算子需求促进了低精度模型的实用化部署。

title: Supervision Recovery for Time Series Anomaly Detection via Context-Anchored Pairing
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) remains challenging not only because anomaly labels are scarce, but also because temporal anomalies are highly context-dependent. Existing methods often rely on unsupervised objectives or surrogate abnormal patterns, providing limited supervision for context-dependent normal--anomalous distinctions. We propose Context-Anchored Pair Supervision (CAPS), a supervision-recovery framework for TSAD. CAPS views ideal anomaly supervision as a matched comparison between normal and anomalous outcomes under the same temporal context, and seeks to recover such supervision without target-domain anomaly labels. Using simulated normal--anomalous pairs, CAPS learns structure and anomaly-semantic representations through reconstruction, background consistency, and within-pair counterfactual recombination. The resulting anomaly representations form a continuous semantic space with coarse modes and induce a sampleable multimodal prior. CAPS conditionally realizes sampled semantics as residual-form effects on target reference trajectories. The resulting context-anchored normal--anomalous counterparts provide temporal supervision for discriminative detector learning. Experiments on nine datasets show that CAPS achieves the strongest aggregate performance across all four evaluation metrics among the compared methods, while complementary ablations and transfer analyses support the roles of context anchoring, semantic disentanglement, and conditional realization.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为上下文锚定对监督（CAPS）的时间序列异常检测框架，通过模拟正常-异常配对恢复上下文相关的监督信号，显著提升了检测性能。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测面临标注稀缺及异常具有高度上下文依赖性的挑战。现有方法多依赖无监督目标或代理异常模式，缺乏针对上下文区分正常与异常的充足监督。
AI.method: 提出上下文锚定对监督（CAPS），利用模拟的正常-异常配对，通过重构、背景一致性及配对内反事实重组学习结构与异常语义表示；构建连续语义空间以生成多模态先验，并将采样语义条件化为残差形式作用于目标参考轨迹，从而生成用于判别式检测器学习的上下文锚定正常/异常对应样本。
AI.result: 在九个数据集上的实验表明，CAPS在所有四项评估指标中均取得了对比方法中最强的综合性能；消融实验和迁移分析验证了上下文锚定、语义解耦及条件化实现的作用。
AI.conclusion: CAPS有效解决了上下文依赖性导致的监督缺失问题，为时间序列异常检测提供了强有力的监督恢复框架。

title: EAT: Expert Account Tracker for Efficient MoE Inference
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as a revolutionary method to scale Transformer models. However, traditional MoE architecture still suffers from inefficiency since a large number of experts are unnecessarily activated. Existing approaches for reducing the number of activated experts often overlook the historical performance of each expert. In this paper, we propose EAT, a novel method called Expert Account Tracker (EAT), which utilizes history-awareness metrics and adaptive thresholding to dynamically select the most important experts, thereby reducing the activated expert number while effectively maintaining the model performance. Experiments show that EAT outperforms the existing baseline Top-P method across multiple models and datasets, achieving over 25% an average reduction compared to the vanilla method in the number of activated experts and performing better token generation speed compared to the baseline. Furthermore, the performance of pruned models can be efficiently recovered via OPD using only 9K data. Additionally, through ablation studies, we find that excessively reducing the number of activated experts can significantly harm model performance, and the importance of experts varies across layers, with higher-level experts being generally more critical.

AI.tldr: 提出EAT（专家账户追踪器）方法，通过历史感知度量和自适应阈值动态选择重要专家，显著减少激活专家数量并提升生成速度，同时保持模型性能。
AI.motivation: 传统MoE架构因大量不必要激活的专家而存在效率低下问题；现有优化方法常忽视每个专家的历史表现。
AI.method: 引入EAT方法，利用历史感知度量和自适应阈值技术，动态筛选最关键专家以减少计算开销。
AI.result: 相比Top-P基线和多专家基线，EAT实现平均25以上的激活专家减少率， Token生成速度更快；仅需9K数据通过OPD即可高效恢复剪枝模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 过度减少激活专家会损害模型性能；不同层级专家的重要性存在差异，高层级专家通常更为关键。

title: ParaAgent: Reinforcing Parallel Acting in Open-World Tool Environments
summary: Language model agents are increasingly deployed in open-world tool environments, which require balancing exploring unknown capabilities and exploiting known ones. Existing methods face a performance-efficiency tradeoff: they either rigidly decouple exploration and execution or interleave them without coordination. We argue that the key lies not in whether to decouple or interleave them, but in how to coordinate them across granularities. We introduce ParaAct, a structured parallel-action loop that combines phase-level Exploration $\rightleftharpoons$ Execution with action-level parallelism. To learn this loop, ParaAgent combines multi-agent cold-start demonstrations with reinforcement learning under multi-level advantage decoupling, making planning structure explicit and supervising it with step-, phase-, and trajectory-level rewards. Learning is supported by our ToolEnv, a scalable simulator grounded in 50,011 realistic tool interfaces. On two open-world tool benchmarks, ParaAgent-4B achieves the best average success among all baselines, including GPT-4.1 systems, with the largest gains on multi-tool tasks. Behavioral analyses show that these gains stem from this action organization, highlighting its importance for capable and efficient open-world agents.

AI.tldr: 提出ParaAgent，通过结构化并行动作循环（结合阶段级探索/执行与动作级并行性）及多级优势解耦强化学习，在开放世界工具环境中平衡探索与利用，显著提升多工具任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型代理在开放世界工具环境中面临性能与效率的权衡困境：要么僵化解耦探索与执行，要么无协调地交错进行。关键在于跨粒度协调二者，而非单纯选择解耦或交错策略。
AI.method: 引入ParaAct结构化并行动作循环，结合阶段级探索⇌执行与动作级并行性；采用ParaAgent架构，融合多智能体冷启动演示与多级优势解耦强化学习，通过步级、阶段级和轨迹级奖励显式规划结构并施加监督；基于包含50,011个真实工具接口的ToolEnv模拟器支持训练。
AI.result: 在两个开放世界工具基准测试中，ParaAgent-4B取得所有基线（包括GPT-4.1系统）中最高的平均成功率，且在多工具任务上增益最大；行为分析表明性能提升源于其动作组织方式。
AI.conclusion: 该动作组织结构对构建能力强大且高效的开放世界代理至关重要，为探索与利用的协调提供了有效范式。

title: Trajectory Unlearning on LLM-based Agents
summary: Existing large language model (LLM) unlearning has focused primarily on removing specific knowledge, such as harmful facts, private data, or copyrighted content. However, as LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, a fundamental yet overlooked problem emerges: beyond suppressing what an agent knows, an agent should not reproduce undesired behaviors through its action trajectories. In this work, we introduce trajectory-level unlearning, a new problem formulation that targets the removal of specific action trajectories in long-horizon agentic tasks, rather than factual knowledge. We identify two fundamental challenges that distinguish trajectory unlearning from knowledge unlearning: (1) our unlearning target is what the agent \emph{does}, not what it \emph{says}; and (2) trajectories are sequentially dependent action sequences that cannot be decomposed into isolated prompt-response pairs without losing inter-step structure. To address these challenges, we propose Group-injected Relative Policy Optimization (GiRPO), which injects forget trajectories into the policy rollout group with penalized rewards and isolates the normalization statistics, yielding a stable and bounded unlearning signal that does not corrupt gradient updates for normal task trajectories. We construct trajectory unlearning benchmarks from two application scenarios, household tasks (ALFWorld) and online shopping (WebShop), and design three complementary metrics for evaluating forgetting quality and model utility. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that GiRPO effectively unlearns target trajectories while preserving task success rates, outperforming existing knowledge-unlearning baselines on both forgetting quality and task utility.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹级遗忘（Trajectory-level Unlearning）新范式，通过GiRPO算法解决智能体在不损害任务性能的前提下移除特定行为序列的问题，填补了现有LLM遗忘研究仅关注知识层面的空白。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）作为自主智能体部署，现有遗忘技术主要关注移除有害事实、隐私数据等“知识”，忽略了智能体可能通过行动轨迹复现不当行为的根本问题。需从“说什么”转向关注“做什么”。
AI.method: 提出Group-injected Relative Policy Optimization (GiRPO)算法。通过将遗忘轨迹注入策略 rollout 组并施加惩罚奖励，同时隔离归一化统计量，产生稳定且有界的遗忘信号，避免干扰正常任务轨迹的梯度更新。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld（家务任务）和WebShop（在线购物两个基准上构建轨迹遗忘数据集，使用三项互补指标评估。实验表明GiRPO能有效遗忘目标轨迹，同时保持任务成功率，在遗忘质量和任务实用性上均优于现有的知识遗忘基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级遗忘解决了智能体行为序列的顺序依赖性及动作与言论的本质区别问题。GiRPO为LLM智能体的安全控制提供了新的技术手段，证明可以在不损失核心能力的前提下有效抑制undesired behaviors。

title: Scalable and Data-Driven Decision Support in the Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul Process
comment: Published in: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management (IEEM)
summary:
Several businesses apply maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) principles to the life-cycle of their existing products. In cases like casted gas turbine component Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), repairing components in frequent intervals can extend the lifetime expectation of the product, provide higher cost efficiency compared to newly produced components, and even improve the part design during the repair cycle. Another aspect of repair concerns sustainability, as products often contain rare materials. The emissions produced by the repair process are usually smaller than mining materials and casting new components.
  To optimize the repair process further, we propose the Smart Expert System (SES), which assists engineering experts with machine learning-based decision support throughout the repair process. We elaborate on its IT architecture and present machine learning models employed for representative MRO use cases. The SES is evaluated using actual industry data from a leading gas turbine company and demonstrably fulfills formulated requirements concerning the suitability of the overall decision support and the stability of the enclosing IT architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的智能专家系统（SES），用于优化燃气轮机部件的维修、修理和大修（MRO）流程，通过实际工业数据验证了其决策支持的有效性和IT架构的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的MRO实践虽能延长产品寿命并提高成本效益，但在维护、修复过程中仍存在优化空间；同时，修复过程比新材料开采和铸造更具可持续性优势，因此需要进一步优化工具以支持工程专家的决策。
AI.method: 提出了智能专家系统（SES），构建了其IT架构，并开发了适用于代表性MRO用例的机器学习模型进行决策支持；利用一家领先燃气轮机公司的真实工业数据对SES进行评估。
AI.result: 系统在总体决策支持的适用性以及外围IT架构的稳定性方面满足了既定要求，证明了其在实际工业场景中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 智能专家系统（SES）能够有效辅助工程专家优化MRO流程，结合机器学习与稳健的IT架构，提升了维修决策的效率与可靠性。

title: Probe to Act: Elevating Browser-Use Agent via Active Visual Probing
summary: Browser-use agents require seamless alignment between structured web metadata and visual information, while preserving relevant context across long interactions. Existing interfaces often rely on either screenshot-level action prediction or static Set-of-Marks overlays, leaving the model to resolve dense DOM-pixel alignment before every operation. We introduce Probe to Act (P2A), an active probing framework for the browser-agent loop that moves this alignment into decision time. P2A addresses an asymmetric bridge between symbolic DOM hypotheses and screenshot layout by rendering on-demand symbolic DOM structure back into pixels. Before committing a state-changing browser operation, the agent can issue lightweight probes to translate DOM handles into pixel evidence, map screen regions back to DOM candidates, register visual-only targets, and commit verified notes. These interleaved processes naturally produce evidence-based memory: only probed, acted-on, or explicitly committed observations are kept across steps, preserving only decision-critical evidence in long-horizon contexts. P2A can be used as a prompting strategy for proprietary models under the standard DOM+SoM interface, and can be distilled into open-weight models through cold-start synthesis and self-bootstrapped SFT. Across three browser-use benchmarks, P2A shows clear gains on task success rate for both proprietary and fine-tuned models; on VisualWebArena, for example, it improves Gemini-3-Pro from 54.1% to 61.2% and Qwen3-VL-8B from 24.6% to 32.9%, while matching the costly full-observation history ($\sim$3$\times$) at only $\sim$1.2$\times$ the peak retained input context of action-only history.

AI.tldr: 提出P2A（Probe to Act）框架，通过在决策阶段动态将DOM结构渲染为像素来优化浏览器代理的视觉-符号对齐，利用按需探测和证据记忆机制，在显著降低上下文开销的同时提升了多种模型在浏览器任务中的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器代理接口依赖截图级动作预测或静态标记覆盖，导致模型在每次操作前需处理密集DOM与像素的对齐问题，难以在长交互中保持相关语境，且存在符号假设与视觉布局之间的非对称障碍。
AI.method: 引入主动探测框架P2A，在执行状态改变操作前，通过轻量级探针将DOM句柄转换为像素证据、将屏幕区域映射回DOM候选项、注册纯视觉目标并记录已验证信息。该过程基于“仅在 probing 后执行的动作或明确承诺的观察才被保留”的原则，构建证据导向的记忆机制。P2A既可作为专有模型的提示策略，也可通过冷启动合成和自我引导的监督微调蒸馏至开源模型。
AI.result: 在三个浏览器使用基准测试中，P2A显著提升了专有模型和微调模型的任务成功率。例如在VisualWebArena上，Gemini-3-Pro成功率从54.1%提升至61.2%，Qwen3-VL-8B从24.6%提升至32.9%。同时，该方法仅需约1.2倍的峰值输入上下文占用，即可媲美成本高得多的完整观察历史记录方法。
AI.conclusion: P2A通过将在地对齐转化为决策时间内的主动探测，有效解决了浏览器代理中视觉与符号信息的整合难题，实现了高效率、高准确率的长程浏览器操作控制。

title: AgentBoundary: Counterfactual Evaluation of Safety in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) in conversational settings is largely framed around whether to answer or refuse a request. In agentic settings, however, the same models must decide whether to act as permission-critical evidence emerges during execution. This creates a distinct challenge: apparent risk, action permissibility, and task competence are easily confounded, making agentic over-refusal difficult to distinguish from ordinary task failure. To address this, we introduce AgentBound, the first four-way counterfactual generation-and-evaluation framework for tool-using agent safety. AgentBound transforms the same executable workflow by independently varying apparent risk and action permissibility, enabling controlled comparisons of risky-looking but authorized tasks and routine-looking but unauthorized tasks. These comparisons jointly diagnose over-refusal and unsafe compliance while controlling for task competence. We instantiate AgentBound as a human-validated 4,000-task evaluation suite with trajectory-based and post-state-based judgments. Across 17 model and harness configurations, high safety frequently coexists with poor authorized-task completion: GPT-5.5 blocks 99.5\% of routine-looking unauthorized actions yet completes only 28.7\% of risky-looking authorized tasks. We further train a lightweight runtime calibration module that improves authorized-task completion by 18.2\% on average across 10 evaluated configurations, while improving unsafe-action blocking by 5.4\% on average. These show that effective agentic alignment requires action decisions to track permission-relevant execution evidence, rather than refusal strength alone.

AI.tldr: 提出了AgentBound框架，解决大模型在智能体设置中的“过度拒绝”问题，通过四维反事实生成与评估分离风险感知与权限许可，并训练校准模块提升平衡性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐多关注对话场景下的回答或拒绝，而在智能体（agentic）场景中，模型需在执行过程中基于证据决定行动。这导致表观风险、行动许可性和任务能力相互混淆，使得难以区分“过度拒绝”与正常的任务失败。
AI.method: 引入AgentBound，首个用于使用工具的智能体安全的四路反事实生成与评估框架。通过独立变化同一可执行工作流中的“表观风险”和“行动许可性”，控制任务能力变量，从而对比分析“看似危险但被授权”的任务与“看似普通但未获授权”的任务。构建包含4,000个任务的验证评估集，采用轨迹和后状态判定方法。
AI.result: 在17种模型配置中，高安全性常伴随授权任务完成率低：GPT-5.5阻止了99.5%的看似普通的未授权行动，但仅完成了28.7%的看似危险的已授权任务。开发的轻量级运行时校准模块使授权任务完成率平均提升18.2%，未授权行动阻止率平均提升5.4%。
AI.conclusion: 有效的智能体对齐要求行动决策必须追踪与权限相关的执行证据，而不能仅依赖单一的拒绝强度。

title: Audit-First VAPO: Risk-Certified Selective Updates under Imperfect Verification
summary: Imperfect verifiers can assign a harmful update direction even when clipping and regularization bound its magnitude. We introduce Audit-First VAPO, which separates discrete directional admission from continuous magnitude control. An observation-only accept-appeal-abstain policy uses a finite secondary-verification budget; its action trace is frozen before clean labels are joined. Simultaneous finite-sample bounds then certify selected harmful risk, coverage, and verifier-call rate over a predeclared policy family. Conditional Hoeffding-Azuma bounds account for the dependence induced by shared budgets, and rollout or verifier changes initiate a new certification stage. After admission, a bounded trust-clip-KL actuator controls magnitude. We evaluate two models on two reasoning benchmarks against static RLVR, matched-random selection, confidence thresholding, noise correction, and verifier augmentation. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and GSM8K at target risk $ρ=0.08$, RC-VAPO achieves 74.1% accuracy, selected harmful risk 0.0697, coverage 0.4125, and relative verifier cost $1.16\times$. At matched coverage and update magnitude, its selected-risk difference from matched random is -0.0260 with paired 95% interval $[-0.0364,-0.0157]$. Across asymmetric, confidence-dependent, and correlated-verifier noise, the certificate is satisfied on 57 of 60 independent runs. These comparisons isolate informative directional selection from proposal suppression, update shrinkage, and additional verifier computation.

AI.tldr: 提出Audit-First VAPO框架，通过分离方向选择与幅度控制，在有限二次验证预算下，利用条件Hoeffding-Azuma界限保证有害风险控制、覆盖率和验证调用率的理论上限。
AI.motivation: 解决不完美的验证器可能在裁剪和正则化限制幅度的情况下，仍赋予有害更新方向的问题；旨在从提议抑制和幅度收缩中隔离出信息性的方向选择优势。
AI.method: 引入“审计优先”策略，采用仅观察的接受-上诉/放弃政策，利用有限的二次验证预算进行离散方向准入控制，并在结合干净标签前冻结动作轨迹。随后应用同时有限样本界限认证风险等指标。 Admission后，使用有界信任-clip-KL执行器控制连续幅度。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-0.8B和GSM8K基准上，RC-VAPO在目标风险0.08下实现74.1%准确率，选定有害风险为0.0697。相比随机匹配，其选定风险差异显著负向（-0.0260）。在多种噪声场景下，证书在60次独立运行中的57次得到满足，优于静态RLVR及多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效实现了方向选择的可控性，在保证理论风险界限的同时提升了推理准确性，证明了分离离散方向控制与连续幅度控制的优越性。

title: CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents
summary: Automatically generated environments provide a scalable source of interaction data for training general agents. However, existing approaches mainly generate tasks within a single environment, while real-world workflows require agents to connect information and actions across multiple services. We introduce Compositional Environment Scaling (\textbf{CompoWorld}), which expands the task space by composing a finite library of reusable services. Coding agents turn tool specifications into verified services with typed states and shared interfaces, while a world model handles tools that cannot be reliably implemented. A random-walk procedure connects services through dependency graphs, enabling the generation and verification of tasks that require information to flow across services. Verified trajectories support supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while our Completion-Focused Rubric Reward guides reinforcement learning (RL) toward full task completion by emphasizing criteria with lower pass rates within each rollout group. We construct 448 services exposing 10,130 tools and use 3K SFT trajectories and 1K RL tasks to train Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Experimental results show that CompoWorld improves on its backbone by 9.17 points on average across eight benchmarks. On AutomationBench, it surpasses frontier models such as Claude Opus 4.6 and leads all compared agent-specialized 35B-A3B models.

AI.tldr: 提出CompoWorld框架，通过组合可重用服务构建复杂多环境任务空间，利用SFT和基于完成导向奖励的RL训练智能体，显著提升了跨服务信息流动任务的解决能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自动生成的环境多在单一场景内生成任务，无法模拟现实世界中需要跨多个服务连接信息和操作的复杂工作流程。
AI.method: 1. 通过编程代理将工具规范转化为具有类型化状态和共享接口的已验证服务；2.使用世界模型处理难以可靠实现的工具；3.通过依赖图随机游走过程连接服务，生成跨服务任务并验证轨迹；4.采用监督微调（SFT）和专注于任务完成的评分奖励强化学习（RL）进行训练。
AI.result: 构建了包含10,130个工具的448个服务，使用3K SFT轨迹和1K RL任务训练Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型。在八个基准测试中平均提升9.17分，在AutomationBench上超越Claude Opus 4.6等前沿模型及所有同规模的专用智能体模型。
AI.conclusion: CompoWorld通过组合式环境缩放有效解决了跨服务工作流的建模问题，显著增强了通用智能体在复杂真实场景下的表现。

title: RSD-Poker: Structure-Adaptive and Shift-Robust Risk-Utility Certification for Residual Policies in Imperfect-Information Games
summary: Residual policy adaptation provides a lightweight way to modify a strong reference policy, but a shared scale and a fixed subgroup partition can hide heterogeneous degradation and become fragile when the deployment mixture of information states changes. We introduce RSD-Poker, a structure-adaptive and shift-robust certification framework that freezes a bank of residual families and scales, learns a policy-visible partition on an independent structure split, and freezes that partition before calibration labels are joined. Each candidate-group pair receives a weighted simultaneous upper certificate for anchor-relative risk and a lower certificate for weak-response utility. A robust group-to-candidate map is then selected over a predeclared uncertainty set of deployment group proportions. Under independent calibration units drawn from each frozen group's law, a candidate bank and partition fixed before calibration, and invariant within-group conditionals, the selected map satisfies its declared mixture-robust risk budget and utility certificate with probability at least $1-ζ_{risk}-ζ_{util}$. The information contract supports both a teacher-backed transform and a teacher-free observation-only student. The retained deterministic 24-state audit remains an exact replay diagnostic: empirical-zero selects $α=0.08$, raising the weak-response proxy from 4.2082 to 4.2889 with $0/12$ held-out threshold crossings. On stratified held-out states, the learned-partition dual selector raises weak utility from 4.4074 under global dual certification to 4.4936 and lowers held-out violation from 0.0215 to 0.0078; its mixture-robust variant reaches violation 0.0059. Across five observation-only checkpoints, risk-calibrated residuals attain weak utility $4.3659\pm0.0177$ and violation rate $0.0178\pm0.0057$.

AI.tldr: 提出RSD-Poker框架，解决残差策略适应中因固定分区和共享缩放导致的异构退化问题。通过冻结残差族与分组、学习结构自适应分区及混合鲁棒映射，在部署状态分布变化下提供风险预算与效用证书保证，实现零教师或强教师支持下的策略校准，显著提升弱响应效用并降低违规率。
AI.motivation: 现有的残差策略适应方法使用共享缩放因子和固定的子组划分，容易掩盖异构退化现象，并且在部署时的信息状态分布发生变化时显得脆弱，缺乏对分布偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 引入RSD-Poker框架：1) 冻结残差族和缩放参数；2) 在独立结构拆分上学习对策略可见的分区，并在校准标签接入前冻结该分区；3) 为每个候选-组对提供锚点相对风险的加权同步上限证书和弱响应效用的下限证书；4) 在预声明的部署组比例不确定集上选择鲁棒的“组到候选”映射；5) 支持教师支持的变换和仅观察的学生两种模式。
AI.result: 1) 理论保证：在校准条件下，所选映射以至少 $1-ζ_{risk}-ζ_{util}$ 的概率满足声明的混合鲁棒风险预算和效用证书；2) 实证结果：确定性审计显示弱响应代理从4.2082提升至4.2889（无阈值跨越）；分层保持外状态测试中，学习分区双选择器将弱效用从4.4074提升至4.4936，违规率从0.0215降至0.0078，混合鲁棒变体违规率达0.0059；5个仅观察检查点上，风险校准残差达到弱效用 $4.3659\pm0.0177$ 和违规率 $0.0178\pm0.0057$。
AI.conclusion: RSD-Poker是一种结构自适应且对分布偏移鲁棒的认证框架，有效解决了传统残差策略适应方法的脆弱性问题，在理论和实证层面均实现了更优的风险-效用平衡，适用于不同依赖背景的策略校准场景。

title: Auditing Agent Actions through Query-Conditioned Attribution
summary: LLM agents increasingly take consequential actions through interactions with users, policies, and external tools. Auditing these agents requires automated attribution of realized actions to their historical basis. However, existing attribution formulations do not provide question-specific traces for diverse auditing objectives. Additionally, when access to the acting model is limited (e.g., in API-only deployments), applicable methods commonly rely on costly input perturbations or external LLM analysis of complete trajectories. We therefore formulate $\textit{query-conditioned agent action attribution}, a new task that takes a natural-language auditing query as input and recovers the source and ordered intermediate evidence for the query-specified aspect of an action. We instantiate this task with $A^3Bench$, a benchmark comprising 1,396 auditing queries across policy basis, parameter provenance, failure propagation, and unsafe-behavior tracing. To enable efficient, query-specific attribution, we use small open-weight models as attribution proposers that combine query-conditioned gradient saliency with query-semantic relevance to rank history units. Our proposer consistently achieves stronger source and evidence rankings at lower inference cost than open-weight baselines, improving source MRR by up to 40.9\% and evidence MAP by 42.1\% with only two forward passes and one backward pass. Controlled evaluations confirm that our proposer improves attribution specificity by adapting its rankings to fine-grained changes in the auditing query. Building on a proposer ensemble, our end-to-end system surpasses the strongest frontier-model baseline in source accuracy (64.5\% vs.\ 60.4\%) while reducing empirical deployment latency by 29.9\% relative to the fastest frontier API baseline. Code and data will be released after the initial review period following final validation and cleanup.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的LLM智能体审计任务“查询条件化的智能体行为归因”，并通过结合小模型梯度显著性和语义相关性，实现了比前沿大模型更高效、更精准的根源追溯和证据排序。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法无法提供针对特定审计目标的细粒度追踪；且在仅API访问受限场景下，现有方法依赖高成本的输入扰动或外部LL分析完整轨迹，效率低下且成本高昂。
AI.method:
1. 定义新任务：查询条件化的智能体行为归因，输入自然语言审计查询，恢复动作来源及有序中间证据。
2. 构建基准：$A^3Bench包含1,396个审计查询。
3. 设计核心模块：使用小型开源模型作为“归因提议者”，结合查询条件化梯度显著性与查询语义相关性对历史单元进行排名。
4. 构建端到端系统：基于提议者集成，形成最终审计系统。
AI.result:
1. 效率与性能提升：仅用2次前向传播和1次反向传播，相比开源基线，来源MRR提升最高40.9%，证据MAP提升42.1%。
2. 具体性验证：证明能根据审计查询的细微变化调整排名，提高归因特异性。
3. 整体优势：端到端系统在来源准确率上超越最强前沿模型基线（64.5% vs 60.4%），同时部署延迟比最快前沿API基线降低29.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入轻量级模型结合梯度和语义信息的方法，有效解决了LLM智能体审计中成本与精度的权衡问题，为受限访问环境下的自动化归因提供了高效解决方案。

title: SWE-Game: Can Coding Agents Build the Games We Want?
summary: We introduce SWE-Game, a benchmark of 247 tasks grounded in 41 executable reference Godot games spanning 13 gameplay categories in 2D and 3D. Five task types cover development from a brief, implementation from a game design document, skeleton completion, repair of 83 injected-fault cases, and Godot-to-Unity porting. Reference materials specify the intended gameplay, while a shared instrumentation interface lets evaluator-owned drivers and probes execute actions and observe independently implemented games. Evaluation combines engine-state checks, certified reference-input replay, and agent-authored feature demonstrations to assess mechanic correctness, demonstrated playability, and behavioral restoration and preservation after repairs. Game-specific vision-language rubrics separately assess presentation. Across six models, Opus5 achieves the highest overall score in all five task types. Best overall scores remain below 60 out of 100 across the three construction tasks, with Brief-to-Game reaching 50.38. Analysis of reviewed submissions identifies requirement omissions and gameplay logic errors as predominant implementation problems. On human-labeled behaviors from 100 agent-built games, executable checks achieve 92.59% balanced accuracy, compared with 78.41% for a video-based VLM judge. Rubric-based visual scores reach a Spearman correlation of 0.829 with human ratings of 200 gameplay clips. Together, these results characterize current agent capabilities across game-development activities and support combining runtime evidence with visual assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出SWE-Game基准，涵盖41款Godot游戏的247项任务，用于评估AI代理在2D/3D游戏开发全流程中的能力。Opus5模型表现最佳，但整体得分低于60分，揭示了需求遗漏和逻辑错误等主要问题。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的发展，需要一种标准化的方法来全面评估智能代理（Agent）在游戏开发这一复杂多步骤活动中的实际能力，特别是在实现、修复和移植等不同阶段的表现。
AI.method: 构建了包含247个任务的多模态基准测试，覆盖从简短描述生成完整游戏、依据设计文档实现、骨架补全、83处注入故障修复到Godot至Unity移植五种任务类型。采用引擎状态检查、参考输入回放演示及视频视觉语言规范进行多维度的自动化与人工辅助评估。
AI.result: 在六个测试模型中，Opus5在所有五类任务上均获得最高总分。但在构建类任务中最佳得分仍低于60/100（Brief-to-Game为50.38）。分析显示需求遗漏和游戏逻辑错误是实施失败的主要原因。基于执行检查的准确性（92.59%）显著高于视频VLM判题（78.41%），视觉评分与人类评级相关性高（Spearman 0.829）。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI代理在游戏开发各阶段的能力仍存在局限，特别是准确理解和实现完整游戏逻辑方面。研究证实了结合运行时数据证据与视觉评估是一种有效的多维度测评方法，为后续提升代理的游戏生成能力提供了基准支持。

title: TopoMamba: A Load-Support Relation-Guided Multi-Directional State-Space Model for Topology Optimization
summary: Deep learning has emerged as an efficient alternative for predicting high-performance material distributions in topology optimization. Existing methods struggle to accurately capture load-transfer information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization, while their model architectures often incur high computational costs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes TopoMamba, a topology prediction framework incorporating a load-support relation-guided multi-directional state-space model. Coupling physical fields with load-support relations enables more effective modeling of mechanical dependencies. A load-support relation-guided spatially adaptive fusion mechanism dynamically adjusts multi-directional scan features according to spatial conditions. Mamba is coupled with the solid isotropic material with penalty method to enhance structural mechanical performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Results on two-dimensional topology optimization benchmarks demonstrate that TopoMamba achieves superior topology prediction accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art models. The proposed load-support physics-guided framework enables efficient optimization of more complex structural systems.

AI.tldr: 提出TopoMamba框架，通过载荷-支撑关系引导的多方向状态空间模型解决拓扑优化中分布外泛化能力差和计算成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法难以准确捕捉载荷传递信息，导致分布外泛化受限，且模型架构计算成本高。
AI.method: 构建TopoMamba框架，结合物理场与载荷-支撑关系建模机械依赖性；设计空间自适应融合机制动态调整多方向扫描特征；耦合Mamba与SIMP方法。
AI.result: 在二维拓扑优化基准测试中，TopoMamba在预测精度、分布外泛化能力和计算效率方面均优于最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的载荷-支撑物理引导框架能有效优化更复杂的结构系统。

title: One Latent, Many Tokens: Jointly Learning Compressed Embeddings for Efficient Language Diffusion
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, and 8 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Most continuous diffusion language models process one latent position per token at each sampling step, making generation expensive. Two-stage methods lower the cost by reducing the latent length, but they fix the compressed embedding space before training the diffusion model. Embeddings from the fixed space can be difficult to model with diffusion and decode reliably into tokens, which limits generation quality after compression. To address this problem, we introduce JPEG-DLM (Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model), which jointly trains a compressor, a flow matching model and a decoding module. With joint-embedding prediction, JPEG-DLM learns compressed embeddings that are more structured, easier to model with diffusion and reliably decodable into tokens. JPEG-DLM achieves the lowest mean Gen-PPL and highest throughput among recent diffusion and flow models on LM1B and OWT. At a compression rate of 0.5 on OWT, it reaches a Gen-PPL of 34.52 and approximately 2.3 times ELF's throughput. These results suggest that jointly learning compressed embeddings offers a promising path toward efficient diffusion language modeling. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出JPEG-DLM，通过联合训练压缩器、流匹配模型和解码模块，解决传统两阶段扩散语言模型因固定嵌入空间导致的生成质量低和成本高问题，在LM1B和OWT数据集上实现最低的Gen-PPL和最高的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 传统连续扩散语言模型每采样步骤处理一个潜在位置，生成成本高昂；现有的两阶段方法虽通过减少潜在长度降低成本，但因预置固定的压缩嵌入空间，导致嵌入难以用扩散建模且解码不可靠，限制了生成质量。
AI.method: 引入JPEG-DLM（Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model），采用联合嵌入预测机制，同步训练压缩器、流匹配模型和解码模块，学习结构更清晰、更易被扩散建模且可可靠解码为token的压缩嵌入。
AI.result: 在LM1B和OWT数据集上，JPEG-DLM取得了最低的均值生成困惑度（Gen-PPL）和最高的吞吐量。在OWT数据集上以0.5的压缩率下，Gen-PPL达到34.52，吞吐量约为ELF模型的2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习压缩嵌入为高效扩散语言建模提供了一条有前景的路径，证明了该方法能有效平衡生成效率与质量。

title: SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications
comment: 13 pages. Benchmark data and code at https://github.com/EDGAhab/specread
summary: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails such a benchmark, the failure is ambiguous: it may have misread the specification, or it may have understood the specification and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.1 contains 385 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, contradiction detection in mutated specifications, and spec-RTL consistency checking, plus 82 controls (41 distractor, 41 consistent-RTL). Type-4 items are built from real RTL mutations; we retain only mutations that Icarus Verilog simulation shows to change observable behavior. A with-spec vs. without-spec ablation suggests the questions require the excerpt, not training recall alone (without-spec accuracy 3/20 on the t1/t2 subset), though memorization of the source text may still help spot mutations. As an initial characterization with a small model, Ministral-3B scores 33.2% overall (128/385; macro average 39.0%): 55.2% on retrieval, 51.7% on cross-section reasoning. On the two contradiction-focused types, the verdict-plus-location measure gives 48.0% (t3) and 63.3% (t4), with a 51.2% false-positive rate on distractors and 100% on consistent-RTL controls. Layered scoring shows the model locates contradictions well (78.9-81.6% location accuracy) but scores lower on their category (43.9-49.7%). A structured "rule-table" prompting intervention lowers accuracy on every question type except t2 (tied). SpecRead is automatically scorable by deterministic checks, with gray-zone cases counted wrong under the conservative main scoring. The benchmark is regenerable for type-3 items via mutation injection, and built exclusively from public sources.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecRead基准测试，旨在隔离大型语言模型（LLM）在硬件设计中对规格说明书的理解能力与代码生成能力。该基准包含385个问题，通过确定性检查自动评分，揭示了模型在检索和定位矛盾方面表现较好，但在分类矛盾类型上较弱，且结构化提示并未显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有针对LLM硬件设计的基准测试主要评估生成的RTL、断言或测试台等下游产物。当模型失败时，原因不明确：无法区分是未读懂规格说明，还是读懂了但未能正确写出代码。因此，需要一种能够独立评估规格理解能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建了SpecRead v2.1基准，基于10个开源OpenTitan IP模块的385个问题及82个控制项。问题类型包括精确检索、跨章节推理、变异规格中的矛盾检测以及规格-RTL一致性检查。其中第4类项目基于真实RTL变异构建，仅保留改变可观测行为的变异。通过有/无规格消融实验验证问题对原文引用的依赖性，并使用Ministral-3B小模型进行初步特征分析，同时尝试引入“规则表”结构化提示干预。
AI.result: Ministral-3B总体准确率为33.2%。在检索任务上表现较好（55.2%），跨章节推理为51.7%。在矛盾检测方面，判定加定位测得t3类准确率48.0%，t4类63.3%，但在干扰项上的误报率为51.2%。分层评分显示模型在定位矛盾位置方面表现良好（78.9-81.6%准确率），但在识别矛盾类别上得分较低（43.9-49.7%）。引入结构化“规则表”提示后，除t2类持平外，其他所有问题类型的准确率均下降。
AI.conclusion: SpecRead成功实现了将规格理解与生成能力解耦，并通过自动确定性的评分机制提高了评估的可信度。研究表明，LLM在定位规格矛盾方面优于识别矛盾性质，且简单的结构化提示可能并不总是有效，甚至可能有害。该基准完全基于公开来源构建，具有可再生性。

title: Does Adversarial Training Improve Generalization in Multi-View VLAs? Revealing and Mitigating View Collapse
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for closed-loop robot control, transferring their perceptual and semantic capabilities to action prediction. Despite strong in-distribution performance, however, VLAs often degrade under deployment shifts. Adversarial training (AT) offers a model-adaptive approach to robustness without explicitly anticipating individual shifts, but its effect on natural distribution-shift generalization in multi-view VLAs remains unclear. We study this question using a multi-view VLA directly adapted from a pretrained VLM and evaluate generalization across seven LIBERO-Plus shift axes. Direct AT substantially improves Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise, the two shifts affecting only the third-person view, yet produces mixed or negative effects on other shifts. Controlled view interventions reveal a surprising failure mode that we term view collapse: Direct AT can shift cross-view reliance so strongly that the policy becomes dominated by the wrist view. This exposes a \textit{robustness shortcut}: apparent robustness to a shifted view can arise from reduced use of that view rather than more robust perception of it. This motivates a distinction between robust perception, extracting reliable information under within-view shifts, and robust fusion, adapting reliance across views according to their reliability. To reduce fixed view reliance, we use a simple View Swap intervention and then re-evaluate AT. With View Swap, AT further improves Camera Viewpoint, Sensor Noise, and Robot Initial State, while its effects remain mixed on other shifts. Our results show that multi-view robustness requires separating improved perception from changes in cross-view reliance, and that AT provides selective rather than generic distribution-shift benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对抗训练（AT）对多视角视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在分布偏移下泛化能力的影响。发现直接AT会导致“视图坍缩”这一鲁棒性捷径，即模型减少依赖受干扰的视图而非真正提升该视图的感知能力。通过引入视图交换干预，AT能更有效地改善特定视角的鲁棒性，表明多视角鲁棒性需区分鲁棒感知与鲁棒融合。
AI.motivation: 尽管VLA模型在分布内表现良好，但在部署时的分布偏移下性能会下降。对抗训练是一种通用的鲁棒性增强方法，但其在多视角VLA中如何应对自然分布偏移、以及是否会产生意外的副作用（如过度依赖某一视图），目前尚不明确。旨在厘清AT在多视角场景下的真实效果及潜在缺陷。
AI.method:
1. 使用从预训练VLM直接适配的多视角VLA模型。
2. 在LIBERO-Plus基准的7个分布偏移轴上进行评估。
3. 执行直接对抗训练（Direct AT）并观察性能变化。
4. 进行受控的视图干预实验，揭示“视图坍缩”现象。
5. 提出并实施“视图交换”（View Swap）干预，结合重新评估AT的效果，以区分鲁棒感知与跨视图依赖的调整。
AI.result:
1. 直接AT显著改善了仅影响第三视角的两个偏移维度（相机视角和传感器噪声），但对其他偏移维度的效果混合甚至负面。
2. 发现了“视图坍缩”失败模式：直接AT导致策略过度依赖腕部视图，这是一种“鲁棒性捷径”，看似对某视图鲁棒，实则是减少了对该视图的使用。
3. 引入视图交换后，AT进一步提升了相机视角、传感器噪声和机器人初始状态三个维度的性能，且对其他偏移的效果依然混合。
AI.conclusion: 多视角鲁棒性需要明确区分“鲁棒感知”（在单一视图内提取可靠信息）和“鲁棒融合”（根据可靠性调整跨视图依赖）。对抗训练提供的是选择性的而非通用的分布偏移收益，必须小心处理视图依赖关系以避免虚假的鲁棒性表象。

title: BIRD: Distilling Decision Boundaries into Rationales for MLLM Adaptation
summary: Adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to specialized domains requires learning domain-specific decision criteria, which often hinge on subtle visual distinctions between otherwise plausible answers. Rationale augmentation aims to expose such evidence through additional observations or inter-sample comparisons, yet a visually valid cue is not necessarily decision-relevant: it may describe how samples differ without changing the model's relative preference between competing answers. We therefore introduce BIRD, a self-improving Boundary-Informed Rationale Distillation framework that uses model-specific confusions to locate unresolved local decision boundaries and distills the evidence that resolves these confusions into rationales. For each sample, BIRD retrieves candidate neighbors from the target MLLM's own representation space and selects the most confusable one according to its answer preferences. It then generates answer-blind candidate evidence from their visual differences and functionally verifies which evidence most effectively strengthens the model's preference for the correct answer while avoiding inappropriate transfer across the pair. The verified evidence is then distilled into a single-sample rationale for standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on medical and chart VQA show that BIRD outperforms competing rationale-augmentation methods across two target MLLMs, while further analyses demonstrate clearer separation of confusable answers and stronger gains from model-matched supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出BIRD框架，利用模型自身在决策边界附近的混淆样本，通过验证视觉差异证据的有效性来生成单样本理由（rationale），以改进多模态大语言模型在特定领域的性能。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型适配专业领域时面临细微视觉区分的挑战；现有基于“理由增强”的方法往往引入的视觉线索虽有效但不一定与决策相关，无法改变模型对竞争答案的相对偏好。
AI.method: 构建自提升边界感知理由蒸馏框架（BIRD）：1. 从目标MLLM表示空间中检索候选邻近样本，选出最易混淆的样本；2. 盲测生成候选证据（基于视觉差异）；3. 功能验证筛选出能增强正确答案偏好且避免不当迁移的证据；4. 将验证后的证据蒸馏为标准监督微调所需的单样本理由。
AI.result: 在医学和图表视觉问答（VQA）任务上，BIRD优于现有的其他理由增强方法，并显示出更清晰的混淆答案分离度及更强的模型匹配监督增益。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型特定混淆定位决策边界并蒸馏验证过的证据，能有效解决理由增强中非决策相关线索的问题，显著提升专用领域多模态模型的准确性。

title: Self-Designed Evaluators and Warm Memory for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: A tool-using language-model agent deployed over a long stream of tasks receives no reward, so it cannot tell whether it succeeded, cannot safely retry, and cannot label the experience it needs to improve. We present SelfSuite, in which the agent's own base model, given only the world's public materials, designs a small evaluation suite of weighted judges and grounded per-task briefs, freezes it, and uses it to gate a keep-best retry and to label a typed, outcome-tracked memory. On matched five-repeat benchmarks over tau2-bench and AppWorld, SelfSuite scores above the plain agent without any labels, matches methods given ten expert labels on tau2-bench, and trails Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) on AppWorld, where code execution gives a direct success signal. In an ablation campaign run on the same tasks, it is above label-free ACE in every repeat, and the gated second attempt is the only component whose removal hurts in every repeat. We also simulate a subject-matter expert who grades ten onboarding tasks per world. Using those labels to calibrate SelfSuite's evaluator gives a small, consistent gain, and using them to warm up ACE's memory lifts ACE to tie calibrated SelfSuite. A single-run study on a second model family shows the same ordering.

AI.tldr: 提出SelfSuite，利用基础模型基于公开材料构建评估套件，在无人工标注的情况下实现智能体的自我评估、重试筛选和经验记忆，在tau2-bench和AppWorld基准上达到或接近专家标注方法水平。
AI.motivation: 解决无奖励信号下，工具使用型语言模型代理无法判断任务成功与否、难以安全重试及积累改进经验的问题。
AI.method: SelfSuite让基础模型仅依靠公共资料设计包含加权评审器和接地任务简报的轻量级评估套件，冻结该评估器以过滤最佳重试尝试并标记带有结果追踪的记忆。通过消融实验验证各组件有效性，并利用少量专家标签校准评估器以提升性能。
AI.result: 在匹配的五次重复基准测试中，SelfSuite得分高于无标签的基础代理，与获得十个专家标签的方法在tau2-bench上持平，但在AppWorld上略逊于ACE（因代码执行提供直接成功信号）。消融实验显示“门控第二次尝试”是唯一移除后导致所有情况性能下降的关键组件；经专家标签校准后，SelfSuite性能进一步提升，且与加热记忆的ACE相当。
AI.conclusion: SelfSuite提供了一种无需大量人工标注即可实现代理自我评估与改进的有效框架，其核心机制（特别是门控重试）对性能提升至关重要，且在结合少量专家反馈后能取得具有竞争力的效果。

title: Robust Biomolecular Complex Design Across Protein Conformational Landscapes
summary: Proteins populate conformational ensembles, yet structure-based biomolecular design typically optimizes candidates against a single target conformation. Consequently, a candidate that fits one state can lose favorable interactions or develop steric clashes when the target adopts another. We introduce FlexEvo, a model-agnostic evolutionary framework that adapts candidates once at inference time from a single target conformation to improve compatibility with alternative natural conformations unseen during adaptation, without retraining the source model or requiring a conformational ensemble. FlexEvo casts cross-state adaptation as geometry-constrained bi-objective optimization, balancing preservation of input-state interactions against robustness to plausible conformational perturbations. To limit the search space and reduce invalid structural edits, geometry-derived FlexBoxes define protected anchor regions, adaptable regions for local exploration, and forbidden regions for clash avoidance. A unified all-atom representation supports topology-preserving adaptation across diverse binder categories, while Pareto selection preserves nondominated candidates across the two objectives. We evaluate FlexEvo across multiple generation baselines and nine representative binder categories spanning diverse molecular sizes and structural topologies. FlexEvo reduces the category-balanced mean relative performance degradation from 47.8% to 4.4%, while adding only 1.4--3.1 minutes of adaptation per sample. These results establish single-state inference-time adaptation as a practical route toward robust biomolecular complex design across protein conformational landscapes.

AI.tldr: 提出FlexEvo框架，在推理阶段通过几何约束的双目标优化，将单一构象设计的候选蛋白适应到未见的自然构象，显著提升跨状态兼容性而不需重新训练模型。
AI.motivation: 基于结构的生物分子设计通常针对单一靶标构象优化候选物，导致其在靶标发生构象变化时可能丧失有利相互作用或产生空间位阻冲突。
AI.method: 引入模型无关的进化框架FlexEvo，将跨状态适应建模为几何约束的双目标优化问题；利用源自几何的“FlexBoxes”定义受保护锚点、局部探索适应区和避免冲突的禁止区；采用统一的全原子表示进行拓扑保持的适应，并通过Pareto选择保留非支配候选项。
AI.result: 在九个代表性结合剂类别上评估，FlexEvo将类别平衡的平均性能相对退化从47.8%降低至4.4%，每个样本仅增加1.4-3.1分钟的适应时间。
AI.conclusion: 单状态推理时适应是实现蛋白质构象景观中稳健生物分子复合物设计的实用途径。

title: HTN Planning as a Coordination Layer for Multi-Server MCP Tool Orchestration
comment: 5 pages. Camera-ready version of a paper accepted at the ICAPS 2026 Workshop on Hierarchical Planning (HPlan 2026), Dublin. Non-archival. Code: https://github.com/PCfVW/hplan26-artifact
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) isolates servers by design: only the host can orchestrate cross-server workflows. When the host is a large language model, the resulting orchestrations are non-deterministic, non-reproducible, and pay one inference round-trip per tool call. We present a coordination architecture in which a Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planner generates a verifiable cross-server plan once, and a runtime middleware executes it deterministically across multiple MCP servers, binding cross-action data dependencies via a template mechanism (\verb|${context.X}|) substituted at execution time. The architecture mirrors MCP's isolation constraint: each compound task decomposes into server-local primitive actions, and inter-server data flow is bound at execution time via JSON-path output extractors. We instantiate the architecture on five HTN domains spanning laboratory robotics, bioinformatics and multiscale modelling, and demonstrate end-to-end execution from a browser-based plan controller against eight live third-party MCP servers querying real biological databases.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于HTN规划器的MCP跨服务器协调架构，通过一次性生成可验证计划并确定性执行，解决LLM编排中的非确定性和高延迟问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的Model Context Protocol (MCP)设计中，若主机为大语言模型（LLM），其跨服务器工作流编排具有非确定性、不可复现性，且每次工具调用需一次推理往返，导致效率低下且结果不稳定。
AI.method: 设计了一种分层任务网络（HTN）规划器与运行时中间件相结合的协调架构。HTN规划器生成一次性的可验证跨服务器计划；运行时中间件在多个MCP服务器上确定性执行该计划。通过模板机制（如 ${context.X}）在执行时绑定跨动作数据依赖，利用JSON路径输出提取器实现服务器间的数据流绑定，同时保持每个复合任务分解为服务器本地的原始操作，符合MCP隔离约束。
AI.result: 在涵盖实验室机器人技术、生物信息学和 multiscale modelling 的五个HTN领域实例化了该架构，并在浏览器端计划控制器与八个第三方实时MCP服务器（查询真实生物数据库）之间实现了端到端的执行演示。
AI.conclusion: 该架构成功实现了MCP跨服务器工作流的确定性、可复现及高效编排，验证了其在复杂多服务器环境下的可行性。

title: Skill2Env: Capability-Oriented Environment Synthesis from Skills for General Agents
summary: Executable environments are critical for post-training agents on tasks that require tool use and multi-step interaction, but constructing executable tasks together with their environments remains difficult to scale. Skills provide reusable domain knowledge, operational procedures, and tool-use instructions, but a substantial gap remains between the information contained in a skill and a concrete, challenging task with a complete executable environment. To address this gap, we introduce Skill2Env, a capability-oriented framework that starts from a skill and uses agent capability demands to guide task and environment synthesis. Skill2Env represents these demands through reusable difficulty patterns and instantiates them into task blueprints that specify objectives, challenges, environment facts, information boundaries, and acceptance criteria. These blueprints guide the joint construction of task instructions, execution substrates, workspaces, and rubric-based evaluators around source skills. We further propose Iterative Task Hardening, which uses solver execution evidence to identify insufficiently challenging task designs, strengthen or extend their difficulty-pattern instantiations, and revise the corresponding blueprints and environments. Using 1.5K high-scoring trajectories generated from Skill2Env environments for supervised fine-tuning, we observe consistent improvements across a broad range of agent benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of capability-oriented environment synthesis for agent post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill2Env框架，利用技能难度模式自动生成可执行任务环境，并通过迭代强化提升挑战度，显著改善智能体在多个基准测试中的性能。
AI.motivation: 构建兼具可执行性与挑战性的任务环境极其困难，现有技能与具体任务间存在巨大鸿沟。
AI.method: 开发Skill2Env能力导向框架，将智能体需求转化为难度模式生成任务蓝图；并提出迭代任务硬化机制，依据求解证据持续优化任务设计与环境。
AI.result: 基于1.5K高分轨迹进行监督微调后，智能体在广泛的评估基准上均取得了持续且一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 面向能力的任务与环境合成方法能有效缩小技能与复杂环境间的差距，显著提升训练效果。

title: Learning Strategies to Break Judges
summary: As AI agents surpass human performance, it becomes exceedingly hard for system designers to evaluate them directly and understand their failure modes. Consequently, agents themselves are being deployed extensively to evaluate, judge, and provide feedback on model traces. But this raises an important question: how can we trust the judge? In this work, we propose an agent-guided method to find weaknesses of agentic judges that expose interpretable failure mechanisms. Our method focuses on mathematical reasoning and proceeds in two stages: first, we deploy adversarial agents to mutate a set of sound proofs by introducing errors, attempting to misguide judges---in other words, injecting errors that judges are unable to catch. Then, we distill these attempts into a small set of mutation strategies which allow us to analyze the failure modes of the judges. To ensure that these strategies are not overfit to the initial set of proofs, we evaluate them by applying the mutation strategies to a held-out set of proofs and querying the same judge. We deploy our method on GPT-5.6-sol and Claude Opus 5, paired with their agent orchestrators, Codex and Claude Code, respectively. These are used both as mutators to introduce errors and as judges to evaluate correctness of mathematical reasoning. We find that across all the agentic judges, we are able to distill mutation strategies that consistently bypass their evaluations, thereby enabling us to ascertain actionable failure modes. Our analysis also reveals that judge reliability degrades at the frontier: errors in Olympiad-level proofs or graduate-level mathematical texts are detected more consistently, whereas flaws in research-level manuscripts are more likely to escape detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于对抗性智能体的评估方法，用于发现大型语言模型代理在数学推理任务中作为评判者时的脆弱性和可解释的失败机制。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理性能超越人类，系统设计者难以直接评估它们并理解其失败模式；虽然广泛使用AI代理进行相互评估，但亟需解决如何信任这些“评判者”的问题。
AI.method: 采用两阶段代理引导方法：1）部署对抗性智能体对有效证明集引入错误（突变），试图误导评判者以注入其无法捕捉的错误；2）将这些攻击尝试提炼为少量突变策略，并在独立验证集上测试以确保不过拟合。研究结合了Codex和Claude Code作为编排器，分别搭配GPT-5.6-sol和Claude Opus 5进行测试。
AI.result: 成功提炼出能一致性地绕过所有被测试代理评判者评估的突变策略，明确了其具体的失败模式。研究发现评判者在前沿领域（如研究生级数学文本、研究级别手稿）的可靠性显著下降，而对奥林匹克级或研究生级错误检测较一致，但对更高级别的缺陷漏检率高。
AI.conclusion: 提出了针对代理式评判者的系统性漏洞分析方法，揭示了顶级AI模型在处理高复杂度数学推理作为评判工具时存在特定的、可复现的盲区，特别是在处理前沿研究级内容时可靠性降低。

title: Evidence-Inference Reconstruction: When The Evidence Is Recalled But The Reasoning Goes Wrong
summary: Modern multi-hop LLM agents are equipped with built-in mechanisms to detect errors in intermediate reasoning steps. Such errors trigger corrective actions from these agents, which mostly follow the paradigm of retrying the steps or the reasoning trajectories. Not only are these retries expensive, we present in this paper that they are also potentially unnecessary. To this end, we introduce Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR), which uses structured state to guide one retrieval trajectory, accumulating source evidence in the process. We show that as long as the relevant evidence has been collected, EIR is capable of generating the correct answer in a single final model call even if erroneous evidence has been mixed in due to incorrect intermediate reasoning steps. In one evaluation, using Haiku 4.5 and GPT-4.1 Mini, we evaluate EIR on matched 1,000-question subsets of HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, showing that EIR improves Answer F1, the overlap between the model's and the correct answer, over the baseline by 8.3--32.8 points, Agentic SSR by 10.6--29.1 points, and Reflexion by 1.1--15.9 points. Additionally, we show that EIR averages 4.85 total model calls per question, compared with 35.29 for Agentic SSR and 12.41 for Reflexion. Together, these results corroborate EIR's central premise: separating evidence retrieval from the final answer model call can improve answer accuracy while utilizing substantially less computation.

AI.tldr: 提出证据推理重建（EIR）方法，通过结构化状态引导检索轨迹积累源证据，最终单次模型调用生成答案。该方法解决了多跳LLM代理中错误重试昂贵且不必要的问题，在HotpotQA等数据集上显著提升准确率并大幅减少模型调用次数（平均4.85次 vs 基线的35.29/12.41次），验证了将证据检索与最终答案生成分离的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现代多跳大语言模型（LLM）代理具备检测中间推理步骤错误的机制，但当前的纠错方式主要依赖于昂贵的“重试”模式（重新执行步骤或推理轨迹）。本文指出这种重试不仅计算成本高，而且往往是多余的。
AI.method: 引入证据推理重建（Evidence-Inference Reconstruction, EIR）方法。该方法利用结构化状态指导单一检索轨迹，在此过程中累积来源证据。即使中间推理步骤出错导致混合了错误证据，只要收集到相关证据，EIR就能在最后一次模型调用中生成正确答案，从而将证据检索与最终答案生成分离。
AI.result:
在Haiku 4.5和GPT-4.1 Mini上的评估显示：
1. **性能提升**：在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue的数据集子集上，EIR相比基线方法，Answer F1提高8.3--32.8分，Agentic SSR提高10.6--29.1分，Reflexion提高1.1--15.9分。
2. **效率优化**：EIR平均每个问题仅需4.85次模型调用，远低于Agentic SSR的35.29次和Reflexion的12.41次。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证实了EIR的核心前提：将证据检索过程与最终的答案模型调用分离，可以在显著提高回答准确性的同时，极大地降低计算资源消耗，证明不需要对每一步进行冗余的重试。

title: Is your uncertainty map wrong, or is its target? Exact diagnostics for the Tweedie diagonal, and a gradient-free alternative
summary:
A diffusion model can predict a follow-up medical scan from a baseline, but a clinician needs a per-voxel map of where that prediction can be trusted. Many such maps approximate the diagonal of the Tweedie posterior covariance, and are evaluated against another approximation of it, so whether the estimator or the target limits them is unclear. We compute the exact diagonal on six checkpoints across fourteen model-corpus conditions. Hutchinson at M=200 tracks it at rank agreement of at least 0.92 everywhere, yet in four of the fourteen the exact diagonal is anti-correlated with the denoising error, reaching -0.13, so a faithful estimator reproduces that reversal. All four are real-image conditions; on the models' own samples the reversal does not appear, so evaluating on generated samples flatters this family. What limits these maps is the target, not the estimator.
  We then introduce Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT), a gradient-free residual probe that corrupts one model-supported prediction repeatedly and measures the voxel-wise variance of the denoiser's response. T-PT reads a different functional of the same Jacobian, and its exact second-order form ranks with the diagonal wherever the diagonal reverses; at thirty probes it returns a map too unstable to reproduce that ranking, while Hutchinson at M=5 already reproduces it, so T-PT there is not evidence against the reversal. We offer it as an instrument, not a better approximation. On brain MRI at full resolution, where every Jacobian-based estimator we test runs out of memory, T-PT leads a twenty-chain Monte-Carlo ensemble on five of eight endpoints inside tissue and trails it on none, at 16x fewer network evaluations; over the whole volume the ensemble leads, and fifty chains close the tissue gap. On lung CT the ensemble is ahead throughout. Both lose most of their discrimination where the change is, which remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文指出评估预测可信度的关键不在于估算器的精度，而在于目标量本身在真实图像中可能出现的反常相关性；提出的Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT) 是一种低开销的梯度无残差探测工具，能在内存受限场景下提供接近蒙特卡洛集合的性能，但其与真实变化区域的相关性识别能力仍有局限。
AI.motivation: 临床医生需要知道扩散模型生成的随访医学扫描中哪些体素（voxel）的预测是可信的。现有的每体素可信度地图通常近似于Tweedie后验协方差的对角线，但现有评估方法缺乏明确性，且难以区分误差是来自估算器还是目标本身的局限性，尤其是在生成样本与真实图像之间的表现差异上。
AI.method:
1. 计算六个检查点在十四种模型-语料条件下的精确对角线，以验证Hutchinson估计器及其他近似方法的准确性。
2. 提出Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT)，这是一种梯度无残差探针，通过对同一模型支持的预测进行多次扰动，测量去噪器响应的体素级方差。
3. 在脑MRI全分辨率和肺CT数据上进行基准测试，对比T-PT与多链蒙特卡洛（Monte-Carlo）集合方法在内存限制下的性能表现。
AI.result:
1. Hutchinson估计器（M=200）能高精度追踪精确对角线，但在真实图像条件下，精确对角线与去噪误差呈现负相关（最高-0.13），而生成样本中未出现此现象，表明仅用生成样本评估会高估性能。
2. T-PT在不同探针数量下的表现不一：30个探针时不稳定，5个探针时效果较好。
3. 在内存耗尽的脑MRI全分辨率场景中，单链T-PT在组织内五个指标上优于二十链蒙特卡洛集合，且网络评估次数减少16倍；整体体积上集合方法更优，五十链可弥补组织内的差距。在肺CT中，集合方法始终占优。
4. 两种方法在涉及变化的区域均丢失了大量判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 限制预测可信度地图的主要因素是目标量本身的性质（如在真实图像中的反常相关性），而非估算器的近似能力。T-PT作为一种低成本、低内存需求的替代方案，在特定条件下表现优异，适合作为仪器而非更优近似值使用。然而，如何在变化显著的区域提高判别能力仍是未解决的问题。

title: Dual-Vocabulary Language Model for Cross-Tokenizer Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) bridges teacher supervision and student behavior, but different teacher-student tokenizers introduce misalignment in both input tokenization (#1) and output logits (#2). Existing approaches address the former by matching same-text spans or converting tokens to bytes, often losing fine-grained token information or disrupting the native-token paradigm, while for the latter, strategies such as ranking, padding, or key-token selection retain only shared logit dimensions, resulting in much distribution loss. In this paper, we propose Dual-Vocabulary Language Model (DVLM), which replaces the teacher's LM head with a new student-vocabulary projection head and obtains full-dimensional student logits (for #2). To support student tokens (for #1), it takes a Parallel-Tokenized Sequence (PTS) as input, which concatenates the original teacher-tokenized sequence and a re-tokenized sequence formed by independently converting each student token into a teacher-token group. To avoid inference inconsistency with the original teacher tokens, the Hybrid-Prefix Attention (HPA) further restricts re-tokenized groups to their corresponding teacher prefix and uses its last state as the aggregation of the original student-token representation for projection into the student vocabulary space. Similarly, via the combined use of PTS and HPA, the DVLM teacher can provide distribution-aligned supervision with the student's input-tokenization and output-logit during OPD. Experimental results demonstrate that our DVLM teacher has a similar converged loss as the original teacher model and enables student models to improve performance across six reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了DVLM模型，通过双词表投影和并行分块序列解决On-policy distillation中师生模型的词表不对齐问题，显著提升学生模型在推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于策略蒸馏（OPD）的方法在处理不同师生词表时，输入分词和输出logits存在错位：现有技术往往丢失细粒度信息或导致分布损失严重。
AI.method: 提出DVLM框架：1) 用学生词表投影头替换教师LM头以获取全维student logits；2) 使用并行分块序列(PTS)同时处理师生token；3) 采用混合前缀注意力(HPA)限制重分词组仅关注对应的前缀状态，确保与原始教师token的一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，DVLM教师模型具有与原教师模型相似的收敛损失，且使学生在六个推理任务上的性能得到提升。
AI.conclusion: DVLM通过解决输入分词和输出logits的双重不对齐问题，实现了更有效的分布对齐监督，证明了该方法在提升小模型推理能力方面的有效性。

title: Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory
summary: An agent harness controls how a language model accesses information, uses tools, preserves memory, and checks its work. Improving this software is costly when each evaluation requires a long interaction with an environment. We introduce Vestrum, a framework that turns failures in execution traces into scoped harness changes without training the task model. Its organizing overhypothesis is that tasks of a shared kind may exhibit recurring failures whose remedies transfer within that kind. Vestrum expresses failures as recognizable classes, proposes changes across verification, retrieval, decomposition, and knowledge synthesis, and screens their scope before evaluating them as a bundle. A persistent lessons file informs subsequent proposals. Across five settings and two baseline harnesses, the frozen harnesses improve held-out performance: UltraHorizon rises from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM, Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks passed over Claude Code on eight held-out tasks at 1.03x test cost, and cell-type annotation agreement from 67.5% to 77.8% on held-out sections of one slide, alongside gains on LoCoMo and AMA-Bench. Across our searches, verification grounded in evidence helped both intermediate steps and final answers, at lower cost at intermediate steps, while critics asked to rebuild finished answers broke more than they repaired. On the three memory benchmarks, Vestrum also scores above the evaluated GEPA configurations in every paired evaluation.

AI.tldr: Vestrum 框架通过自动化分析执行失败痕迹来优化语言模型的控制软件（Harness），无需微调任务模型即可显著提升模型在多个基准测试中的表现。
AI.motivation: 改进控制语言模型的信息访问、工具使用、记忆保留和工作检查的软件（Harness）成本高昂，因为每次评估都需要与环境进行长时间的交互。
AI.method: 引入 Vestrum 框架，将执行轨迹中的失败转化为范围受限的 Harness 更改，无需训练任务模型；基于“同类任务常有可迁移修复方案的失败”这一假设，将失败分类并提出涵盖验证、检索、分解和知识综合的建议变更；利用持久化的经验文件指导后续提案，并以捆绑方式筛选和评估变更。
AI.result: 在五个设置和两个基线 Harness 中，冻结的 Harness 在未见过数据上性能提升显著：UltraHorizon (GAM) 从 47.6 升至 59.8；Terminal-Bench 4 Hard (Claude Code) 正确率从 63.7% 升至 70.3%，且测试成本仅增加 1.03 倍；细胞类型注释一致性从 67.5% 升至 77.8%；同时在 LoCoMo 和 AMA-Bench 上也有提升；在三个记忆基准测试中得分高于 GEPA 配置。
AI.conclusion: 基于证据的验证有助于提高中间步骤和最终答案的质量，且中间步骤成本更低；而要求重建已完成答案的批评者往往弊大于利。Vestrum 能有效提升 Harness 性能并优于特定基线配置。

title: Laya as a Typed Probabilistic Assessor: An Independent Reproduction and a Preregistered Study of Calibration and Selective Escalation
