comment: 31 pages, 8 figures. Ancillary files include the frozen preregistration, all run manifests, per-decision prediction records, and the metric code
summary: The shipped Laya Typed-Decisions checkpoint, a 421M-parameter ModernBERT-large assessor that answers typed choice/noul/score questions over workflow state, is uniformly under-confident. The signed confidence-accuracy gap is $-0.214$, every occupied reliability bin's accuracy exceeds its confidence, and that sign uniformity collapses every binned ECE variant to the same value, $0.214$. The card frames the risk as over-confidence; the measured direction is the opposite, and the direction decides which way a confidence-gated cascade fails. A single disjointly fitted temperature ($T=0.469$, sharpening) removes most of the miscalibration (held-out ECE $0.204$ to $0.037$) and outperforms the shipped per-option-count table. The frozen selection rule instead chose isotonic regression, which overfit and failed its held-out NLL contrast on both tracks, so hypothesis H2 is not supported. Re-running the released checkpoint on its full official test split reproduces the card's headline accuracy ($0.767$ vs. $0.766$). The retrospective E1 reproduction preceded the analysis freeze; E2-E8 were prospectively preregistered, and 20 of 22 executed confirmatory tests reject under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at $q=0.05$ (two descoped). The frozen gate beats random escalation but misses its 10% accepted-set error target on both tracks, an exploratory out-of-distribution probe finds no zero-shot transfer (accuracy $0.617$), and every score measures agreement with a synthetic teacher whose self-agreement ceiling ($0.735$) the specialist exceeds. Per-decision predictions, run manifests, and the frozen preregistration are in the ancillary files. The author has no affiliation with the model's publisher, the dataset's publisher, or TypeSafe.

AI.tldr: 分析指出Laya Typed-Decisions模型（ModernBERT-large）存在严重的“过度自信”误判与实际的“低置信度/高准确度”校准问题。通过单一起拟合的温度缩放（T=0.469）显著改善了校准误差（ECE从0.214降至0.037），优于原表的每选项计数方法，且证明了原卡片的风险评估方向相反。
AI.motivation: 旨在评估并修正Laya Typed-Decisions检查点中的置信度校准偏差，解决模型在基于工作流状态的决策中存在的系统性置信度-准确性不匹配问题，以优化风险管理和级联失败机制。
AI.method: 1. 分析模型的置信度-准确性差距及可靠性直方图；2. 应用单一 disjointly fitted 温度缩放（T=0.469）进行校准；3. 对比实验：测试各选项计数的查找表、单调回归（Isotonic Regression）及其他方法；4. 在官方测试集上复现准确率；5. 执行预注册的确认性检验（Benjamini-Hochberg FDR控制）。
AI.result: 1. 模型实际表现为过度保守（信心低于准确率，符号为负），而非卡片所述的过度自信；2. 温度缩放将保留集ECE从0.204大幅降至0.037，效果优于原每选项计数表；3. 单调回归过拟合，未获支持（H2不成立）；4. 复现准确率一致（0.767 vs 0.766）；5. 冻结门控策略虽优于随机升级，但未达到10%错误目标；6. 零样本迁移测试显示无转移能力（准确率0.617）；7. 模型在与合成教师的协议得分上超过了其自我一致的天花板。
AI.conclusion: Laya Typed-Decisions模型存在显著的校准方向误判，正确的校准方向应为增加自信（sharpening）。简单的温度缩放即可有效解决多数校准问题，显著提升性能。研究强调了准确评估置信度方向对风险控制的重要性，并指出了现有策略在非零样本场景下的局限性。

title: How code helps different tasks? A decompositional lens on LLM post-training
summary: Evaluating code data as a single corpus can obscure which types of code data benefit which models and downstream tasks. Effective data selection requires understanding both the benefits of individual categories and whether these benefits persist when categories are combined. We introduce a decompositional lens for studying these effects in LLM post-training. We first decompose an execution-verified code corpus into interpretable categories based on the computational patterns of its solutions. Through controlled fine-tuning experiments, we compare individual categories with a balanced mixture across instruction-tuned models on question answering, mathematics, and code generation. The resulting response maps reveal recurring gains in average question-answering performance, while the same category can improve one model or task and degrade another. The best-performing category also varies with the starting model and target task. We then compose compact mixtures guided by these results and examine whether benefits observed in individual categories persist under joint training. On selected model--task pairs, mixtures whose constituents each improve the target task outperform both their best constituent and full-corpus training while using roughly 10--15\% of the full corpus. These exploratory findings illustrate a \emph{less is more} pattern and highlight how the value of code data in post training depends on which categories are combined for which model and task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分解性视角来研究LLM后训练中的代码数据效果，通过分解语料库为可解释类别并组合成紧凑混合集，发现少量精选类别数据的组合能超越全量数据训练，体现了“少即是多”的原则。
AI.motivation: 评估代码数据作为单一整体语料库可能会掩盖不同类型代码数据对特定模型和下游任务的具体益处；有效数据选择需要理解各类别的独立效益及其在组合时的持续性。
AI.method: 1. 将经过执行验证的代码语料库基于其解法的计算模式分解为可解释类别；2. 在指令微调模型上，针对问答、数学和代码生成任务，对比单个类别与平衡混合集的受控微调实验；3. 构建由结果引导的紧凑混合集，考察个体类别的效益在联合训练中是否持续。
AI.result: 响应映射显示平均问答性能有重复增益，但同一类别在不同模型或任务上的影响各异（可能提升也可能降级）；最佳类别随起始模型和目标任务变化。对于选定的模型-任务对，由各均能提升目标任务的 constituents 组成的混合集，在仅使用约10-15%完整语料库的情况下，超越了最佳单一构成部分和全语料库训练的效果。
AI.conclusion: 代码数据在后训练中的价值取决于针对特定模型和任务所组合的数据类别，展示了“少即是多”的模式，强调精细化的数据策略优于粗放的全量数据训练。

title: R$^2$ Flow: Recursive Self-Improvement via Recursive Skill Evolution
summary: LLM-based agents can improve themselves across tasks by reusing and revising the skills they orchestrate into executable procedures. Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. The graph merges histories that differ only in the order of independent steps, allowing flow training to pool evidence across equivalent executions. A flow-share readout of the trained flow, invariant to the backward policy, and a separate signed utility rank which skills to change, verifier evidence decides whether an edit is warranted, and a residual-variance plateau sets when to update. Committed edits reshape the graph the next policy learns on, realizing recursive skill evolution. Across question answering, mathematical reasoning, interactive decision making, and code generation, R$^2$ Flow improves task accuracy and library-edit precision over heuristic orchestration, reinforcement learning, and skill-evolution baselines, and transfers across executors. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.

AI.tldr: 提出R² Flow框架，通过共享状态编排图解决流训练中的策略坍缩、正向奖励偏差和过度依赖任务奖励问题，实现LLM代理技能的递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的代理在自我改进中存在三个主要障碍：1. 流训练在树状历史结构下面临策略坍缩；2. 非负流的信用分配倾向于频繁使用而非有益技能；3. 技能库编辑过度依赖当前策略优化的任务奖励，缺乏独立验证。
AI.method: 引入R² Flow框架，包含三个交替阶段：策略学习、独立验证和版本化技能库更新。核心创新包括：1. 共享状态编排图，合并仅顺序不同的独立步骤历史以汇聚证据；2. 使用不依赖于反向策略的流共享读出来评估技能价值；3. 采用独立的签名效用等级对技能进行排序；4. 利用验证器证据决定是否进行编辑，并通过残差方差平台期确定更新时机。
AI.result: 在问答、数学推理、交互式决策制定和代码生成任务中，R² Flow在任务准确率和技能编辑精度上均优于启发式编排、强化学习及技能演化基线方法，并具备跨执行器的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: R² Flow通过结构化证据聚合和独立验证机制，解决了流训练中的关键缺陷，实现了可靠且高效的LLM代理技能递归进化，显著提升了多领域任务的性能和稳定性。

title: When Successful Strategies Fail: Adaptation to Environmental Novelty in Terminal Agents
comment: 53 pages, including references and appendices; 10-page main text with 5 figures
summary: LLM agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks by autonomously interacting with their environment. In doing so, their strategies rely on assumptions about that environment: which resources and tools exist, where they are located, and how they behave. When these assumptions no longer hold, reliable agents must detect the change and adapt while pursuing the same goal. We study this adaptation capability through environmental novelty: a change that keeps the task objective fixed while invalidating an assumption underlying an otherwise successful trajectory. We introduce AGNI, an automated pipeline that extracts trajectory-relevant assumptions, injects targeted environmental changes, and validates that the resulting novel tasks remain solvable. Across three terminal benchmarks, AGNI produces diverse novelties spanning resources, interfaces, constraints, and execution semantics. Evaluating multiple LLM agents reveals a substantial adaptation gap between base and novel tasks. Trajectory analysis suggests that agents often encounter evidence of the change but fail to diagnose its cause and revise their strategy. Finally, post-training for environmental novelty improves adaptation to held-out novel tasks while also improving performance on base tasks. Our results highlight a gap between task competence and adaptive capability and motivate environmental variation as a core dimension of agent training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文针对LLM智能体在环境假设失效时适应能力不足的问题，提出了AGNI自动化管道以生成环境新颖性变化，并证明了后训练能显著提升智能体的适应性及基础任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在执行长程任务时依赖对环境资源、工具及行为的特定假设。当这些假设因环境变化而不再成立时，可靠智能体必须能够检测变化并调整策略以继续追求相同目标。目前缺乏系统化评估和改进这种“环境适应性”的方法。
AI.method: 引入“环境新颖性”（Environmental Novelty）概念，即保持任务目标不变但使原有成功轨迹的假设无效化的环境改变。提出AGNI自动化流程：提取与轨迹相关的假设，注入定向的环境变化，并验证新任务的可解性。在三个终端基准测试中进行实验，并通过轨迹分析诊断智能体行为，最后通过后训练增强适应性。
AI.result: 1. AGNI成功生成了涵盖资源、接口、约束和执行语义等多种类型的多样化新颖性挑战。2. 评估显示基础任务与新任务之间存在显著的适应性差距，智能体常未能正确诊断变化原因并调整策略。3. 针对环境新颖性的后训练不仅提高了对未见新颖任务的适应性，也提升了基础任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了智能体在“任务能力”与“适应能力”之间的差距，证实了环境多样性应成为智能体训练和评估的核心维度，为提升鲁棒性提供了方向。

title: Curating Merchant-Matching Training Data with Two Confidence-Gated Local LLM Judges
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables, Accepted for publication in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining Workshops (ICDMW), SENTIRE 2026 Workshop
summary: Merchant matching resolves a noisy payment descriptor to a retrieved merchant entity or returns no match. A key challenge in curating training labels is distinguishing teacher abstention from evidence that no acceptable entity exists: false no-match labels contaminate pseudo-labeled data, while conservative labeling reduces coverage. We investigate whether agreement between two local large language model judges improves pseudo-label reliability. A label is retained only when the judges agree, with separate ordered thresholds for selections and abstentions that guarantee disjoint positive and negative label sets. Retrospective replay on 2,000 expert-annotated queries shows that higher selection thresholds can improve positive-label purity, whereas higher abstention thresholds increase false no-match labels. At thresholds (0.86, 0.80), Muse Glimmer 30B and Gemma 4 31B jointly label 1,633 queries (81.7% coverage) at 96.88% purity; positive and negative purities are 99.47% and 93.38%. This exceeds either constituent model at the same thresholds by more than two percentage points, with lower coverage. A split-half check finds only 0.14 percentage points of threshold-selection optimism. A symmetric threshold of 0.86 adds 40 erroneous no-match labels, while 46 false abstentions persist even with no confidence threshold. Across five matched within-model comparisons, higher reasoning effort yields no clear F0.5 gain and increases median latency by 1.8-5.0 times. These results motivate separate thresholding and auditing for positive and negative pseudo-labels. The study establishes label purity, not student utility; fresh-data curation and student fine-tuning remain necessary to demonstrate downstream value.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了两个本地大语言模型（LLM）法官在商户匹配任务中通过投票一致性强伪标签可靠性的效果。研究发现，分离设置选择和拒绝阈值可平衡正负标签纯度，但并未显著提升学生模型效用，且高推理努力未带来明显增益，强调了需对正负标签分别审计及进行后续微调。
AI.motivation: 解决商户匹配中标注数据中的噪声问题，特别是区分教师模型的“拒绝回答”与“确实无匹配”的情况。虚假的“无匹配”标签会污染伪标签数据，而过于保守的标注则会降低覆盖率。旨在提高伪标签的可信度和质量。
AI.method: 采用两个本地大型语言模型（Muse Glimmer 30B 和 Gemma 4 31B）作为独立法官，仅在他们意见一致时保留标签。针对“选择”（有匹配）和“拒绝”（无匹配/不确信）分别设置有序的置信度阈值，确保正负标签集合互斥。使用2,000个专家标注查询进行回顾性重放评估。
AI.result:
1. 在阈值(0.86, 0.80)下，联合标记覆盖率为81.7%，总纯度为96.88%（正标签纯度99.47%，负标签纯度93.38%），优于单一模型。（尽管覆盖率较低，但在相同阈值下比单个模型高出两个百分点以上）
2. 阈值选择乐观偏差极低（仅0.14%）。
3. 对称阈值增加错误无匹配标签；即使无置信度阈值仍存在假拒绝。
4. 五种内部比较显示，更高的推理努力并未带来F0.5分数的明确提升，且使中位数延迟增加1.8-5.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 高一致性结合分离阈值能提高伪标签纯度，但这仅代表标签质量而非学生模型效用。研究指出必须进行新数据筛选和学生模型微调才能证明下游价值，并建议对正负伪标签实施单独的阈值设定和审计机制。

title: When Consent Outlives Context: Residual Authority Replay in Long-Lived Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on user approval to authorize security-sensitive actions at runtime. Such approvals are granted within a specific task and execution context. In long-lived agents, authorization decisions may need to persist across tasks or sessions. We find that this continuity can outlive the context that originally justified the approval, creating residual authority reusable without renewed consent. We expose this failure mode through a longitudinal attack that starts from a target security-sensitive action, identifies the authority required to execute it, induces benign interactions that legitimately obtain that authority, and later replays the residual authority during adversarial execution. Across controlled and live settings, we demonstrate that residual-authority replay arises in practice and substantially increases the success of prompt-injection and context-rebinding attacks. We evaluate 508 AgentDojo attack cases across six LLM families using production-derived authorization semantics. With residual authority, attack success rate (ASR) increases by up to 35.1 percentage points compared with a fresh authorization state. In live context-rebinding attacks on 55 Terminal-Bench cases across three real-world production coding agents, residual-authority replay increases ASR by 24.9 percentage points on average. These findings expose a fundamental mismatch between persistent authorization and the contextual nature of user consent in long-lived LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 长期运行的LLM智能体存在“残留权限重放”漏洞，攻击者利用先前合法交互获取的持续授权，在后续恶意上下文中实施提示注入和上下文绑定攻击，显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖用户授权执行安全敏感操作，但现有机制未解决长期运行中授权决策与原始同意语境脱节的问题，导致“残留权限”可能被滥用。
AI.method: 提出一种纵向攻击模型，从目标安全操作回溯所需权限，通过良性交互获取该权限，随后在对抗性场景中重放残留权限。基于AgentDojo（508案例，6类LLM）和Terminal-Bench（55案例，3个真实生产代码智能体）进行实证评估。
AI.result: 1) 残留权限重放显著降低攻击防御效果；2) 在测试中，相比全新授权状态，攻击成功率(ASR)最高提升35.1个百分点；3) 在真实场景上下文绑定攻击中，ASR平均提升24.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 现有持久化授权机制与用户同意的语境本质存在根本性错配，亟需引入基于语境的动态授权或重新确认机制以保障长期运行智能体的安全性。

title: HyperMCTS: Hypergraph-Augmented MCTS for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate decisions under constraints that span an entire solution. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) offers a promising approach to test-time scaling by exploring alternative action trajectories, but model computation and environment interaction make search costly. Efficient search therefore requires effective reuse of trajectory feedback. Standard MCTS maintains prefix-specific statistics, without explicitly accumulating outcomes for decision groups that recur across different paths. To fill this gap, we propose HyperMCTS, a training-free method that augments an ordered MCTS tree with a cross-trajectory hypergraph. Hyperedges represent groups of canonical decisions and accumulate their observed returns within the current task. Our hypergraph-guided HyperUCT selection rule aggregates evidence from overlapping hyperedges into an action prior, allowing outcomes collected under one prefix to inform selection under another while preserving execution histories in the tree. On DeepPlanning, HyperMCTS improves average planning accuracy by 2.3--7.3 percentage points over the strongest baseline for each of three backbone models. It enables Qwen3.6-27B to outperform Claude Opus 4.6 (max) on Shopping Planning, while achieving higher accuracy with fewer LLM calls and output tokens than the evaluated MCTS-based baselines. SealQA experiments further demonstrate improvements in question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperMCTS，通过引入交叉轨迹超图复用轨迹反馈，提升LLM代理在长视界任务中的搜索效率与规划准确率。
AI.motivation: 长视界任务中，标准蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）因需维护前缀特定统计量而无法有效复用跨路径的决策组结果，导致计算成本高且搜索效率低。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的HyperMCTS方法，在有序MCTS树上增强构建一个交叉轨迹超图。其中，超边表示规范决策组并累积当前任务中的观测回报；利用超边引导的HyperUCT选择规则，将重叠超边的证据聚合为动作先验，使不同前缀下的结果能相互 informing 同时保留执行历史。
AI.result: 在DeepPlanning基准上，相比最强基线，HyperMCTS使三种骨干模型的平均规划准确率提高了2.3--7.3个百分点；Qwen3.6-27B在Shopping Planning任务上超越Claude Opus 4.6 (max)；同时以更少的LLM调用和输出token实现更高准确率；SealQA实验亦显示出问答任务的改进。
AI.conclusion: HyperMCTS通过超图机制有效复用轨迹反馈，在降低计算成本的同时显著提升了LLM代理在复杂规划及问答任务中的性能。

title: Designing Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge Measurement Systems for Multi-Turn Business Agents
summary: Many LLM-as-a-judge evaluations score fixed outputs under a fixed task definition. Production multi-turn business agents instead require a maintained measurement system: correctness depends on business-specific facts and procedures, outcomes emerge across turns, and failures must be attributed to either agent capability or missing business knowledge before they are actionable. We present an integrated methodology spanning evaluation specification, modular LLM judges, intent-preserving user simulation, and human-in-the-loop governance. The specification defines conversation-level end states and actionable failure ownership. Atomic judges share versioned evidence and feed an explicit aggregation graph. The simulator is released only after task-preservation and stability checks. Independent human audits estimate measurement fidelity, renew tiered reference sets, and route disagreements to label correction, guideline revision, or judge improvement. Production studies show that system-level fidelity improved across repeated audits, that human reviewers and automated judges improved together under the shared feedback loop, and that their combined workflow had the strongest descriptive performance in both reported task-completion settings. Because the studies are observational and the human reference itself required revision, these findings demonstrate operational usefulness rather than causal or universal superiority. The contribution is a practical framework for making multi-turn agent measurement reliable, actionable, and maintainable as the evaluated system and its evidence evolve.

AI.tldr: 提出一套针对生产环境多轮商业智能代理的综合评估框架，通过规范定义、模块化LLM裁判、意图保持模拟及人工审计，解决传统固定评估无法适应动态业务事实和多轮交互的问题，实现了高保真、可操作且可维护的测量系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）作为裁判的评估方法主要针对固定输出和单一任务定义；然而，生产环境中的多轮商业代理需要维持性的测量体系，因为正确性依赖于特定业务事实和流程，结果在多轮对话中逐步显现，且失败原因需在代理能力缺陷或业务知识缺失之间进行归因，以便采取可行措施。
AI.method:
1. **评估规范**：定义会话级最终状态和可操作的失败责任归属。
2. **模块化LLM裁判**：共享版本化证据，并通过显式聚合图进行信息整合。
3. **用户模拟**：经过任务保持性和稳定性检查后发布意图保持的用户模拟器。
4. **人在回路治理（Human-in-the-loop）**：独立人工审计以估算测量保真度，更新分层参考集，并将分歧路由至标签修正、指南修订或裁判改进。
AI.result: 生产研究显示：1. 系统在重复审计中整体保真度提升；2. 在共享反馈循环下，人工审核者与自动化裁判的性能同步提升；3. 结合工作流在任务完成设置中表现出最强的描述性性能。
AI.conclusion: 由于研究具有观察性质且人工参考系本身需修订，这些发现证明了该框架的操作实用性而非因果或普适优势。贡献在于提供了一个实用框架，使多轮代理的测量在评估系统及证据演变过程中保持可靠、可操作和可维护。

title: EHRAdapt: Adapting Pretrained Language Models to Electronic Health Records with Semantic Priors for Rare Clinical Events
summary: Electronic health records (EHRs) encode clinical histories as (time, modality, code) tuples, whereas pretrained language models expect text tokens. Serializing them as text inflates sequence length and redundantly encodes structure. We introduce EHRAdapt, an adapter that maps tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space. Modality receives a learned embedding, time gaps enter through learned attention biases, and event codes receive dedicated vectors. Learning event vectors is the central challenge: clinical vocabularies are long-tailed, leaving rare events too few observations for reliable estimates. EHRAdapt therefore represents each event vector as the sum of a semantic prior and an evidence residual. The prior is a frozen embedding of the event's clinical description from a biomedical language model trained on clinical ontologies, mapped into the model's input space by a shared learned projection, so it supplies clinical meaning even when observations are scarce. The residual, a learned low-rank event-specific correction, refines it as evidence accumulates. We run continued pretraining on about 4 million patients' records with three frozen LLM backbones (OLMo2 1B, Llama3.2 1B, and OLMo2 7B), training only the adapter (0.1--0.6% of all parameters). The full adapter outperforms all ablations in held-out next-event prediction on every backbone. Removing the semantic pathway hurts rare events over ten times more than the most frequent ones, whereas removing the residual hurts overall prediction but improves it for the rarest events. On reportable infectious-disease and syndromic downstream classification tasks, EHRAdapt outperforms text-based LLM and count-based baselines, and both pathways improve rare-disease discrimination. The two pathways therefore play complementary roles, visible only when results are broken down by event frequency rather than averaged.

AI.tldr: 提出EHRAdapt适配器，通过语义先验与证据残差的结构化映射，解决电子健康记录中稀有事件编码难题，在长尾数据下显著提升语言模型对临床序列的预测及下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将电子健康记录（EHR）序列化为文本会膨胀序列长度并冗余编码结构；同时，临床词汇呈现长尾分布，导致稀有事件因观测数据不足而无法获得可靠的向量估计。
AI.method: 引入EHRAdapt适配器，将(EHR时间、模态、代码)元组直接映射至冻结的大型语言模型嵌入空间：1) 为模态和学习注意力偏差中的时间间隔分配独立嵌入；2) 将每个事件向量表示为“临床描述的语义先验”（来自生物医学预训练模型）与“低秩学习残差”之和，以平衡通用性与特异性。
AI.result: 在400万患者记录上针对三种 backbone (OLMo2, Llama3.2, OLMo2 7B) 进行持续预训练。完整适配器在下注事件预测中优于所有消融实验。仅保留语义路径对罕见事件伤害极小但整体稍逊，仅保留残差路径则整体提升但对最罕见事件表现较差。在传染病和综合征分类任务中，全面优于基于文本和计数的基线。
AI.conclusion: 语义先验与证据残差两个路径发挥互补作用：前者保障稀有事件的基准语义理解，后者精细化高频事件预测。这种互补性仅在按事件频率细分结果时才显著可见，证明了结构化适配与语义融合在处理医疗长尾数据中的有效性。

title: A Computer Vision Approach to Visual Fraud Detection in Phishing Websites Using YOLOv8
summary: Phishing remains one of the most common vectors for financial and identity fraud, and most detection systems still rely on inspecting a page's URL, HTML markup, or domain registration history. These signals are easy for an attacker to rotate or obfuscate, and they say very little about what actually convinces a victim to hand over a password or a card number: the way the page looks. This paper describes a visual, image-based approach to phishing detection that treats a rendered webpage the same way a human eye would, as a picture that either matches a trusted brand or doesn't. A YOLOv8 convolutional neural network was trained to classify full-page website screenshots as phishing or legitimate based on layout, logo placement, color scheme, and login-form structure, rather than on text extracted from the page. The system reached 92% classification accuracy on a held-out test set, processed a single screenshot in roughly 100 milliseconds, and, after a round of data augmentation aimed specifically at lighting, compression, and scaling variation, cut the false-positive rate by 11% relative to the pre-augmentation baseline. The paper walks through the dataset construction, the augmentation strategy, the model architecture and training setup, and the resulting performance, and closes with a discussion of where this kind of visual detector fits alongside, rather than instead of, existing URL- and content-based defenses.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于YOLOv8卷积神经网络的视觉图像钓鱼检测系统，通过识别网页截图的布局、Logo和配色等视觉特征，而非传统的URL或文本内容，实现了92%的分类准确率并显著降低误报率。
AI.motivation: 传统钓鱼检测方法过度依赖URL、HTML标记或域名注册历史，这些信号易被攻击者轮换或混淆，且无法反映让受害者泄露信息的页面视觉说服力（即“页面长什么样”）。
AI.method: 采用YOLOv8卷积神经网络对完整网页截图进行分类，将其视为图片以匹配可信品牌；训练依据布局、Logo位置、色彩方案和登录表单结构等视觉特征，而非提取页面文本；结合针对光照、压缩和缩放变化的数据增强策略进行优化。
AI.result: 在预留测试集上达到92%的分类准确率；单张截图处理时间约为100毫秒；经过特定数据增强后，相较于基线模型，假阳性率降低了11%。
AI.conclusion: 该视觉检测器不应替代现有的基于URL和内容防御机制，而应与其互补共存，作为多层次安全防护的一部分。

title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation. Preliminary Results
summary: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.

AI.tldr: Jev 1.13在医学研究摘要理解上表现接近前沿模型，但在复杂诊断和考试题目上准确率显著低于GPT-6 Sol；尽管速度快、成本低且校准良好，但临床使用前需针对具体任务进行验证。
AI.motivation: 评估非生成式“System One”模型Jev 1.13在医学问答和基于案例的诊断推理任务中的准确性与校准能力，这些指标此前尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在四个医学基准测试（MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ, NEJM Case Challenges）上评估Jev 1.13，以带有和不带有推理能力的GPT-6 Sol作为参照。主要结果为Top-1准确率，次要结果包括校准度、选择性预测及对不可回答问题识别能力。
AI.result: Jev在PubMedQA上准确率与GPT-6 Sol相当（78.4% vs 78.2%），但在MetaMedQA（74.8% vs 82.7%）、DiagnosisArena-MCQ（59.8% vs 82.4%）和NEJM案例（61.8% vs 82.4%）上显著更低。Jev在校准方面表现优异（例如MetaMedQA预期校准误差0.063），且在特定阈值下高精度，但在复杂诊断区分度上较差。其响应速度极快（0.27-0.31秒）且成本极低（USD 0.08）。
AI.conclusion: Jev模型运行快速且经济实惠，在处理研究摘要时性能接近前沿大型语言模型，但在处理考试题目及复杂诊断案例时表现较差。由于其为预设答案选项分配概率的非生成式特性，临床使用前必须针对不同任务进行特定的有效性验证。

title: Large Language Models for Structured Clinical Data Analysis: Dual-Agent Grounding and Validation
summary: Objective: To develop and characterize CLEAR-Med, a dual-agent framework for natural-language analysis of structured clinical data that separates SQL-based invocation from independent validation. Methods: CLEAR-Med uses one agent to translate a question into executable Structured Query Language (SQL), retain the executed query and database result, and produce a draft. Deterministic checks and a separately invoked cross-provider Validation Agent then accept the draft, request one bounded repair, or abstain. We formalized the system as a bounded selective pipeline and evaluated CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability, and the Invocation Agent's accuracy and consistency on a 25-query development benchmark, using a harmonized 21-site neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy table containing 532 de-identified infant records and approximately 1,300 variables. Results: CLEAR-Med completed all six nominal scalability configurations, including 500x1300. Across 25 development-benchmark queries repeated five times, the Invocation Agent answered 83 of 125 responses correctly (66.4%; query-cluster bootstrap 95% CI, 48.0-83.2%), compared with 15 of 125 (12.0%; 95% CI, 3.2-22.4%) for the ungrounded ChatGPT baseline, a paired improvement of 54.4 percentage points (95% CI, 36.8-72.0%). Conclusion: CLEAR-Med provides a general architecture for traceable analysis of structured clinical data: numerical claims remain linked to executed SQL, and unresolved cases can fail closed. The reported experiments characterize CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability and the Invocation Agent's accuracy, while the formal analysis establishes the encoded-property guarantee of the complete control flow; a prospective full-pipeline evaluation of the validation and abstention stages is the next stage of this work.

AI.tldr: CLEAR-Med 是一个双代理框架，用于自然语言分析结构化临床数据。它通过一个代理将问题转化为 SQL 并生成草稿，再由独立的验证代理进行确定性检查和修复。在 25 个查询的基准测试中，其准确率（66.4%）显著优于未加约束的 ChatGPT 基线（12.0%），展示了良好的可扩展性和可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 为了开发一种能够处理结构化临床数据的自然语言分析框架，该框架需将 SQL 调用与独立验证分离，以实现更准确、可追溯且安全的分析结果。
AI.method: 提出 CLEAR-Med 框架，包含两个主要组件：一是“调用代理”（Invocation Agent），负责将自然语言问题转化为执行 SQL 语句、获取数据库结果并生成初步回答；二是“验证代理”（Validation Agent），通过确定性检查接受草案、请求修正或中止响应。研究团队将其形式化为有界选择性管道，并在包含 532 条婴儿记录的 neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy 数据集上，使用 25 个查询的开发基准进行了配置、可扩展性及准确性的评估。
AI.result:
1. 系统在所有六项名义可扩展性配置下均完成运行，包括 500x1300 的配置规模。
2. 在 25 个开发基准查询重复五次的测试中，调用代理在 125 次回答中有 83 次正确，准确率为 66.4%（95% CI, 48.0-83.2%）。
3. 相比之下，未加约束的 ChatGPT 基线准确率仅为 12.0%（95% CI, 3.2-22.4%），配对提升幅度达 54.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR-Med 提供了一种通用的、可追溯的结构化临床数据分析架构，确保数值声明与实际执行的 SQL 相关联，且未解决的案例可以安全失败（fail closed）。实验验证了其配置、可扩展性及调用代理的准确性，形式化分析确立了完整控制流的编码属性保证。未来的工作将对验证和中止阶段进行前瞻性的全流程评估。

title: Thinking Outside the Box: Retention and Transmission of Information in Sliding-Window KV Inference
summary: Sliding-window KV inference refers to processing a sequence incrementally while retaining only a fixed-size cache of recent key and value states. It can be applied to pretrained causal transformers at inference time without additional training, while its KV-cache memory remains fixed as more tokens are processed. Because cached states are computed in the context of earlier tokens, they may carry information from beyond the current window and transmit it to later states. This study presents a series of experiments using five open-weight models spanning Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Muse Glimmer. We investigate whether information originating outside the immediate context window can persist through a rolling KV cache and remain useful for retrieval. Initial results show that retaining previously computed states improves retrieval across the models tested compared with recomputing the final fixed window from raw tokens. We then measure how far this effect extends and find that Muse Glimmer and Mistral 7B show the strongest \emph{latent information relay}: they can recover information even after the relevant source tokens have left the cache. Both models incorporate sliding-window attention in their published architectures, an association that motivates testing whether training with sliding windows promotes more reliable information retention.

AI.tldr: 研究证明，在推理阶段使用滑动窗口KV缓存时，即使源token已离开窗口，模型仍可能通过隐藏的KV状态“接力”保留并检索早期信息。
AI.motivation: 验证在预训练因果Transformer的推理过程中，固定大小的KV缓存是否能在超出当前上下文窗口的情况下，持续传递并利用早期token的信息。
AI.method: 对Qwen、Llama、Mistral和Muse Glimmer五种开源模型进行实验，比较保留滚动KV缓存与重新计算最终固定窗口在信息检索上的表现，并测量信息延时效应的影响范围。
AI.result: 保留先前计算的KV状态优于仅使用当前固定窗口的原始token进行重算。其中，Muse Glimmer和Mistral 7B表现出最强的“潜在信息接力”能力，能够在相关源token离开缓存后仍能恢复信息。
AI.conclusion: 具有滑动窗口注意力架构的模型（如Muse Glimmer和Mistral 7B）更倾向于在滚动KV缓存中可靠地保留历史信息，这提示滑动窗口训练可能增强了信息的长期留存能力。

title: Towards Certificate-Driven Software Porting: A Self-Improving Agentic Harness for Scientific Program Optimization
summary: The upgrade and rewriting of large scientific codebases has traditionally been a major challenge. While evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can port and accelerate legacy code, repair feedback in prompts alone does not prevent subsequent candidates from repeating the same errors. We introduce Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search (CDES), which extends evolutionary search with enforceable restrictions derived from failed candidates, recorded as certificates of assumptions, checker evidence, and justified restrictions. Its control logic enforces these restrictions through rejection, backtracking, and targeted repair while preserving compatible edits. We apply CDES to CPU-to-GPU translation of two particle-simulation functions from the Geant4 toolkit, evaluated with a harness that goes beyond unit tests to combine formal checks, numerical comparisons, physics checks, and GPU safety tests. Generated implementations achieve 13.78x and 23.54x function-level speedups over CPU code, including data conversion and transfers; for one function, GPU throughput exceeds an expert implementation by 14.9%, reaching 16.1% when complementary components are combined. In an ablation over execution settings, certificate feedback increases the fraction of candidates passing required correctness checks from 55% to 90%.

AI.tldr: 提出证书驱动的进化搜索（CDES），通过从失败候选项生成“证书”以强制施加限制，解决大型代码库升级中LLM重复犯错的问题。在Geant4粒子模拟函数翻译中实现了显著的加速（13.78x-23.54x）和更高的正确率（55%至90%）。
AI.motivation: 传统大型科学代码库的升级重构极具挑战；尽管基于大语言模型（LLM）的进化搜索可用于移植和加速遗留代码，但仅依靠提示中的反馈无法阻止后续候选代码重复相同的错误。
AI.method: 引入证书驱动的进化搜索（CDES），该方法扩展了传统的进化搜索算法。它从失败的候选项中提取可执行的限制条件，并将其记录为包含假设证书、检查器证据和有理限制的证据。其控制逻辑通过拒绝、回溯和定向修复来强制执行这些限制，同时保留兼容的编辑。
AI.result: 在将Geant4工具集中的两个粒子模拟函数从CPU翻译到GPU的应用场景中：1. 生成的实现比CPU代码快13.78倍至23.54倍（含数据转换与传输）；2. 其中一款函数的GPU吞吐量比专家级实现高出14.9%，结合互补组件后达16.1%；3. 消融实验显示，证书反馈使通过必要正确性检查的候选项比例从55%提升至90%。
AI.conclusion: CDES能够有效防止LLM在进化搜索中重复错误，显著提升代码翻译的正确性和性能，证明了结合形式化检查、数值比较及物理检查的综合评估方法的有效性。

title: PhysFieldBench: Can Multimodal Models Understand Physical Fields?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly envisioned as core components of scientific and engineering agents, yet their ability to interpret physical fields remains poorly understood. Existing physics benchmarks largely emphasize textbook problem solving or intuitive physical reasoning, leaving open whether MLLMs can infer physically meaningful information from continuous field observations. We introduce PhysFieldBench, a benchmark comprising 24 tasks and 1,160 evaluation examples across controlled equation fields, simulated physical fields, and observed physical fields. The tasks assess three forms of inference: identifying physical mechanisms, comparing latent control variables, and predicting outcome properties. Across representative open-source and proprietary MLLMs, zero-shot performance is low: the best model achieves a chance-normalized score of 29.3, while several open-source models remain near chance. In contrast, a task-specific supervised vision transformer performs substantially better, demonstrating that the inputs contain learnable physical information. To diagnose these failures, a structured self-explanation analysis attributes most errors to missed visual patterns and incorrect visual-to-physical mappings. Further, to explore whether post-training can improve physical inference and generalize to unseen tasks, we compare supervised fine-tuning with final answers or chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning. Final-answer supervision performs best overall but transfers less effectively, whereas reinforcement learning after chain-of-thought supervision achieves the best generalization. Together, these findings highlight the need to improve visual-to-physical grounding and cross-task generalization for MLLMs to reliably interpret physical fields in scientific and engineering workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysFieldBench基准，评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）解释物理场的能力。结果显示现有模型零样本性能差，主要因视觉-物理映射错误所致；强化学习结合思维链监督在泛化性上表现最佳，揭示了改善视觉-物理接地的重要性。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLMs被视为科学和工程智能体的核心组件，但其在解释连续物理场观察数据方面的能力尚未被充分理解。现有的物理基准主要集中在教科书式问题解决或直观推理，缺乏对从连续场中提取物理意义信息的评估。
AI.method:
1. 构建PhysFieldBench基准：包含24个任务和1,160个评估样本，涵盖控制方程场、模拟物理场和观测物理场。
2. 评估任务类型：识别物理机制、比较潜在控制变量、预测结果属性。
3. 模型对比：测试开源及专有MLLMs的零样本性能，并与特定任务的监督视觉Transformer对比。
4. 错误诊断：通过结构化自我解释分析归因错误原因。
5. 后训练探索：比较最终答案监督、思维链监督下的监督微调以及强化学习的效果。
AI.result:
1. 当前MLLMs零样本性能低下，最佳模型得分仅为29.3（经过机会率标准化），部分开源模型接近随机水平。
2. 特定任务的监督视觉Transformer表现显著更好，证明输入中包含可学习的物理信息。
3. 大多数错误源于遗漏视觉模式和错误的视觉到物理映射。
4. 最终答案监督整体效果最好但泛化性较差；经过思维链监督后的强化学习实现了最佳的跨任务泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 为使MLLMs能在科学和工程工作流中可靠地解释物理场，亟需提升其视觉-物理接地能力及跨任务泛化性能。

title: GenoMorph: Pathway-Grounded Genomic Disease Reasoning via Adaptive Latent Computation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in biological reasoning; however, genomic disease inference remains largely dependent on memorized gene-disease associations rather than understanding biological pathways. This shortcut learning undermines robustness and generalization, and breaks down when molecular identifiers are unavailable. We present GenoMorph, a multimodal genomic reasoning framework that shifts disease prediction from associative gene-disease mapping toward pathway-grounded reasoning. GenoMorph couples a frozen DNA foundation model with question-conditioned cross-attention fusion, self-adaptive latent reasoning (LatentSp), a residual reasoning gate for iterative genomic evidence reinjection, and rejection sampling fine-tuning regularized by hierarchical optimal transport (OT). Rather than learning direct gene-disease mappings, GenoMorph aligns genomic sequence representations with latent pathway dynamics, enabling reasoning trajectories that follow molecular interactions before producing disease predictions. LatentSp dynamically allocates computation according to reasoning confidence, reducing unnecessary reasoning steps and improving inference efficiency. We further construct an anonymized benchmark from the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), replacing every gene and molecular identifier with anonymous symbols while preserving sequences and pathway topology, thereby removing memorization shortcuts. GenoMorph raises the weighted F1 from 0.7863 (BioReason) to 0.9412, and rejection sampling fine-tuning with self-adaptive latent reasoning pushes it to 0.9725 while cutting latency nearly 60%. On the anonymized benchmark it reaches 0.9465 F1, substantially outperforming prior systems and confirming that accurate disease prediction can arise from pathway reasoning rather than memorized gene-disease associations.

AI.tldr: 提出GenoMorph框架，通过通路推理而非记忆基因-疾病关联来提高基因组疾病预测的鲁棒性，并在匿名基准测试中实现0.9465 F1得分。
AI.motivation: 解决大型语言模型在基因组疾病推理中过度依赖记忆化的基因-疾病关联而缺乏对生物通路的理解问题，这种捷径学习削弱了模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建多模态基因组推理框架GenoMorph：结合冻结的DNA基础模型与问题条件交叉注意力融合；采用自适应潜在推理（LatentSp）动态分配计算资源；引入残差推理门进行迭代证据注入；使用层次最优传输正则化的拒绝采样微调；基于KEGG构建匿名基准测试以消除记忆捷径。
AI.result: 加权F1从0.7863提升至0.9725，延迟降低近60%；在匿名基准测试上达到0.9465 F1，显著优于现有系统，证实了基于通路推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GenoMorph成功将疾病预测从关联性映射转向基于通路的推理，证明了准确疾病预测可源于对分子相互作用的理解而非记忆的基因-疾病关联。

title: K-OPSD: Verifiable On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Vision-Language Models on AEC Drawings
summary: Interpreting architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) drawings is hard for general Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce K-OPSD, a VLM post-training methodology for improving AEC drawing understanding. Building on On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) with verifiable supervision, we construct a teacher from the model's own best-of-N generations, certified by a process-level verifier, and rescue failed prompts by resampling under a hint that exposes the verified answer. We then perform an on-policy model update by training on verified completions with a cross-entropy inner-loss, outperforming the bounded token-wise generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) used by on-policy distillation. Using K-OPSD, we fine-tune Qwen3-VL models on the AECV-Bench dataset. The resulting models attain the top average judge score (0.819) and combined accuracy (0.738), achieving competitive results against open-source baseline models. The recipe transfers to the out-of-domain ArchCAD dataset, where the 8B model gains most. We present the verifier suite and the continual learning and self-improving pipeline, our results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-guided self-distillation is a promising route toward more reliable machine reading of architecture drawings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了K-OPSD，一种基于可验证监督的对策自我蒸馏VLM后训练方法，旨在提升多模态大语言模型对建筑、工程和施工（AEC）图纸的理解能力。通过结合过程级验证器和提示重采样技术，该方法在AECV-Bench数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能表现，并证明了验证器引导的自我蒸馏是提升机器读取建筑图纸可靠性的有效途径。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）难以准确解释复杂的建筑和工程施工图（AEC drawings）。现有的策略性蒸馏方法使用有界令牌广义Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），效果受限，需要更高效的后训练方法来提升特定领域图纸的理解能力。
AI.method:
1. 基于On-Policy自我蒸馏（OPSD）框架；
2. 构建教师模型：利用模型自身的Best-of-N生成结果，并通过过程级验证器进行认证；
3. 失败提示救援：在暴露经过验证答案的提示下重新采样以挽救失败的提示；
4. 策略模型更新：使用交叉熵内部损失在已完成的验证数据上进行训练，取代传统的JCD方法；
5. 在Qwen3-VL模型上使用AECV-Bench数据集进行微调。
AI.result:
1. 在AECV-Bench数据集上，该模型获得了最高的平均评审分数（0.819）和综合准确率（0.738），性能优于开源基线模型；
2. 该方法具有良好的迁移能力，在域外ArchCAD数据集上同样有效，其中8B参数模型增益最大；
3. 提供了验证器套件及持续学习与自我改进管道。
AI.conclusion: 验证器引导的自我蒸馏是一种非常有前景的途径，能够显著提高机器阅读和理解建筑图纸的可靠性与准确性。

title: A Differentiable Optimization Framework for Registering Sequential Bounding Boxes with Point Cloud Stream
summary: Refining a sequence of coarse 3D bounding boxes against a LiDAR point-cloud stream demands tracks that are geometrically accurate (high IoU) and temporally coherent (low roughness), preferably without training data. The usual recipe keeps the two concerns apart: register each frame independently, then smooth the trajectory afterwards with a Kalman~RTS or Savitzky--Golay filter. Smoothing displaces boxes from a geometric optimum and never re-optimises, so it trades accuracy for smoothness. We instead fold the temporal smoothness constraint into a training-free registration objective and solve for all poses jointly with L-BFGS. The payoff depends on how well the object is seen. On well-observed tracks it is large: within the low-roughness budget, the joint objective beats both post-hoc smoothers on paired multi-seed statistics and cuts roughness several-fold relative to frame-wise registration at matched accuracy. Treating visibility as an experimental variable exposes the limit. The advantage decays monotonically as views become one-sided, until it is indistinguishable from zero for near-edge-on objects and slightly negative under a ray-cast simulator with range-dependent density and ego motion, where the decoupled pipeline is in fact ahead at tight roughness budgets. We locate that boundary and trace it to one term: orientation alignment ties yaw to the estimated velocity and fails once that estimate is noisy. A ground-truth-free rule can choose the temporal scale and keep every track inside the roughness budget.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无训练的联合优化框架，将时间平滑约束直接融入3D目标配准过程，通过L-BFGS算法同时求解所有位姿，旨在解决传统“先独立配准、后平滑”方法在几何精度与轨迹平滑度之间的权衡问题。该方法在观测良好时显著优于后处理平滑器，但在视角受限或噪声较大时需调整策略。
AI.motivation: 传统的3D目标跟踪流水线通常将几何配准与时间平滑分离：先逐帧独立注册以获得高精度边界框，再通过卡尔曼RTS或Savitzky-Golay滤波器进行后处理平滑。然而，这种解耦方法会导致位置偏离几何最优解且无法重新优化，从而在平滑过程中牺牲了几何精度，无法在保证低粗糙度（高平滑性）的同时维持高交并比（IoU）。
AI.method:
1. **联合优化目标**：构建一个无训练的注册目标函数，显式包含几何准确性（IoU最大化）和时间平滑性（轨迹粗糙度最小化）的约束。
2. **全局求解**使用L-BFGS算法对所有帧的位姿进行联合优化，而非逐帧处理。
3. **自适应策略**：引入基于可见性的实验分析，确定联合优化的适用边界；针对方位对齐导致偏航角估计受速度噪声影响的问题，提出无Ground-Truth的时间尺度选择规则，以确保每条轨迹保持在设定的粗糙度预算内。
AI.result:
1. **高性能优势**：在观测良好的轨道上，该方法在相同的粗糙度预算下，其统计性能显著优于后处理平滑器；在与帧级配准精度匹配的情况下，其轨迹粗糙度降低了数个数量级。
2. **局限性识别**：当视角变为单侧（near-edge-on）时，优势单调递减直至消失；在带有距离相关密度和自运动的光线投射模拟器中，若粗糙度预算紧逼，解耦管道（传统方法）实际上表现更好。
3. **原因定位**：性能下降主要归因于方位对齐项将偏航角绑定到估计速度上，在速度估计 noisy 时失效。
4. **可行性验证**提出的无GT规则能有效选择时间尺度，确保轨迹符合约束。
AI.conclusion: 通过将时间平滑约束整合进训练-free的注册目标并进行联合优化，可以在数据条件良好时显著提升3D跟踪的几何精度和平滑度。然而，该方法对数据质量敏感，特别是在视角单一或运动估计噪声大时表现不佳。因此，应根据场景可见性和数据质量灵活选择联合优化还是传统解耦流程，并利用无监督规则动态调整参数以平衡精度与平滑性。

title: SpecRegMatch: Robust Semi-Supervised Regression for Vehicle Interior Noise Prediction
comment: Published in IEEE Access, vol. 12, pp. 60-72, 2024
summary: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has observed increased application in predicting vehicle interior noise levels within the automotive industry. However, the collection of labeled data for training models in this context involves significant costs. Previous studies in semi-supervised regression (SSR) have effectively mitigated the reliance on labeled data by incorporating unlabeled data. Nonetheless, these approaches often introduce a high computational cost due to the training of multiple models and data sampling. This study introduces SpecRegMatch, a novel SSR method aimed at addressing the computational cost associated with training by leveraging a single model, thus eliminating the need for multiple data samplings. SpecRegMatch integrates consistency regularization and information maximization to robustly train the model, achieved through various augmentations applied to both the embedding vectors and predicted values. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecRegMatch achieves state-of-the-art performance across various scenarios, even when using a single model. It attains a remarkable performance, as indicated by an R^2 score of 0.434. This is especially noteworthy in scenarios where labeled data is scarce. You can access the code for our proposed method at https://github.com/sejin-sim/SpecRegMatch.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecRegMatch，一种用于预测车内噪声的新型半监督回归（SSR）方法。该方法通过单一模型结合一致性正则化和信息最大化，解决了传统多模型SSR计算成本高及采样繁琐的问题，在标签数据稀缺场景下取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然AI在预测车内噪声方面应用增多，但标注数据采集成本高昂。现有的半监督回归（SSR）方法虽能利用未标记数据减少依赖，但因需训练多个模型和数据进行采样，导致极高的计算成本。
AI.method: 提出SpecRegMatch方法，核心创新在于：1. 仅使用单一模型进行训练，消除对多模型集成和数据采样的需求；2. 结合一致性正则化（Consistency Regularization）和信息最大化（Information Maximization）来增强模型鲁棒性；3. 对嵌入向量（embedding vectors）和预测值施加多种增强操作以构建训练信号。
AI.result: 在多种场景下实现了最先进的（SOTA）性能。特别是在标签数据稀缺的情况下表现卓越，取得了0.434的R^2分数。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SpecRegMatch证明了在保持高性能的同时，通过单一模型和特定的正则化策略可以显著降低半监督回归的计算复杂度，为标注成本敏感的汽车NVH（噪声、振动与声振粗糙度）领域提供了高效解决方案。

title: GUITAR: Structured Failure Diagnosis of GUI Agents via State Transitions
summary: Understanding where and why Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents fail is essential for building more reliable systems, yet current evaluation relies on step accuracy, a metric that treats each screen independently and overlooks the underlying structure of GUI environments. This leads to two critical blind spots: (1) functionally equivalent screens are evaluated in isolation, obscuring systematic failure patterns across shared screens; and (2) the long-tailed GUI distribution renders failures on rare but critical screens invisible under standard metrics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{GUITAR}, a state-centric diagnostic framework that performs structured failure analysis over both states and transitions, using a State Transition Graph (STG) by mapping visually diverse screens to shared functional states. Across 8 agents and 6 tasks from AndroidControl and Mind2Web, GUITAR reveals that 60.4\% of failures occur in 20\% of states, localizing errors to a small set of bottlenecks. Bottleneck-targeted guidance improves SR by 2.8\% and retains a 1.88\% average gain across 7 agents under three-fold trajectory-held-out evaluation with fully automatic STGs. These findings demonstrate the diagnostic and actionable value of structure-aware evaluation within the evaluated mobile and web tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/sqzhang-lazy/GUITAR

AI.tldr: 提出GUITAR框架，通过状态转换图（STG）分析GUI代理的结构化故障，揭示少数关键状态导致大部分失败，并通过针对性指导显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅关注单步准确性，忽视了GUI环境的底层结构，存在两大盲点：无法识别跨共享屏幕的系统性失败模式，且长尾分布使得罕见但关键的屏幕故障被掩盖。
AI.method: 构建GUITAR诊断框架，利用状态转换图（STG）将视觉多样但功能相同的屏幕映射为共享的功能状态，对状态和转移进行结构化故障分析，并实施瓶颈定向引导策略。
AI.result: 在AndroidControl和Mind2Web的8个代理和6个任务中测试发现，60.4%的故障集中在20%的状态中；针对瓶颈的引导使成功率提升2.8%，且在7个代理上保持1.88%的平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 基于结构的评估具有显著的诊断价值和可行动性，能有效揭示系统薄弱环节并提升GUI代理的可靠性与鲁棒性。

title: From Attack Success to Attack Severity: Counterfactual Memory Attacks on LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent memory for long-horizon and personalized behavior, they can retain and reuse information across interactions, but this also creates a lasting channel through which malicious memory writes can influence future behavior. Persistent-memory attacks are typically evaluated by whether they succeed, yet successful attacks can leave persistent states with substantially different downstream consequences. We study this severity as a distinct attack-design objective and formalize it with counterfactual memory regret (CMR), the paired increase in expected downstream loss relative to clean memory. We introduce MemHarm, which predeclares a finite class of sparse, grounded semantic edits, evaluates candidates through the normal agent memory interface using offline paired-loss feedback, and certifies resolved selections within that class. Compared with attack-success optimization, CMR-guided selection produces substantially larger downstream loss while retaining most of the success-rate gain. Across two agent benchmarks and diverse memory designs, MemHarm attains the highest CMR point estimates among the evaluated general attacks on identical support. Factor-removal interventions link this harm to the selected semantic factor, and native-agent deployments verify the write-to-fresh-process attack path.

AI.tldr: 提出MemHarm框架，通过优化“反事实记忆遗憾（CMR）”而非仅攻击成功率，对LLM代理的持久化记忆进行恶意写入，实现更大程度的下游损害。
AI.motivation: LLM代理依赖持久化记忆以支持长期和个人化行为，这使得恶意记忆写入能持续影响未来行为。现有评估仅关注攻击是否成功，但忽视了不同攻击成功后造成的严重后果差异。
AI.method: 形式化定义“反事实记忆遗憾（CMR）”作为攻击设计目标；引入MemHarm框架，预声明稀疏、接地气的语义编辑类，通过正常代理记忆接口利用离线成对损失反馈评估候选方案，并认证选定结果。
AI.result: 相比传统攻击成功率优化，CMR引导的选择在保持大部分成功率增益的同时，显著增大了下游损失。在两个代理基准测试和多种记忆设计中，MemHarm在同支撑集上实现了最高的CMR点估计值。干预实验证实了危害与所选语义因子的关联。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了持久化记忆攻击的严重程度是一个可优化的独立目标，MemHarm能有效利用这一特性造成更深远的破坏，为理解LLM代理记忆安全提供了新视角。

title: StateGuard: Analytical-State Management with Validity-Aware Intervention for Long-Horizon Data Agents
summary: LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities in automated data analysis and are increasingly moving toward long-horizon, multi-stage analytical workflows. However, as the analytical process evolves, constraints, variables, and conclusions remain implicitly embedded in interaction histories, making it difficult for agents to track which analytical artifacts remain valid over increasingly long horizons and changing dependencies. Consequently, stale artifacts may be silently inherited, propagating errors to downstream stages. To address this challenge, we propose StateGuard, an analytical-state validity management framework for long-horizon data agents. StateGuard externalizes evolving analytical progress into a state graph containing constraints, versioned variables, intermediate conclusions, and cross-state relations, treating each state as an executable, verifiable, and traceable object rather than textual memory alone. StateGuard maintains state validity through evidence-grounded verification and hierarchical intervention. To equip StateGuard with these capabilities, we first introduce Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision, which constructs 3K state-centric trajectories through counterfactual runtime synthesis to fine-tune StateGuard for state maintenance, verification, and repair. We then apply Validity-Guided Policy Optimization, using runtime validity evidence to provide fine-grained learning signals for protocol correctness, state grounding, and intervention quality. Experiments on three diverse long-horizon data-analysis benchmarks show that StateGuard consistently improves data-agent performance while reducing dependency-induced downstream error propagation, demonstrating the advantages of explicit analytical-state management for reliable long-horizon data analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出StateGuard框架，通过构建显式状态图和管理机制，解决大语言模型智能体在长周期数据分析中因隐式历史信息导致的 stale artifacts 传播错误问题，提升分析可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长周期、多阶段数据分析工作流中，随着过程演进，约束、变量和结论隐含在交互历史中，难以追踪哪些产物依然有效，导致陈旧产物被静默继承并向下游传播错误。
AI.method: 1. 提出StateGuard框架，将分析进展外化为包含约束、版本化变量、中间结论及跨状态关系的“状态图”，视每个状态为可执行、可验证、可追溯的对象；2. 引入面向管理者的反事实监督（Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision），通过3K条轨迹微调以增强状态维护、验证和修复能力；3. 应用有效性引导的策略优化（Validity-Guided Policy Optimization），利用运行时有效性证据提供细粒度学习信号以优化协议正确性和干预质量。
AI.result: 在三个不同的长周期数据分析基准测试中，StateGuard一致提升了数据智能体的性能，减少了由依赖关系引起的下游错误传播。
AI.conclusion: 显式的分析状态管理对于实现可靠长周期数据分析具有显著优势。

title: Evo2Team: When Do Evolved Skills Transfer? From Selection to Deployment
summary: A skill bank that helps one multi-agent system may leave another's behavior unchanged. A transferred rule helps only when target agents act on it successfully. We study this path for routing and communication skills in Count-Frequency and AgentsNet, using teams of 4--32 agents and GPT and Qwen model ladders. Source evolution meets a joint quality, cost, model-tier, and confirmation goal in 14 of 16 settings. We then evaluate Evo2Team, which selects, adapts, and confirms source skills for the target team, alongside six frozen selectors across 28 transfer directions. Evo2Team's target-side exploration cost is below that of evolving a new target bank in every direction, even when reused reference evaluations are charged once. Twenty of 28 held-out outcomes meet the positive-transfer criterion, including three saved diagnostic tests. Selection alone does not explain these outcomes: KNN and CORAL choose different banks in two AgentsNet directions but produce identical recorded executions. When Evo2Team changes execution, gains can reach many tasks, as in a Count-Frequency direction that improves 28 of 32 tasks over KNN. Seven positive AgentsNet outcomes save 6.1--14.6\% in deployment cost while using transferred skills on only three to six of fifteen tasks. In five earlier accepted directions, all 22 task records using transferred skills pass three fixed-graph confirmations, but four fail in recorded executions on new graphs. Graphs and model responses change together in this comparison. These results show that skill transfer must be assessed through the actions agents take, the tasks those actions reach, and the quality and cost of the final deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了多智能体系统中技能（路由和通信）的转移效果，提出Evo2Team方法来评估源技能的转移、适应和确认。实验表明，技能转移必须通过智能体的具体行动、任务覆盖以及最终部署的质量与成本来综合评估，而非仅依赖选择机制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究指出，适用于一个多智能体系统的技能库可能无法改善另一个系统的行为；只有当目标智能体成功执行转移规则时，转移才有效。因此，需要深入探究技能在从源团队到目标团队转移过程中的有效性及其影响因素。
AI.method:
1. 基于Count-Frequency和AgentsNet模型，使用4-32个智能体的团队及GPT和Qwen模型序列进行实验。
2. 验证Source evolution在不同设置下的表现。
3. 评估Evo2Team方法（负责选择、适应和确认源技能），并与六种固定选择器在28个转移方向上进行对比。
4. 分析不同选择算法（如KNN和CORAL）的表现差异及部署成本节省情况。
AI.result:
1. Source evolution在16个设置中的14个达到了质量、成本、模型层级和确认的综合目标。
2. Evo2Target在28个转移方向中，其目标侧探索成本低于直接为新目标银行演变的情况，即便重复使用参考评估也如此。
3. 20/28的保留结果满足正转移标准。
4. 选择本身不能解释所有结果：KNN和CORAL在某些方向上选择不同的技能库但产生相同的执行记录；但在Count-Frequency方向上，Evo2Team改进显著。
5. AgentsNet的正向结果节省了6.1-14.6%的部署成本。
6. 新图结构上的执行失败揭示了图和模型响应的共同变化对转移效果的影响。
AI.conclusion: 技能转移的有效性不能仅看选择策略，而必须通过智能体采取的具体行动、这些行动所覆盖的任务范围，以及最终部署的质量和成本来进行全面评估。图和模型响应的协同变化对转移结果有重要影响。

title: Waggle: Learning One Anonymous Local Law for Self-Organizing LLM Swarms
summary: As LLM agents increasingly collaborate on complex tasks, how to organize their interactions becomes a central design question. Existing multi-agent systems typically learn or adapt explicit roles, hierarchies, routing policies, or communication topologies. We shift the learning target to a reusable local law that can be shared across interchangeable agents and adapt coordination as populations or interaction conditions change, without redefining a global organization. We introduce Waggle, a shared anonymous policy over bounded local views that jointly selects task actions, semantic communication, and local commitment updates. Repeated execution of the same law allows coordination to form, persist, and reorganize online without explicit roles or global topology. To learn this law across interchangeable agents and evolving coordination, we develop Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD), combining anonymous-orbit consistency with rollout-grounded prediction of the next local coordination field, with no added inference-time components. Across diverse coordination settings, the same learned law remains effective as populations and interaction budgets change, retains over 96% of substrate-specific oracle quality, and transfers without retraining; SCD further improves reorganization after counterevidence. Together, these results show that LLM-agent organization can emerge and adapt through repeated execution of a learned local law.

AI.tldr: 提出Waggle框架，通过共享的、基于本地视角的匿名策略（local law）来实现LLM多智能体系统的动态协作。该方法无需预定义的全局角色或拓扑结构，而是让协调模式在重复执行中自发涌现，并利用Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD)算法进行训练，实现了跨不同环境和种群变化的高泛化性和自适应性。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂任务中的合作日益增多，如何组织它们的交互成为核心设计难题。现有的多智能体系统通常依赖显式的角色、层级、路由策略或通信拓扑，这些方法缺乏灵活性且难以适应动态变化的环境或交换式智能体群体。旨在寻找一种可重用、无需全局重新定义的局部协调机制。
AI.method: 引入了名为Waggle的方法，这是一种针对有界本地视角的共享匿名策略。它联合选择任务动作、语义通信和本地承诺更新。为了学习这种策略，开发了Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD)，结合匿名轨道一致性与基于 rollout 的下一步局部协调场预测，无需增加推理时的组件。
AI.result: 在多样的协调设置中，同一学习到的局部法律在种群和交互预算变化时保持有效，保留了超过96%的子特定Oracle质量，并可迁移而无需重新训练。SCD还进一步改善了反证后的重组能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体的组织可以通过重复执行一个学到的局部法律来涌现并适应变化，证明了去中心化、基于局部规则的协调机制在多智能体系统中的潜力。

title: You Can't Have It Both Ways: Concept Entanglement Limits Diffusion Model Unlearning
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress a target concept (e.g., \texttt{horse}) while preserving related but distinct content (e.g., \texttt{donkey}), yet existing methods either leak under indirect prompts or visibly degrade other concepts. We show that these failure modes stem from the geometry of concept representations rather than from any particular algorithm. Formalizing concepts as activation-space regions, we prove that the overlap between a target and other concepts lower-bounds the damage any robust erasure must inflict on them, with the trade-off scaling linearly in the degree of overlap. Across thirteen unlearning methods, including methods designed to preserve non-target concepts, no method achieves both strong erasure and strong neighbor preservation: STEREO nearly eliminates indirect leakage but cuts neighbor generation by more than 75\%, while sparse inference-time methods preserve neighbors but leak. Damage increases with our overlap measure, monotonically so for STEREO; the $κ$-scaling reproduces on SDXL, and neighbor-selective damage recurs on FLUX. Perfect unlearning is the wrong target for entangled concepts; methods should be evaluated on the Pareto frontier our theorem establishes.

AI.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型中的概念未学习存在固有局限，目标概念与其他概念的几何重叠决定了无法同时实现完美擦除和保留邻近概念，现有方法均受此理论极限约束。
AI.motivation: 解决现有概念未学习方法在抑制目标概念时，要么通过间接提示泄露信息，要么明显退化为其他相关概念（如“驴”）的问题。
AI.method: 将概念形式化为激活空间区域，证明目标概念与其他概念的重叠程度为任何稳健擦除带来的损害设定了下限；跨十三种未学习方法进行实验评估，包括STERO、稀疏推理时间方法等，并在SDXL和FLUX上复现验证。
AI.result: 发现所有方法的失败模式源于概念表示的几何结构而非算法本身；目标与邻近概念的重叠度线性放大损害；STEREO消除泄漏但导致邻居生成率下降超75%，稀疏方法保留邻居但产生泄漏；不存在能同时实现强擦除和强邻居保留的方法。
AI.conclusion: 对于纠缠的概念，“完美未学习”并非正确目标；应基于定理建立的帕累托前沿来评估方法性能，接受在擦除效果与概念保留之间的权衡。

title: Same Tasks, Different Apps: Why Mobile GUI Agents Fail to Generalize?
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages
summary: Mobile GUI agents deployed in real settings must work across different applications that support the same functionality. Most existing benchmarks test each task in only one app, so a high score can mean the agent understands the task, or only that it knows that particular app. We introduce AnyAppBench, a category-controlled live Android benchmark that evaluates cross-application generalization while keeping the user goal fixed. It spans 10 functional categories, 100 task templates, and 520 task--application pairs over 52 applications. Agents run from raw instructions and with app-independent sub-goals, and a VLM judge labels every failed run under a fixed failure taxonomy whose reliability is measured by human annotation. We find that, across 13 agents, success on the original application does not transfer reliably to new applications with the same goal. Furthermore, providing high-level sub-goal decomposition produces only small, category-dependent changes that do not close the gap, and the mix of failure types changes with the target interface. Based on those insights, we believe the AnyAppBench benchmark provides an important stepping stone toward robust real-world deployment of mobile GUI agents. Our code, data and the leaderboard can be found at the project website https://anyappbench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出AnyAppBench基准，用于评估移动GUI代理在不同应用间的跨应用泛化能力，揭示了现有代理在新应用中表现不佳且难以通过子目标分解有效改进的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试多在单一应用中评估任务，高分可能仅反映代理对特定应用的熟悉程度而非真正理解任务，缺乏对跨应用泛化能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建涵盖10个功能类别、100个任务模板和52个应用的Android基准；使用VLM裁判对失败运行进行分类，并通过人工标注验证可靠性；测试13种代理在固定用户目标下的表现。
AI.result: 在原有应用上成功的代理无法可靠地泛化到新应用；提供高层子目标分解仅带来微小且不稳定的性能提升；失败类型随目标界面变化而改变。
AI.conclusion: AnyAppBench为移动GUI代理在真实世界中的稳健部署提供了重要基础，指出了当前技术在跨应用泛化方面的显著不足。

title: Self-Evolving Agents via Likelihood-Guided Tool-Space Optimization
summary: Self-evolving agents can continually improve their behavior, while tools define the executable action space through which they interact with the environment. However, exposing the full tool library to model introduces substantial irrelevant context and can impair tool-use decisions. We study tool-space self-evolution, where each recurring task type maintains a persistent tool space which is constructed from accumulated output experience. We identify three limitations of existing methods: (1) output-unaware selection: they rely primarily on tool descriptions or model priors rather than observed tool outputs; (2) statelessness across request: they select tools independently for each request without consolidating prior output experience into persistent task-specific state; (3) inference cost: they repeatedly search, rank, or reason over candidate tools for subsequent requests of the same task. We address these limitations through output-aware tool scoring, persistent task-specific tool spaces, amortized tool selection, and reusable configurations across models. We introduce LOTS (Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring), which evolves an agent's tool space from accumulated output experience while keeping model parameters fixed. After each request, LOTS holds the model's generated answer and estimates each tool's contribution by measuring how much the answer likelihood changes when its observed output is removed. These contributions are aggregated within each recurring task to rank tools and update its persistent space. Across three benchmarks, LOTS improves task performance while substantially reducing tool context. More importantly, sequential experiments demonstrate that task-specific spaces persist and continue to improve over time, while cross-model experiments show that learned configurations transfer across different models.

AI.tldr: 提出LOTS方法，通过保留模型参数固定，利用历史输出经验对工具进行评分和筛选，构建持久化、特定任务的工具空间，从而减少上下文冗余并提升长期性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法暴露全量工具库导致无关上下文增加，且存在输出感知缺失、跨请求无状态、推理成本高等局限性，无法有效利用累积经验优化工具使用决策。
AI.method: 引入LOTS（仅似然工具评分），在每次请求后，通过移除观测到的输出来测量答案似然的变化，评估每个工具的贡献度；将这些贡献度聚合到重复发生的任务中，更新持久化的特定任务工具空间。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，LOTS在提升任务性能的同时显著减少了工具上下文开销；序列实验证明特定任务空间会随时间推移持续改进，跨模型实验表明学习到的配置具有可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 基于输出感知的自我演化机制能有效解决现有工具选择的低效问题，实现持久化任务状态管理和跨模型复用，为智能体的自主进化提供了新途径。

title: TableSeek: Structure-Preserving Agentic Evidence Seeking over Heterogeneous Table Corpora
summary:
Open-domain table retrieval seeks tables that contain sufficient evidence for answering a question or verifying a claim. Yet semantic relevance is often misleading: topically similar tables may lack the required facts, while answer-bearing evidence is often confined to a few cells whose meaning depends on surrounding schema and table context. Heterogeneous schemas, value formats, and serializations further weaken one-shot matching.
  We present TableSeek, a structure-preserving agentic search framework for heterogeneous table corpora. Instead of ranking tables once, an LLM agent iteratively follows sparse clues, inspects schema-preserving previews, identifies schema- and value-level mismatches, and refines its investigation. TableSeek uses cells and schemas as evidence anchors while retaining complete tables as evidence units, enabling fine-grained localization without losing the context required for interpretation and answerability checking.
  Without relying on retriever training or a precomputed semantic index, TableSeek produces transparent evidence-seeking trajectories and achieves competitive end-to-end performance against strong retrieval-and-reranking pipelines on heterogeneous table benchmarks. These results suggest that active, structure-preserving evidence seeking is a promising paradigm for open-domain table retrieval.

AI.tldr: TableSeek：一种用于异构表格库的结构保持型智能体搜索框架，通过LLM迭代验证和细粒度定位，解决开放域表格检索中语义相关性误导及上下文缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有开放域表格检索面临语义相关性误导（表面相关但缺乏事实证据）、答案往往局限于依赖Schema和上下文的少数单元格、以及异构Schema/值格式削弱一次性匹配效果等挑战。
AI.method: 提出TableSeek框架，利用LLM智能体迭代执行稀疏线索追踪、Schema保留预览检查、Schema/值级别不匹配识别及调查优化。该方法以单元格和Schema为证据锚点，同时保留完整表格作为证据单元，实现细粒度定位与语境保留。无需训练检索器或预计算语义索引。
AI.result: 在异构表格基准测试中，TableSeek实现了透明化的证据搜索轨迹，并取得了与强大的检索-重排序流水线相当的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 主动式、结构保持的证据搜索是开放域表格检索的一种有前景的研究范式。

title: RoutePrism: Tracing Construction Order Effects in Agent Memory
summary: Processing the same records in a different order can discard different evidence, yet endpoint accuracy alone cannot reveal what changed or whether it mattered. We introduce RoutePrism, a diagnostic protocol that builds memory twice from the same source pool in two processing orders, then traces which sources, compiled contexts, and answers differ. Because record content, timestamps, policy, and the answer model all stay fixed, any observed difference is localized to the memory construction step. A matched four-condition intervention tests whether a record displaced by reordering actually carried task-relevant evidence: restoring that single record recovers over 60 percentage points of lost accuracy, while substituting a non-supporting record of equal length does not. We evaluate the protocol on PersonaMem-32K (63 primary queries, 29 users) and 470 LongMemEval-S questions with histories spanning 38 to 62 sessions, replicating the core intervention across five answer models. Survivor selection, defined as the choice of which record a cluster retains, drives most source-level changes, while different memory policies (compaction, bounded recency, MemoChat-style summarization, A-MEM) produce distinct failure signatures at the source, context, and metadata layers.

AI.tldr: 提出RoutePrism诊断协议，通过双重记忆构建揭示记录处理顺序对系统准确性的影响机制。核心发现：被重新排序移除的记录携带关键证据，恢复这些记录可挽回超过60%的准确率损失；集群的存活选择（Survivor selection）是驱动源级变化的主要因素，不同记忆策略表现出独特的故障特征。
AI.motivation: 现有的端点准确性指标无法解释在处理相同记录的不同顺序中，哪些具体证据被丢弃以及这种变化是否影响了最终结果。需要一种诊断方法来隔离并定位因处理顺序不同导致的记忆构造差异及其对答案的影响。
AI.method: 引入RoutePrism诊断协议，从同一源池中按两种不同处理顺序分别构建记忆两次。固定记录内容、时间戳、策略和答案模型，仅观察记忆构造步骤中的差异。采用匹配的四条件干预测试：验证被移位记录是否包含任务相关证据，通过恢复该单一记录或替换为非支持性记录来检验准确率的恢复情况。在PersonaMem-32K和LongMemEval-S数据集上，跨越五个答案模型进行验证。
AI.result:
1. 关键证据定位：被重新排序位移掉的记录确实携带了任务相关的证据，恢复该单条记录可恢复超过60个百分点的准确率损失，而替换为同等长度的非支持记录则无效。
2. 主要驱动因素：存活选择（即集群保留哪条记录的选择）导致了大部分源级变化。
3. 策略差异：不同的记忆策略（如压缩、有界最近性、MemoChat式摘要、A-MEM）在源层、上下文层和元数据层产生了 distinct 的故障签名。
AI.conclusion: RoutePrism有效证明了记录处理顺序通过影响“存活选择”进而改变记忆内容，直接决定系统准确性。该协议成功量化了特定记录被丢弃的损失程度，并为评估和优化不同记忆管理策略提供了细粒度的诊断依据。

title: ReplayLens: Auditing Agents' Use of Outcomes
summary: When an agent reuses logged experience, a changed decision may reflect the recorded score, the action's name, or the record's position in storage. Standard memory evaluations do not reveal which relationship drives that change. We introduce ReplayLens, a black-box audit that changes one relationship in the stored history at a time, holds the remaining interface fixed, and measures the resulting decision. Four interventions target four relationships. Outcome reassignment swaps which scores belong to which actions. Pair transport moves intact action-score pairs to new record slots. Consistent renaming relabels actions in both history and menu. Key-slot reassignment changes both score attachment and position. A constructive separation shows why the audit is needed: two memory writers with identical endpoint accuracy respond differently to the same replay, so conventional evaluation cannot resolve the underlying dependence. On black-box LLM interfaces, swapping scores changes decisions while moving intact pairs does not, separating score attachment from record order. A bounded-memory study exposes ingestion-order sensitivity that endpoint comparison misses. In sequential experiment planning, altered historical scores redirect exploration and reduce final utility despite fresh measurements. A code-debugging agent with sealed hidden tests shows the same pattern outside model selection. ReplayLens provides a relationship-level audit for deciding whether logged experience can be merged, reordered, or reindexed safely.

AI.tldr: 提出ReplayLens，一种针对重用历史经验智能体的黑盒审计方法。通过单次改变记录中的一个关系（得分、动作名、位置等）并测量决策变化，分离出驱动决策的具体因素，解决传统评估无法揭示记忆依赖机制的问题。
AI.motivation: 当智能体重用日志经验时，决策变化可能源于记录的分数、动作名称或存储位置。传统的内存评估（endpoint evaluation）只能比较最终准确性，无法揭示是哪种内在关系（relationship）导致了决策差异，因此无法判断日志经验是否可以安全地合并、重排或重新索引。
AI.method: 引入ReplayLens黑盒审计框架，保持其他接口固定，每次仅改变存储历史中的一个关系，并测量 resulting decision。设计了四种干预措施对应四种关系：1. 结果重分配（Outcome reassignment）：交换分数与动作的归属；2. 配对传输（Pair transport）：将完整的“动作-分数”对移动到新记录槽位；3. 一致重命名（Consistent renaming）：在历史和菜单中同时重标动作名；4. 关键槽重分配（Key-slot reassignment）：改变分数附着和位置。
AI.result: 1. LLM界面测试显示，交换分数会改变决策而移动完整配对则不会，证明了分数附着与记录顺序是可分离的独立因素；2. 有限内存研究揭示了传统对比忽略的“摄入顺序敏感性”；3. 序列实验规划中，更改历史分数会引导探索方向并最终降低效用；4. 代码调试智能体（隐藏测试）也表现出相同模式，证明该问题具有通用性。
AI.conclusion: ReplayLens提供了一种基于“关系级别”的审计方法，能够明确识别日志经验中的驱动因素，从而决定这些经验是否可以被安全地合并、重排或重新索引，弥补了传统评估方法的不足。

title: RAGWarrant: Evidence-Preserving Governance for RAG Policy Promotion Under Quality, Cost, Latency, and Risk Constraints
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Preprint v0.1.1-rc1. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/RAGWarrant/ragwarrant-governance
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are extensively instrumented with metrics, benchmarks, traces, and automated judges, but these tools do not decide whether a proposed policy change is safe to release. We present RAGWarrant, an open-source promotion-control framework that treats deployment as a constrained evidence decision rather than a leaderboard choice. RAGWarrant normalizes evaluator outputs and operational telemetry, applies predeclared quality and hard-risk gates, assigns evidence-class claim ceilings, preserves negative outcomes, and emits auditable PROMOTE, BLOCK, REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE decisions. We evaluate the framework across T2-RAGBench, MultiHop-RAG, CRAG, HotpotQA, synthetic reproduction, and bounded local generative experiments. On HotpotQA, operational savings were blocked because answer quality fell beyond the declared margin. A bounded CRAG study selected a lower-cost quality-tied policy, but related generative gains were unstable and a held-out guardrail failed closed. We claim an auditable promotion-control abstraction, not optimizer superiority, human validation, or production readiness. The tagged artifact reproduces from a fresh clone, runs as a hardened Docker job, accepts external evaluator exports, and verifies artifact integrity.

AI.tldr: RAGWarrant 是一个用于检索增强生成（RAG）系统的开源部署控制框架，它通过将部署视为受限的证据决策过程，提供可审计的 PROMOTE/BLOCK/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE 决策，而非依赖传统的排行榜选择。
AI.motivation: 现有的 RAG 评估工具（指标、基准、追踪和自动评判器）主要用于性能评估，无法有效判断政策变更是否在释放前是安全的；缺乏一种机制来决定何时可以安全地部署改进策略。
AI.method: 提出 RAGWarrant 框架：标准化评估器输出和操作遥测数据；应用预设的质量和硬性风险关卡；分配证据类主张上限；保留负面结果；生成可审计的部署决定（推进、阻止、拒绝或不确定）。在 T2-RAGBench、MultiHop-RAG、CRAG、HotpotQA 等基准上进行评估。
AI.result:
1. 在 HotpotQA 上，由于答案质量下降超过规定阈值，操作节省被阻止（即未批准低成本但有质量风险的策略）。
2. 在 CRAG 研究中，虽然选定了与质量挂钩的低成本策略，但生成的增益不稳定且护栏失效。
3. 提供的工件可通过克隆复现，以 Docker 容器运行，并接受外部评估器导出。
AI.conclusion: RAGWarrant 提供了一个可审计的推广-控制抽象层，其核心贡献在于部署决策的安全性与可追溯性，而非证明优化器的优越性、人类验证或生产环境的完全就绪。

title: Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen
summary: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了在视频文本证据固定的情况下，不同决策读出方式（Jev vs Qwen）的性能。结果显示在XD-Violence数据上Jev显著优于Qwen，但在UCF-Crime数据上无优势且概率校准较差。结论表明该接口未证明具有因果性益处、普遍优越性或端到端加速能力。
AI.motivation: 探究当视频导出的文本证据固定时，决策读出机制对性能的影响有多大，以评估不同类型界面和概率读出的质量及局限性。
AI.method: 在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集的稀疏开发样本（各40个视频、400个目标锚点）上，评估Jev类型决策与三种Qwen读出方法。通过摘要和有序字幕呈现数据，严格遵循数值政策进行预测响应筛选，并计算平均精度(AP)、ROC-AUC及Brier分数等指标。
AI.result: 1. 在XD-Violence字幕数据上，Jev Noul的平均精度为75.99%，显著高于Qwen生成的48.47%和局部序数似然预期的57.81%，差异达18.18个百分点。2. 在UCF-Crime数据上未显示此优势，序数似然预期的ROC-AUC (65.95%) 高于Noul (52.26%)。3. 两种概率读出方法在UCF上的Brier分数均差于基准参考值(0.0475)。4. 缺少二元似然控制，无法建立因果效应。
AI.conclusion: 这些探索性离线结果描绘了排序、概率质量和界面故障的特征。研究既未证实类型化界面具有因果关系带来的益处或普遍优越性，也未证明其校准效果或端到端加速能力。

title: Efficient Reasoning via Constrained Optimization in Latent Space
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. To leverage this, we keep reasoning focused within this region via a quadratic program which projects deviating hidden states back into the region. Then we propose a novel training-free framework to achieve efficient reasoning that reduces token generation costs without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 14B, and across six benchmarks in math reasoning, coding, and scientific QA, validate the effectiveness of our method, up to a 12.1\% improvement in accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 11.8\% to 52.8\%. Codes are available at \href{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}.

AI.tldr: 针对大推理模型(LRMs)过度思考导致的token消耗高及现有方法易引发思考不足的问题，提出一种基于潜在空间聚类的无训练框架。通过二次规划将偏离高效推理区域的隐藏状态投影回该区域，在提升准确率（最高12.1%）的同时大幅减少生成token数（降低11.8%-52.8%）。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)存在“过度思考”现象，产生冗余推理步骤导致高昂的token消耗。现有的缓解方法（如抑制反思关键词或强制缩短长度）往往会截断必要步骤，导致“思考不足”，从而损害模型性能，因此需要在保持推理质量的同时提高效率和降低成本。
AI.method:
1. **观察分析**：研究发现高效推理步骤在潜在空间中自然聚集在一个集中区域内，而偏离此区域的步骤倾向于产生冗长序列。
2. **核心机制**：利用二次规划(Quadratic Program)，将偏离该有效区域的隐藏状态投影回该区域，以保持推理的聚焦和高效。
3. **框架提出**：构建了一种无需训练的推理优化框架(Opt4Reasoning)，直接在推理过程中进行隐式修正。
AI.result: 在1.5B至14B参数的四个模型上，以及数学推理、编程和科学问答领域的六个基准测试中进行了广泛实验。结果显示，该方法最多能将准确率提高12.1%，同时将生成的token数量减少了11.8%至52.8%，证明了其在平衡效率与性能方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜在空间中约束推理步骤的范围，可以在不牺牲甚至提升模型性能的前提下，显著减少大型推理模型的token消耗，为解决过度思考问题提供了一种高效且无需重新训练的解决方案。

title: CASS: Contribution-Aware Structured Sparsity for Model Merging
summary: Model merging integrates task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model, but often suffers from parameter interference caused by conflicting task-vector updates. Existing methods typically mitigate conflicts by pruning task vectors based on weight magnitude or random heuristics, treating Transformers as unstructured ``bags of parameters'' and overlooking their inherent modularity. In this paper, we propose \textbf{C}ontribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{S}parsity (CASS), a unified framework that reduces parameter interference by identifying and preserving task-specific components. At the core of CASS is a contribution-aware structured mask that identifies task-relevant attention heads and FFN neurons. We instantiate this mask in two settings: CASS-Merging, the primary post-hoc setting where masks serve as a plug-and-play denoising filter for existing merging operators, and CASS-Tuning, an extension for scenarios with fine-tuning access where masks constrain gradients to reduce structural overlap between task vectors. Our analysis shows that task-relevant components are sparse and partially disjoint, supporting structured component-level filtering as an effective way to reduce merging interference. Extensive experiments across vision (ViT, 20 tasks) and language (RoBERTa, 8 tasks; Qwen2.5, 4 tasks) benchmarks demonstrate that CASS improves a range of representative merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出CASS框架，通过识别和保留任务相关的注意力头和前馈神经网络神经元，以结构化稀疏性减少模型合并中的参数干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法通常基于权重大小或随机启发式规则对任务向量进行剪枝，将Transformer视为无结构的“参数集合”，忽视了其内在的模块化特性，导致参数干扰严重。
AI.method: 提出贡献感知结构化稀疏（CASS）框架，核心为贡献感知的结构化掩码，用于识别任务相关的组件；包含两种实例化设置：CASS-Merging（后处理设置，作为即插即用滤波器）和CASS-Tuning（微调访问设置，约束梯度以减少结构重叠）。
AI.result: 任务相关组件呈现稀疏和部分不相交的特性；在视觉（ViT，20个任务）和语言（RoBERTa 8个任务，Qwen2.5 4个任务）基准测试中，CASS能显著提升多种代表性合并基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化组件级过滤来减少合并干扰是有效的方法，CASS提供了一个统一的框架来解决Transformer模型合并中的参数冲突问题。

title: PainterBench: A Figural Divergent-Thinking Benchmark for Tool-Using Language Models
summary: Figural divergent thinking is the ability to develop a given shape fragment into an original drawing. In humans, this ability is assessed with incomplete-drawing tasks. We introduce PainterBench, a benchmark that ports the incomplete-drawing task to the agentic setting. The agent draws on a canvas through tool calls and observes the result after every turn. The canvas includes a starting shape which cannot be erased, and the agent's goal is to incorporate this shape into the most original drawing it can produce. The task is open-ended, and the agent itself decides when the drawing is finished. The benchmark tests incremental visual planning over a short horizon and the transfer of creative ability from pretraining to multi-turn tool use. We evaluate 14 multimodal language models from small to frontier scale. Across the primary study and six sensitivity analyses, we collect 2,700 drawings and crowdsource creativity and recognizability ratings for every drawing and for 300 human reference drawings. We also present ViDrA-adapted, an automated scorer that predicts human creativity ratings of agent drawings (r = 0.85 on random held-out test split). Figural divergent thinking varies widely across the 14 models, and GPT-6 Astra produces the most creative drawings. Relative to the human drawings, the agent drawings score higher in creativity but lower in recognizability. We release the final drawings, per-round canvas snapshots, tool call traces, stimulus bank, benchmark harness, crowdsourced ratings (N = 72,000), and ViDrA checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 提出PainterBench基准测试，评估多模态模型在“不完整绘图任务”中的具象发散思维与多轮工具使用能力。评测14个模型（最大规模GPT-6 Astra表现最佳），发现其创造力高于人类但可识别性较低，并提供自动化评分器ViDrA-adapted。
AI.motivation: 人类通过不完整绘图任务评估具象发散思维能力，目前缺乏将其迁移到智能体（agentic）设置下的标准化基准。旨在测试模型在短期增量视觉规划及将预训练创意能力转化为多轮工具使用方面的性能。
AI.method: 构建PainterBench基准：智能体通过工具调用在画布上作画，起始形状不可擦除，目标是在融入该形状的基础上创作最具原创性的画作，并由智能体自主决定结束时机。对14个多模态语言模型进行评测，收集2,700幅画作及人工创意/可识别性评分，并开发自动化评分器ViDrA-adapted预测人类评分。
AI.result: 不同模型在具象发散思维上差异显著，GPT-6 Astra生成最富有创意的画作。与人类参考画作相比，智能体画作在创造力评分上更高，但在可识别性上较低。ViDrA-adapted在随机 held-out 测试集上与人类评分的相关系数达到0.85。
AI.conclusion: PainterBench有效揭示了当前多模态模型在创造性视觉生成上的优势与局限。研究开源了所有画作、画布快照、工具调用轨迹、刺激库、基准工具包、7.2万条众包评分及ViDrA检查点，以促进后续研究。

title: Behavior-Grounded Semantic Enrichment for Financial Fraud Modeling and Reasoning
summary: In financial fraud detection, rich semantic context can provide important evidence for transaction behavior modeling and fraud reasoning. However, public real-world financial datasets often lack rich semantics due to privacy constraints. Consequently, synthetic datasets incorporate generated semantics, but at the cost of behavioral realism; textual descriptions for contextual reasoning remain scarce.
