AI.result: 对4个家族8种LLM的实验揭示三大鲁棒性特征：(1) 扰动可导致任务进展与科学可靠性解耦——代理可能在信息或推理已不可靠的情况下仍继续推进任务；(2) 清洁任务性能强不代表鲁棒性强——高精度模型在扰动下可能出现更大程度退化；(3) 扰动效应具强烈时间动态——扰动可潜伏多轮后才显现，并通过下游依赖关系传播。
AI.conclusion: 当前科学智能体对科学上合理的扰动缺乏足够鲁棒性，其失败往往具有隐蔽性，易引发连锁传播且难以恢复，亟需提升其在复杂多轮交互中的可靠性和容错能力。

title: APOLO: Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning
comment: Accepted at the Posters and Demos Track of the International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC 2026)
summary: Ontology Learning (OL) from text has advanced with the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs), but it remains challenging due to the limited availability of annotated training data and the difficulty of adapting LLMs to perform OL effectively. We address this via APOLO - Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning, by casting OL as an explicit prompt optimization problem over LLM modules. To obtain training data, we employ a multi-agent system that generates text-ontology pairs from existing expert-curated ontologies. We then propose two ontology learner architectures: a greedy and an autoregressive learner, and optimize both using GEPA, a greedy evolutionary prompt optimizer built on DSPy. Experiments on two ontologies - a biomedical (DOID) and a plant ontology (PO) show consistent improvements after optimization across nearly all model and mode combinations, with autoregressive learners achieving the largest gains. Our results demonstrate that prompt optimization is a viable and lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for OL, and that the autoregressive formulation better captures ontological structure than the greedy approach.

AI.tldr: 提出APOLO框架，通过DSPy中的GEPA优化提示词（Prompt Optimization）来解决大语言模型在本体学习（OL）中因标注数据稀缺而导致的适应难题。利用多智能体系统生成训练数据，并对比了贪婪与自回归两种架构，证明提示优化是微调的轻量级有效替代方案，且自回归模式更优。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）推动了本体学习的发展，但受限于标注训练数据的稀缺以及LLMs难以直接有效适配本体学习任务，该方法仍面临挑战。旨在解决如何高效利用LLMs进行本体构建的问题。
AI.method: 1. 将本体学习建模为LLM模块上的显式提示优化问题（APOLO框架）。2. 采用多智能体系统从专家 curated 的本体中自动生成文本-本体对作为训练数据。3. 提出贪婪型和自回归型两种本体学习器架构。4. 使用基于DSPy构建的贪婪进化提示优化器（GEPA）对上述架构进行优化。
AI.result: 在生物医学（DOID）和植物（PO）两个本体数据集上的实验表明，经过优化后，几乎所有模型和模式组合的性能均得到提升；其中，自回归学习器取得了最大的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 提示优化是本体学习中一种可行且轻量的、可替代微调的方法；此外，自回归形式的模型比贪婪方法能更好地捕捉本体结构特征。

title: Remember Before You're Asked: MemDream for Self-Probing Memory Evolution
summary: Memory is essential for enabling LLM-based agents to maintain coherent, personalized behavior over long-horizon interactions. However, existing memory systems share a fundamental limitation: they never proactively test their own memory, repairing it only after real queries expose weaknesses. This reactive paradigm means every retrieval failure corresponds to a real interaction in which the cost has already been paid. We propose MemDream, a framework that enables self-probing memory evolution for LLM agents. Our framework periodically enters offline dream cycles where three specialized agents (Dreamer, Analyst, Consolidator) collaboratively probe, diagnose, and repair the memory graph before failures occur. A policy trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization learns which repair operations produce durable retrieval improvements, while a soft decay mechanism provides reversible forgetting driven by the same anticipatory signal. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemoryAgentBench demonstrate that MemDream improves answer F1 by 4.5 points on LoCoMo and achieves a 9.1-point higher overall score on MAB over the strongest reactive-evolution baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MemDream框架，通过离线“梦境周期”让LLM代理主动探测、诊断和修复记忆图缺陷，解决传统记忆系统仅在检索失败后被动修复的局限性。实验显示在LoCoMo上F1提升4.5分，在MemoryAgentBench上总分超越最强基线9.1分。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆系统存在根本局限：仅采取反应式策略，即在真实交互中检索失败后才进行修复。这种被动模式导致每次错误都已在实际应用中付出了成本代价，缺乏预防性维护机制。
AI.method: 提出MemDream框架，包含三个专用代理（Dreamer、Analyst、Consolidator）在离线梦境周期中协同工作。利用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练策略模型以学习能产生持久检索提升的修复操作，并结合由预测信号驱动的软衰减机制实现可逆遗忘。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准测试中，答案F1分数提升4.5点；在MemoryAgentBench（MAB）基准测试中，总体得分比最强的反应式演化基线高出9.1分，证明其能有效提升记忆检索性能。
AI.conclusion: MemDream通过引入主动的自我探针记忆进化机制，成功解决了传统被动修复范式的高成本问题，显著增强了LLM代理在长程交互中维持连贯性和个性化行为的能力。

title: SGG-ReflAct: Sub-Goal Guided ReflAct with Structured Planning for Reliable Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in reasoning backbones have empowered large language model (LLM)agentstotackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, as reasoning horizons grow, inconsistent internal beliefs induce intermediate errors that cause agents to drift from their goals. This limitation also persists in REFLACT, which reflects only on the end-goal at each step without explicitly considering intermediate sub goals. To address this problem, we propose SGG-ReflAct (Sub-Goal Guided Re flAct), a reasoning backbone that integrates sub-goals generated through a single path LLM planner into the reflection process. We further extend this framework to BeamSGG-ReflAct, which replaces the single-path planner with a beam search based LLM planner for structured plan exploration. We run experiments on ALF World, ScienceWorld, and Jericho with multiple LLM models. SGG-ReflAct out performs REFLACT in nearly all settings, achieving best success rate gains of 14.9 percentage points on ALFWorld and 8.0 percentage points on ScienceWorld with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Our experimental analysis shows that SGG-ReflAct re duces hallucinated actions and achieves its largest gains on procedurally ordered tasks. Furthermore, experimental results with BeamSGG-ReflAct show that the backbone's effectiveness depends on plan quality: explicitly specifying the re quired operations recovers gains that plan searching alone cannot achieve. These results demonstrate that SGG-ReflAct offers a practical and highly effective rea soning backbone, enabling LLM agents to achieve reliable performance in com plex, long-horizon tasks through easy integration.

AI.tldr: 提出SGG-ReflAct及其扩展BeamSGG-ReflAct，通过将子目标整合到反思过程中，解决LLM智能体在长时序任务中因信念不一致导致的漂移问题，显著提升ALFWorld等环境的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在处理复杂多步任务时，随着推理视界增长，内部信念的不一致会导致中间错误，使智能体偏离目标。现有的REFLACT方法仅反思最终目标，未显式考虑中间子目标，导致性能受限。
AI.method:
1. SGG-ReflAct：单路径LLM规划器生成子目标，并将这些子目标整合进反思过程。
2. BeamSGG-ReflAct：将单路径规划器替换为基于束搜索（beam search）的LLM规划器，以进行结构化的计划探索。
3. 在ALF World、ScienceWorld和Jericho环境中使用多个LLM模型进行实验验证。
AI.result:
1. SGG-ReflAct在几乎所有设置下优于REFLACT。
2. 使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型时，在ALFWorld上成功率高出14.9个百分点，在ScienceWorld上高出8.0个百分点。
3. SGG-ReflAct减少了幻觉动作，在程序化有序任务中增益最大。
4. BeamSGG-ReflAct表明骨架框架的有效性取决于计划质量：显式指定所需操作可恢复仅靠计划搜索无法实现的增益。
AI.conclusion: SGG-ReflAct提供了一种实用且高效的推理骨架，通过易于集成的方式，使LLM智能体能够在复杂的长时距任务中实现可靠的表现。

title: SkillRubric: Co-Evolving Actor Guidance and Evaluator Rubrics for Multimodal Agents
summary: Recent work incorporates reusable skills distilled from past interactions into multimodal agent training, providing procedural guidance for long-horizon planning and tool use. However, policy optimization in these methods remains driven primarily by sparse outcome rewards, providing little supervision for intermediate decisions. Rubric-based rewards address this limitation through explicit intermediate criteria, but reliable rubrics are difficult to construct at scale and often disconnected from the procedure followed by the actor. We observe that a well-structured skill naturally specifies both how to act and what successful execution should achieve. Based on this insight, we introduce SkillRubric, which represents each skill through aligned actor-facing guidance and an evaluator-facing rubric. A multimodal verifier evaluates skill-defined goals using screenshots and tool outputs, assigning completion and progress rewards to the responsible turns. We further introduce an alternating co-evolution scheme that validates guidance revisions through paired rollouts under a frozen policy and rubric revisions offline under fixed guidance. Experiments across diverse multimodal agent benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance gains, while controlled paired rollouts further show that evolved skills provide more effective guidance for planning and tool use than their preceding versions.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillRubric方法，利用结构化技能同时生成执行指导与评估标准，通过交替共演化解决多模态智能体训练中间决策缺乏监督的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有将复用技能整合进多模态智能体训练的方法主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励进行策略优化，导致对中间决策的监督不足；而基于量规（rubric）的奖励虽能提供明确的中期标准，但难以大规模构建且常与实际行为脱节。
AI.method: 1. 引入SkillRubric框架：将技能表示为面向执行者的对齐指导与面向评估者的量规。2. 设计多模态验证器：结合屏幕截图和工具输出来评估技能定义的目标，分配完成度和进度奖励。3. 实施交替共演化机制：在固定政策下离线验证并修订指导，或在固定指导下离线修订量规。
AI.result: 在多个多模态智能体基准测试中实现了持续的性能提升；受控配对 rollout 实验表明，演化后的技能比之前的版本能提供更有效的规划与工具使用指导。
AI.conclusion: 充分利用结构化的技能来自然定义“如何行动”和“成功执行的标准”，能有效弥补中间决策监督缺失的短板，显著提升多模态智能体的长期规划和工具使用能力。

title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions. However, retaining the full history increases context costs, while compressing it risks losing details needed later, and the relevance of historical information often becomes apparent as the task progresses. To address these challenges, we propose FlowState, which treats execution state as memory that can be retained and revisited across requests, unifying current decision-making with the reuse of historical information. FlowState preserves semantically typed state nodes, their relations, and references to raw tool observations, separating persistent retention from on-demand access. Within a single execution loop, Incremental State Update (ISU) maintains the current state based on new inputs and feedback, while Progressive State Access (PSA) progressively reveals historical states and supporting evidence as needed during reasoning. Together, these mechanisms enable agents to reassess prior decisions in light of new information and guide subsequent actions. Compared with a full-context baseline using the same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model, FlowState improves the average success rate on MemoryArena and the average pass rate on $τ^3$-Bench by 4.55 and 13.95 percentage points, respectively, while reducing total token consumption by 43.2% and 40.6%. These results demonstrate the performance and efficiency advantages of FlowState on long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出FlowState框架，通过增量状态更新和渐进式状态访问机制，将执行状态作为可复用内存，在保持长周期任务性能的同时显著降低Token消耗。
AI.motivation: 长周期任务需持续利用历史交互信息。保留完整历史记录导致上下文成本过高，而压缩历史信息则可能丢失后续关键细节，且历史信息的关联性往往随着任务推进才显现。现有方法难以平衡记忆保留与计算效率。
AI.method: 提出FlowState架构，核心包含：1）语义类型状态节点及其关系、原始工具观测引用的持久化保留与按需访问分离；2）增量状态更新（ISU），基于新输入和反馈在当前执行循环中维持最新状态；3）渐进式状态访问（PSA），在推理过程中根据需要逐步揭示历史状态和支持证据。
AI.result: 相较于使用相同DeepSeek-V4-Flash模型的完整上下文基线，FlowState在MemoryArena上的平均成功率提升4.55个百分点，在τ³-Bench上的平均通过率提升13.95个百分点；同时总Token消耗分别降低43.2%和40.6%。
AI.conclusion: FlowState通过解耦状态保留与访问，实现了长周期任务中模型性能与计算效率的双重优势验证。

title: PersonaManifold: Revealing and Exploiting Curved Geometry in LLM Persona Representations
summary: Controlling persona in large language models (LLMs) at inference time is important for role-playing, personalized dialogue, and social simulation. Recent methods extract persona vectors from the model's activation space and apply Euclidean operations---addition, scaling, and linear interpolation---under the linear representation hypothesis. However, these methods themselves report systematic failures: non-orthogonal trait dimensions, asymmetric ceiling and resistance effects, and significant deviations in multi-trait composition, suggesting that the linear isotropic assumption does not hold. We propose PersonaManifold, a framework that models persona representations as points on a curved, low-dimensional Riemannian submanifold in activation space. We estimate the manifold's intrinsic geometry---local metric tensors, geodesic distances, and Ollivier-Ricci curvature---and introduce geodesic steering, which interpolates between personas along manifold geodesics rather than Euclidean straight lines. We also propose the Behavioral Similarity Triplet (BST) benchmark, which automatically generates situational questions grounded in six established psychological constructs and defines persona similarity through behavioral responses rather than self-report questionnaires. Experiments on three open-source LLMs show that persona activations form a manifold with heterogeneous curvature, geodesic distance predicts behavioral similarity more accurately than Euclidean alternatives with independent contributions from anisotropy and curvature, and geodesic steering produces more coherent intermediate personas on both our BST benchmark and external evaluations, with the advantage concentrated in high-deviation regions where the manifold deviates most from flatness.

AI.tldr: 提出PersonaManifold框架，将大模型人格表示建模为激活空间中的流形而非线性向量，通过测地线插值提升多角色混合的连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于欧几里得运算的人格控制方法存在系统性失败（如非正交性、天花板效应），表明线性各向同性假设在复杂人格维度上不成立。
AI.method: 1. 构建PersonaManifold：估计黎曼子流形的内在几何结构（局部度量张量、测地线距离、Ollivier-Ricci曲率）；2. 引入测地线引导（Geodesic Steering）进行沿流形测地线的角色插值；3. 提出BST基准测试，基于心理学构造和行为响应评估人格相似性。
AI.result: 实验显示人格激活形成具有异质曲率的流形；测地线距离比欧氏距离更能准确预测行为相似性；测地线引导在高偏差区域显著产生更连贯的中间人格角色。
AI.conclusion: 非线性流形方法克服了线性假设局限，为推理时的大模型人格控制在角色扮演和社会模拟中提供了更精确和一致的技术路径。

title: Nudgeability: Reasoning Models Follow Confidence Signals Without Tracking Their Own Competence
summary:
Reasoning language models that can call tools must decide during inference whether to answer unaided or delegate. Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective signal on delegation. We call this behavioral response Nudgeability and measure it along two dimensions: sensitivity, how strongly confidence and doubt change delegation rates, and targeting, whether delegation increases for problems the model cannot solve unaided and decreases for those it can.
  Across nine small-to-medium open-weight reasoning models from three families (Qwen, Gemma, and GLM) and two tasks, models are consistently sensitive: doubt increases delegation and confidence decreases it, with a median confidence-to-doubt swing of 20.6 percentage points, and 53 to 70 points for the larger provider-served models. This responsiveness is poorly targeted: a median 42% of induced flips are well-targeted, only a +2 percentage-point lift over a random-selection baseline. Confidence language is thus a strong control surface for delegation, but current models use it only weakly in accordance with their actual competence. Nudgeability offers a simple, post-training-free way to evaluate both sensitivity and targeting as endogenous self-reflection mechanisms mature.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出“可劝导性”（Nudgeability）概念，用于评估推理语言模型在自我反思中根据信心/怀疑信号调整工具调用行为的因果效应。研究发现模型对此类信号高度敏感，但缺乏针对性，即无法有效区分自身能力边界。
AI.motivation: 现有的自反射机制需要解决信号来源、呈现方式及对后续行动的影响三个问题。本研究旨在孤立并量化第三个核心问题：反思信号是否以及如何在因果层面上改变模型后续的决策行为（直接回答或委托工具）。
AI.method: 在相同的推理轨迹中插入表达信心或怀疑的第一人称语句作为反事实控制实验，测量由此引发的模型行为变化。通过两个维度评估“可劝导性”：灵敏度（信号对委托率的改变强度）和靶向性（委托增加是否针对无法解决的问题，减少是否针对能解决的问题）。实验涵盖Qwen、Gemma和GLM系列的九种中小型开源模型及两个任务。
AI.result: 1. 高灵敏度：怀疑显著增加委托率，自信显著降低委托率，中等模型平均置信度-怀疑摆动幅度为20.6个百分点，大型供应商模型达53-70个百分点。2. 低靶向性：仅42%的行为翻转具有良好靶向性，比随机基线仅提升2个百分点。表明模型对自信语言的响应与其实际能力匹配度低。
AI.conclusion: 自信语言是控制工具调用的强大表面手段，但当前模型未能据此优化其实际能力的利用。“可劝导性”提供了一种无需额外训练即可评估模型内生的自我反思机制成熟度的简单方法，揭示了当前模型在利用自我反思信号进行精准决策方面的不足。

title: Diffusion Subgoal Planning for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) learns goal-directed policies from reward-free data, but in long-horizon tasks, goal-conditioned value functions often provide unstable guidance due to sparse rewards and discounting. Hierarchical methods partially mitigate this issue via subgoal decomposition; however, high-level decision-making still relies on noise-sensitive value estimates, leading to unstable behavior in complex environments. We address this limitation by proposing \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{S}ubgoal \textbf{P}lanning (\textbf{DSP}), a diffusion-based framework for high-level subgoal generation. DSP casts high-level planning as guided generative inference over goal-conditioned subgoals and learns both conditional and unconditional flows, enabling classifier-free guidance to introduce a goal-directed bias at inference time. By removing explicit value-based guidance from high-level planning, DSP generates reachable and goal-directed subgoals through a generative model while retaining hierarchical execution. Experiments on offline GCRL benchmarks demonstrate that DSP outperforms prior methods on a range of navigation and manipulation tasks, with particularly strong performance in maze environments that require multi-step subgoal planning.

AI.tldr: 提出DSP，一种基于扩散模型的高层子目标规划框架，通过生成式推理替代不稳定的值函数引导，在离线目标条件强化学习中生成可达且以目标为导向的子目标。
AI.motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）在处理长视野任务时，由于奖励稀疏和折现问题，值函数指导往往不稳定。现有的分层方法虽通过子目标分解缓解了部分问题，但高层决策仍依赖对噪声敏感的值估计，导致复杂环境中行为不稳定。
AI.method: 提出扩散子目标规划（DSP），将高层规划视为针对目标条件子目标的引导式生成推理。该方法学习条件和非条件流，利用无分类器引导在推理时引入目标导向偏差，从而在不使用显式值函数引导的情况下生成子目标，同时保持分层执行结构。
AI.result: 在离线GCRL基准测试中，DSP在多种导航和操作任务上优于现有方法，特别是在需要多步子目标规划的迷宫环境中表现尤为强劲。
AI.conclusion: DSP通过移除高层规划中的显式值引导并采用生成式模型，有效解决了长期任务中层级决策不稳定的问题，显著提升了多步规划任务的性能。

title: Calibrated Uncertainty for Informative Path Planning in Aquatic Environmental Monitoring
summary: Informative Path Planning for scalar field reconstruction uses predictive uncertainty to direct sensing vehicles toward maximally informative locations. Gaussian Processes provide this signal but their stationary isotropic kernels are misspecified for non-homogeneous phenomena such as oil spills, producing miscalibrated estimates that degrade planning. We investigate whether replacing the Gaussian Process with a well-calibrated Deep Ensemble improves path planning outcomes, and whether uncertainty quality interacts with the choice of planning algorithm. Five strategies ($ε$-Greedy, Value Greedy, Uncertainty Greedy, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and Receding Horizon Orienteering) share a common Deep Ensemble backbone trained on physics-based oil spill simulations. On held-out stochastic spill scenarios, the Deep Ensemble reduces normalised reconstruction error by $83\%$ relative to the Gaussian Process baseline. Crucially, well-calibrated uncertainty amplifies the importance of the planning strategy: the performance gap between algorithms is negligible under miscalibrated models but becomes substantial under the ensemble, where multi-step lookahead planners outperform greedy selection by up to $32\%$ in reconstruction error and achieve IoU above $0.85$. Monte Carlo Tree Search is the recommended planner, matching Orienteering in reconstruction quality at an order-of-magnitude lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在标量场（如漏油）重建中，用深度集成替代高斯过程能显著降低重构误差83%。校准良好的不确定性放大了规划策略的重要性，蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)因计算成本低且精度高成为推荐算法。
AI.motivation: 传统高斯过程的各向同性核无法准确描述非均匀现象（如漏油），导致不确定性估计偏差和路径规划效果下降。旨在验证深度集成是否能通过提供校准良好的不确定性来改善路径规划，并探究不确定性质量对规划算法选择的影响。
AI.method: 使用基于物理的漏油模拟训练通用深度集成主干网络，结合五种规划策略：ε-Greedy、Value Greedy、Uncertainty Greedy、蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)和重定向奥里恩特林格(Receding Horizon Orienteering)。在随机漏油场景下进行对比实验。
AI.result: 1. 深度集成相比高斯过程基线，将归一化重构误差降低了83%。2. 在不确定性未校准时，不同规划策略性能差异微小；但在深度集成下，多步 lookahead 规划器比贪婪选择法在重构误差上表现高出最多32%，并实现超过0.85的IoU。3. MCTS在保持与Orienteering相当重构质量的同时，计算成本降低了一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 深度集成能有效解决高斯过程在非均匀场重建中的校准问题，显著提升感知效率。高质量的校准不确定性对于凸显高级规划策略的价值至关重要。推荐使用蒙特卡洛树搜索作为平衡精度与计算效率的最佳规划方案。

title: SpeechCritic: Learning a Diagnostic Speech Judge from Limited Human Preferences
summary: Human speech conveys rich perceptual information, such as emotion and speaker identity, yet most automatic speech quality judges reduce it to a single naturalness score. We study diagnostic speech judges: given two candidates, a diagnostic judge decides which is better, along which perceptual dimensions (e.g., timbre, emotion, timing) they differ, and which audible cues support its decision. Learning such judges is challenging: expert annotation is costly, and simply prompting a frontier audio-language model to produce labels is unreliable: our probing reveals substantial errors and unstable instruction following. We introduce SpeechCritic, which learns a diagnostic judge in a reference-conditioned cross-lingual setting from only about 300 human-labeled comparisons. Rather than replacing the frontier model, SpeechCritic calibrates it with these labels: for each dimension, it selects the acoustic measurements that agree with human judgments, maps them to A/Tie/B probabilities, and passes these to the model as non-binding hints alongside the audio. Compared with the same model labeling without hints, this raises dimension-level agreement with humans by 6.3 points and cuts the mismatch with human Tie rates by 10.4 points. We then train a 7B judge on this supervision and find that different training signals shape different judge behaviors: SFT establishes the task, OPD transfers the teacher's dimension-level strengths and weaknesses, and RL helps most on clear-cut comparisons where human raters agree. Notably, human listeners also find that RL makes rationales cite more specific, localized acoustic cues, although it never directly rewards rationale text. Finally, we show that the pipeline is language-pair agnostic by instantiating it on both English-Japanese and English-Spanish. Together, these results demonstrate a path from limited human preferences to a diagnostic speech judge.

AI.tldr: 提出SpeechCritic，一种通过少量人类标注校准前沿音频-语言模型的方法，使其成为能识别多维差异及依据的诊断性语音评判器。
AI.motivation: 自动语音质量评估通常仅给出单一自然度分数，无法提供关于情感、身份等多维感知信息的诊断；且直接利用前沿模型进行标签预测存在错误率高和指令遵循不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 引入SpeechCritic，在参考条件跨语言设置下学习诊断性评判器。它不替代前沿模型，而是通过选择与人类判断一致声学测量值并映射为概率作为非绑定提示（hints）来校准模型。随后对7B参数模型进行监督训练，采用SFT、OPD和RL三种不同训练信号以塑造不同的评判行为。
AI.result: 相比无提示，维度级与人类的一致性提升6.3分，与人类“平局”率的不匹配减少10.4分。RL训练使理由更具体地指向局部声学线索。该方法在英日、英西语对中均有效，证明其语言无关性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了从有限人类偏好构建高一致性、多维度诊断性语音评判器的可行路径。

title: TULIP: Targeted LLM Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-Input
summary: Representation-level unlearning intervenes on the intermediate hidden states of LLMs. Although knowledge is distributed across layers, existing methods operate at a single fixed layer for the entire forget set. We ask whether such a fixed layer is sufficient. To answer this, we design a hijacking experiment that grafts hidden states of the target model into an oracle trained only on the retain set. The oracle cannot produce the forget answer on its own, yet it produces the answer from the grafted state. Thus, the answer is formed at an intermediate layer and merely read out afterward, so unlearning should focus on formation, not readout. Moreover, the layer where formation ends varies widely across inputs. Motivated by these findings, we propose Targeted Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-input (TULIP). For each input, TULIP uses the logit lens to locate the formation-readout boundary and removes the hidden state's alignment with the forget answer's unembedding vector there. TULIP consistently outperforms output- and representation-level baselines on TOFU, PISTOL, and WMDP across Llama, Qwen, and Zephyr models. It also remains robust to paraphrase and quantization attacks. Beyond standalone use, its per-input layer selection serves as a plug-and-play component that further improves existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TULIP方法，通过每个输入特定的层级干预LLM中间隐藏状态以消除遗忘知识，解决传统固定层级方法的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有表征级卸载方法在整个“遗忘集”上使用单一固定层级进行操作，但知识分布跨层且答案形成的层级因输入而异，需验证固定层级是否足够以及卸载应聚焦于知识形成还是读出。
AI.method: 设计劫持实验证明答案在中间层形成；提出每输入特定层级定位的靶向卸载（TULIP），利用logit lens确定形成-读出边界，并在该层级移除隐藏状态与遗忘答案非嵌入向量的对齐。
AI.result: 在TOFU、PISTOL和WMDP基准上，针对Llama、Qwen和Zephyr模型，TULIP持续优于输出级和表征级基线方法，并对重述和量化攻击保持鲁棒性；其每输入层级选择可作为即插即用组件提升现有方法性能。
AI.conclusion: 记忆的形成发生在中间层且层级可变，卸载应针对具体输入定位的形成-读出边界进行干预，而非在单一固定层级操作，TULIP证明了这一假设的有效性并提供了通用改进方案。

title: After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks
summary: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了“修复”与简单“复用”失败经验对后续任务记忆和绩效的影响。结果显示，ThinkingBox方法的修复能显著提升性能（最高增益44%），但大部分优势源于未修复基线性能的差异而非真正的“更好记忆”。相比之下，APEX方法未能证明类似收益。结论指出：修复经验的内在价值不同于单纯复用其结果，有效的记忆更新需要同时参考旧版和新版的起始状态。
AI.motivation: 探究修复一个失败 episode 是否能使其成为针对下一个任务的更好记忆；旨在区分“从错误中修复学习”与“直接复用历史执行”之间的实际效能差异。
AI.method: 通过3,300次运行，在100个ThinkingBox配对和100个APEX配对中进行实验，涵盖有无状态继承的十一项条件。采用“接受修复前”与“接受修复后”同一失败源向固定目标的迁移策略，并与独立执行进行对比评估。
AI.result:
1. ThinkingBox的Full/Skill/Hybrid修正增益分别为44/29/32个百分点，且均高于独立执行表现。
2. 然而，Full相比Skill有更大的修正差距，但这15点差距中有12点源于更差的未修复基线性能，而非更好的修正后记忆。
3. Full方法的46次向上过渡中有22次恢复了观测到的基线成功。
4. APEX两种模式均未建立 comparable 的聚合修正收益；文本APEX的接受执行率达52%（摘要仅为40%），但未表现出稳健的层级优势。
5. 较小交接减少输入但增加调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 修复经验的“价值”与其“复用”的价值是截然不同的。要形成有效的记忆更新，系统不仅需要之前的版本作为参考，还需要一个全新的起始状态（fresh-start）作为参照。简单的复用并不等同于高质量的记忆构建。

title: LLMs for Executable Multi-Agent System Specification Generation
summary: MAS specifications express the effects of the actions of the agents and their environment, as well as other temporal phenomena, such as the intervals during which an agent may perform an action. The specification of a MAS should also be executable in order to allow for run-time monitoring. Constructing the specification of a MAS requires formal language expertise, while machine learning techniques depend on labelled data which are rarely available. To address these issues, we propose `genRTEC', a method that leverages pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate executable MAS specifications, in the language of the `Run-Time Event Calculus' (RTEC), from natural language descriptions. genRTEC constructs MAS specifications with complex hierarchical and cyclic dependencies based only on short natural language descriptions of the concepts involved. We present an extensive empirical evaluation of genRTEC, spanning various MAS specifications, including both a qualitative and a quantitative assessment. Our results demonstrate that genRTEC constructs executable MAS specifications of high predictive accuracy without compromising reasoning efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为genRTEC的方法，利用预训练大型语言模型（LLMs）将自然语言描述转换为可执行的多智能体系统（MAS）规范，解决了传统方法对形式化语言专家经验和标注数据的高需求问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）规范的构建通常需要形式化语言专业知识，而依赖标注数据的技术又面临数据稀缺的问题；同时，MAS规范需具备可执行性以支持运行时监控，但现有方法难以平衡这一需求与构建难度。
AI.method: 提出genRTEC方法，利用预训练大语言模型（LLMs），基于简短的自然语言描述生成采用“运行时事件演算”（RTEC）语言的、具有复杂层次和循环依赖的可执行MAS规范。
AI.result: 通过广泛的实证评估（包括定性和定量分析），证明genRTEC能够构建具有高预测准确率且不影响推理效率的可执行MAS规范。
AI.conclusion: genRTEC能够有效利用LLM从自然语言生成高质量、可执行的MAS规范，无需额外的形式化领域专家或大量标注数据即可实现复杂的规范建模。

title: A Persistent State for Auditable Mixture-of-Experts Routing
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models repeatedly route tokens to sparse subsets of experts, but conventional routers expose no routing-specific record of how cross-layer influences accumulate. We introduce Scratchpad-Augmented Mixture-of-Experts (SA-MoE), which gives each router access to a low-dimensional persistent state that is not provided to the experts. Learned layerwise writes update this state, and their realized post-update changes exactly decompose the state-mediated contribution to any later routing margin, forming a routing ledger. Across sparsely upcycled SmolLM2- and Gemma-based models and three independent training seeds per architecture, this pathway adds less than 1% analytical forward compute and is strongly used by trained routers: local removal of its router contribution changes the selected Top-2 expert set in 87.6% and 69.9% of decisions, respectively. Relative to a matched latest-write-only control, persistent accumulation increases long-horizon future-routing accessibility by 19.4 and 12.2 percentage points, with positive effects in every seed. More than 90% of absolute ledger contribution comes from non-recent writes in both families, and full-forward suppression of ledger-selected writes changes later routing and output distributions. The ledger is an exact provenance object for the persistent-state pathway, not a complete causal explanation of routing. Sensitivity-aware scores better predict full-forward intervention effects, and post-hoc methods recover related cross-layer attribution without architectural modification. SA-MoE instead makes one routing-specific computational history explicit and directly inspectable within the model's natural forward computation.

AI.tldr: 提出SA-MoE，通过低维持久状态（Scratchpad）为MoE路由器提供跨层累积信息的显式记录（Routing Ledger），以解决传统路由器无法追踪跨层影响的问题。该方法计算开销极小（<1%），显著增强长期路由可访问性，并提供精确的路由归因线索。
AI.motivation: 传统的Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 模型中，路由器在将Token路由到稀疏专家子集时，缺乏对跨层影响如何积累的特定记录，导致路由决策的历史因果性不透明。
AI.method: 引入Scratchpad-Augmented MoE (SA-MoE)，为每个路由器分配一个仅路由器可见的低维持久状态。通过学习的逐层写入更新该状态，形成“路由账本”（routing ledger），其增量精确分解了状态介导的后续路由边际贡献。
AI.result:
1. 计算效率：正向计算开销增加不足1%，且在Sparsely upcycled SmolLM2和Gemma系列模型及多个随机种子中均被有效使用。
2. 影响力验证：移除路由器对该部分的影响，分别改变87.6%和69.9%的Top-2专家选择决策。
3. 性能提升：相比仅关注最新写入的控制组，持久累积使长期未来路由的可访问性提高了19.4和12.2个百分点。
4. 归因特性：超过90%的绝对账本贡献来自非近期写入；完全抑制账本选定的写入会改变后续路由和输出分布。
AI.conclusion: SA-MoE通过显式的、可检查的计算历史路径，为持久状态路由提供了确切的溯源对象（exact provenance object）。虽然它不是路由机制的全部因果解释，但它直接揭示了跨层影响，且敏感度评分能更好地预测干预效果，无需架构修改即可恢复相关的跨层归因。

title: MechReasoner: A Simulator and Benchmark for Mechanistic Reasoning in Qualitative Physics
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables, and 2 algorithms; includes supplementary material. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/idiap/mech-reasoner
summary: This work introduces MechReasoner, a mechanistic qualitative simulator grounded in confluence-based qualitative physics, together with a benchmark for mechanistic inference. Current large language models (LLMs) generate fluent mechanistic descriptions that do not reliably follow from underlying structural and causal constraints. The benchmark tests whether answers preserve simulator-licensed ambiguity, quantified claims, episode-graph transition evidence, repairs, and trace-support judgments. Its 1,120 items are generated deterministically from admissible interpretation sets, component states, scenario restrictions, confluence constraints, and derivation steps across 18 catalog mechanisms and six task families. Each mechanism undergoes converter checks of structure and topology and behavioral checks against quantitative simulations. GPT-5.5 accuracy decreases as family-specific mechanistic complexity increases, from 76.1% in the lowest-complexity bucket (B1) to 38.0% in the highest-complexity bucket (B4). The negative association remains after controls for rendered-prompt and expected-answer length. These results show that qualitative simulators can support auditable NLP benchmarks for mechanistic inference.

AI.tldr: 提出MechReasoner，一种基于共流定性物理的机械性定性模拟器及评测基准。针对LLM生成的机械描述缺乏结构因果约束的问题，该基准通过1,120个确定性生成的项目评估模型保留不确定性、量化主张等能力。实验显示GPT-5.5在低复杂度任务准确率达76.1%，但在高复杂度任务降至38.0%，证实定性模拟器可支持可审计的NLP机械推理评测。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型（LLMs）虽能生成流畅的机制性描述，但这些描述往往未能严格遵循潜在的结构和因果约束，导致可靠性不足。因此，需要建立严格的基准来评估模型在面对结构性与因果性限制时的真实理解能力。
AI.method: 开发了基于共流定性物理（confluence-based qualitative physics）的MechReasoner模拟器，并构建了包含18种目录机制和6类任务家族的评测基准。基准中的1,120个项目通过许可解释集、组件状态、场景限制、共流约束和推导步骤确定性生成。所有机制均经过结构拓扑的检查以及针对定量模拟的行为检查。
AI.result: GPT-5.5的准确率随机制特异性复杂度的增加而显著下降：从最低复杂度桶（B1）的76.1%降至最高复杂度桶（B4）的38.0%。即使在控制了提示长度和预期答案长度后，这种负相关关系依然显著存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，定性模拟器能够为支持可审计的自然语言处理（NLP）基准提供有效支持，特别是在评估复杂的机械推理任务方面具有重要价值。

title: Beyond Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Context Management Policies for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
summary: Harness evolution improves LLM agents by learning from execution trajectories, but existing experience- and skill-based methods are less effective on long-horizon tasks. As interactions grow, useful evidence can be buried by redundant or outdated context, making context management itself a key bottleneck. We introduce ContextEvo, a framework that learns a context policy from long-horizon trajectories. ContextEvo reconstructs the model-visible context at key decision points, identifies context-related failures, and applies targeted policy updates. Starting from the open-source Pi-agent harness, ContextEvo improves performance across three long-horizon task benchmarks, achieving results comparable to or better than several prominent agent harnesses, including Codex, OpenCode, and OpenClaw. Additional analyses show that fixed or locally evolved context strategies can fall short under long-horizon information pressure, while our methods adapt to the information demands of each environment.

AI.tldr: 提出ContextEvo框架，通过从长期轨迹中学习上下文管理策略，解决大语言模型代理在长视距任务中因冗余上下文导致性能下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于经验和技能的进化方法在长视距任务中效果不佳；随着交互增加，有用信息容易被冗余或过时上下文掩盖，导致上下文管理成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入ContextEvo框架，从长视距轨迹中学习上下文策略；在关键决策点重建模型可见的上下文，识别与上下文相关的失败案例，并应用针对性的策略更新。
AI.result: 在三个长视距任务基准测试中，ContextEvo的性能优于或媲美Codex、OpenCode和OpenClaw等主流代理框架；分析表明其能动态适应不同环境的特定信息需求，克服了固定或局部进化策略的局限。
AI.conclusion: 针对长视距任务优化的动态上下文管理策略能显著提升LLM代理的性能，解决了信息过载带来的上下文瓶颈问题。

title: OmniTide: Co-Designing Algorithms and Systems for Efficient On-Device Omni-LLM Streaming
summary: On-device streaming omni-modal inference safeguards user privacy and eliminates prohibitive per-token API costs, but faces a critical bottleneck: the continuous influx of multimodal data rapidly exhausts constrained memory and compute budgets via monotonic KV cache growth. Existing sparse attention methods fall short, either incurring prohibitive online estimation latency or destroying interleaved cross-modal context, while failing to resolve physical memory fragmentation. We present OmniTide, the first algorithm-system co-design tailored for efficient on-device streaming omni-modal inference. Driven by the observation of modality-aware structural sparsity, OmniTide adopts a unit-based abstraction with two components: (1) At the algorithm level, OmniPick logically retains critical multimodal context based on unit boundaries and modality importance to preserve task accuracy; (2) At the system level, OmniPage physically partitions the cache by retention likelihood and dynamically compacts surviving sparse tokens, minimizing both memory fragmentation and data-movement overhead. Extensive evaluations across three streaming benchmarks and two consumer-device architectures show that OmniTide achieves up to $12.72\times$ kernel speedups and $2.40\times$ lower stream-loop latency. On StreamingBench, it improves accuracy by up to 18.0 percentage points over sliding-window baselines at comparable session cost. OmniPage further reduces the physical KV span by up to 26.7% relative to native logical eviction, unlocking real-time, infinite-context streaming on edge devices.

AI.tldr: OmniTide通过算法-系统协同设计解决端侧流式多模态推理中的KV缓存内存瓶颈，实现高效、低延迟且高精度的无限上下文流式处理。
AI.motivation: 端侧流式全模态推理面临连续多模态数据输入导致的显存和计算资源耗尽问题，现有稀疏注意力方法存在在线估计延迟高、破坏跨模态上下文或无法解决物理内存碎片等缺陷。
AI.method: 提出OmniTide算法-系统协同架构：(1) 算法层OmniPick基于单位边界和模态重要性逻辑保留关键多模态上下文；(2) 系统层OmniPage按保留可能性物理分区缓存并动态紧凑化稀疏token，减少内存碎片和数据移动开销。
AI.result: 在三个流式基准和两个消费级设备上，Kernel速度提升最高12.72倍，流循环延迟降低2.40倍；在StreamingBench上较滑动窗口基线准确率提升最高18.0个百分点；物理KV跨度相比原生逻辑驱逐减少最高26.7%。
AI.conclusion: OmniTide成功解锁了边缘设备上实时无限上下文流式处理的能力，在保持任务准确性的同时显著提升了效率和内存利用率。

title: A General Harness for Protein Foundation Model Fitness Prediction
summary: Accurate fitness prediction is central to protein engineering and understanding sequence-function relationships. With advances in deep learning, protein foundation models (PFMs) have become widely used for this task. Recent analyses, however, show that these models share preferences reflecting their training corpora, while unreliable inputs can further distort fitness predictions. Family-specific evolutionary evidence and structural context can help address these limitations by providing complementary constraints on model scores, motivating VenusREM-Harness (VRH), a general, model-agnostic, training-free Retrieval-Enhanced Mutation harness. It fuses frozen model scores with multiple sequence alignment (MSA) evidence according to model uncertainty, then applies gated background correction and score shrinkage based on structural confidence and solvent exposure. Across 1,211 assays and 3.1 million measured variants from ProteinGym, VenusMutHub, and the newly curated viral benchmark VenusViroHub, all 71 configurations improve Spearman correlation on all 3 benchmarks by 0.073 on average, with broad gains across 5 metrics. Extended analyses relate retrieval gains to model-MSA preference differences, assess domain-level gains and immune-escape cases, and quantify computational speedups. Built with VRH, VenusREM2 is the first to rank highest in all function, taxon, MSA-depth, and mutation-depth categories, with a ProteinGym Average Spearman of 0.556, 0.038 above the prior best.

AI.tldr: 提出VenusREM-Harness（VRH），一种无需训练的检索增强突变处理框架，通过融合基础模型得分与多序列比对及结构证据，显著提升蛋白质功能预测准确率。
AI.motivation: 解决现有蛋白质基础模型因训练数据偏差导致的偏好问题，以及不可靠输入对 fitness 预测造成的扭曲；利用家族特异性进化证据和结构上下文提供互补约束。
AI.method: 开发模型无关的 VRH 框架：根据模型不确定性融合冻结模型得分与 MSA 证据，应用基于结构置信度和溶剂可及性的门控背景校正与分数收缩技术。
AI.result: 在 ProteinGym、VenusMutHub 和 VenusViroHub三大基准（1,211项测试，310万变异）上，所有71种配置均提升Spearman相关系数（平均提升0.073）。衍生模型 VenusREM2 在所有类别中排名最高，ProteinGym 平均 Spearman 达 0.556，超越此前最佳结果0.038。
AI.conclusion: VRH 有效解决了预训练模型的局限性，显著提高了跨物种和突变深度的预测性能，为蛋白质工程提供了更准确且高效的评估工具。

title: Jailbreak Context Lingers: Divergent Safety Routing and Its Cross-Task Predictability in Tool Agents
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 17 tabels, ICLR 2027 Under Review
summary: As large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, post-jailbreak safety feedback is often assumed to serve as a reliable safeguard; however, how lingering jailbreak context shapes subsequent agent behavior remains largely unexplored. To systematically examine this dynamic, we introduce a paired continuation framework across 192 parent tasks spanning 42 domains, evaluating 12,148 analyzed continuation pairs (curated from a 12,288-pair initially design) across eight diverse agents. We find that identical safety feedback induces sharply model-dependent behavioral routing rather than uniform protection: redirecting unsafe trajectories toward legitimate completion (\emph{rescue}), sustaining unauthorized execution (\emph{persistent unsafe}), or triggering over-refusal on benign tasks (\emph{collateral loss}). Through layer-wise activation patching, we discover a shared \emph{late-commit pattern} where causal intervention effects surge sharply near the final layers (relative depths of 0.958--0.984) despite an over 30-fold variation in peak magnitude across architectures. Crucially, critical-layer representations correlate with macroscopic routing outcomes, and intervening at these layers causally alters concrete next-step tool actions. Building on this causal foundation, we test whether localized intervention-derived features can serve as predictive proxies for full-trajectory routing outcomes on unseen parent tasks under leave-one-parent-task-out evaluation, finding that they provide viable predictive signals in responsive agents with peak ROC AUCs reaching 0.675 for \emph{rescue}, 0.777 for \emph{collateral loss}, and 0.702 for \emph{persistent unsafe}. These findings establish a mechanistic lens and a predictive baseline for anticipating the safety and utility trade-offs of post-jailbreak feedback in autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了大语言模型在越狱后，其安全反馈并非产生统一保护效果，而是引发模型依赖的行为路由。通过层式激活插补发现关键的“晚期承诺模式”，证实了干预特定层可因果改变工具使用行为，并利用这些特征建立了预测后续行为的安全/效用权衡基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型作为工具使用代理日益普遍，且假设事后越狱安全反馈是可靠的保障措施，但遗留的越狱上下文如何塑造后续代理行为这一关键问题仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 引入跨192个父任务（涵盖42个领域）的配对续写框架，评估了12,148对分析续写数据在8种不同代理上的表现。采用逐层激活插补技术识别因果干预点，并通过留一父任务交叉验证测试基于层插补特征的预测能力。
AI.result: 1. 相同安全反馈导致截然不同的行为路由：包括将不安全轨迹导向合法完成（rescue）、维持未经授权执行（persistent unsafe）或对良性任务过度拒绝（collateral loss）。2. 发现共享的“晚期承诺模式”，因果干预效应显著集中在最后几层（相对深度0.958-0.984）。3. 关键层表征与宏观路由结果相关，且在这些层进行干预可因果改变具体的下一步工具动作。4. 基于局部干预推导的特征可作为未见过任务的预测代理，在响应式代理中达到最高ROC AUC值：rescue为0.675，collateral loss为0.777，persistent unsafe为0.702。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一个机制性视角和预测基线，用于 anticipate（预判）自主代理中事后越狱反馈的安全性与效用权衡问题，强调了理解深层机制对于设计可靠代理的重要性。

title: VCN-Bench: A Video-Contextualized Navigation Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning over Prior Visual Experience
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to embodied agents, yet it remains unclear whether spatial understanding can be carried forward to guide sequential interactions. Existing spatial-reasoning benchmarks typically terminate at offline predictions, while navigation benchmarks evaluate spatial reasoning as part of instruction following and exploration. We introduce VCN-Bench, a \textbf{V}ideo-\textbf{C}ontextualized \textbf{N}avigation benchmark for probing closed-loop spatial reasoning over prior visual experience in MLLMs. Given a prior video covering both the initial location and destination, the agent is tasked with reasoning out the instruction-specified target and navigating toward it with the inferred spatial context. Built on Matterport3D, VCN-Bench contains five instruction types, 100k training episodes, and 1,250 evaluation episodes. Navigation serves as the primary evaluation, while diagnostic goal identification helps distinguish destination-resolution errors from subsequent navigation failures. We further propose MV-DualVLN, a planning-oriented baseline that jointly leverages prior video and in-episode observations. Experiments reveal limited navigation performance, a substantial destination-resolution-to-navigation gap, and frequent navigation failures even after correct destination identification.

AI.tldr: 提出VCN-Bench基准和MV-DualVLN模型，旨在通过闭环导航评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）基于先前视频记忆的空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准多为离线预测，无法体现指导连续交互的能力；而导航基准主要关注指令跟随与探索，缺乏对“先前视觉经验转化为空间理解以指导后续交互”这一过程的专门探针。
AI.method: 构建基于Matterport3D的VCN-Bench基准，包含5类指令、10万训练片段和1250评估片段；提出MV-DualVLN基线模型，联合利用先前视频和episode内观察进行规划；采用导航作为主评估指标，并通过诊断性目标识别区分错误类型。
AI.result: 实验显示当前方法导航性能有限，存在显著的“目的地解析到导航执行”差距，且即使正确识别目的地也常发生导航失败。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了MLLMs在将先验视频信息转化为闭环空间推理并指导实际导航方面仍存在显著不足，为未来研究提供了新的评估视角。

title: ResonAct: Streaming Metrics for Runtime Diagnosis and Self-Healing in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to automate enterprise workflows involving multiple specialized agents, external tools, and long-running task execution. Failures may arise from tool degradation, context propagation errors, coordination breakdowns, or repeated agent interactions that prevent task completion. While existing observability frameworks provide traces and logs, diagnosis and remediation are largely performed after execution completes, limiting opportunities for recovery during runtime. We present ResonAct, a runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of multi-agent systems through streaming operational metrics. ResonAct ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics layer that continuously derives task progress, context health, and tool reliability metrics. These metrics serve as runtime control signals for detecting anomalous execution patterns and localizing root causes using a structured failure model. Based on the diagnosed failure, ResonAct dynamically selects remediation policies and performs actions. The framework operates as an external control plane, enabling intervention without modifying application agents or orchestration logic. We evaluate ResonAct across enterprise workflow scenarios and AppWorld benchmarks. The results show that the streaming metric-based analysis identifies execution degradations and localizes faults. Furthermore, policy-driven remediation improves task completion rates by up to 10.00 percentage points, with detection precision ranging from 70.59% to 82.91%, recall from 63.09% to 100%, recovery rates from 10.48% to 46.67%, and runtime overhead ranging from $-0.25%$ to 14.12% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出ResonAct，一种用于多智能体系统(MAS)的运行时自愈框架，通过流式分析指标实现持续监控、故障诊断与动态修复。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS可观测性框架主要在执行结束后进行诊断和修复，缺乏运行时干预能力，限制了系统在工具退化、协调失败等场景下的恢复机会。
AI.method: 构建外部控制平面，将执行轨迹、代理交互和工具调用摄入流式分析层，实时推导任务进度、上下文健康和工具可靠性指标；基于结构化故障模型检测异常并定位根因，进而动态选择并执行修复策略。
AI.result: 在企业工作流和AppWorld基准测试中，ResonAct成功识别执行退化和定位故障；政策驱动修复使任务完成率提高最高10.00个百分点；检测精确率70.59%-82.91%，召回率63.09%-100%，恢复率10.48%-46.67%，运行时开销为-0.25%至14.12%。
AI.conclusion: ResonAct通过运行时流式指标分析实现了有效的MAS故障检测与自愈，显著提升了任务完成率和系统鲁棒性，且无需修改应用代理或编排逻辑。

title: FromPitch2Board: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Football Management
summary: Long-horizon agent benchmarks typically report how far an agent progresses, but do not identify whether its performance comes from the foundation model, scaffold, responsibility scope, match-control granularity, or horizon. We introduce FromPitch2Board, a deterministic football-management benchmark that studies five configurable factors through controlled comparisons on a single simulator, using paired seeds and a frozen calibration. We evaluate four foundation models and four agent scaffolds. In the Model Track, Coach points Z-scores span 0.19, while Manager points Z-scores span 0.68, with GPT-5.6 showing a sharp rise in passivity under responsibility expansion. Its responsibility ladder rises from 46.1 to 58.1 points with recruitment, then falls to 46.8 under full management, localizing the regression to the final responsibility boundary. Across that boundary, its skipped-decision rate rises from 1.1% to 57.9%. Within the Flash-Pro pair crossed across every scaffold, scaffold choice changes Manager points Z-scores by up to 0.48 relative to the fixed stateless scaffold. The 3Y cohort shows a directional reversal in mean ranking between years one and three, while a selected Claude Code+Pro configuration peaks in year three and remains below that peak, showing that responsibility scope and horizon expose behavior changes that a single headline score conceals.

AI.tldr: 介绍FromPitch2Board基准，通过控制变量法评估基础模型、Agent脚手架、责任范围等五个因素对长周期足球管理表现的影响。发现GPT-5.6在责任扩大时被动性激增，脚手架选择影响显著，且长期表现存在方向性反转，表明单一总分无法揭示深层行为变化。
AI.motivation: 现有长周期Agent基准仅报告进展距离，无法区分性能提升源自基础模型、脚手架设计、责任范围、控制粒度还是时间跨度。旨在提供一个确定性环境以隔离并研究这些配置因子的具体影响。
AI.method: 构建FromPitch2Board确定性与足球管理基准，基于单一模拟器，使用配对种子和冻结校准进行受控比较。评估四个基础模型和四个Agent脚手架，重点分析“模型轨道”和“脚手架对比”，通过Z分数量化Coach与Manager角色的表现差异及决策跳过率。
AI.result:
1. GPT-5.6在责任扩张时表现出显著的被动性上升；其责任感得分先升后降，在最终责任边界处回归失败，决策跳过率从1.1%飙升至57.9%。
2. 脚手架选择对表现有重大影响，相对于固定的无状态脚手架，不同脚手架使Manager得分Z值变化高达0.48。
3. 长期测试显示行为反转：3Y队列中位数排名在第1至第3年间发生方向性逆转；特定Claude Code+Pro配置在第3年达到峰值后未能保持，证明责任范围和时间跨度暴露了被单一标题分数掩盖的行为变化。
AI.conclusion: 长周期Agent的性能不能仅由单一总分概括。基础模型的局限性（如责任边界内的决策遗漏）和脚手架的结构差异对最终结果有决定性影响，必须通过细粒度的控制实验来理解Agent在长周期任务中的真实能力边界和行为演变。

title: RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents
summary: Practical deployment of large language model (LLM) agents requires strong task performance at affordable inference cost. For long-horizon agentic tasks, this performance-cost trade-off can be improved through within-task large-small model collaboration, as smaller models can handle some stages even when they cannot solve the full task. In this paper, we introduce RSI-router, a routing framework that constructs subtask-level model assignments and model-specific skills through recursive self-improvement over accumulated experience. Each iteration consists of four stages: Subtask Mining derives subtask definitions and identification rules from training trajectories; Routing Strategy Evolution proposes and evaluates diverse model assignments; Model-Specific Skill Evolution compares routed and large-model-only trajectories to diagnose failures and develop reusable execution skills; and Pareto-Optimal Router Selection updates the Pareto population using historical and newly generated routers while retaining dominated routers as experience for subsequent evolution. Routing between DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.5-9B, RSI-router consistently surpasses the DeepSeek-only baseline at roughly half the inference cost (48.3%) across five agentic benchmarks. In particular, on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, it cuts inference cost by 74.7-82.2% while simultaneously improving performance; on Terminal-Bench 2.0, it achieves a 16.7% relative performance gain at 18.0% lower cost. Moreover, RSI-router establishes a stronger performance--cost Pareto frontier than 9 routing methods.

AI.tldr: RSI-router是一种通过递归自我改进构建子任务级模型分配和特定技能的路由框架，利用大-小模型协作在降低约48.3%推理成本的同时，在五项代理基准测试中超越了仅使用大模型的基线，并在部分任务中实现了性能提升与成本大幅下降（74.7-82.2%）。
AI.motivation: 解决大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在实际部署中面临的性能与推理成本之间的权衡问题，特别是针对长程代理任务，旨在通过大模型与小模型的协作来优化这一 trade-off。
AI.method: 提出RSI-router路由框架，包含四个迭代阶段：1. 子任务挖掘（Subtask Mining）从训练轨迹中提取子任务定义和识别规则；2. 路由策略演化（Routing Strategy Evolution）提出并评估多种模型分配方案；3. 特定模型技能演化（Model-Specific Skill Evolution）对比路由轨迹与大模型单一轨迹以诊断失败并开发可重用执行技能；4. Pareto最优路由器选择（Pareto-Optimal Router Selection）基于历史和新生成的路由器更新Pareto种群，同时保留受支配路由器作为后续演化的经验。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qwen3.5-9B之间进行路由时，RSI-router在五项代理基准测试中持续优于DeepSeek-only基线，平均推理成本降低48.3%。具体而言，在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop上，推理成本降低74.7-82.2%且性能提升；在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，性能相对提升16.7%，成本降低18.0%。该方法建立了比9种其他路由方法更强的性能-成本Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: RSI-router通过递归自我改进机制，有效实现了大-小模型间的子任务级协作，显著提升了长程代理任务的性能-成本效率，证明了在小模型无法独立完成任务的情况下，其仍可在子任务层面发挥重要作用从而实现成本节约。

title: PDE-JEPA: Predictive Representation Learning of Latent Dynamics Modeling for Parametric PDEs
summary: Physical trajectories contain more than snapshots of a system: they also reveal how its states evolve under governing conditions. However, representation learning for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) has largely relied on reconstruction-based objectives that emphasize recovering observed physical fields. In this paper, we investigate predictive representation pretraining as an alternative to reconstruction-based learning. We find that predictive representations preserve rich physical information, yet this advantage alone does not ensure accurate field evolution. Based on these observations, we introduce PDE-JEPA for parametric PDE dynamics. Specifically, we first train an encoder using a masked-latent prediction to capture the underlying regularities of PDE dynamics. To explicitly adapt the pretrained representation toward a more dynamics-aligned state space, we then introduce a geometry projector that aligns latent trajectory geometry with the evolution geometry of physical fields. Finally, building on this geometry-aligned latent space, we further develop a physics-structured latent predictor that decomposes the dynamics into parameter-independent evolution and parameter-dependent response components. Extensive experiments on nine widely used PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by an average of 33.4\% in-distribution, while achieving an average improvement of 51.4\% when extrapolating to unseen governing parameters. The project page is available \href{https://tanpig-x.github.io/PDE-JEPA/}{here}.

AI.tldr: 提出PDE-JEFA框架，通过掩码潜变量预测训练编码器，利用几何投影器对齐潜在轨迹与物理场演化几何，并结合物理结构化的潜变量预测器分解动力学，在9个PDE基准测试中显著优于SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数化偏微分方程（PDE）表示学习主要依赖基于重建的目标，强调恢复观测到的物理场，忽略了物理轨迹所蕴含的状态演化规律信息；需要探索能更好捕捉动态演化的预训练表示方法。
AI.method: 提出PDE-JEPA框架：1) 使用掩码-潜变量预测训练编码器以捕获PDE动力学的潜在规律；2) 引入几何投影器，将潜在轨迹的几何结构与物理场的演化几何对齐；3) 构建物理结构化的潜变量预测器，将动力学分解为与参数无关的演化部分和与参数相关的响应部分。
AI.result: 在九个广泛使用的PDE基准上，该方法分布内性能平均提升33.4%，在未见过管理参数的外推场景下平均改进51.4%，显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 预测性表示预训练结合几何对齐和物理结构化分解，能有效捕捉PDE动力学特征，大幅提升参数化PDE动力学的建模精度和泛化能力。

title: From Human Narrative to Harmonic Structure: A Human-Centered Investigation of Algorithmic Music Generation through the Chord Wheel Diagram
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, link to GIT
summary: Contemporary AI-based music generation can produce compositions that satisfy formal requirements of tonality and musical coherence. However, whether musical expression can be described by mathematical properties alone remains a fundamental question. Human composers operate within personal and cultural contexts that influence harmonic decisions and deliberate departures from established patterns. This study investigates six narrative-driven popular songs by Bob Dylan, Johnny Cash, and Ritchie Valens. Original human harmonies are compared with outputs of an explainable computational harmonizer operating on the same melodies without access to the original chord progressions. We examine harmonic vocabulary, functional persistence, repetition, non-diatonic events, and tension-resolution patterns using Chord Wheel Diagrams and BPMN-based representations. Results show that high melody-chord compatibility does not necessarily imply preservation of the original human harmonic decision pattern. Some generated harmonizations retain the economical structure of the reference, while others alter harmonic diversity or suppress distinctive events while remaining compatible with the melody. Rather than quantifying artistic quality, the study introduces narrative-conditioned harmonic structure as a complementary perspective for computational music analysis. The findings suggest that generative systems may benefit from modeling not only harmonic correctness, but also structural identity, context, and human compositional intention.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，尽管生成式AI能和弦与旋律高度兼容，但往往无法保留人类作曲家独特的和声结构与意图。研究主张计算音乐分析应超越单纯的“正确性”，引入叙事条件来建模和声的结构身份与上下文。
AI.motivation: 探究音乐表达是否仅由数学属性描述；分析人类作曲家基于个人与文化语境的和声决策及对既定模式的刻意背离，并检验现有AI生成和声是否保留了人类原有的和声模式。
AI.method: 选取Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash和Ritchie Valens的六首叙事流行歌曲，比较原始人类和声与可解释计算和声器在相同旋律上生成的和声（无原始和弦输入）。使用调轮图（Chord Wheel Diagrams）和基于BPMN的表示法，从和声词汇、功能持续性、重复、非自然音事件及张力-解决模式进行分析。
AI.result: 高旋律-和弦兼容性并不一定意味着保留了原始的人类和声决策模式。部分生成和声保持了经济结构，但另一些改变了和声多样性或抑制了独特事件，尽管仍与旋律兼容。
AI.conclusion: 不应仅量化艺术质量，而应引入“叙事条件的和声结构”作为计算音乐分析的补充视角。生成系统需建模除和声正确性外的结构身份、上下文及人类作曲意图。

title: SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to select the most suitable model for each incoming query. Most existing routers learn this decision directly from query embeddings, model representations, preference data, or clusters of similar examples. Such approaches can be effective, yet the representation used for routing rarely states what a query actually requires. We introduce SeLMRoute, a routing framework that separates the extraction of candidate-independent semantic evidence from the learning of candidate performance and the application of deployment objectives. A decision model first evaluates a set of interpretable questions about the query, such as its reasoning requirements and use of external knowledge, with each judgment retained as a probability distribution. The resulting probabilistic semantic state is used by a lightweight supervised router to estimate candidate model performance. Routing objectives are applied after performance estimation, which allows the same semantic state to support performance-oriented and cost-aware decisions. On the LLMRouterBench (15 datasets, 20 candidate models, 11,481 queries), SeLMRoute achieves an average accuracy of $72.08\% \pm 0.45$, while grouped five-fold out-of-fold evaluation reaches $72.64\%$, compared with $69.23\%$ for the strongest fixed candidate. The representation achieves the highest mean performance among the evaluated semantic, dense, lexical, and domain-level representations. In a separate 13-model performance-cost setting, SeLMRoute improves performance in all five grouped splits, with a mean PerfGain of $2.66\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/SeLMRoute.

AI.tldr: 提出SeLMRoute框架，通过将语义证据提取与候选模型性能学习解耦，利用可解释问题生成概率语义状态，实现兼顾准确性与成本aware的LLM路由。在LLMRouterBench上平均准确率达72.08%，优于最强固定基线，并在性能-成本场景中提升2.66%的性能增益。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法虽有效，但其表征（如嵌入、聚类）未能明确说明查询实际所需的能力或要求，导致缺乏可解释性且难以兼顾不同部署目标（如准确率vs成本）。
AI.method:
1. 语义证据提取：针对查询设计一系列可解释问题（如推理需求、外部知识使用），由决策模型评估并输出概率分布形式的语义状态；
2. 性能估计：轻量级监督路由器基于该概率语义状态预测各候选模型的表现；
3. 应用部署目标：在性能估计后应用路由策略，使同一语义状态支持面向性能和面向成本的不同决策。
AI.result:
1. 在LLMRouterBench（15数据集、20模型、11,481查询）上，SeLMRoute平均准确率为72.08% ± 0.45，五折交叉验证达72.64%，显著高于最强固定候选模型的69.23%；
2. 在各类表征（语义、稠密、词汇、领域级）中，其语义表征达到最高平均性能；
3. 在13模型的性能-成本设置中，所有分组分割均提升性能，平均性能增益（PerfGain）为2.66%。
AI.conclusion: SeLMRoute通过解耦语义理解与性能建模，实现了更透明、灵活且高效的LLM路由机制，在准确性和性能-成本平衡方面均优于现有方法。

title: Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pipeline (confidence gating, depth validation, temporal smoothing, bone-length consistency, bad-frame rejection) plus systematic information-lever ablations. On the public MM-Fi benchmark (same TI IWR6843 sensor, cross-subject), our full configuration reaches 7.45 cm 12-joint MPJPE, with ablations proving the causal value of point accumulation (k = 3, -0.34 cm), Doppler (-0.85 cm; -2 cm at the wrist on fast actions), and velocity loss (-0.27 cm). On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint. Deployment inference is radar-only - no camera, no image.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种跨模态教师-学生框架，利用SAM 3D Body生成的弱监督标签和StudentPoseFormer网络，解决了商用毫米波雷达点云极度稀疏的问题，实现了全身体素级、逐帧的3D网格重建及关节不确定性估计。在MM-Fi基准上达到7.45cm MPJPE，证明了点累积、多普勒信息和速度损失对精度的关键作用，且推理阶段仅需雷达数据，无需摄像头。
AI.motivation: 商用单芯片毫米波雷达存在点云极度稀疏（平均每帧~6.5个点，28%空帧）的问题，限制了现有技术仅能用于肢体关键点检测或离散动作分类，无法实现精细的全身体感知。目标是突破这一限制，实现公认真实的指标级3D人体网格重建。
AI.method:
1. **Mesh-Foundation-Model Teacher**: 使用预训练的SAM 3D Body模型，从单张RGB帧直接生成包含70个关节点、18,439个顶点的全身MHR真值作为监督信号，大幅降低标注成本。
2. **StudentPoseFormer Student Model**: 采用集合编码与掩码注意力池化、时序Transformer架构，以及CVAE多假设头结构，不仅输出姿态均值，还输出每个关节的方差以量化感知不确定性。
3. **Ground-Truth Quality Pipeline**: 构建包含置信度门控、深度验证、时间平滑、骨长一致性和坏帧拒绝的多阶段真值质量评估流程。
AI.result:
1. 在MM-Fi公开基准测试中，全配置模型达到7.45 cm的12关节MPJPE误差。
2.消融实验证实了点累积(k=3)、多普勒信息（尤其在快速动作的手腕处影响显著）及速度损失的因果价值。
3. 在自建同步雷达+RGB-D语料库上，端到端错误率为21.47 cm，呈现从髋部(4.8 cm)到手腕(34.7 cm)的物理层级误差分布。
4. 发现样本多样性而非数量是性能提升的主要瓶颈，预计增加约3万多样样本可将误差降至15 cm。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将低成本商用雷达的性能提升至支持全身体感知的水平，同时通过不确定性量化诚实地反映了传感器的物理局限。研究指出提升性能的关键在于数据多样性，且最终部署仅需雷达数据，实现了隐私保护下的无摄像头监控能力。

title: When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety
summary: Reliable AI safeguards require both control mechanisms that reduce unsafe behavior and monitoring mechanisms that detect safety risks during model interactions. Established behavioral safeguards include alignment methods that optimize model outputs and text monitors that assess interaction text. Representation engineering instead reads or modifies internal model states, but the relative strengths of these approaches remain unclear because they are often evaluated under different settings. We present a matched evaluation across two tracks. For safety control, we compare DPO, a behavioral alignment method, with three representation steering methods across robustness, practicality, and granularity. DPO provides the strongest overall control and generally improves with increasing training data, although its safety can degrade after subsequent benign fine-tuning. Representation steering remains competitive primarily in low-data settings, particularly with high-quality contrastive data. For safety monitoring, we compare representation probes with fine-tuned and open-weight text monitors across full-response detection, early detection, and computational cost. Specialized text monitors achieve the strongest overall detection accuracy, while representation probes remain competitive at substantially lower marginal cost. Finally, monitor-guided interventions recover much of the safety lost by DPO after benign fine-tuning, with little additional over-refusal. Overall, representation engineering does not generally replace behavioral safeguards, but offers practical advantages under specific conditions and can provide complementary safety benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文通过匹配评估对比了行为对齐（DPO）与表征工程（Representation Steering/Probes在安全控制与监控中的作用，发现两者互补：DPO总体控制最强但易受微调影响，而表征方法在低数据场景、低成本监控及辅助恢复安全方面具有独特优势。
AI.motivation: 现有的行为安全机制（如对齐方法和文本监控器）与表征工程（读取或修改内部模型状态）的相对强度尚不清楚，主要原因是以往研究往往在不同的评估设置下进行评价，导致缺乏公平的直接对比。
AI.method: 构建了统一的匹配评估框架，分为两个赛道：1. 安全控制：对比DPO（行为对齐法）与三种表征引导方法，从鲁棒性、实用性细粒度进行考察；2. 安全监控：对比表征探针、微调文本监控器和开源文本监控器，在全响应检测、早期检测和计算成本上进行评估。
AI.result: 1. 安全控制方面：DPO提供最强的整体控制力且随训练数据增加而提升，但在随后的良性微调后安全性可能退化；表征引导主要在低数据设置下保持竞争力，尤其是使用高质量对比数据时。2. 安全监控方面：专用文本监控器实现最强的整体检测准确率；表征探针以显著更低的边际成本保持竞争力。3. 干预效果：基于监控器的干预能弥补DPO在良性微调后损失的大部分安全性，且几乎不增加过度拒绝率。
AI.conclusion: 表征工程通常不能替代行为安全机制，但在特定条件下（如低数据环境、低成本监控需求）具有实用优势，并能提供补充性的安全效益。

title: Before the Token Commits: Trajectory-Level Benchmarking of Visual Hallucinations in Diffusion VLMs
summary: Multimodal diffusion language models generate responses by iteratively unmasking tokens, making each answer the endpoint of a multi-step trajectory rather than an immediate commitment. Hallucination benchmarks built for autoregressive models evaluate only the final output, and therefore cannot determine whether an unsupported claim in diffusion VLMs appears late or has already stabilized before any answer token is revealed. We introduce DynaHall, a trajectory-level benchmark of annotation-backed binary visual propositions covering object existence, counting, attributes, and relations, with controlled hard negatives graded by visual prior. DynaHall is paired with a commitment-aware protocol that records the intermediate answer tendency at every unmasking step alongside the committed output. Across five diffusion VLMs from three architecture families, visual hallucination is settled before commitment: an unsupported answer is already the preferred state while the answer position is still masked, and later unmasking steps rarely reverse it, so the failure is not introduced at the write step. This holds across decoding schedules, answer formats, and open-ended generation. DynaHall also exposes failures hidden by final-output metrics, including counting and relation collapse, prior-driven false positives, and attribute errors whose direction changes by type. Guided by this diagnosis, PGS (Pre-commitment Gradient Steering) edits still-masked answer states to reduce false positives, bringing the affirmation rate close to balance, and transfers to another architecture without degrading general ability. DynaHall and PGS suggest that hallucination should be measured and mitigated along the generation trajectory of diffusion VLMs, not only at the final answer.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态扩散语言模型（Diffusion VLMs）的传统幻觉评估仅关注最终输出，无法捕捉生成轨迹中的早期错误。本文提出DynaHall基准及承诺感知协议，揭示幻觉在“承诺”前已稳定，并创新性地提出PGS方法，通过编辑未掩码状态减少假阳性，证明应在生成轨迹层面而非仅最终输出来测量和缓解幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归模型幻觉基准仅评估最终输出，无法确定多模态扩散VLM中未被支持的声明是在生成后期出现还是在任何答案标记揭示前已稳定。因此，现有方法难以准确评估扩散模型在中间步骤中的幻觉行为及其形成机制。
AI.method:
1. 构建DynaHall基准：包含覆盖对象存在、计数、属性和关系的二进制视觉命题，由人工标注支持，并引入受控的困难负样本（由视觉先验分级）。
2. 提出承诺感知协议：记录每一步解掩码过程中的中间答案倾向及最终承诺输出。
3. 实验分析：在五款来自三种架构族的扩散VLM上测试视觉幻觉的形成时机。
4. 提出PGS（Pre-commitment Gradient Steering）：基于诊断结果，通过编辑仍被掩码的答案状态来减少假阳性。
AI.result:
1. 视觉幻觉在“承诺”发生前即已确立：即使答案位置仍处于掩码状态，不支持的答案已成为首选状态，且后续步骤很少逆转此失败，说明错误非写入步骤引入。
2. DynaHall揭示了最终输出指标隐藏的失败模式，包括计数与关系坍塌、先验驱动的假阳性以及方向随类型变化的属性错误。
3. PGS有效减少了假阳性使肯定率趋于平衡，且迁移至其他架构时未降低通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 对于多模态扩散VLM，幻觉应当在生成的整个轨迹过程中进行测量和缓解，而不仅仅依赖于最终答案的输出评估。DynaHall和PGS为这一新范式提供了基准工具和方法论支持。

title: Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026: A Five-Variant Study on French PDFs
summary: We study retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for questions about French PDF documents when both the answer and its supporting document pages are evaluated. Five system variants add dense retrieval, rank fusion, reranking, and query decomposition to a BM25 baseline. On 595 challenge questions, the complete system scores 0.4450 MRR@10 and 0.4013 Recall@10, compared with 0.3430 and 0.2994 for BM25. Dense retrieval alone and a simple lexical--dense fusion both underperform BM25. Reranking improves the hybrid system, whereas adding query decomposition produces the largest further gain, with higher latency and more detected output artifacts. The complete system slightly exceeds the reported anonymous overall mean on two answer metrics but falls below it on most page-retrieval metrics. These results identify accurate page selection, rather than semantic retrieval in isolation, as the main opportunity for improvement in this setting.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了检索增强生成（RAG）在法国PDF文档问答中的表现。结果显示，结合BM25基线、密集检索、重排序和查询分解的完整系统优于单一BM25模型，其中查询分解带来最大提升，但同时也增加了延迟和输出瑕疵。主要改进机会在于提高页面选择的准确性。
AI.motivation: 研究如何在法国PDF文档的问答任务中，同时准确回答问题和检索支持答案的相关文档页面。
AI.method: 基于BM25基线，引入五种系统变体进行对比实验：密集检索、秩融合（rank fusion）、重排序（reranking）和查询分解（query decomposition）。使用595道挑战性问题进行测试。
AI.result: 完整系统在MRR@10（0.4450）和Recall@10（0.4013）上显著优于BM25基线（分别为0.3430和0.2994）。单纯密集检索和简单词汇-密集融合效果不如BM25；重排序提升了混合系统效果；查询分解带来的增益最大，但伴随更高延迟和更多输出瑕疵。完整系统在答案指标上略超匿名整体均值，但在大多数页面检索指标上低于均值。
AI.conclusion: 在该场景下，主要的改进机会不在于单纯的语义检索，而在于提高页面选择的准确性。

title: Applying Language Models in medical Medicine: Recent Trends and Perspectives
comment: 7 pages, aimed to be a blogpost of the current state of the medical LLM field
summary: The use and applicability of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical research and clinical practice has received increasing attention in the literature over recent years. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has expanded discussions in regards to applications of AI within healthcare. While traditional deep learning based AI applications in medicine have often focused on specific and defined tasks, LLMs offer broader capabilities and flexibility in working with available data,. At the same time of writing, the integration of LLMs into medical settings raises important questions regarding their reliability, accuracy, transparency, safety, and appropriate role in a medical setting. This text presents and discusses recent talks and articles concerning the application of LLMs in medicine, with particular emphasis on their potential utility in research and clinical practice. It considers both the opportunities offered by these technologies and the challenges associated with their implementation, aiming to provide a perspective on the current and emerging role of LLMs within the medical field.

AI.tldr: 探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）在医学研究及临床应用中的潜力、机遇与挑战，重点关注其可靠性、准确性、透明度、安全性及角色定位。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型的出现，AI在医疗保健中的应用讨论范围扩大；传统深度学习侧重于特定任务，而LLM具备更广泛的能力与灵活性，但其整合引发了关于可靠性、安全性和适用性的关键问题。
AI.method: 综述并讨论近期有关医学中应用LLMs的演讲和文章，分析其技术特性及其在医疗场景中的整合情况。
AI.result: 明确了LLMs在医学领域带来的新机遇，同时也识别出实施过程中面临的具体挑战，为理解其当前及新兴角色提供了视角。
AI.conclusion: LLMs为医学研究和临床实践提供了更灵活的数据处理能力，但在部署前需充分解决其在可靠性、准确性和安全性方面的挑战，以确立其适当的医疗角色。

title: BEHAVE: Functional Behavior Modeling Enables Self-Improving Agents for Hardware Design and Verification
summary: Developing agents for hardware design and verification requires reliable correctness feedback. As a hardware specification may permit correct implementations with different latencies, matching design and reference outputs cycle by cycle can reject valid designs. To address this, we introduce BEHAVE, an agentic framework for multi-turn joint hardware design and verification through functional behavior modeling. We define Behavior IR to express task functionality as executable behavior models without prescribing implementation timing beyond the specification. The agent iteratively develops a register-transfer-level (RTL) design and a behavior model as the design's verification reference. Our evaluator, BEHAVE-Sim, checks both artifacts separately against a hidden golden behavior model using input stimuli generated by random sampling and solver-guided search. BEHAVE thus supports power, performance, and area (PPA) exploration across task-permitted latencies and microarchitectures. During training, the same evaluator provides verifiable reinforcement learning (RL) rewards from specification-behavior pairs without reference RTL. For self-improvement, the agent continually searches for high-level implementations relevant to its capability gaps, constructs and checks specification-behavior pairs, and trains on the expanded task pool. We release BEHAVE-Train and BEHAVE-Eval with 600 human-reviewed specification-behavior pairs for realistic hardware workloads. Starting from 60 seed tasks and acquiring 100 new tasks, self-improvement raises Qwen3.8-27B's RTL pass@1 on BEHAVE-Eval from 55.0% to 75.0%, reaching performance comparable to RL using a 540-task pool.

AI.tldr: 提出BEHAVE框架，通过行为建模实现硬件设计与验证的联合优化，解决传统逐周期匹配导致的正确设计被误拒问题，并在自我提升下显著提升RTL生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件设计与验证缺乏可靠的正确性反馈机制；若设计输出与参考模型逐周期匹配，会因允许不同延迟的实现而错误拒绝有效设计。
AI.method: 1. 定义Behavior IR作为可执行的行为模型，仅表达功能而不强制实施时序；2. 智能体迭代开发寄存器传输级（RTL）设计和对应的行为模型；3. 使用BEHAVE-Sim评估器分别比对RTL和行为模型与隐藏黄金模型的差异；4. 基于规范-行为对提供强化学习奖励，并通过搜索能力缺口相关任务进行自我提升。
AI.result: 1. BEHAVE-Train和BEHAVE-Eval包含600个人类审核过的规范-行为对；2. Qwen3.8-27B在BEHAVE-Eval上通过自我提升，利用60个种子任务和新增100个任务，将RTL pass@1指标从55.0%提升至75.0%，性能达到与使用540-task池的强化学习相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: BEAVE框架通过功能行为建模支持PPA探索，证明智能体可通过自我提升显著增强硬件生成能力，无需大量预设训练数据即可达到高水平表现。

title: STRIDE: Automated Evaluation of Text-to-Trajectory Alignment across Diverse Contexts
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2027, Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Language-conditioned trajectory generation is here, but its evaluation has not kept pace. Existing pedestrian trajectory metrics compare trajectories with real-world human data. This does not scale to text-to-trajectory generation across diverse contexts, as collecting human trajectories for every scenario is costly and infeasible. Moreover, pedestrian behavior is heterogeneous and context-dependent, with no single metric as the correct answer, and current evaluation frameworks are not transferable to this domain. These challenges make scalable, reliable evaluation difficult. We introduce STRIDE, the first framework for evaluating context alignment between scenario descriptions and pedestrian trajectories. STRIDE addresses these challenges through three design choices. First, we derive our VRDST evaluation protocol from sociological theories to define a complete evaluation space. Second, it decomposes high-level context into scenario-adaptive behavioral questions. Third, every question is resolved against a deterministic measurement tool library that yields reproducible answers. Together, STRIDE enables complete, verifiable, automated, and scalable evaluation across diverse contexts without requiring human trajectory data. We instantiate STRIDE in the crowd domain as STRIDE-Bench, comprising 1K scenarios, 6K behavioral questions, and 11K measurements with calibrated expected answers across 30 real-world maps. Comprehensive human validations show that STRIDE-Bench is consistent with human behavior and judgment, achieving 80% human agreement. We further evaluate several text-to-trajectory models, finding limited context-alignment capability and persistent challenges in fine-grained context conditioning. We believe that the STRIDE framework provides a first step toward principled evaluation of context-aligned pedestrian trajectory generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了STRIDE框架，旨在解决文本到轨迹生成场景中缺乏可扩展评估方法的问题。通过基于社会学理论构建VRDST协议、分解场景自适应行为问题及使用确定性测量工具库，实现了无需人工数据即可在多样化场景中进行完整、可验证且自动化的评估。实例化为STRIDE-Bench后，该框架展现了与人类判断80%的一致性，并揭示了现有模型在细粒度上下文条件化方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的行人轨迹评价指标多基于真实世界的人类数据进行比对，这种依赖人工采集数据的方式在面对跨不同语境的文本到轨迹生成任务时，因成本高昂且不可行而无法扩展。此外，行人行为具有异质性和语境依赖性，缺乏单一的标准答案，且现有评估框架难以迁移至新领域，导致可扩展且可靠的评估面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出STRIDE评估框架，包含三个核心设计选择：1）从社会学理论衍生出VRDST评估协议，以定义完整的评估空间；2）将高层语境分解为适应特定场景的行为问题；3）使用确定性的测量工具库来解决每个问题，从而产生可复现的答案。该框架无需收集真实人类轨迹数据即可实现自动化和可扩展的评估。研究还构建了STRIDE-Bench，包含1K场景、6K行为问题和11K测量值，覆盖30个真实世界地图。
AI.result: STRIDE框架被实例化为STRIDE-Bench基准测试，涵盖1000个场景、6000个行为问题和11000项带有校准预期答案的测量指标（分布在30个真实世界地图上）。人类验证表明，STRIDE-Bench与人类行为和判断保持一致，达到了80%的人类 agreement率。对多种文本到轨迹模型的进一步评估发现，现有模型在上下文对齐能力方面表现有限，且在细粒度上下文条件化方面仍面临持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE框架为语境一致的行人轨迹生成的原则性评估迈出了第一步。它提供了一种无需人类轨迹数据即可完成完整、可验证、自动化和可扩展评估的新范式，证明了其在多样本场景中评估语境对齐能力的有效性与可行性，同时指出了当前文本到轨迹生成模型在精细化语境处理上的改进空间。

title: SIPO: Selective-Inference Policy Optimization for Tree-Structured Agentic RL
summary: Tree-structured reinforcement learning trains search agents by comparing alternative continuations and propagating terminal rewards to intermediate decisions. Adaptive expansion, however, creates a statistical asymmetry: an incumbent is selected using its own generation statistic, whereas fresh siblings are sampled after selection. When that statistic is associated with return, branch values can reflect selection history as well as continuation quality, even for a shared parent. We propose Selective-Inference Policy Optimization (\SIPO{}), which incorporates this distinction into tree-based credit estimation. Its scale-free branch criterion keeps generation scores and sibling penalties on a consistent relative scale; exchangeable branching supplies multiple fresh continuations from each selected parent; and order-statistic correction adjusts retained incumbent values using selection rank and the estimated score--outcome association. These mechanisms preserve the leaf budget and the host policy optimisation objective. Across seven QA benchmarks using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, \SIPO{} achieves the highest reported multi-hop and single-hop averages among the compared methods. On Qwen3-8B, it improves these averages over AT\textsuperscript{2}PO by $1.31$ and $1.07$ percentage points, respectively, and ranks first on six of seven benchmarks. Component ablations evaluate the individual and combined changes, while early-training paired diagnostics show a selected--fresh value gap alongside a near-zero fresh--fresh reference. Together, these results support accounting for selection history when constructing and evaluating search-agent rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/SIPO

AI.tldr: 提出SIPO（选择性推理策略优化），通过校正选择历史引起的统计不对称性，提升树结构强化学习在问答任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应扩展方法存在统计不对称性：当前胜者（incumbent）与其生成的统计数据相关，而新兄弟节点是在选择后采样的。这导致分支值不仅反映延续质量，还受选择历史影响。
AI.method: 1. 无尺度分支标准：统一生成分数和兄弟惩罚的相对尺度；2. 可交换分支：为每个选定父节点提供多个新延续；3. 顺序统计校正：根据选择排名和分数-结果关联估计调整保留胜者的值。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B和Qwen2.5-7B模型的七个QA基准测试中，SIPO取得了最高的多跳和单跳平均成绩。相比AT²PO，Qwen3-8B上多跳平均提高1.31个百分点，单跳提高1.07个百分点，在七项中有六项排名第一。消融实验验证了各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在构建和评估搜索智能体轨迹时，必须考虑选择历史的影响。SIPO通过修正统计偏差有效提升了模型性能。

title: UniOPSD: Unifying Outcome and Hindsight Feedback for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become an effective approach to training language model agents, but sparse and delayed outcome rewards provide limited guidance for credit assignment across long interaction sequences. Recent work on on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers complementary supervision by evaluating a policy's sampled responses under privileged training-time context. However, our diagnostics show that positive average agreement between outcome and hindsight feedback coexists with substantial local disagreement, raising the question of how to allocate influence between them at each decision. We introduce UniOPSD (Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation), which unifies these feedback sources through adaptive local credit arbitration. UniOPSD constructs comparable credit estimates from environmental returns and successful-peer hindsight at shared interaction anchors. Historical agreement determines the global mixing level, while current signal availability and relative precision adjust each source's influence at individual decisions. The episode-level outcome contribution is retained, and bounded token modulation refines the fused step credit for policy optimization. With Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, UniOPSD achieves ALFWorld success rates of $82.8\%$ and $83.6\%$, WebShop success rates of $75.0\%$ and $82.0\%$, and Search-QA aggregate accuracies of $45.3\%$ and $49.8\%$, respectively. On 3B WebShop, UniOPSD improves over SDAR by $7.0$ percentage points. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/Uniopsd

AI.tldr: UniOPSD通过自适应局部信用仲裁统一了环境奖励和后见之明反馈，解决了强化学习中长序列credit assignment问题，在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA上显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 解决强化学习中因稀疏延迟结果奖励导致的长期交互序列信用分配困难问题；克服现有On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)中全局一致性高但局部不一致的局限性，优化不同反馈源的影响力分配。
AI.method: 提出UniOPSD（统一策略自蒸馏），利用自适应局部信用仲裁机制：1. 基于共享交互锚点构建来自环境回报和对等后见之明的可比信用估计；2. 历史协议确定全局混合水平；3. 当前信号可用性和相对精度调整每个决策点的个体影响力；4. 保留片段级结果贡献并使用有界令牌调制细化融合步信用以进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct模型上：ALFWorld成功率分别达82.8%/83.6%；WebShop成功率分别达75.0%/82.0%；Search-QA综合准确率分别达45.3%/49.8%。相比SDAR方法，3B模型在WebShop任务上提升7.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: UniOPSD有效统一了多源反馈，通过精细化信用分配机制显著增强了语言模型智能体在复杂交互式任务中的学习与决策能力，代码已开源。

title: Simulating Respondents, Not Single Questions: Coherent Survey Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate response distributions in social surveys. Prior work has achieved accurate population-level simulation for individual questions. Real questionnaires, however, ask each respondent a sequence of related questions. A simulated respondent should show coherent preferences across the whole questionnaire, not merely accurate distributions for isolated items. Existing single-item methods cannot accurately reproduce how the same person answers a complete survey. We propose FullRespondent-LLM (FR-LLM), which fine-tunes two specialized LLMs: a marginal model for each item's response distribution and a respondent-level autoregressive model for dependencies across answers. Marginal-Constrained Joint Projection (MCJP) then projects the autoregressive joint distribution onto the set satisfying the item-level marginals learned by the first model. This yields complete questionnaires with realistic cross-item relationships while retaining strong item-level accuracy. On two real-world social survey datasets, FR-LLM more accurately reproduces multi-question response patterns, maintains competitive single-item accuracy, and generalizes better to unseen populations and questions. In a small commercial-survey dataset, we use simulated responses to make pricing and stocking decisions; FR-LLM achieves the highest realized profit.

AI.tldr: 提出FR-LLM，通过联合边际模型与自回归模型及投影算法，实现更连贯、准确的多题社会调查模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在单题层面模拟准确，但无法处理问卷中题目间的关联，导致缺乏受访者整体回答的一致性。
