AI.method: 微调两个专用LLM：一个是针对每个项目的边际模型，另一个是跨答案依赖的受访者级自回归模型；利用边际约束联合投影（MCJP）将自回归联合分布投影到满足项目级边际的集合上。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上，FR-LLM更准确地复现多题响应模式，保持单项准确率，并对未见人群和题目有更好泛化能力；在商业调查中实现了最高利润。
AI.conclusion: FR-LLM能有效生成具有真实跨项目关系且单项准确的完整问卷，解决了现有方法在群体一致性上的不足。

title: BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
summary: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by proposing multiple tokens in parallel. Despite recent advances in speculative decoding through sequence-level drafting and verification, existing training objectives remain largely designed around token-level verification. To address this mismatch, we introduce Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss), a training objective designed to maximize the expected acceptance length of a drafted sequence. BV loss is directly derived from the block verification acceptance rule, providing a principled connection between the drafter training objective and the inference-time verification mechanism at the sequence level. Across math, code, and chat benchmarks, BV loss increases the mean number of tokens accepted per verification call under block verification by 13.0--21.0\% over cross-entropy loss training for DFlash and DSpark with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B without changing the inference procedure. BV loss also outperforms tokenwise acceptance objectives such as TV loss and LK loss, and its gains extend to token verification and greedy decoding. These results demonstrate the benefit of training block diffusion drafters with an objective aligned with sequence-level verification, rather than optimizing each token independently.

AI.tldr: 提出了针对块级验证（Block Verification）的BV loss训练目标，解决了现有训练与推断时序列级验证机制不匹配的问题。在Qwen3-4B/8B模型上，通过对齐块验证规则，显著提升了扩散草案器（Diffusion Drafters）的接受长度，优于传统的交叉熵和Token级损失方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测解码（speculative decoding）训练目标主要围绕Token级别的验证设计，这与最近基于序列级草案和验证的前沿进展存在错配（mismatch），导致效率未能最大化。
AI.method: 引入了“块验证感知损失”（Block Verification-aware loss, BV loss）。该损失直接推导自块验证接受规则，旨在最大化已起草序列的预期接受长度，从而在原理上将训练目标与推断时的序列级验证机制对齐。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和对话基准测试中，相比交叉熵损失，BV loss使DFlash和DSpark模型的每次验证接受的平均Token数提升了13.0--21.0%。同时，其性能超越了Tokenwise接受目标（如TV loss和LK loss），且收益延伸至Token验证和贪婪解码场景。
AI.conclusion: 为扩散草案器训练一个与序列级验证机制一致的目标（而非独立优化每个Token）具有显著优势，能够有效提升推测解码的效率。

title: Nociception as a Control Primitive: Afferent Channels and Nociceptive Memory for Agents Deployed in One Body
summary: An agent deployed in a single body cannot learn how fast that body wears, because every trial that would reveal its wear resistance wears the body it would protect. We study this \emph{epoch-one} setting, in which the parameters of a fixed-weight policy are set before the body is drawn and never updated in life. The agent carries a load-gated nociceptive channel and a memory that retains what was felt. We prove that felt cost moves the allocation to the best-\emph{paid} work not yet felt rather than the gentlest, that an agent without retention never sees the felt-cost constraint bind, and that the channel pays only where the threat is individually unpredictable, cheap to avoid and expensive to ignore. We measure per body, setting the agent with channel and memory against the same individual without them, where neither carries a schedule learned across lives. On $2{,}000$ simulated floor-layer knees, with wear anchored to published loss rates, feeling, retaining and substituting extends the working life from age $55.2$ to $59.6$ and raises career output from $33.7$ to $36.1$. $69.3\%$ of bodies gain and \textbf{none lose}. A body that feels but retains nothing past the day gains one of the $+4.4$ years, and retention carries the rest. A population-trained agent gains $+0.65$ years from the same channel at $-0.54$ output. The difference is what a species prior already supplies, and a single body has none. The two are related by an identity, the ablation mean reporting $(1-χ)$ of the per-body value with $χ$ the share a blind schedule already captures, so we report both. Where the regime map predicts value, a care robot sextuples its certified service life and a field-anchored fleet writes off $0.15$ of its machines instead of $0.55$. Where it predicts none, a rover gains little over blind caution, so the map holds in both directions.

AI.tldr: 研究“第一纪元”设定下，携带疼痛感知通道和记忆的单主体智能体如何延长设备（身体）寿命。证明机制将工作分配转向高报酬而非最温和任务，并验证该机制在模拟中显著延长工作寿命且不损害性能，适用于机器人领域以延长服务周期。
AI.motivation: 解决单一载体无法学习其磨损速率的问题，因为每一次测试都会消耗其剩余寿命。旨在探索在参数固定且不可更新的“第一纪元”设定下，如何通过内置机制（感知与记忆）优化资源分配以保护载体。
AI.method: 构建具有负荷门控伤害感受通道和记忆功能的固定权重策略模型。对比有/无记忆及通道配置的智能体表现。利用2000个模拟铺设地板的膝关节进行仿真，结合公布的损耗率数据，评估工作寿命和职业产出变化。
AI.result: 引入感觉、记忆和替代机制后，平均工作寿命从55.2岁延长至59.6岁，职业产出从33.7提升至36.1。69.3%的个体获益，无一受损。其中当日保留仅带来部分收益，长期记忆贡献剩余增益。群体训练代理虽略有增益但产出略降，凸显单个体预存的独特价值。care robot在预测有效区域可将认证服务寿命翻六倍，车队报废率从0.55降至0.15。
AI.conclusion: 疼痛感知通道的支付机制针对不可预测、低成本避免且高忽视代价的威胁。个体特异性先验知识对延长单载体寿命至关重要。所提出的状态映射方法在预测价值和无价值场景均准确，为机器人维护策略提供了理论依据和量化指标。

title: Can We Trust the Teacher? Decoupled Credit Direction-Magnitude for Self-Distillation
summary: RLVR provides reliable trajectory-level credit, while OPSD offers dense supervision for token-level credit. This exposes a fundamental coupling when updating step-level credit direction and magnitude with teacher supervision, preventing steps from receiving reliable credit directions and contribution magnitudes, while making both vulnerable to teacher judgment errors and preference variance, as supported by our theoretical analysis. To separate credit direction from its contribution magnitude, we introduce \textit{Decoupled Credit Self-Distillation (DCSD)}, which theoretically decouples credit direction and magnitude into two reliable signals and uses them to calibrate privileged teacher supervision. Specifically, we design belief-margin probing to determine credit direction and marginal information gain to quantify credit magnitude, enabling step-to-token credit assignment for policy optimization. Across 11 benchmarks, DCSD achieves the best overall scores against GRPO, OPSD, RLSD, and RLCSD. Compared with base models, DCSD improves the overall score by 8.45 points on mathematical reasoning and 7.01 points on multimodal reasoning, while correcting the credit direction for 6\% of tokens and yielding a 1.5$\times$ reduction in token credit magnitude.

AI.tldr: 提出了去耦信用自蒸馏（DCSD）方法，通过分离信用方向和幅度来解决RLVR和OPSD在步骤级更新中的耦合问题，显著提升了数学和多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法如RLVR提供可靠的轨迹级信用，而OPSD提供密集的Token级信用，但在更新步骤级信用方向和幅度时存在根本性的耦合问题，导致步骤难以获得可靠的信用方向和贡献幅度，且容易受到教师判断错误和偏好差异的影响。
AI.method: 引入去耦信用自蒸馏（DCSD），从理论上将信用方向和幅度解耦为两个可靠信号以校准特权教师监督。具体设计信念边际探测（belief-margin probing）来确定信用方向，以及边缘信息增益（marginal information gain）来量化信用幅度，从而实现从步骤到Token的信用分配。
AI.result: 在11个基准测试中，DCSD的整体得分优于GRPO、OPSD、RLSD和RLCSD。与基础模型相比，在数学推理方面整体得分提高8.45分，在多模态推理方面提高7.01分；修正了6% Token的信用方向，并将Token信用幅度降低了1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: DCSD通过有效解耦信用方向与幅度，解决了步骤级信用更新的脆弱性，显著增强了策略优化的鲁棒性和性能表现。

title: From Soft Targets to Reward Signals: How Assignment and Reward Objectives Interact
summary: Soft preference targets specify supervision strength, and reward objectives convert that strength into learned reward signals. A central design question remains: how does assigning a fixed set of preference strengths to different response pairs change the rewards produced by different objectives? We introduce assignment geometry to study this interaction. Mean-matched smoothing controls target dispersion, while within-stratum reassignment changes correspondence and preserves the complete target distribution. Across five reward objectives, intact correspondence retains the largest clean preference margins among the compared soft targets within a common accuracy-equivalence budget. Attenuation orderings change with the reward objective, revealing different responses to the same target assignments. Independent reassignments and a related source construction reproduce the retention direction. An attenuation-retention profile compares these combinations through margin magnitude, edit response, and accuracy. Against independently calibrated scaling, APLOT uniform targets deliver additional attenuation on both aggregate and presentation edits. These findings establish a joint design space in which target placement and reward objective shape reward properties beyond preference accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了“分配几何”概念，探究固定偏好强度分配如何影响不同奖励目标产生的信号。研究发现，保持完整的对应关系能在同等精度下保留最大的干净偏好边际；并揭示了不同奖励目标对相同目标分配的衰减响应差异。特别是APLOT均匀目标在编辑响应的聚合和呈现层面提供了额外的衰减，确立了超越偏好精度的目标放置与奖励目标联合设计空间。
AI.motivation: 核心设计问题尚不明确：将固定的偏好强度集分配给不同的响应对时，不同的奖励目标会产生怎样的变化？即偏好强度分配与奖励信号生成之间的相互作用机制不明。
AI.method: 引入“分配几何”（assignment geometry）来研究这一互动。采用均值匹配平滑控制目标分散度，并在分层内进行重分配以改变对应关系同时保留完整的目标分布。评估了五种奖励目标，并通过独立重分配和相关源构造复现结果，使用衰减-保留曲线对比这些组合的边际幅度、编辑响应和准确性。
AI.result: 1. 在相同的精度等效预算内，保持完整的对应关系能保留最大的干净偏好边际。2. 衰减排序随奖励目标的不同而变化，表明不同目标对同一目标分配的响应不同。3. APLOT均匀目标比独立校准缩放提供了额外的衰减，既体现在聚合编辑上也体现在呈现编辑上。4. 独立重分配和源构造验证了这种保留方向。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一个联合设计空间，证明目标放置（target placement）和奖励目标（reward objective）共同塑造了奖励属性，其影响超出了单纯的偏好准确性（preference accuracy）。这为理解软偏好目标和奖励信号之间的关系提供了新的视角和设计原则。

title: AUV-Bench: Aesthetic Understanding and Generation Evaluation for User Interfaces
summary: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used for evaluating and generating user interfaces (UIs), often producing seemingly reasonable aesthetic judgments and visually plausible pages. However, under professional design scrutiny, their behavior can differ substantially from that of human designers. In professional design practice, designers rely on a systematic set of aesthetic principles that consistently guide judgment, diagnosis, repair, and creation. A coherent aesthetic capability should therefore connect aesthetic judgment with design actions. Existing evaluations, however, typically assess these abilities in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether task-level success reflects a shared aesthetic understanding or merely fragmented task-specific competence. To address this gap, we introduce AUV-Bench, developed in collaboration with professional UI designers around 1,395 executable web interfaces and four tasks: aesthetic scoring, diagnosis, repair, and text-to-UI generation. The tasks share a pool of UIs and aesthetic principles, with diagnosis and repair further aligned on 660 controlled-degradation instances to enable instance-level analysis of judgment and action. Evaluation of 12 models reveals a capability imbalance: models show moderate agreement with professional designers in holistic aesthetic scoring, yet exact diagnosis-chain success peaks at only 24.7%. On the aligned diagnosis-repair cases, correct judgments and successful repairs do not consistently coincide, exposing a Judgment-Action Gap between identifying aesthetic problems and successfully acting on them. In open-ended generation, even leading models achieve only moderate aesthetic quality under human-calibrated evaluation. Overall, current models exhibit partial aesthetic competence, but still lack the fine-grained understanding and judgment-action coherence required for reliable UI design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AUV-Bench评估框架，揭示多模态基础模型在UI美学能力上存在“判断-行动鸿沟”（Judgment-Action Gap），即模型虽具备一定的美学评分能力，但在诊断修复和生成环节缺乏与专业设计师一致的细粒度理解及判断与行动的连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常孤立地测试审美判断或设计任务，无法确定任务级成功是源于共享的审美理解还是碎片化的特定任务能力；同时，专业设计中审美原则需连贯指导判断、诊断、修复和创作，而现有模型在此方面表现与人类设计师差异巨大。
AI.method: 联合专业UI设计师构建AUV-Bench基准，包含1,395个可执行Web界面及四项共享美学原则的任务：美学评分、诊断、修复和文生UI生成。特别通过660个受控退化实例对齐诊断与修复任务，以支持实例级别的判断与行动分析。对12个主流模型进行评估。
AI.result: 1. 模型在整体美学评分上与专业设计师呈现中度一致性；2. 精确的诊断链成功率仅为24.7%；3. 在诊断-修复对齐案例中，正确判断与成功修复并不一致，暴露出显著的“判断-行动鸿沟”；4. 即使在开放生成中，领先模型在人 calibrated 评估下仅能达到中等美学质量。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型仅具备部分美学能力，缺乏进行可靠UI设计所需的细粒度理解以及判断与行动的连贯性（coherence）。

title: On the Limits of Metacognitive Monitoring in LLMs
summary: Reliable decisions depend on recognizing when an answer may be wrong. In biological cognition, metacognitive monitoring can dissociate from task performance, raising the question of how closely solving and judging are linked in language models. Here we study the confidence reports of four frontier models across 15 benchmarks. High task accuracy can coexist with weak error discrimination: a model solves 97% of competition mathematics problems while its answer-time confidence ranks correct answers above errors barely better than chance. Confidence separates correct answers from errors more effectively on questions solved by a separate reference model, while review brings limited improvement on reference-hard questions. Aggregate discrimination also rewards ranking correct answers on easy questions above errors on hard ones, which question-only forecasts already do well. Cross-evaluation helps most where the evaluator answered correctly, and errors shared by the two models usually retain high confidence. Hard questions and shared errors remain difficult targets for prompted self-review and peer oversight, even in models with strong problem-solving performance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现前沿语言模型虽然在任务准确率上表现优异，但其基于时间的置信度报告在区分正确与错误答案时表现极差（接近随机水平）。模型的元认知能力与其实际解题能力存在显著脱节。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究大语言模型中“解决问题”与“判断准确性”之间的关联程度。受生物认知中元监控可独立于任务表现的影响，研究试图揭示模型是否能可靠地识别自身可能出现的错误。
AI.method: 对四个前沿语言模型在15个基准测试中的置信度报告进行分析。重点考察了模型在解决高难度竞赛数学问题时的准确率与其答案生成时间置信度在区分正误上的有效性，并评估了参考模型辅助、自我审查及同伴监督等机制对提升置信度判断力的作用。
AI.result:
1. 高准确率伴随弱错误辨别力：模型能解决97%的竞赛数学题，但其置信度区分正确/错误的能力仅略优于 chance。
2. 参考模型有助于区分：使用单独的参考模型进行交叉评估时，置信度对正确/错误的分离效果更明显。
3. 简单问题主导判别：聚合判别主要奖励将简单问题的正确答案排在困难问题错误答案之上，这已被单一问题的预测所涵盖。
4. 自我审查与同伴监督局限性：即便对于具备强解题能力的模型，针对难题和共享错误的提示性自我审查及同伴监督带来的改善非常有限。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的解题能力并不保证其具备相应的元认知监控能力。现有的置信度报告和常见的改进机制（如自我回顾）难以有效处理复杂或共享的错误案例，表明当前模型在可靠性评估方面仍存在重大缺陷。

title: One Readout, Many Repairs: Diffusion-Guided Hierarchical Search for Tool-Agent Repair
summary: Tool agents use large language models to act through external tools, yet successfully executed calls can still leave user requests unfulfilled. Tool-agent repair seeks alternative call sequences that execute successfully and fulfill the original requests. However, repair requires exploring both operation choices and their concrete realizations, making complete-sequence regeneration costly. Moreover, regeneration repeats operation selection even when failure arises from how those operations are realized. The resulting challenge is to reduce this repetition while preserving exploration of alternative operations and realizations. Therefore, we formulate repair as hierarchical search over operation supports, which we introduce as sets of permitted operation types that define reusable search regions for concrete tool-call sequences. We propose ReCommit, a training-free, diffusion-guided framework for improving tool-agent failure recovery while reducing repair computation. ReCommit amortizes operation-level proposal computation across repair trials by reusing operation-type scores from a single parallel readout of a masked diffusion language model. These scores guide search across supports, while realization search explores alternative entity bindings, arguments, and action composition within each support. Experiments on real failures across four enterprise services in the Agent-Diff benchmark show 75.9\% and 63.2\% relative recovery gains with 61.3\% and 51.3\% reductions in mean full-budget repair time at repair budgets $B=3$ and $B=13$, respectively, over the strongest evaluated 8B comparison method. ReCommit achieves a favorable recovery--cost trade-off, including in comparisons with the evaluated 32B models.

AI.tldr: 提出ReCommit框架，通过分层搜索和扩散模型指导，高效修复工具代理失败，显著提升恢复率并降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有工具代理修复方法在探索操作选择和具体实现时存在重复计算问题，导致完全序列再生成本高且效率低。
AI.method: 将修复建模为基于“操作支持”的分层搜索；提出ReCommit，一种无需训练的扩散引导框架，复用掩码扩散语言模型的并行读取得分来摊销操作级提议计算，结合操作类型评分与具体实体绑定、参数及动作构成的实现搜索。
AI.result: 在Agent-Diff基准测试的四个企业服务的真实故障实验中，相较于最强的8B对比方法，ReCommit在修复预算B=3和B=13时分别实现了75.9%和63.2%的相对恢复增益，以及61.3%和51.3%的平均全预算修复时间减少，且在对比32B模型时也展现出有利的恢复-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: ReCommit通过减少重复操作选择并保留替代操作与实现的探索，实现了更好的故障恢复与计算成本之间的平衡，有效提升了工具代理的容错能力。

title: Fewer Assumptions by Design: A Reusable Skill for LLM-Assisted Verus Verification
summary: LLM-assisted Verus verification is a less tedious method to verify Rust implementations, but paired with self-referential structures, e.g., Doubly Linked Lists (DLLs)—notoriously difficult to formalise for verification—it becomes a substantially more demanding verification task.    Moreover, a specification weakness can arise when verification relies on unproven or invalidated assumptions, such as axiomatic lemmas and assume statements. We investigate whether LLM agents can synthesize strong DLL specifications while minimizing these trusted base. The analysis follows three different approaches: manual verification, property-specific verification, and a defined skill for the specific case of DLLs and certain properties of this type of data structure. The skill encodes domain knowledge and a task-decomposition strategy. We show that an LLM agent equipped with a carefully designed verification skill can generate strong, low-trust specifications for DLLs in Verus.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，配备特定验证技能的LLM智能体能够生成低信任基础的强双链表（DLL）规格说明，从而简化Rust实现的Verus验证。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决LLM辅助的Verus验证在处理自引用结构（如难形式化的双链表DLL）时任务繁重的问题，以及消除因依赖未证明假设（如公理化引理和assume语句）而产生的规格说明弱点。
AI.method: 采用三种方法进行研究：手动验证、特定属性验证，以及定义针对DLL及其特性的专门技能（包含领域知识和任务分解策略）。通过分析LLM智能体在运用该技能时的表现来评估其有效性。
AI.result: LLM智能体结合精心设计的验证技能，能够为Verus中的DLL生成强有力的、低信任基础的规格说明。
AI.conclusion: 利用领域知识和任务分解策略定义的“技能”，可以有效提升LLM在复杂数据结构验证中的能力，减少对可信基础假设的依赖。

title: DeShortcut-Align: Decoupling Spurious Shortcuts for Robust Safety Alignment in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Safety alignment of large reasoning models (LRMs) via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) often yields near-perfect safety scores, yet this apparent success comes at the cost of severe over-refusal and degraded general capabilities. Through systematic empirical analysis, we find that these failures are closely associated with the learning of spurious shortcuts rather than robust intent-sensitive safety evaluation. Specifically, we identify two dominant shortcuts: formatting shortcuts, where refusal behaviors are overly bound to structural prompt templates that frequently appear in safety alignment corpora; and lexical shortcuts, where sensitive keywords reflexively trigger refusals on benign queries. To mitigate reliance on these shortcuts, we propose DeShortcut-Align, a shortcut-decoupling alignment framework that reduces dependence on superficial cues. DeShortcut-Align operates across three coordinated stages: (1) Refusal Sensitivity Attribution, which masks input tokens to quantify their impact on the final refusal response distribution; (2) Attribution-Guided Contrastive Augmentation, which constructs benign contrastive samples using high-sensitivity tokens to mitigate lexical shortcuts; and (3) Counterfactual Consistency Regularization, which constructs template-ablated states via attention blinding to enforce decision consistency across SFT and RL, mitigating formatting shortcut dependence. Experiments on 7B and 14B models demonstrate that DeShortcut-Align significantly improves robustness against template-stripping bypass attacks (reducing performance drops by up to 72%), substantially reduces over-refusal by over 58%, and better preserves general-purpose reasoning capabilities, thereby mitigating the alignment tax commonly observed in safety training.

AI.tldr: 提出DeShortcut-Align框架，通过解耦格式和词汇两种“捷径”依赖，缓解大型推理模型（LRM）在安全对齐中常见的过度拒绝和能力退化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SFT和RL的安全对齐方法虽能获得高安全评分，但导致严重的过度拒绝（over-refusal）和通用能力下降，其根源在于模型学习了虚假捷径而非鲁棒的安全意图识别。
AI.method: 提出DeShortcut-Align框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 拒绝敏感性归因，通过遮蔽输入令牌量化其对拒绝响应的影响；(2) 归因引导的对比增强，利用高敏感令牌构建良性对比样本以缓解词汇捷径；(3) 反事实一致性正则化，通过注意力盲化构建去模板状态，强制SFT和RL阶段的决策一致性以缓解格式捷径。
AI.result: 在7B和14B模型上，该方法显著提升了抵抗模板剥离绕过攻击的鲁棒性（性能下降减少高达72%），大幅降低过度拒绝现象（超过58%），并更好地保留了通用推理能力，缓解了安全训练中的“对齐税”。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦对表面线索（如特定模板和关键词）的依赖，DeShortcut-Align能在保持模型安全性同时恢复其通用能力，证明了消除虚假捷径对于提升大模型安全对齐有效性的关键作用。

title: Dual-Stream Simultaneous Translation via 2D Grid Attention
comment: Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing. 12 pages, 7 figures
summary: Simultaneous machine translation must generate target tokens before the source input is complete. Existing approaches address this through post-hoc read-write policies, leaving the attention mechanism unaware of bidirectional stream dependencies. We propose a dual-stream attention framework that represents source and target streams as a two-dimensional grid of hidden states and models their interaction through four structurally distinct attention types merged via joint QK Softmax normalization. Two approximations---broadcast and Hadamard---reduce the per-layer complexity from O(X^2Y+XY^2) to O(X^2+Y^2+XY) with provably decaying error. Training uses a self-guided loop: a per-cell loss heatmap drives dynamic-programming path recovery, which generates read/write decision supervision labels without external alignment. An incremental KV cache with anchored rotary position embeddings enables efficient streaming inference. On Chinese-to-English simultaneous translation, the proposed model outperforms the Wait-k baseline by +5.66 BLEURT and +10.36 COMET at comparable latency, and surpasses the non-streaming reference on COMET at a fraction of the response delay.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双流注意力框架，通过将源和目标流建模为二维网格并合并四种注意力类型，解决了同时翻译中目标生成先于源输入完成时双向依赖未知的问题；利用广播和Hadamard近似将复杂度从O(X^2Y+XY^2)降至O(X^2+Y^2+XY)，并通过自引导循环实现无需外部对齐的监督学习。在中文到英文同时翻译任务上，显著优于Wait-k基线及非流式参考模型。
AI.motivation: 现有同时机器翻译方法通过后处理读写策略解决生成问题，但导致注意力机制无法感知双向流依赖关系，限制了性能提升。
AI.method:
1. 构建双流注意力框架，将源和目标流表示为隐藏状态的二维网格，通过联合QK Softmax归一化合并四种结构不同的注意力类型以模拟其交互。
2. 引入广播（broadcast）和Hadamard两种近似方法，降低每层计算复杂度，并提供可证明的误差衰减保证。
3. 采用自引导训练循环：基于单元格损失热力图驱动动态规划路径恢复，生成读写决策监督标签，无需外部对齐信息。
4. 使用带锚点旋转位置嵌入的增量KV缓存，实现高效的流式推理。
AI.result: 在中文到英文同时翻译任务上，该模型在与可比延迟下比Wait-k基线提升+5.66 BLEURT和+10.36 COMET分数；且在响应延迟仅为非流式参考模型一小部分的情况下，超越了其在COMET指标上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的双流注意力框架能有效建模双向流依赖，通过低复杂度近似和自监督训练策略，在保持低延迟的同时显著提升同时机器翻译的质量。

title: DGF-Bench: A Benchmark for Simulating and Auditing Deception Against Multi-Agent Governance Boards
comment: 52 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://www.dgfbench.com/ ; code: https://github.com/jeremy1392/DGF-Bench ; package: https://pypi.org/project/dgf-bench/
summary: Tool-using language-model agents can review enterprise projects as governance boards do: they read the evidence, apply written rules and decide whether the project may proceed. Part of that evidence comes from suppliers and project members with a stake in the decision. DGF-Bench is a benchmark in which a board of agents (specialist gates and a General gate that consolidates their decisions) reviews synthetic dossiers while an attacker plants deceptive content in evidence the organization does not vouch for. Dossiers are generated from canonical facts under 61 executable rules, with 42 authoritative records and 32 narrative documents; every gate is certified decidable from those records. Attacks never change an authoritative value, so an attacked dossier keeps the reference decisions of its clean copy. A success is attributable only when the agent receives the injection and takes the exact injected action, which it does not take on the paired clean dossier; the DGF score is the share of applicable fixed attacks a model blocks. Reading documents and records themselves, five of six models were outcome-strict (disposition, findings, actions and authorization all correct) on 82 to 85 of 85 gates. Over 2,622 attacked gate runs, seven direct-order, false-data and false-authority attacks obtained one attributable success against these five, whereas task-aligned attacks imitating the organization's own process passed against four of them: a record note citing a fake review procedure lowered GPT-6 Luna Pro from 34 to 6 outcome-strict gates and DeepSeek V4 Pro from 33 to 7. DGF scores ranged from 96.2 to 26.9, and a policy-aware adaptive attacker writing in records succeeded against five of six models. The approval tool executed no forged approval, yet deceived agents submitted approvals that the rules forbid. The open-source package dgf-bench computes the DGF score with one command.

AI.tldr: DGF-Bench是一个用于评估语言模型代理作为企业治理委员会时，抵御证据投毒攻击能力的基准测试。研究发现，尽管大多数模型在干净数据上表现良好，但精心设计的“任务对齐”攻击和策略感知的自适应攻击能显著降低模型的合规性，导致非法审批通过。
AI.motivation: 评估具备工具使用能力的语言模型代理（LM Agents）在充当企业项目治理委员会时，面对恶意攻击者植入的欺骗性证据时的稳健性和决策准确性。
AI.method: 构建了DGF-Bench基准测试：1. 生成合成档案（包含权威记录和叙事文档），基于61条可执行规则；2. 设置由专业门控和综合门控组成的代理董事会进行审查；3. 攻击者在不改变权威事实的前提下，在不可验证的证据中植入欺骗性内容；4. 定义成功标准为代理在收到注入后采取了仅在注入场景中会出现的特定动作；5. 计算DGF分数为模型阻止固定攻击的比例。
AI.result: 1. 在干净档案上，六分之五的模型在所有85个检查点中达到82-85个“结果严格”状态；2. 在2,622次受攻击的运行中，直接排序、假数据和假权威攻击仅造成少数成功；3. “任务对齐”攻击（模仿组织流程）成功绕过四个模型，使GPT-6 Luna Pro和DeepSeek V4 Pro的有效合规门控从约34个骤降至6-7个；4. DGF分数范围在96.2到26.9之间，策略感知的自适应攻击成功突破了五个模型；5. 即使工具本身未执行伪造审批，代理仍会被欺骗提交违规审批。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的语言模型代理在处理结构化治理任务时，虽然对标准噪音具有较强鲁棒性，但对模拟组织内部流程的高级欺骗性攻击（如利用记录中的虚假审查程序引用）非常脆弱。这揭示了在关键决策场景中，仅依靠模型内在能力不足以防范精心策划的证据投毒攻击，需引入更强的对抗性验证机制。开源工具dgf-bench可用于量化此类风险。

title: RISE: Red-teaming via Iterative Strategy Evolution for Modern Text-to-Image Models
summary: On modern production text-to-image systems, successful policy violations are rare, and previously effective human-written seeds are often patched out. Current automated red-teamers are poorly matched to this regime in two ways: unreliable success measurement and poor exploration. First, we find that judges widely used in prior T2I red-teaming work are unreliable under vague unsafe-content targets: they either miss true violations or reward benign borderline images on hardened APIs. We therefore define strict category-specific success criteria and calibrate strong VLM judges against human labels. Second, we show that broadly used prompt-modification pipelines do not solve the exploration problem: on harder guardrail settings they remain tied to seed prompts, fail to transfer, or cannot bootstrap positive examples. We introduce RISE, which evolves reusable strategies used to generate prompts rather than rewriting them one by one. The best discovered strategies are then reused to generate attacks across new scenarios. On DALL-E 3, Nano Banana 2 (Google) and GPT-Image-2, RISE reaches up to 13% human-verified ASR; under the same calibrated evaluation, prior methods with reported ASR as high as roughly 30% fall to near zero.

AI.tldr: 针对现代文生图系统防御增强导致的红队测试困境，提出RISE方法：通过定义严格评估标准和演化可复用攻击策略，显著提升了在强保护模型上的有效攻击率。
AI.motivation: 现代文生图系统（T2I）已修补许多传统漏洞，导致自动红队测试面临两大挑战：一是现有裁判对模糊违规目标的测量不可靠；二是现有的提示词修改流程无法有效探索新场景或迁移策略。
AI.method: 1. 建立严格的类别特定成功标准，并校准视觉语言模型（VLM）裁判以对齐人类标签；2. 提出RISE算法，不再逐个重写提示词，而是演化可重用的生成策略，并将最佳策略复用于新场景的攻击生成。
AI.result: 在DALL-E 3、Nano Banana 2和GPT-Image-2上，RISE达到了最高13%的人类验证攻击成功率（ASR）；相比之下，先前报告ASR高达约30%的方法在经过校准的评估下成功率降至近零。
AI.conclusion: RISE通过改进评估可靠性和引入策略演化机制，解决了当前红队测试在强化守卫设置下的探索与评估难题，证明了其在实际高安全阈值系统中的有效性。

title: PDEU-Bench: Benchmarking the Personalized Planning Lifecycle of Tool-Calling LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from tool-calling systems that execute isolated instructions into task-oriented agents that pursue user goals through sustained, multi-step interactions. However, existing benchmarks for personalized tool use largely assess isolated calls or reactive execution, leaving unclear whether agents can formulate, execute, and revise an explicit plan while preserving user preferences throughout long-term interaction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{PDEU-Bench} (\textbf{P}ersonalized plan \textbf{D}efinition, plan \textbf{E}xecution, and plan \textbf{U}pdate \textbf{Bench}mark), a benchmark for evaluating the complete planning lifecycle of personalized tool-using agents. PDEU-Bench comprises 214 long-horizon interaction tasks spanning 12 everyday domains and 94 tools, with stage-specific assessments of preference adherence and plan quality. Extensive evaluations of 15 representative open-source and closed-source LLMs reveal a pronounced gap between local tool execution and dynamic planning: LLMs can often instantiate preferences in individual calls, yet struggle to construct coherent plan definition and plan update. We further evaluate mainstream personalization and memory-augmentation methods. Although these methods improve particular stages, none of the evaluated methods reliably propagates user preferences throughout the complete lifecycle, and their gains frequently fail to transfer to subsequent execution. Fine-grained error analysis further reveals that preference omissions and conflicts persist throughout the planning lifecycle, highlighting the need for future research to parameterize LLMs with preference-aware information retrieval and memory capabilities. We provide the relevant code and data in the appendix to support future research.

AI.tldr: 提出PDEU-Bench基准测试，评估LLM代理在长期交互中定义、执行和更新个性化计划的完整生命周期能力，发现现有模型在动态规划中存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化工具使用基准主要评估孤立调用或反应性执行，缺乏对代理在长期交互中制定、执行及修正明确计划并始终保留用户偏好的能力评估。
AI.method: 构建包含214个长程交互任务、涵盖12个日常领域和94个工具的PDEU-Bench基准，对15种主流开源和闭源LLM进行全面评估，并分析主流个人化和记忆增强方法的效果。
AI.result: LLM在局部工具执行上表现尚可，但在构建连贯的计划定义和更新方面存在明显短板；主流个人化和记忆增强方法虽能改善特定阶段，但无法可靠地将用户偏好贯穿整个生命周期，且收益难以迁移至后续执行。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM代理在跨阶段的偏好保持和计划连续性上存在不足，未来研究需关注参数化LLM的偏好感知信息检索和记忆能力，以解决规划生命周期中的偏好遗漏和冲突问题。

title: Proactive Dialogue Policy Optimization via Cognitive-State Transition
summary: Proactive dialogue requires agents to continually adapt their policies to user feedback while progressing toward task objectives over multiple turns. To move beyond imitation learning on static datasets, recent approaches use user simulators to collect interactive data for policy optimization. However, many simulators do not explicitly model the evolution of user cognition, limiting the consistency and state dependence of feedback across turns. Moreover, representing each action only by a high-level strategy label overlooks the large utterance space and cannot distinguish alternative realizations of the same strategy. To this end, we jointly design a $\textbf{Cog}$nitive User $\textbf{Sim}$ulator $\textbf{(Cog-Sim)}$ and $\textbf{C}$ognitive-$\textbf{S}$tate $\textbf{T}$ransition--Driven $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{O}$ptimization $\textbf{(CSTPO)}$. Cog-Sim maintains the user's cognitive and affective states and generates responses through constrained state transitions across turns, so feedback depends on both the realized utterance and the user's current state. CSTPO organizes each action as a hierarchical strategy--utterance representation: a high-level strategy label constrains utterance sampling, and utterances are optimized within each label. Sparse complete-branch sampling reuses shared dialogue prefixes and estimates separate strategy-level and utterance-level advantages, enabling fine-grained optimization at both levels. Across three tasks, Cog-Sim exhibits monotonic dose--response relationships and is preferred over prompt-based simulators for naturalness. CSTPO improves Qwen3-14B's performance to a level comparable to that of GPT-5.5-based planning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Cog-Sim模拟器和CSTPO优化方法，通过显式建模用户认知状态演变及分层策略-话语表示，解决主动对话中反馈一致性和动作粒度细化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于静态数据集的模仿学习无法适应动态反馈；现有用户模拟器未显式建模认知演变，导致跨轮次反馈缺乏一致性；传统方法仅用高层策略标签表征动作，忽视了具体话语空间，无法区分同一策略的不同实现。
AI.method: 联合设计Cog-Sim（维护用户认知与情感状态，通过受限状态转移生成反馈）和CSTPO（采用分层策略-话语表示，利用稀疏完整分支采样复用共享前缀，分别估计策略级和话语级优势以进行细粒度优化）。
AI.result: 在三个任务上，Cog-Sim表现出单调剂量反应关系且在自然度上优于基于提示的模拟器；CSTPO将Qwen3-14B的性能提升至与GPT-5.5-based规划方法相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合认知驱动的用户模拟器和分层策略优化的政策优化方法，能有效提升多轮主动对话系统中代理对动态用户反馈的适应能力及整体任务性能。

title: VD-DeepStack: Bridging Visual Comparison and Language Reasoning for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot visual anomaly detection is fundamentally a visual comparison task, requiring fine-grained inspection of a query against normal references. Many recent methods based on large vision-language models (LVLMs) emphasize comparative reasoning through language chain-of-thought. Yet discrete, abstract descriptions may underrepresent dense, fine-grained visual differences, leaving a gap between visual comparison and its expression in language. To address this gap, we propose Visual Difference DeepStack (VD-DeepStack), which explicitly conditions language reasoning on query-reference visual differences. Specifically, we fuse DINO features with the LVLM visual hierarchy to strengthen fine-grained representations, then construct dense difference evidence from residuals between query features and softly matched reference features. The difference-evidence path injects spatially weighted difference vectors into query-image states at multiple decoder depths, while an auxiliary visual-context path provides fine-grained appearance information to support their interpretation. Experiments on 4 industrial and 2 medical anomaly benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements in few-shot anomaly detection over baselines relying on textual comparative reasoning. These results support mitigating the visual comparison-reasoning gap through the joint design of comparison representations and their integration into the decoder. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出Visual Difference DeepStack (VD-DeepStack)方法，通过融合DINO特征与LVLM视觉层级构建密集差异证据，并将空间加权差异向量注入解码器各层，以弥合视觉比较与语言推理间的鸿沟，显著提升少样本异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的方法侧重于通过语言思维链进行对比推理，但离散、抽象的描述可能无法充分表示密集、细粒度的视觉差异，导致视觉比较与其在语言中的表达之间存在差距。
AI.method: 提出VD-DeepStack框架：1. 融合DINO特征与LVLM视觉层级以增强细粒度表示；2. 从查询特征与软匹配参考特征的残差中构建密集差异证据；3. 差异证据路径将空间加权差异向量注入查询图像状态的多层解码器深度；4. 辅助视觉上下文路径提供细粒度外观信息以支持解释。
AI.result: 在4个工业和2个医疗异常基准测试上进行了实验，结果表明VD-DepStack在少样本异常检测任务上相比依赖文本对比推理的基线方法有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过在解码器中联合设计比较表示及其集成方式，可以有效缓解视觉比较与推理之间的差距。

title: AX is the New AEO
summary: In 2023, AI models answered from training data and hallucinated when it ran out, and businesses were told to seed that knowledge. Models' training knowledge has since given way to live web search, and the advice followed it there: answer-engine optimization, or AEO, now tells businesses to scatter breadcrumbs across forum threads, listicles, and off-site citations, so AI engines are likelier to surface and recommend them. But being surfaced is no longer enough: an agent opens the results and reads them before deciding, and one buyer question sends it through several rounds of search and fetch. What decides the outcome at this drill-down step is whether the agent can fetch and read the business's own site: agent experience (AX). We argue that AX is the new AEO. We run 37,927 agent journeys, each a buyer question about a business, across four independent harnesses over 1,056 real businesses, matched on fame, prior model knowledge, and two AEO proxies, then split based on their AX level. Only 7-10% of the finished answer comes from the model's training knowledge, whether or not the site is readable. Agent-ready businesses have answers built from their own pages 78% of the time against 56% and are clearly recommended 1.9x more often, while every grounded answer about a not-agent-ready business costs the agent 64% more. Holding business, harness, and question fixed, answers built from the site are 41% more accurate. The dominant failure is not fabrication but omission: web-built answers are 3.7x more likely to contain none of the facts the buyer asked for. Baselines differ sharply across the four harnesses, with clear-recommendation rates varying sevenfold from stack to stack, yet the effect holds in every one. In the agentic web era, being readable beats being talked about, and improving a site's AX is the strongest lever a business has.

AI.tldr: 文章指出在AI代理时代，“代理体验（AX）”已取代“答案引擎优化（AEO）”成为企业关键指标。研究表明，只有当网站对AI代理易读且可访问时，AI才能有效利用企业自有数据生成准确答案并提高推荐率；反之，难以读取的网站会导致高错误率和低推荐。因此，提升网站的AI可读性比单纯的SEO优化更为重要。
AI.motivation: 随着AI模型从依赖训练数据转向实时网络搜索，企业的关注点曾集中在答案引擎优化（AEO）上。然而，随着AI代理（Agents）能够进行多轮搜索和深度阅读，仅仅被索引已不足够。研究旨在探讨在AI代理主导的检索流程中，决定最终结果的关键因素是否已从“可见性”转变为“可访问性与可读性”，即代理体验（AX）。
AI.method: 研究者进行了37,927次AI代理旅程测试，涵盖1,056家真实企业的买家问题。实验使用四个独立的基准测试工具（harnesses），根据知名度、先验模型知识和AEO代理指标对企业进行匹配，并根据其AX水平（Agent-Ready vs 非Agent-Ready）分组。研究分析了回答来源比例、推荐频率、准确性及错误类型。
AI.result:
1. 模型自身训练知识对最终回答的贡献仅为7-10%。
2. AI准备就绪的企业（Agent-ready）有78%的回答来自其自有页面，而非此类企业仅为56%。
3. AI准备好企业的被推荐频率是非该企业的1.9倍。
4. 针对不可用网站的有依据回答使代理成本增加64%。
5. 基于网站构建的答案准确性高出41%。
6. 主要失败模式是遗漏（omission）而非虚构：无法读取网站导致的回答包含买家所需事实的概率低3.7倍。
7. 尽管不同基准测试结果差异巨大，但AX的影响在所有设置中均显著。
AI.conclusion: 在AI代理时代，网页的可读性和可访问性（AX）比被广泛讨论或提及（AEO）更重要。提升网站的AX是企业所能采取的最强效杠杆，因为它直接决定了AI代理能否正确获取、理解并利用企业信息来为用户提供高质量答案。

title: ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization
comment: 38 pages, 5 figures. Code and supplementary materials: https://github.com/Trace231/ProofLoom
summary: Formalizing research-level stochastic optimization in Lean requires both an algorithm model and domain theory connecting foundational libraries to convergence proofs. Revising a model to restore provability can change the mathematical claim. We introduce ProofLoom, a fully automated LLM-agent system for Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction. Given a published algorithm, target theorem, and source proof, ProofLoom autonomously constructs the Lean model and supporting theory. Open proof obligations drive the development of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans. Signature contracts record evidence and obligations for model revisions; an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims, and Audit checks whether the Lean proof follows it. Across tasks, SOptLib accumulates verified mathematics and construction experience: reusable results are extracted, generalized, and verified, while modeling decisions and failed proof routes are recorded. Later tasks retrieve these results and records and contribute new developments, forming a cycle of construction, accumulation, and reuse. On fifteen textbook and research-paper tasks, ProofLoom obtains mean human ratings of 6.3/7 and 6.4/7, compared with 4.9/7 and 5.0/7 for the strongest of six baselines. Across 33 developments, it produces 490,693 lines of algorithm-local Lean code with no sorry. The formalizations also expose 28 incorrect formulas, proof gaps, and algorithm-analysis mismatches in published sources across 22 developments, each with checked evidence.

AI.tldr: ProofLoom是一个完全自动化的LLM代理系统，用于“证明义务驱动”的数学理论构建。它通过分析算法、目标定理和源证明，自动生成Lean形式的模型和理论，解决随机优化领域的形式化难题。该系统不仅提高了形式化验证的成功率和代码质量，还通过积累经验库实现了持续复用，并在实际任务中发现了多处已发表文献中的错误和漏洞。
AI.motivation: 在Lean中进行研究级随机优化的形式化需要结合算法模型与连接基础库至收敛性证明的领域理论。然而，为了恢复可证明性而修订模型可能会改变原本的数学声明，导致形式化过程困难重重。旨在解决这一挑战，自动化地构建正确的模型和理论体系。
AI.method: 引入ProofLoom系统，核心机制包括：1) 基于开放证明义务（Open proof obligations）自主构建定义、接口、引理和证明计划；2) 使用签名合同（Signature contracts）记录模型修订的证据和义务；3) 独立法官（Judge）拒绝 unsupported 假设和弱化的结论；4) 规划器（Planner）将公开论证扩展为中间声明；5) 审计器（Audit）检查Lean证明是否遵循规划；6) SOptLib库积累经过验证的数学知识和构建经验，支持后续任务的检索、泛化和复用。
AI.result: 1) 在15个教科书和研究论文任务上，ProofLoom获得人类评分6.3/7和6.4/7，显著优于最强基线（4.9/7和5.0/7）。2) 在33个开发项目中生成490,693行无sorry（完整证明）的局部Lean代码。3) 在22个开发项目中揭示了已发表来源中的28处错误公式、证明漏洞和算法分析不匹配，并附带经过检查的证据。
AI.conclusion: ProofLoom成功实现了一种循环式的构建、积累和重用机制，能够自动、高置信度地完成复杂的研究级数学形式化工作。它不仅提升了形式化验证的效率和质量，还能作为“纠错工具”发现现有学术文献中的潜在错误，证明了自动化智能代理在辅助数学研究和形式化验证方面的巨大潜力。

title: Safe Greenhouse Climate Control Using Lagrangian-Constrained PPO with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Greenhouse climate control balances economic return with maintaining temperature, humidity and CO2 within crop-adapted growth ranges. Conventional reinforcement learning (RL) greenhouse controllers use fixed reward penalties to limit climate constraint violations, yet such heuristic penalties cannot explicitly constrain long-term cumulative violations. Poorly tuned weights either lead to overly conservative policies and lower yields, or fail to suppress persistent climate deviations that harm photosynthesis and induce crop diseases. To address this issue, we formulate greenhouse climate regulation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and use a Lagrangian safe RL framework RCPO-PPO to separate economic optimization and cumulative safety constraints, enabling adaptive penalty adjustment without manual tuning. To handle strong nonlinear, time-varying coupling between greenhouse microclimate and crop growth, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) as policy and value approximators for improved nonlinear representation. Sinusoidal cyclic time features are embedded in observations to capture diurnal environmental periodicity. Simulations use a classic winter lettuce greenhouse model driven by 40-day real weather disturbances. Compared with vanilla penalty-based PPO, our method cuts cumulative climate violations by 18.65% and raises lettuce economic profit by 2.91%, keeping violations stable near the safety threshold. This decoupled CMDP optimization with KAN-based policy representation mitigates long-term climate risks and boosts planting profits, offering a constraint-aware control strategy for precision greenhouse cultivation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）和拉格朗日安全强化学习框架（RCPO-PPO）的温室气候控制方法，结合柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（KANs），有效解决了传统强化学习中因固定奖励惩罚导致的长期累积违规问题，显著降低了气候违规率并提高了生菜经济效益。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习温室控制器使用固定的奖励惩罚来限制气候约束违反，这种启发式惩罚无法显式约束长期的累积违规行为。权重调优不当会导致政策过于保守、产量降低，或无法抑制损害光合作用和引发作物疾病的持续气候偏差。
AI.method: 将温室气候调节建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），采用拉格朗日安全强化学习框架RCPO-PPO以分离经济优化和累积安全性约束，实现无需手动调整的自适应惩罚调整。为解决微气候与作物生长间的强非线性、时变耦合，使用柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（KANs）替代多层感知机（MLPs）作为策略和价值近似器，并将正弦循环时间特征嵌入观测中以捕捉昼夜环境周期性。模拟基于受40天真实天气扰动驱动的经典冬季生菜温室模型。
AI.result: 与基于普通惩罚的PPO相比，该方法将累计气候违规减少了18.65%，将生菜经济利润提高了2.91%，并使违规情况稳定在安全阈值附近。
AI.conclusion: 这种解耦的CMDP优化与基于KAN的策略表示减轻了长期气候风险并提升了种植利润，为精准温室栽培提供了一种具有约束意识的控制策略。

title: Action-Space Shaping for LLM Agents: Measuring and Mitigating Tool-Schema Bias
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on tool-use agentic tasks when given a fixed tool schema. Yet a tool schema is not the action space of an agent; it is merely one interface representation of it. The same executable action can be exposed through many different, functionally equivalent tool definitions, and an agent that has truly learned a task should behave consistently across them. We show that current agents often do not, a phenomenon we term schema bias. To study this systematically, we introduce an executable transformation framework that rewrites a native tool schema using nine operators, including merging and splitting tools, altering how a single tool is expressed, and distributing one action across several dependent calls. The tasks, executable actions, and reachable states remain fixed, so any change in success is attributable to the interface alone. Evaluating eleven LLMs, including two closed models, on up to 32 schema variants, we ask how large schema bias is, how it manifests, whether the difficulty of a schema variant can be predicted without a full evaluation, and whether training removes it. We find that schema bias is substantial even for the newest models: success rates range from complete failure to 97% depending solely on the schema. To reliably estimate schema difficulty, it requires running a small sample of the target queries. Training repairs a schema variant only when that variant appears in the training data.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在工具使用中存在“Schema Bias”现象，即相同的可执行动作因接口定义不同导致模型表现差异巨大。研究通过转换框架评估发现，仅改变Schema表述可使成功率从0%波动至97%。训练数据若包含特定Schema变体才能修复该偏差，且无需完整评估即可预测Schema难度。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明LLM在给定固定工具Schema时表现良好，但Schema仅是智能体动作空间的接口表示之一。真正的能力应体现在面对功能等效但表述不同的工具定义时保持一致性。目前缺乏系统性方法量化这种由接口引发的偏差。
AI.method: 引入可执行变换框架（executable transformation framework），使用合并、拆分、修改表达及分布依赖调用等九种操作符重写原生工具Schema。保持任务、可执行动作和可达状态不变，仅改变接口形式。对11个LLM在最多32种Schema变体上进行评估，分析偏差规模、表现形式、难度预测及训练影响。
AI.result: Schema偏差显著：即便最新模型，仅因Schema不同，成功率可从完全失败到97%。准确估计Schema难度需运行少量目标查询样本。模型仅在训练数据中包含特定Schema变体时，才能修复该变体的性能劣势。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM并未真正泛化掌握工具使用逻辑，而是对特定Schema表示存在过拟合或依赖性（Schema Bias）。要使Agent具备鲁棒性，需解决对接口定义的敏感度，单纯微调可能不足以消除偏差，除非训练覆盖多种等效Schema变体。

title: APEX-Voice: Can Voice Agents Complete Professional Workflows Through Full-Duplex Interaction
summary: Full-duplex voice agents can now listen, speak, use tools, and act during spoken interactions, but fluent dialogue does not guarantee correct completion of delegated professional workflows. We introduce APEX-Voice, a benchmark of 120 interactive professional workflows spanning ten work archetypes such as form completion, corporate negotiation, coordination, consulting, and interviewing. Each workflow executes in a stateful Voice Workbench environment with task-specific knowledge, typed tools, gold-annotated final work artifact, authorization constraints, and a user simulation policy backed by validated, pre-compiled speech realizations. We evaluate both artifact field accuracy and end-to-end workflow success, which requires the correct terminal state, valid process, completed actions, and a valid final artifact. Across five frontier real-time voice agents-GPT-Live-1, Gemini-3.8-Live, Grok-Voice-Think-2.0, Step-Audio3, and GPT-realtime-2.1, none exceeds 25% Pass@1, and the best Reliable@3 is only 10.8%. Moreover, stateful coordination is the dominant failure point across systems, while success decreases further on workflows requiring greater knowledge retrieval and mid-speech corrections. Overall, APEX-Voice is the first benchmark for evaluating whether voice agents can translate conversational competence into dependable professional work.

AI.tldr: APEX-Voice是一个包含120个交互式专业工作流的基准测试，旨在评估全双语音色智能体是否能将对话能力转化为可靠的专业工作能力。测试显示，目前五大前沿模型在专业工作流完成上表现不佳（最高Pass@1未超过25%），主要瓶颈在于状态协调、知识检索和发言中修正。
AI.motivation: 尽管全双语音色智能体具备听、说、用工具和行动的能力，但流畅的对话并不保证能正确完成委托的专业工作流程。需要评估智能体是否具备从“对话能力”到“专业工作可靠性”的转化能力。
AI.method: 引入APEX-Voice基准，涵盖表单填写、企业谈判等10类原型的工作流。在具有任务特定知识、类型化工具和授权约束的状态化Voice Workbench环境中进行评估。评价指标包括工件字段准确性和端到端工作流成功率（要求正确的终端状态、有效流程、已完成动作及有效最终工件）。评估了GPT-Live-1、Gemini-3.8-Live等五个前沿实时语音智能体。
AI.result: 所有测试的前沿语音智能体Pass@1均未超过25%，最佳Reliable@3仅为10.8%。系统主要的失败点是状态协调；随着工作流对知识检索和发言中修正的要求增加，成功率进一步下降。
AI.conclusion: APEX-Voice是首个用于评估语音智能体能否将对话能力转化为可靠专业工作的基准测试，揭示了当前技术在处理复杂、状态依赖的专业工作流时的显著局限性，特别是在状态管理和动态纠错方面。

title: Before Acting, Change the State: Prospective State Intervention for Web Agents under Deceptive Interfaces
summary: LLM-based Web agents can autonomously complete user tasks, yet deceptive interfaces can steer them toward outcomes that conflict with users' interests. Existing defenses primarily intervene on agent behavior through blocking, guidance, or replanning. We identify a distinct failure mode: a task-valid action can still realize an unauthorized consequence because of the current Web state. This motivates treating task-relevant Web state itself as a runtime control target. We introduce Veer, an agent-side runtime defense that leaves task planning to the base agent and intervenes on Web state when a proposed action would produce an unauthorized consequence. Before modifying the live environment, Veer constructs a prospective intervention trajectory toward a safe task-relevant state and executes it with runtime grounding and verification. Across TrickyArena and WebDecept, Veer achieves the highest safe task completion in all three evaluation settings, exceeding the next-best defense by 15.9 and 25.0 percentage points on TrickyArena-Single and TrickyArena-Multi, respectively, while reducing dark-pattern success on WebDecept to 0.3%. These gains persist across dark-pattern types and all 12 agent, model, and benchmark configurations. Ablations show that active state intervention provides the largest gain, while prospective rollout and temporal evidence contribute additional improvements. These results establish task-relevant Web state as an effective runtime control target for protecting Web agents from deceptive outcomes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Veer的基于大语言模型的Web代理运行时防御机制，通过干预“与任务相关的Web状态”而非仅干预行为或规划，来解决欺骗性界面导致的非授权后果问题，显著提升了安全任务完成率和反暗模式能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的防御措施主要通过阻止、引导或重新规划来干预Agent行为，但未能解决“任务有效的动作因当前Web状态导致非授权后果”这一特有的失败模式。因此，需要将与任务相关的Web状态本身作为运行时控制目标。
AI.method: 引入Veer，一种代理侧运行时防御机制。它不改变基础Agent的任务计划，而是在提议的动作可能导致非授权后果时，对Web状态进行干预。具体流程包括：构建通向安全任务相关状态的预期干预轨迹，并通过运行时接地（runtime grounding）和验证执行该轨迹，以修改实时环境。
AI.result:
在TrickyArena和WebDecept基准测试上表现优异：
1. 安全任务完成率在所有评估设置中最高，比次优防御高出15.9个百分点（TrickyArena-Single）和25.0个百分点（TrickyArena-Multi）。
2. WebDecept上的暗模式成功率降至0.3%。
3. 效果在不同暗模式类型及所有12种Agent、模型和基准配置下保持一致。
4. 消融实验表明，主动状态干预带来最大收益，预期 rollout 和时间证据提供额外提升。
AI.conclusion: 将“与任务相关的Web状态”确立为保护Web代理免受欺骗性结果影响的有效运行时控制目标，证明了通过直接干预Web状态来防止非授权后果的可行性与有效性。

title: From One-Shot Generation to Incremental Music Composition: Adapting a General-Purpose Instruction LLM for Persistent Symbolic Editing
summary: Most music-generation systems are still framed and evaluated primarily as producers of complete outputs, whereas composition often proceeds through successive revisions to a shared musical artifact. This paper studies a different use of a general-purpose instruction-following large language model: not as a one-shot music generator, but as a reusable operator over an evolving symbolic score. We formulate incremental composition as a sequence of operation-aware state transitions over persistent ABC notation, with explicit requirements on what each operation may change and what it must preserve. The interaction includes two artifact-initialization variants and three editing operations -- chord addition, inpainting, and transposition. We instantiate the formulation by adapting Llama 3.1 8B Instruct with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on 496,038 operation-aware dialogue records derived from Irish traditional music. The comparison with the unadapted model is used to test the feasibility of learning this interaction contract, not to claim novelty for fine-tuning itself. Across 500 dialogues per model (1,750 attempted output states), checker admission rises from 29.37% to 99.37%, while compliance conditional on admission rises from 0.7205 to 0.9798. Strict eligibility for reference-relative musical-feature analysis increases from 14 to 1,548 outputs, and Longest Common Subsequence analysis does not show a systematic increase in high-overlap sequences relative to held-out baselines under the specified protocol. The results support the technical feasibility of persistent, operation-aware symbolic editing with a general-purpose instruction LLM. They do not establish superior musical quality or human-AI co-creativity, which remain questions for musician-centered evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用通用指令遵循大语言模型（LLM）作为持久化符号乐谱的可重用操作算子，通过增量式、操作感知的状态转换进行音乐创作，而非一次性生成完整作品。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐生成系统多侧重于产出完整作品，但实际作曲过程往往涉及对共享音乐素材的连续修订。旨在探索LLM作为迭代编辑工具在持久化符号乐谱上的可行性。
AI.method:
1. 将增量式作曲形式化为基于ABC记谱法的操作感知状态转移序列，明确定义每次操作的变更范围及需保留的内容。
2. 采用两种初始化和三种编辑操作（和弦添加、修复/修补、移调）。
3. 使用Llama 3.1 8B Instruct模型，结合低秩适配（LoRA）技术在496,038条源自爱尔兰传统音乐的“操作感知”对话记录上进行微调。
4. 通过对比未适配模型，验证模型学习该交互契约的能力。
AI.result:
1. 校验通过率（checker admission）从29.37%提升至99.37%。
2. 在校验通过条件下，合规性从0.7205提升至0.9798。
3. 严格符合条件的参考相对音乐特征分析输出量从14个激增至1,548个。
4. 最长公共子序列分析未显示相较于基线有系统性的高重叠度增加。
AI.conclusion: 证明了使用通用指令LLM进行持久化、操作感知的符号编辑在技术上是可行的。但该研究未证明其音乐质量优于人类或具备更优的人机共创能力，这些问题仍需以音乐家为中心进行评估。

title: Automated feature engineering, AutoML, and decision-focused learning for improved energy consumption forecasting
comment: PhD thesis, School of Computer Science, University of Nottingha, United Kingdom
summary: The rising cost and demand for energy, together with environmental sustainability goals, create major challenges for energy management. Energy Consumption Forecasting (ECF) supports planning by predicting future consumption, but Machine Learning (ML) models for ECF often depend on expert-driven Feature Engineering (FE). This thesis addresses that dependence through three contributions. First, it establishes and evaluates a comprehensive FE pipeline for ECF and investigates domain-specific features. Second, it introduces AutoEnergy, a domain-tailored automated FE algorithm that generates interpretable features from timestamps and lagged consumption and integrates with AutoML for end-to-end ECF modelling. Across eighteen real-world energy datasets spanning residential, commercial, industrial, renewable, and grid domains, AutoEnergy reduces forecasting error by 19.52%-84.72% relative to baseline AutoML and established automated FE methods, while running 1.31-4.41 times faster, with gains varying by dataset. Third, AutoEnergy is integrated with Decision-Focused Learning (DFL) for a Battery Energy Storage System problem, jointly forecasting electricity prices and demand while optimising charging and discharging decisions. On a real-world UK property dataset, this approach reduces operating costs by 22.9%-56.5% compared with the same DFL models without automated FE. Overall, the results show that domain-specific automated FE can reduce reliance on manual feature design, improve forecasting accuracy, and translate predictive gains into measurable operational benefits in energy management.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化特征工程算法AutoEnergy，通过生成可解释特征并结合AutoML和决策导向学习，显著降低能耗预测误差并优化电池储能系统运营成本。
AI.motivation: 解决能源管理中因能耗预测对专家驱动的特征工程依赖性强而导致的效率低下问题，应对能源成本上升及可持续性挑战。
AI.method: 1. 建立全面能耗特征工程管道；2. 开发AutoEnergy算法，从时间戳和滞后消费数据自动生成可解释特征并与AutoML集成；3. 将AutoEnergy与决策导向学习结合用于电池储能系统优化。
AI.result: 在18个真实数据集上，AutoEnergy比基线AutoML误差降低19.52%-84.72%，速度提升1.31-4.41倍；在电池储能应用中，运营成本低22.9%-56.5%。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的自动化特征工程能有效减少手动设计依赖，提高预测精度并将预测优势转化为实际运营效益。

title: TermJudge: A Document-Level Metric Judging, Not Counting, Terminology in Machine Translation Evaluation
summary: Existing automatic metrics for evaluating terminological use in machine translation (MT) penalise any divergence from a fixed reference, conflating translation errors with the valid terminological variation that human translators routinely produce. We introduce TermJudge, a document-level terminology metric that assigns an interpretable verdict to every term occurrence: glossary-conforming occurrences are settled deterministically, while divergences are assessed under a two-step LLM-as-judge procedure using the full document context: the first detects and labels terminology errors; the second sorts valid document-level variations from inconsistencies. Validated against expert error annotations and document-level human MQM scores, TermJudge ranks first in both system- and segment-level meta-evaluation, ahead of glossary-conformity and quality-estimation baselines. When applied to eight systems translating academic documents, under two prompting conditions, we observe that glossary injection improves terminology translation in all paired comparisons, by removing genuine errors rather than valid variation. TermJudge is released as open-source code.

AI.tldr: 提出TermJudge，一种基于文档级的术语翻译评估指标。通过“LLM-as-judge”两步流程区分真正的术语错误与合法变化，在系统级和段级评估中超越现有基线，证明词汇注入能有效提升术语翻译质量并开源代码。
AI.motivation: 现有自动指标惩罚任何偏离固定参考的翻译，将人类译者产生的合法术语变异与真正的翻译错误混淆，导致评估不准确。
AI.method: 引入TermJudge：对于符合词表的术语采用确定性判定；对于偏离项，利用完整文档上下文进行两步LLM评判：第一步检测和标记术语错误，第二步区分合法的文档级变异与不一致性。
AI.result: 经专家错误标注和MQM分数验证，TermJudge在系统级和段级元评估中均排名第一，优于合规性和质量估计基线。应用显示，术语注入通过在消除真正错误（而非合法变异）方面显著提升术语翻译准确率。
AI.conclusion: TermJudge提供了一种更精细、可解释的术语评估机制，揭示了词汇注入对术语质量的实际贡献，其开源代码有助于推动机器翻译术语评估的标准化。

title: Environmental requirements for the use of social information by artificial life agents using evolved plastic artificial neural networks
summary: Evolved Plastic Artificial Neural Networks (EPANNs) consist of two principal processes, the first, evolution, and the second, development and in-life learning. In the context of the origins of social = learning, very few studies have been carried out using ALIFE models based on EPANN requirements. Studies in this field have usually involved an imitative teacher/pupil relationship. This, however, ignores the possibility that the observed behaviour is a consequence of social information cues rather than direct imitation or teaching. Starting with the first of the EPANN processes (evolution), a series of experiments was undertaken using artificial neural network (ANN) based agents in a variety of foraging environments to examine under what minimal environmental conditions the use of social information might have evolved, as measured by the number of generations taken to meet a specified fitness criterion. NEAT (Neuroevolution of Augmenting Topologies) was the ANN used as its evolutionary algorithm would evolve a network's topology as well its weights. Unintentionally, in the experiment there was a simple network topology based on the location of the nearest food item which enabled agents to swiftly meet the fitness criterion. With this topology, additional information, social or otherwise, was not required and could have proved to be a hindrance. However, this does indicate that for the use of social information to have evolved, it would require a greater degree of complexity in the environment to do so.

AI.tldr: 通过基于EPANN的实验研究发现，在简单的觅食环境中，由于存在无需社会信息即可快速达成适应度的简单网络拓扑，导致社会信息的演化未能被触发；只有当环境复杂性增加时，使用社会信息的性状才可能演化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于人工生命（ALIFE）模型关于社会学习起源的研究多局限于模仿式的师徒关系，忽视了社会信息线索而非直接模仿的作用。本研究旨在填补这一空白，考察在什么最小环境条件下使用社会信息的习性会演化出来。
AI.method: 以进化为起点，利用基于神经网络的智能体（使用NEAT算法进化拓扑和权重）在不同的觅食环境中进行一系列实验，测量达到特定适应度标准所需的世代数以评估社会信息的演化条件。
AI.result: 实验中意外发现了一种仅基于最近食物位置简单拓扑的网络结构，使智能体能迅速满足适应度标准。在这种简单环境下，额外信息（包括社会信息）并非必需甚至可能成为阻碍，因此未观察到社会信息的演化。
AI.conclusion: 要使“使用社会信息”这一特性在演化中产生，必须存在更高复杂度的环境压力或条件；在过于简单的环境中，个体可通过更基本的机制解决生存问题，从而抑制了社会信息处理能力的演化。

title: AutoDataBench: Can Agents Write the Data That Feeds the Self-Improvement Loop?
summary: Recent gains in language model capability have come more from data than from architecture. Frontier labs and data companies produce verifiable agentic tasks, which supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning then turn into capability.This production line still rests on human labour and on human-in-the-loop collaboration. Automating task creation would let data production scale with compute rather than with expert headcount, would extend to more domains, and would enable a key step in recursive self-improvement (RSI). Current evaluations of an agent's ability to write such tasks measure how a model performs after training on what the agent produced. That does not match common practice in the data industry, where data is delivered sample by sample and each sample is accepted against a set of criteria rather than put straight into training. No existing evaluation asks whether an individual task meets the acceptance criteria of a data pipeline. We therefore introduce AutoDataBench. Given an original benchmark task and a record of the target model attempting it, an agent must write a new task for the same suite that meets practical acceptance standards on validity, novelty, difficulty and behavioural coverage. Across three benchmarks of executable agent tasks, no agent we evaluate scores above 20 out of 100 at the default time budget of 45 minutes. Giving the strongest agent four times as long improves its score substantially, while the cost of one usable task stays almost unchanged. Current agents can write training tasks of the required quality, but not efficiently. AutoDataBench provides a direct measure of an agent's capacity for autonomous data synthesis: one artifact at a time, judged against the criteria a production pipeline would apply, and without a training run. Code and data are available at https://github.com/StarDewXXX/AutoDataBench.

AI.tldr: 针对当前Agent数据合成评估缺乏直接质量衡量标准的问题，提出AutoDataBench。该基准要求Agent在无需训练的情况下，独立写出符合有效性、新颖性、难度和行为覆盖标准的任务。实验显示现有Agent虽能产出合格任务但效率极低，暗示可通过增加时间预算提升自动化程度以支持递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型能力的提升高度依赖数据生产，而现有的数据生产流水线仍依赖人工劳动和人机协作。为了实现自动化任务创建，使数据生产能力与算力而非专家人力挂钩，并支持递归自我改进（RSI），需要一种评估Agent能否独立生成高质量任务的能力。然而，现有评估往往关注模型在训练后的表现，而非直接评估单个任务是否符合工业界“逐样本次”的验收标准。
AI.method: 引入AutoDataBench评估基准。给定原始基准任务和目标模型的尝试记录，要求Agent为同一套件编写新任务。评估核心在于判断生成的单个任务是否满足数据流水线的实际验收标准，包括四个维度：有效性（Validity）、新颖性（Novelty）、难度（Difficulty）和行为覆盖（Behavioral Coverage）。该过程不涉及训练循环，仅对单一产物进行质量判定。
AI.result: 在三个可执行Agent任务的基准上测试发现，在最严格的45分钟时间预算下，没有任何被评估的Agent得分超过20/100。然而，当给予最强Agent四倍的时间预算时，其得分显著提升，且每个可用任务的平均成本几乎保持不变。这表明Current agents有能力写出符合要求的高质量训练任务，但在效率上存在巨大瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: AutoDataBench提供了一种直接衡量Agent自主数据合成能力的指标，即在不经过训练的情况下，按生产管线标准逐样本评判。研究证实了通过延长生成时间可以有效提高Agent生成数据的合格率，为实现从依赖人工转向依赖算力的自动化数据生产提供了实证基础，尽管当前效率仍有待大幅优化。

title: WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents
summary: We present WebPageBench, an open framework for evaluating web agents in which every task is verified from the interface's own event log. Six instrumented mock sites with brand identifiers removed (a marketplace, a bookstore, a grocery service, rail ticketing, hotel search and a document cabinet) emit typed events with parameters as a user or an agent acts. A task declares the events it requires, and success is decided by matching them, with no judge model and no scraping of rendered pages. The same instrumentation supports controlled UI variation: one configuration switch re-renders a task through a different implementation of a single control while the prompt and the success conditions stay completely identical, so sensitivity to interface form can be measured under a fixed task specification. The WebPageBench release consists of three components: 152 tasks, divided into 65 canonical scenarios and 87 control variants across light/dark UI-modes; a common runner evaluated with six browser/DOM harness configurations and five screenshot-only GUI-agent families; and a public leaderboard of 24 model-harness pairs. On the public 152-task leaderboard the gap between what agents declare finished and what the log confirms reaches 41 points (one configuration declares every task finished and satisfies the conditions on 59%).

AI.tldr: WebPageBench是一个基于事件日志验证的开源Web代理评估框架，通过消除界面干扰和依赖模型判断，实现了对6个场景下152项任务的精准基准测试，揭示了当前代理在任务完成声明与实际执行结果之间存在的巨大偏差（最高达41点）。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有Web代理评估中依赖人工标注、渲染页面抓取或判决模型（Judge Model）所带来的主观性、不可控性及环境差异问题，建立一个自动化、标准化且能敏感捕捉界面变化影响的基准测试平台。
AI.method: 构建六个去除品牌标识的模拟网站（市场、书店等），利用仪器化的事件日志进行任务验证；通过配置开关实现同一控制的不同UI变体（如明暗模式），确保提示词和成功条件一致从而测量界面敏感性；包含152个任务、通用运行器及公开排行榜，使用六种浏览器/DOM harness和五种截图型GUI代理家族进行评估。
AI.result: 建立了包含152个任务、65个标准场景和87个控制变体的数据集；开发了统一运行器和涵盖6种配置/5类代理的评价体系；发布包含24个模型-harness对的公共排行榜；发现代理声称完成任务与实际日志确认之间存在显著差距，最高可达41分，其中某配置声称全部完成但仅59%满足实际条件。
AI.conclusion: WebPageBench提供了一种无需判决模型即可客观验证Web代理行为的评估范式，有效量化了代理对界面形式的敏感性，并揭示了当前状态-of-the-art代理在任务完成判定上的不可靠性，强调了使用底层事件日志而非前端渲染进行性能评估的重要性。

title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
summary: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.

AI.tldr: 提出JRDB-AVR基准和代理，通过主动证据获取评估具身视觉推理，揭示当前VLM存在“无依据正确回答”现象。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉推理基准多评估被动观察，缺乏对需要主动搜索、跨时间/视角获取证据的场景评估；模型可能给出看似合理但缺乏实际观测支持的错误答案。
AI.method: 基于真实JRDB机器人数据构建JRDB-AVR基准，包含时间序列搜索、视角选择和组合推理问题；引入JRDB-AVR-Agent，采用基于图的显式世界模型进行主动观察请求与求解推理。
AI.result: 实验显示当前基线模型在答案准确率和证据准确率间存在巨大差距，证明VLM可生成无支持的正确回答，突显主动证据感知评估的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 具身视觉推理需重视主动证据获取与 grounding 评估，JRDB-AVR为该领域提供新标准和方法。

title: Persona Following Is Not Selective Control: The Neutrality Gap in LLM User Simulation
summary: Persona prompting is widely used to construct user simulations with large language models (LLMs), yet it relies on a largely untested assumption: specifying one user attribute should change that attribute alone. We test this assumption and identify a systematic failure of selective control: across all eight black-box LLMs we audit, changing a target attribute also shifts responses on unspecified, non-target attributes. For example, describing a user as more risk-seeking shifts color choices, even though the prompt never mentions color; we term this cross-attribute influence. Semantic, contextual, and internal analyses collectively suggest that models treat a persona prompt as evidence about the user and extend the inferred profile to unspecified preferences, a process we call trait-conditioned completion. We next ask whether explicitly specifying non-target attributes restores selective control. When a non-target attribute is assigned a clear direction, models generally follow the declaration and suppress the target attribute's influence. However, when the same attribute is declared neutral, the target continues to affect choices across all five open-weight checkpoints, even when the model correctly reports the declared state. This disparity, the neutrality gap, demonstrates that successful persona following does not imply selective persona control, which additionally requires keeping non-target attributes stable. We operationalize this distinction with a three-state diagnostic that leaves the non-target attribute unspecified or declares it directional or neutral; because directional tests can be passed by simply following the stated persona, the neutral state reveals failures they miss. In a post hoc analysis of independent items, neutral declarations leave 51-81% of items target-sensitive, against at most 1 of 320 item-pole comparisons under directional ones.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了大语言模型（LLM）在人设提示中存在的“选择性控制失败”问题：修改目标属性会意外影响未指定的非目标属性。这种“跨属性影响”源于模型将人设视为用户画像证据并扩展推断。研究发现，显式指定非目标属性为“方向性”可恢复控制，但指定为“中性”时仍受目标属性干扰（“中性差距”）。为此提出三状态诊断测试，证明遵循人设不等于具备选择性控制能力，且中性声明下多数项目仍对目标敏感。
AI.motivation: 验证人设提示构建用户模拟时的基本假设，即“指定一个用户属性应仅改变该属性”，以及是否存在系统性失效。
AI.method: 审计八种黑盒LLM及五个开源权重的检查点；通过语义、上下文和内部分析探究机制；设计三状态诊断法（非目标属性未指定、方向性指定、中性指定）进行实验对比。
AI.result: 1. 所有测试模型均存在跨属性影响（选择性控制失败），如风险偏好变化会影响颜色选择；2. “中性差距”现象：当非目标属性被声明为中性时，目标属性仍显著影响决策（51-81%的项目敏感），而方向性声明能抑制此影响；3. 方向性测试可能掩盖控制失败，仅中性状态能有效揭示该缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 成功的人设跟随并不等同于具有选择性人设控制能力，后者要求保持非目标属性稳定。模型通过“特质条件补全”机制扩展人设推断，当前方法无法保证非目标属性的稳定性，需采用三状态诊断更准确评估模型的实际控制能力。

title: What Drives Citations in Production Large Language Models? An Observational Multi-Method Study of Two Million AI Citations Across Ten Thousand Web Pages
summary: Production large language models retrieve and cite web pages alongside generated answers, yet the page-level features that predict citation frequency remain poorly characterised. We present an observational study of approximately 2 million LLM citations from four commercial engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini) over six months, joined to 10,000 crawled pages from nineteen B2B SaaS workspaces. Sixty-plus features are tested using a nine-method consensus framework combining mixed-effects regression with domain fixed effects, FDR correction, stability-selection Lasso, double machine learning, generalised additive models, and temporal hold-out replication. Four findings survive all checks. First, prompt-content alignment (Jaccard overlap between page tokens and the full workspace prompt corpus, including non-citing prompts) is the dominant page-level predictor (beta = +0.37, 95% CI [+0.33, +0.41], q ~ 10^-73). Second, the standard AEO checklist (FAQ blocks, structured data, Core Web Vitals) shows positive effects in pooled data that reverse or collapse to zero once domain fixed effects are applied: Simpson's paradox with practical consequences for the AEO literature. Third, domain-level AI authority exceeds the strongest non-alignment page-level feature by a factor of six in mean absolute SHAP value. We release the analytic pipeline as a methodological contribution.

AI.tldr: 基于200万LLM引用数据的研究发现：提示词-内容对齐度是预测引用频率的最强特征；传统AEO清单在控制域名效应后失效（辛普森悖论）；域名级AI权威性远超其他页面特征。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在生成答案时会检索并引用网页，但能够预测引用频率的页面级特征尚未得到充分刻画和验证。
AI.method: 对ChatGPT、Claude、Google AI和Gemini四个商业引擎六个月内约200万次LLM引用进行观察性研究，结合19个B2B SaaS工作空间的1万个爬取页面。采用混合效应回归、FDR校正、稳定性选择Lasso、双重机器学习、广义加性模型和时间保持外部分验证组成的九方法共识框架，测试60多个特征。
AI.result: 四项发现通过所有检验：1) 提示词-内容对齐度（Jaccard重叠）是最强的页面级预测因子；2) 标准AEO清单（FAQ、结构化数据等）在合并数据中呈正效应，但在应用域名固定效应后反转或归零，揭示辛普森悖论；3) 域名级AI权威性的平均绝对SHAP值是第二强非对齐页面特征的6倍。
AI.conclusion: 明确区分页面级特征与域名级权威性的影响至关重要，揭示了现有AEO文献中因忽略层级结构而导致的统计偏差，并发布分析方法管道作为方法论贡献。

title: When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents
summary: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“形成一致调度（FCD）”机制，旨在解决工具代理在接口可见性变化时产生的“模式时代漂移（schema-epoch drift）”安全问题。通过连接实现分析与执行权限，确保调用在其整个生命周期内严格遵循最初的安全契约，从而防止因部署延迟或版本更替导致的未授权效果暴露或行为偏差。
AI.motivation: 标准调度机制忽略了描述符与处理器之间的关系，导致即使调用本身未改变且符合架构规范，其在实际部署、重连或延迟审批过程中也可能获得不同的安全效应。这种由环境变化引起的安全属性不一致被称为“模式时代漂移”。
AI.method: 提出了形成一致调度（FCD）框架：1. 审查配置文件以生成源自官方源码的、具有溯源限制的声明范围内效应的保守估计；2. 在封闭目标批准策略下，验证器将每次形成的调用映射到摘要，仅当后继状态的效应符合调用的安全契约时才捕获该后继状态；3. 采用原子准入和最终跳跃围栏技术，确保决策被保留至效果层；4. 确立准确源码的优先权，并被捕获的后继状态仅在源码退役后才具资格。
AI.result: 1. FCD在涵盖32个官方版本的四个配置文件中表现出高稳定性：29个无需发行版特定更改，3个进行升级；2. 冻结的16发行版扩展匹配了独立的源码预言机；3. 在预注册的股票对比中，FCD成功完成了3个效应保持私密的待处理调用，并阻止了3个被公开遗漏的调用；4. 相比之下，精确固定和全发行版拒绝虽然阻止了所有调用，但全发行版批准虽完成了所有调用却产生了三个公开效应；5. 独立的生命周期实验显示，形成捕获的证书可跨越源码退役期，并在后续控制新形成而不扩大待处理调用的权限。
AI.conclusion: FCD有效解决了工具代理中的安全效应漂移问题，通过严格的验证和状态锁定机制，确保了从调用形成到执行的完整安全一致性，既允许必要的私有操作，又有效阻断潜在的安全违规，比现有的固定或全局审批策略更具灵活性和安全性。

title: Can Generative AI Automate Data Extraction for Meta-Analysis? A Case Study on Intercropping Research
summary: Meta-analysis is the synthesis of information from multiple sources to arrive at an overarching conclusion. There is a large need for meta-analysis in agricultural research to synthesize what is known and analyze overarching patterns. Extracting data from published literature is, however, labor-intensive, time-consuming, and tedious, and is impeded by a lack of standardization in research design, units of measurement, and terminology. These challenges are particularly evident in the domain of crop species mixtures, also called intercropping. With the growing capabilities of LLMs, many recent attempts have focused on building systems and tools to automate data collection, yet rigorous assessment against human-labeled ground truth is often missing. In this research, we evaluate three LLM-based approaches---direct zero-shot prompting, a staged workflow, and a multi-agent system---with six open-weight models to extract data from the intercropping literature. The results are evaluated against the manually curated ground truth and through a downstream statistical analysis. Overall, direct zero-shot prompting is the strongest and most consistent approach, achieving the highest mean similarity-adjusted F1 of 0.577, although none of the approaches is close to fully accurate. In the downstream analysis, most model--approach combinations recover the direction of the relationship between the predictor and outcome variables, but do not estimate its magnitude accurately.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法，用于从作物间作文献中提取数据。研究发现，直接零样本提示（Direct Zero-shot Prompting）效果最佳，但整体准确率仍有限，下游统计分析仅能恢复变量关系的方向，无法准确估计其幅度。
AI.motivation: 农业研究中Meta分析至关重要，但手动提取数据耗时、费力且受限于缺乏标准化。随着LLM的发展，自动化数据收集成为趋势，但缺乏对人工标注真实值（Ground Truth）的严格评估。旨在解决作物间作领域数据提取的难题并系统评估现有LLM方案的有效性。
AI.method: 研究评估了三种基于LLM的数据提取方法：直接零样本提示（Direct zero-shot prompting）、分层工作流（Staged workflow）和多智能体系统（Multi-agent system），并结合六个开源权重的模型进行实验。通过对比人工策展的真实数据进行评估，并进行了下游统计分析以验证提取数据的可用性。
AI.result: 1. 直接零样本提示是表现最强且最一致的方法，达到最高的均值相似性调整F1分数为0.577。2. 没有任何方法接近完全准确。3. 在下游分析中，大多数“模型-方法”组合能够恢复预测变量与结果变量之间关系的方向，但在估计其幅度方面不准确。
AI.conclusion: 虽然LLM在自动化农业文献数据提取方面展现出一定潜力，特别是在识别关系方向上，但目前的技术尚不足以替代人工完成高精度的Meta分析数据提取工作，仍需进一步提升准确性。

title: DoAtlas-2: A Foundation for Self-Evolving Causal Biomedical Discovery
comment: Technical report. 185 pages, 5 figures. Yulong Li, Rong Xia and Yuxuan Zhang contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Eran Segal, Imran Razzak
summary: We introduce DoAtlas-2, a foundation for self-evolving causal biomedical discovery that organizes knowledge around causal mechanisms and advances through external evidence from human populations. DoAtlas-2 integrates 771 research resources covering more than 720,000 participants in 48 countries, from longitudinal clinical phenotypes, medical imaging, and continuous physiological signals to eight molecular layers, together with an evidence network of approximately 4.7 million literature-derived records over 93,566 concepts and 149,383 candidate causal relations. DoAtlas-2 autonomously formulates research questions from evidence gaps and unresolved mechanisms, prespecifies their causal designs, and generates validated analyses. Supporting, challenging, and unresolved results continuously revise mechanistic interpretations, the causal evidence state, and the discovery frontier, so that DoAtlas-2 self-evolves within a closed loop of hypothesis generation, empirical testing, and renewed discovery. DoAtlas-2 has systematically evaluated 2,031 research questions. In the Human Phenotype Project (HPP), it formulated 4,014 candidate pathway questions across vascular, early-glycemic, and hepatic-metabolic systems, and screening of the first 1,079 yielded statistical support for 756. Representative studies identify blood pressure as a convergence node linking adiposity, hepatic, and lipid phenotypes to vascular outcomes, and show that an adiposity-inflammation-blood-pressure pathway is largely attenuated by joint adjustment for body mass index (BMI) and smoking. The discovered vascular network constitutes a completely interpretable predictive foundation, admitting exact attribution of every prediction and closed-form mediation effects. DoAtlas-2 thereby unifies causal mechanism discovery, population-evidence testing, and interpretable prediction within one continuously evolving foundation.

AI.tldr: DoAtlas-2是一个自我进化的因果生物医学发现基础模型，整合了771个研究资源、超过72万参与者和470万文献记录，通过“假设生成-实证检验-新发现”的闭环实现自动推进。该系统已评估2,031个研究问题，在人类表型项目中发现血压是连接肥胖、肝脏及脂质表型与血管结果的关键枢纽，并构建了可解释的预测基础。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决生物医学研究中知识组织碎片化、因果机制不明确以及缺乏系统性证据验证的问题，需要一种能够整合多维度数据（从临床表型到分子层面）并自主推进科学发现的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建集成大规模多模态数据（纵向临床表型、医学影像、生理信号及八层分子数据）和海量文献证据网络的基础设施；通过算法自动识别证据空白以生成研究问题和因果设计；执行自动化分析以验证假设；利用支持、反驳或未决的结果不断修正机制解释，形成自我进化闭环。
AI.result: 1. 成功整合了覆盖48个国家72万+参与者的771个研究资源和约470万条文献记录。2. 系统评估了2,031个研究问题。3. 在人类表型项目中生成4,014个候选通路问题，其中1,079个初步筛选中有756个获得统计支持。4. 确认血压为连接脂肪量、肝脏及脂质表型与血管结果的关键节点，且该路径部分由BMI和吸烟调节。5. 建立了具有完全可解释性的预测基础，支持精确归因和封闭形式中介效应计算。
AI.conclusion: DoAtlas-2成功实现了因果机制发现、人群证据测试和可解释预测的统一，并通过自我进化机制推动了生物医学研究的自动化和系统化，为理解复杂疾病机理提供了强有力的工具。

title: Using Context Is Not Enough: Test-Time Training for Personalized Reward Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) aligns large language models (LLMs) with human preferences, yet most pipelines learn a single reward model that overlooks individual differences in preferences. Personalized reward models (PRMs) address this by conditioning rewards on user-specific feedback, most commonly through in-context learning (ICL), where a user's historical comparisons are supplied as contextual preference pairs. However, we identify a key limitation of ICL-based PRMs: they fail to capture the preference relations conveyed by contextual pairs. To address this, we propose Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training (P-TTT), which explicitly encodes these relations into user-specific fast weights for personalized reward prediction. P-TTT introduces sequence-level update and apply operations to match the response-level granularity of preference feedback, together with a preference-aligned objective that directly uses pairwise preference relations to guide fast-weight adaptation. Notably, P-TTT is simple to implement and computationally efficient, updating fast weights within a single forward pass without inference-time backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that P-TTT more effectively captures historical preference relations and outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 提出P-TTT方法，通过显式编码上下文偏好关系到用户特定快速权重中，解决基于ICL的个人化奖励模型忽略偏好关系的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于上下文的个性化奖励模型（PRMs）未能捕捉上下文配对所传达的偏好关系。
AI.method: 提出Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training (P-TTT)，引入序列级更新和应用操作以匹配响应粒度的偏好反馈，并利用直接指导快速权重适应的成对偏好关系作为目标函数。
AI.result: 实验表明P-TTT更有效地捕捉历史偏好关系，且在性能上大幅超越最先进的方法，同时实现简单且计算高效（单次前向传播无需推理时反向传播）。
AI.conclusion: P-TTT通过测试时训练机制显著提升个性化奖励模型的偏好捕捉能力和整体性能。

title: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge
summary: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement.
